Abstract: Search-augmented language agents should retrieve external information only when necessary and ground their answers in retrieved evidence. Existing external rewards provide either sparse outcome supervision or richer feedback from process annotations and LLM judges. Outcome rewards scale readily but cannot distinguish grounded retrieval from redundant search, whereas richer signals require costly annotation or inference during training. Internal rewards based on policy-side signals such as entropy, likelihood, or information gain are graded and inexpensive to evaluate, yet mainly reflect model confidence rather than evidence grounding. We propose Search-G1, a representation-based intrinsic reward framework that measures the operational grounding of an agent's answers through two intervention-calibrated readouts. A prompt-state readout predicts closed-book sufficiency, whose complement defines policy-relative retrieval necessity; an answer-commit readout estimates evidence reliance from answer-stage sensitivity to evidence deletion. Together, they provide additional credit to correct searched trajectories when retrieval is estimated necessary and the answer is evidence-sensitive, favor correct direct answers when closed-book knowledge suffices, and penalize repeated search. After calibration, reward scoring requires neither process annotations nor LLM-as-judge inference during policy optimization. Because reinforcement learning changes policy representations, Search-G1 periodically refits both readouts on trajectories from the latest checkpoint, allowing the reward to co-evolve with the policy. Experiments across multiple search-based question-answering benchmarks and two model scales show that Search-G1 improves the grounding--search-cost trade-off, producing shorter response-side trajectories at competitive task accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/Rosy0912/Search-G1.

</details>


### [269] [Scaling Inherently Interpretable Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07594)
*Guide Labs Team,Andreas Madsen,Aya Abdelsalam Ismail,Giang Nguyen,Isaac Plant,Muawiz Chaudhary,Nathaniel Monson,Saqib Azim,Zhichen Guo,Julius Adebayo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文挑战"可解释性是能力的代价"这一前提，提出将可解释性作为训练管线的约束条件，与语言建模目标共同优化。在三个数量级的计算规模上，覆盖自回归和扩散语言模型，可解释性与能力同步提升而非相互拮抗。作者以此训练出Steerling-8B扩散语言模型，其能够对生成token进行输入归因、概念归因和数据归因，实现闭环干预（诊断-检索-纠正），且在仅消耗同级别模型1/16至1/2计算量的情况下保持竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统可解释性方法是在模型训练完成后进行事后逆向工程，其可靠性难以验证，且被视为对能力的额外负担。作者希望挑战这一范式，探索能否将可解释性直接设计进训练过程，使其成为模型的内禀属性而非事后附加品。

Method: 将可解释性作为训练目标中的约束条件与语言建模损失联合优化；构建Steerling-8B扩散语言模型，采用因果注意力掩码，并设计三层次归因能力：token级输入归因、人类可理解的概念归因以及训练数据归因。这些归因支持闭环干预流程：诊断输出→检索相似训练数据→通过概念引导修正行为，无需重训。

Result: 在三个数量级的计算规模实验中发现模型表征随规模增大变得更加解耦（disentangled）且与人类可理解概念对齐。Steerling-8B在消耗2-16倍更少计算量的情况下仍能与公开同级模型竞争，表明可解释性不损害能力，且新扩展范式可行。

Conclusion: 可解释性可以设计进训练流程而非事后补救，且随模型规模扩大而改善。这提出了一个新的缩放范式：可解释性与能力共同演进，为语言模型的透明性和可控性开辟了新路径。

Abstract: Interpretability is often treated as a tax on capability: language models are trained as opaque systems, then explained after the fact, with methods whose reliability is difficult to establish. In this work, we challenge this premise. Rather than reverse-engineering a model, we make interpretability a constraint of the training pipeline, optimized alongside the language modeling objective. Across three orders of magnitude of compute, on both autoregressive and diffusion language models, interpretability scales with capability rather than against it. Surprisingly, model representations become more disentangled and aligned with human-understandable concepts with scale.
  We instantiate the training-time recipe with Steerling-8B, a diffusion language model with a causal attention mask. For any group of generated tokens, Steerling-8B attributes the output to relevant input tokens, human-understandable concepts, and training data. This enables closed-loop intervention: diagnose an output through its concept or feature attribution, retrieve similar training data, and correct the behavior through concept steering without retraining. Steerling-8B remains competitive with open peer models trained on substantially 2-16x more compute, suggesting a different scaling paradigm: interpretability can be designed into training, and it improves with scale.

</details>


### [270] [Embedding Initialization for Unseen Low-resource Languages in Multilingual NMT: A Case Study on Limbum-English Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07629)
*Samiratu Ntohsi,Neza David Tuyishimire,Anesu Kafesu,Marvin Ogore,Samuel Oluwajunwonlo Babalola,Oche Ankeli*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种针对NLLB-200等多语言机器翻译模型中未覆盖语言的语言token嵌入初始化策略，即用多个类型学相关语言嵌入的平均值作为新语言的token嵌入。在Limbum-英语翻译任务上，该方法（chrF2++=46.7）与最佳单语言代理token（Swahili，47.3）性能相当，且远优于零样本（12.5）和从零训练（14.5）基线。然而所有系统都无法保留声调变音符号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NLLB-200覆盖200种语言，但仍有数千种语言（特别是喀麦隆的Grassfields Bantu语言）不受支持。微调这些模型处理未见语言时，从业者必须选择代理语言token，但目前缺乏系统性的选择方法。

Method: 将来自模型中多个类型学相关语言的嵌入取平均值，作为新语言token的初始化嵌入。在8,837句对的Limbum-英语平行语料（圣经文本+双语词典）上评估，比较四种模型：NLLB-200零样本、从零训练的Transformer、NLLB-200用Swahili代理token微调、NLLB-200用平均嵌入初始化微调。

Result: 多语言平均嵌入初始化（46.7）与最佳单语言代理Swahili（47.3）性能相当。两种NLLB-200微调变体都比从零训练基线高出32个以上chrF2++点。但所有系统均未能保留声调变音符号。

Conclusion: 多语言迁移是极低资源Bantu翻译中的主导因素，同时消除了启发式代理token选择的必要性。但声调变音符号的保留仍是开放挑战。作者公开了数据集和代码以供进一步研究。

Abstract: Multilingual neural machine translation models such as NLLB-200 cover 200 languages but leave thousands unsupported, including most Grassfields Bantu languages of Cameroon. When fine-tuning these models for an unseen language, practitioners must choose a proxy language token, yet no principled method exists for this selection. We implemented an embedding initialization strategy where a language token is the average of embeddings from multiple typologically related languages already in the mod el. We evaluate this approach on Limbum-to-English translation using a parallel corpus of 8,837 sentence pairs from New Testament text and a bilingual dictionary. We compare models: NLLB-200 zero-shot (chrF2++ = 12.5), a Transformer trained from scratch (chrF2++ = 14.5), NLLB-200 fine-tuned with a Swahili proxy token (chrF2++ = 47.3), and NLLB-200 with our averaged embedding initialization (chrF2++ = 46.7). We find that the multi-language initialization achieves performance comparable to the best single-language proxy. Both NLLB-200 variants improve over the from-scratch baseline by over 32 chrF2++ points. These results show that multilingual transfer is the dominant factor in extremely low-resource Bantu translation while eliminating the need for heuristic proxy selection. However, all systems fail to preserve tonal diacritics, highlighting an open challenge. We make our dataset and code available to support further research.

</details>


### [271] [SurveyReview: A Reviewer-Aligned Benchmark for Survey Evaluators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07641)
*Yuheng Zhang,Yuanchun Wang,Fanjin Zhang,Ruyu Zhao,Juanzi Li,Jie Tang,Jing Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SurveyReview，一个与评审者对齐的多维基准数据集，用于评估LLM作为论文评审器的质量；同时提出SurveyAlign强基线模型，通过微调Qwen3-32B显著提升与人类评审者的一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM使综述写作自动化，可靠的评估成为瓶颈。现有LLM-as-a-judge方法缺乏与人类评审者的系统对齐，且缺少量化对齐程度的系统框架。

Method: 构建包含675篇综述论文和1630份评审报告的数据集，将自由格式评论转换为四个维度评分（可读性、批判性、全面性、结构）；提出SurveyAlign基线评估器，使用LoRA微调Qwen3-32B并结合外部知识增强。

Result: 在测试集上，SurveyAlign相比GPT-5.2的提示式评判显著提升评审对齐度，平均MSE从2.28降至1.38，MAE从1.15降至0.69。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了首个多维、与评审者对齐的综述评审数据集及可复现评估框架，并提供了强基线评估器，为未来研究提供竞争性参照。

Abstract: The rapid advancement of large language models has transformed survey writing from a months-long manual effort into an automated process. As generation scales, reliable evaluation becomes the bottleneck, and LLMs are increasingly used as survey evaluators. However, existing approaches largely rely on off-the-shelf LLM-as-a-judge methods without systematic alignment to human reviewers, and there remains a lack of systematic frameworks for quantifying alignment with human reviewers. To address this gap, we propose SurveyReview, a reviewer-aligned, multi-dimensional benchmark and dataset for survey evaluation. We collect and annotate 675 survey papers with 1,630 review reports. We structure authentic peer-review reports by converting free-form comments into four-dimensional scores (Readability, Criticalness, Comprehensiveness, Structure) paired with supporting rationales. We further release standardized train/test splits and an evaluation protocol to measure alignment between automatic evaluators and human reviewers. To validate the benchmark, we develop SurveyAlign, a strong baseline evaluator by fine-tuning Qwen3-32B with LoRA on our annotated data, augmented with external knowledge for knowledge-intensive dimensions. On the test set, SurveyAlign substantially improves reviewer alignment over prompt-based judging with GPT-5.2, reducing average MSE from 2.28 to 1.38 and MAE from 1.15 to 0.69 across all four dimensions. Our contributions are twofold: (1) we establish the first multi-dimensional, reviewer-aligned dataset with a reproducible evaluation framework for survey reviewing; (2) we develop a strong baseline evaluator that substantially improves alignment with human reviewers, providing a competitive reference for future research. Our code and data are available at https://surveyreview.github.io

</details>


### [272] [Evaluating Dedicated Monolingual and Joint Multilingual Causal Models for Dravidian Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07727)
*Venkata Naga Sai Vishnu Rohit Pulipaka*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文从头训练了五个GPT-2架构模型（四个单语模型分别针对泰米尔语、泰卢固语、卡纳达语和马拉雅拉姆语，各配32K词表子词分词器；一个共享64K词表的多语模型），在困惑度、比特/字节、分词器效率和微调结果上与mGPT对比。结果显示单语模型在情感分类和命名实体识别上优于mGPT，且分词器效率高于共享多语模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 达罗毗荼语系语言（泰米尔语、泰卢固语、卡纳达语、马拉雅拉姆语）在多语言模型中训练数据占比很小，因此不清楚这些模型对这些语言的实际能力保留程度如何，需要进行针对性评估。

Method: 训练五个GPT-2架构模型：四个单语模型（各语言独立32K词表分词器）和一个共享64K词表分词器的多语模型。所有模型使用清洗后的CC-100、Wikipedia和Samanantar数据训练，并通过困惑度、bits-per-byte、分词器效率及微调表现进行评估，与mGPT对比。

Result: 单语模型在情感分类和命名实体识别任务上均优于mGPT；单语分词器在所有测试语言上的效率均高于共享多语分词器。

Conclusion: 对于低资源的多语言模型场景，单语模型及分词器在达罗毗荼语系语言上表现更优，共享多语分词器在这些语言上的效率有待提升。

Abstract: Dravidian languages, mainly Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam make up only a small part of the data used to train multilingual language models, so it's not clear how much per-language ability these models actually keep. I have trained five GPT-2 architecture models from scratch to compare four monolingual models (one each for Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam, each with its own 32K-vocabulary subword tokenizer) against one multilingual model sharing a 64K-vocabulary subword tokenizer across all four languages. All the 5 models are trained on cleaned CC-100, Wikipedia, and Samanantar data. I have tested the models on perplexity, bits-per-byte, tokenizer efficiency, and fine-tuning results which are compared against mGPT. The monolingual models outperform mGPT on sentiment classification and named entity recognition, and their tokenizers proved more efficient than the shared multilingual model across all the languages tested.

</details>


### [273] [The No-Meaning Falsity: The Structural Impossibility of the Arbitrary Sign in Classical Arabic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07737)
*Elnaserledinellah Mahmoud Abdelwahab*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文探讨后现代主义宣称的无限制语义任意性及其索绪尔基础——任意符号公理——是否与古典阿拉伯语的结构架构相容。作者建立了阿拉伯语非连接形态学的形式数学模型，证明每个词汇项由词根-模式对唯一生成，并通过条件Kolmogorov复杂度形式化相对任意性，证明阿拉伯语受动机能指的相对任意性严格小于1，与印欧语言形成系统性复杂度不对称。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检验后现代主义关于语义无限不确定性的主张与索绪尔任意符号公理是否适用于具有独特非连接形态结构的古典阿拉伯语，试图在数学上调和或反驳这些语言学哲学主张。

Method: 建立阿拉伯语非连接形态学的形式数学模型，提出形态对应定理和语义定位定理；用条件Kolmogorov复杂度形式化索绪尔的相对任意性概念，将其算法化定义为"无规则性质"；通过形式可判定性分析对比阿拉伯语与印欧语言。

Result: 证明一般相对任意性是形式不可判定的，而阿拉伯语相对任意性是可判定的，且其受动机能指（W和M层）的相对任意性严格小于1，确立了相对于印欧语言系统的严格系统复杂度不对称性。

Conclusion: 古典阿拉伯语的形态架构与后现代主义的无限制语义任意性主张不相容，其结构性、非任意的语义确定机制对索绪尔任意性公理构成了实质性挑战。

Abstract: This paper investigates whether the postmodern claim of unrestricted semantic indeterminacy, and its foundational Saussurean axiom of the arbitrary sign, are compatible with the structural architecture of Classical Arabic. We develop a formal mathematical model of Arabic non concatenative morphology in which lexical meaning is determined by the interaction between an invariant root and a morphosyntactic pattern. Within this framework, we establish a Morphological Correspondence Theorem, demonstrating that every lexical item is uniquely generated by a root pattern pair, and a Semantic Localization Theorem, proving that lexical meaning is determined at the derivational level prior to surface realization. To address Saussurean weaker notion of relative arbitrariness, we formalize it via conditional Kolmogorov complexity, defining arbitrariness algorithmically as the no rule property. We prove that general relative arbitrariness is formally undecidable, while Arabic relative arbitrariness is decidable and provably less than 1 for its motivated signifiers (Levels W and M), establishing a strict system complexity asymmetry over Indo-European languages.

</details>


### [274] [Bridging the Gap Between Semantics and Reconstruction:Unifying Sign Language Translation and Production](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09045)
*Xiao Liu,Shiwei Gan,Yafeng Yin,Jiaxin Yin,Bowen Guo,Yaqi Sun,Zhiwei Jiang,Lei Xie*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Uni-SLTP，一个统一手语翻译（SLT）和手语生成（SLP）的框架，通过共享手语分词器和统一自回归生成模型，实现手语理解和生成的相互转换。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作分别在手语理解子任务（如ISLR、CSLR、SLT）内部进行统一，但手语理解（SLT）与手语生成（SLP）是方向相反的任务，尚未在同一框架内被统一。将两者统一面临两个关键挑战：模态差距（连续手语动作与离散文本token）以及需要单一条件自回归模型支持双向生成。

Method: Uni-SLTP包含两个核心组件：（1）共享手语分词器，将手语序列转换为离散token和潜在表示，同时捕获语义和重建信息；（2）统一的自回归生成模型，将SLT和SLP均形式化为条件序列生成任务。

Result: 在广泛使用的公开数据集上，Uni-SLTP在手语生成（SLP）上实现了更优的动作精度，同时保持有竞争力的手语翻译（SLT）性能。

Conclusion: 实验结果表明，统一手语理解与生成在同一框架内是可行的，Uni-SLTP证明了共享分词器和统一生成模型能够有效处理双向手语-文本映射。

Abstract: Recent advances in sign language (SL) research have shown a trend toward unifying multiple sign language understanding (SLU) subtasks, such as isolated sign language recognition (ISLR), continuous sign language recognition (CSLR), and sign language translation (SLT), within a single framework, leading to substantial progress. Meanwhile, sign language production (SLP), which generates sign sequences from text, has also attracted growing attention. This naturally raises an important question: can sign language understanding and production be unified within a single framework? Compared with unifying SLU subtasks, this problem is substantially more challenging. Existing SLU tasks largely share the same direction of mapping, namely from sign inputs to linguistic outputs, whereas SLT and SLP lie in opposite directions of sign-text mapping. A unified framework must therefore address two key challenges: (1) bridging the modality gap between continuous sign motions and discrete text tokens through a shared sign tokenizer that supports both linguistic abstraction and motion reconstruction; and (2) learning a single conditional autoregressive model that can take either sign or text as input and generate the corresponding target sequence in the opposite modality. To this end, we propose Uni-SLTP, a unified framework for SLT and SLP with two key components: (1) a shared sign tokenizer that converts sign sequences into discrete tokens and latent representations, capturing both semantic and reconstructive information; and (2) a unified autoregressive generation model that formulates both tasks as conditional sequence generation. Experiments on widely used public datasets show that Uni-SLTP achieves superior motion accuracy for SLP while maintaining competitive SLT performance.

</details>


### [275] [Jako Tako or Fluent? Presenting PoVisLE: A Polish Vision-Language Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07763)
*Anna Kołos,Grzegorz Statkiewicz,Karolina Seweryn,Katarzyna Kowol,Karolina Piosek,Wojciech Kusa*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了PoVisLE，一个面向波兰语的单文化视觉语言基准数据集，包含1,117张图片和2,366个手工标注的VQA对，旨在评估模型在文化情境下的多模态理解能力，超越表面的视觉识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型主要在英语中心化数据上训练，缺乏文化感知能力，无法理解特定地区的符号意义和情境化视觉线索。而现有的文化能力基准多为模板驱动，仅关注表面识别，不足以评估深层语言和语用理解。

Method: 构建PoVisLE基准数据集，采用"接地评估"范式，即在视觉上下文中解释语言，数据集包含1,117张图片和2,366个手工标注的VQA对，覆盖波兰文化特定内容。

Result: 数据集本身是主要成果，提供了一个受控且具有挑战性的资源，用于评估文化接地视觉语言理解能力。

Conclusion: PoVisLE为评估多模态模型在波兰文化情境下超越表面识别的深层理解能力提供了受控且富有挑战性的基准资源。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance on tasks such as image captioning, visual question answering, and image-to-text generation. However, they are predominantly trained on English-centric data, which limits their ability to handle culturally grounded visual understanding and leads to failures in interpreting region-specific meanings, symbolic content, and context-dependent visual cues. Existing benchmarks for cultural competence are often template-driven and focused on surface-level recognition, making them insufficient for evaluating deeper linguistic and pragmatic understanding in culturally situated settings. We introduce PoVisLE, a monocultural vision-language benchmark for Polish designed to evaluate culturally grounded multimodal understanding under a grounded evaluation paradigm, where language is interpreted in interaction with visual context. The dataset contains 1,117 images and 2,366 manually annotated VQA pairs. Overall, our dataset provides a controlled and challenging resource for assessing culturally grounded vision-language understanding beyond surface-level recognition.

</details>


### [276] [On the use of foundation models in cognitive science](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07812)
*Raj Sanjay Shah,Alex Warstadt,Michael Frank,Sashank Varma*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个四阶段推理框架来评估基础模型（FMs）作为认知与发展模型的适用性，强调行为拟合本身不足以支持将FM视为解释性认知模型，必须结合明确的理论承诺、理论诊断性任务和系统性的对比评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近年来大量研究评估了基础模型在认知和发展层面的对齐性，但使用FM作为候选认知模型存在方法论和概念上的重大挑战。关键问题在于：在什么条件下，行为一致性才能证明将FM视为认知的解释性模型是合理的？本文旨在厘清这一根本性问题。

Method: 提出一个四阶段推理框架：（1）将人类实验任务适配为模型兼容格式；（2）指定将模型输出映射到人类测量指标的链接假设；（3）评估行为对应性；（4）在候选模型或操作之间进行比较。同时阐明链接假设的作用，识别限制对齐主张的挑战，并提出理论驱动和比较性评估的原则。

Result: 论证了行为拟合本身是不充分的。对齐只有在嵌入明确的理论承诺、理论诊断性任务以及跨候选模型的系统性对比评估时，才具有科学意义。

Conclusion: 将基础模型视为认知模型必须超越简单的行为对齐，需要在理论框架内进行系统性的、可比较的评估，才能真正产生有解释力的认知洞见。

Abstract: A host of recent studies have evaluated the cognitive and developmental alignment of Foundation Models (FMs). These investigations include evaluations of their correspondence to adult performance across a range of cognitive domains, as well as whether aspects of model training track children's cognitive development. However, using FMs as candidate cognitive models poses significant methodological and conceptual challenges. A key question underlies this effort: under what conditions does behavioral alignment justify treating FMs as explanatory models of cognition? In this paper, we articulate a four-stage inferential framework for evaluating FMs as cognitive and developmental models: adapting human experimental tasks to model-compatible formats, specifying linking hypotheses that map model outputs to human measures, evaluating behavioral correspondence, and comparing across candidate models or manipulations. We clarify the role of linking hypotheses in mapping model outputs to human behavioral measures, identify challenges that constrain alignment claims, and propose principles for theory-driven and comparative evaluation. Throughout, we argue that behavioral fit alone is insufficient. Alignment becomes scientifically meaningful only when embedded within explicit theoretical commitments, theory-diagnostic tasks, and systematic contrastive evaluation across candidate models.

</details>


### [277] ["Many Are My Names": The Anatomy of the Assistant and Its Personas via Sparse Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07852)
*Adelaide Danilov,Aria Nourbakhsh,Oleksandr Marchenko Breneur,Salima Lamsiyah*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征分析，探究语言模型内部如何表征不同的"说话者"（Assistant、Roleplay角色、Story角色）。研究发现Assistant与Roleplay角色并非完全独立的表征：Roleplay保留Assistant的核心特征并逐层分化；而Story角色缺乏Assistant核心表征。此外，研究发现Immersive Simulation Mode是区分Assistant与Story/Roleplay的关键，但Assistant在默认设置下有时也会进入或漂移至此模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型内部如何表征说话者身份（Assistant、Roleplay角色、叙事故事人物）仍未被充分探索。理解这一内部表征机制对于可解释性、角色一致性控制以及防止模型偏离预设身份具有重要意义。

Method: 1) 使用包含用户情绪文本和对应模型响应的数据集；2) 在三种生成场景（Assistant、Roleplay、Story）下，从turn边界和代词token位置提取SAE特征；3) 通过过滤管道在不同深度筛选特征；4) 通过steering效应和激活分布对每个幸存特征进行表征刻画。

Result: 主要发现：Assistant与Roleplay角色不是独立的替代选项——角色保留Assistant关联的特征核心，但逐层逐步分化（从操作性机制到行为与风格特征）。而生成的故事角色缺乏Assistant关联核心。Story和Roleplay均可通过Immersive Simulation Mode与Assistant区分。但Assistant在默认设置下有时也会进入或缓慢漂移到该模式。

Conclusion: 语言模型中的说话者表征呈现层次化结构：Roleplay角色基于Assistant核心并逐层分化，而Story角色则完全独立。这一发现揭示了模型内部身份表征的动态性和层间结构，为理解和控制模型角色行为提供了新的视角。

Abstract: How a language model internally represents who is speaking, the Assistant, an assigned roleplay persona, or a narrated story character, remains underexplored. We study speaker representations using a dataset of user-expressed emotional text and corresponding model responses. We decompose three generation settings (Assistant, Roleplay, and Story) into sparse autoencoder features extracted at turn-boundary and pronoun-token positions and selected through a filtering pipeline for different depths. We characterize each surviving feature through its steering effects and activation distribution. Our main finding is that the Assistant and roleplay personas are not independent alternatives: personas retain the Assistant-associated feature core while progressively differentiating from it across layers, starting from operational machinery towards behavioral and stylistic features. Meanwhile, generated story characters lack the Assistant-associated core. Both Story and Roleplay can be distinguished from the Assistant with Immersive Simulation Mode. However, the Assistant can sometimes enter or slowly drift into it even in the default setting.

</details>


### [278] [SurakshaEval: An Indic Safety Benchmark for Multilingual LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07862)
*Debopriyo Banerjee,Kapil Rajesh Kavitha,Angana Borah,Xudong Han,Yuxia Wang,Parameswari Krishnamurthy,Utkarsh Agarwal,Atharva Kulkarni,Swaran Lata,Ayush Munot,Dhruv Sahnan,Aaryamonvikram Singh,Preslav Nakov,Monojit Choudhury*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了SurakshaEval，一个针对十种主要印度语言（阿萨姆语、孟加拉语、古吉拉特语、印地语、卡纳达语、马拉雅拉姆语、马拉地语、旁遮普语、泰米尔语和泰卢固语）以及英语的新型安全评估基准，包含人工撰写的真实场景提示，旨在解决现有安全评估数据集过度聚焦英语和西方语境的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM安全评估数据集主要关注英语和西方环境，忽视了其他语言中的语言多样性和文化特定的安全风险，导致多语言模型在印度语言环境中存在安全漏洞。

Method: 构建SurakshaEval基准，包含涵盖真实场景的人工撰写提示，既有印度通用提示，也有针对特定地区和语言的提示以捕捉本地化社会文化敏感度，并对多种SOTA LLM进行基准测试。

Result: 即使是强大的多语言LLM在处理印度语言（特别是本土文字）时也难以满足细致的安全要求，识别出过度拒绝、隐含偏见检测缺失以及区域敏感情境下的上下文感知不足等反复出现的失败模式。

Conclusion: 迫切需要纳入区域特定数据和结构化评估协议的安全评估框架，以确保AI系统在多样化社会价值观下安全、道德地运行。

Abstract: Existing safety evaluation datasets for large language models (LLMs) predominantly focus on English and Western contexts, often overlooking the linguistic diversity and culturally grounded safety risks present in other languages. To address this gap, we introduce SurakshaEval, a novel safety benchmark composed of human-written prompts spanning real-world scenarios, explicitly designed for ten major Indian languages - Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Punjabi, Tamil, and Telugu, along with English. SurakshaEval includes both generic prompts common across India and region- and language-specific prompts that capture localized sociocultural sensitivities. We benchmark a broad range of state-of-the-art LLMs on SurakshaEval, establish baseline safety performance, and identify recurring failure modes, including over-refusal, missed detection of implicit bias, and insufficient contextual awareness in regionally sensitive settings. Our results show that even strong multilingual LLMs struggle to reliably meet nuanced safety requirements when operating in Indic languages, particularly in native scripts. These findings highlight the urgent need for safety evaluation frameworks that incorporate region-specific data and structured assessment protocols, enabling the development and deployment of AI systems that operate securely, ethically, and in alignment with diverse societal values. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/debobanerjee/SurakshaEval. Warning: This paper contains text that may be offensive or unsafe.

</details>


### [279] [Detection of Self-Introductions in Legislative Testimony](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07891)
*Sofija Dimitrijevic,Pallavi Das,Kasey Liu,Foaad Khosmood*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一条用于检测立法委员会证词中自我介绍的流水线，通过机器学习方法检测自我介绍并提取发言者姓名。使用从五个州立法会议中构建的154万条话语数据集，结合姓名匹配启发式自动标注，训练了决策树、随机森林和XGBoost三种分类器。XGBoost实现最佳性能（F1=0.9747），进一步加入微调BERT概率特征后提升至F1=0.9782。分析表明，少数误报实为因源数据姓名不一致而标注错误的真实自我介绍，表明实际性能优于测量的指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在立法委员会证词中，自我介绍非常普遍。成功检测自我介绍并提取发言者姓名，对于政府会议场景下的发言者识别任务具有巨大帮助。

Method: 构建从154万条话语组成的训练数据集（涵盖五个州立法会议），应用姓名匹配启发式生成自动标签；构建融合词袋、位置上下文、结构信号、介绍性短语指示词和话语上下文特征的特征集；训练决策树、随机森林和XGBoost三种分类器；进一步利用微调BERT分类器为完整候选数据集打分，并将BERT概率输出作为额外特征增强XGBoost模型。

Result: XGBoost获得最佳性能（F1=0.9747，总错误最少）；BERT增强的XGBoost模型将F1从0.9747提升至0.9782，测试错误从241降至207。相比决策树基线（F1=0.9323），主要增益来自话语上下文特征和boosting集成策略，BERT提供适度的补充信号。误报分析显示少数真实自我介绍因源数据姓名不一致被错误标注。

Conclusion: 基于机器学习的自我介绍检测流水线在立法委员会证词中表现良好，其中XGBoost结合BERT概率特征可进一步提升性能。测量指标可能低估了模型的实际表现，因为部分误报实际上是标注错误造成的真实自我介绍。

Abstract: Self-introductions are common in legislative committee testimonies. Successfully detecting them and extracting the speaker's name is enormously helpful in the task of speaker identification in the context of government meetings. In this paper, we present a pipeline for detection of self-introductions in legislative committee testimony using machine learning. We construct a training dataset from 1.54 million utterances spanning five state legislative sessions, apply a name-matching heuristic to generate automatic labels, and train three classifiers: a decision tree, random forest, and XGBoost to find self-introductions and extract the speaker's name. We construct a feature set combining bag-of-words, positional context, structural signals, introductory phrase indicators, and discourse context features. Among the three classifiers, XGBoost achieves the best performance with an F1 score of 0.9747 and the fewest total errors; adding fine-tuned BERT probability features improves this further. As an extension, we score the full candidate dataset with a fine-tuned BERT classifier and add BERT probability outputs as features. This BERT-augmented XGBoost model improves F1 from 0.9747 to 0.9782 and reduces total test errors from 241 to 207. The primary gain over the decision tree baseline (F1 0.9323) is driven by discourse context features and the boosting ensemble strategy; BERT provides a modest complementary signal. Analysis of false positives reveals that a minority are genuine self-introductions mislabeled due to name inconsistencies in the source data, indicating that measured metrics modestly understate true performance.

</details>


### [280] [Thinking Hard, Not Smart: Reasoning Models Fail to Ration Test-Time Compute Across Questions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07968)
*Chenrui Fan,Yize Cheng,Ming Li,Yongyuan Liang,Tianyi Zhou,Soheil Feizi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个"考试式"评估框架，研究推理语言模型如何在多个问题之间分配共享的推理计算预算。研究发现模型在全局预算分配上表现不佳：它们像贪心的顺序求解器，按呈现顺序处理问题，对早期问题投入过多，对问题价值和难度不敏感，且这种倾向随问题数量增加而加剧。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理模型评估通常一次只研究一个问题的测试时计算，但真实场景中多个问题共享端到端的成本或延迟约束。模型需要决定如何在多个问题之间分配有限的推理计算预算，这是一个现有评估框架未覆盖的关键能力。

Method: 引入一个考试式评估框架：模型必须在一个共享的token预算内，跨不同难度和分值的问题进行分配以最大化总分。在多个开源和前沿推理模型上进行了系统实验，并对比了显式规划提示的效果，同时将测试从数学推理扩展到代码推理领域。

Result: 模型在跨问题分配共享预算时缺乏策略性：表现为贪心顺序求解，按呈现顺序优先处理问题，对早期问题过度投入，对问题价值和难度不敏感，且这些倾向随问题数量增加而更明显。显式规划提示能使计算分配更均匀，但不能产生价值或难度感知的优先级排序。同样的行为模式从数学推理延伸到代码推理。

Conclusion: 全局预算分配是一个独立的能力维度，无法被传统的逐问题评估所捕捉，对当前推理模型而言仍然是一个挑战。这揭示了推理模型在资源分配与战略规划方面的显著不足。

Abstract: Reasoning language models increasingly use test-time compute to improve performance, but existing evaluations typically study this compute one question at a time. Yet when multiple problems share an end-to-end cost or latency constraint, models must decide how to divide limited inference compute among them. We introduce an exam-style evaluation framework for studying this setting, in which a model must distribute one shared token budget across questions with different difficulty and point values to maximize its total score. Across several open and frontier reasoning models, we find that models fail to allocate a shared budget strategically across questions of varying difficulties and values. Models behave largely as greedy sequential solvers: they prioritize questions by presentation order, front-load effort on early questions, and remain insensitive to value, with these tendencies becoming more pronounced as the number of questions grows. Explicit planning prompts spread compute more evenly but do not produce value- or difficulty-aware prioritization. The same behavioral pattern extends from mathematical to code reasoning. These findings establish global budget allocation as a distinct capability that is not captured by conventional per-question evaluation and remains a challenge for current reasoning models.

</details>


### [281] [Prompt Embedding Probes (PEP): Hallucination Detection in LLMs from Hidden States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08024)
*Zakhar Mrykhin,Valentin Malykh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Prompt Embedding Probes (PEP)，一种白盒方法，通过在冻结的LLM隐藏状态上添加少量可学习的提示嵌入来增强标准线性探针，实现答案级别的幻觉检测。在TriviaQA、GSM8K和MedQA上用Qwen3多尺度模型评估，PEP在分布内设置中优于标准线性探针，且在预生成预测和跨模型迁移中保持有效，但跨数据集迁移仍具挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型虽然在生成流畅且有用的回答方面表现出色，但仍容易产生幻觉（hallucination），需要有效的检测方法来识别这些不可靠的输出。

Method: PEP通过在标准线性探针的输入中增加少量可学习的提示嵌入（prompt embeddings）来扩展探针，从冻结LLM的隐藏状态中检测幻觉，同时保持模型骨干冻结且只增加少量可训练参数。

Result: 在TriviaQA、GSM8K和MedQA上使用Qwen3多尺度模型的实验中，PEP在分布内设置中优于标准线性探针；在预生成预测和跨模型设置中依然有效，但跨数据集迁移仍然困难。

Conclusion: 基于提示的自适应方法可以在保持骨干冻结且仅添加少量可训练参数的情况下，增强基于隐藏状态的探针性能，但跨数据集的鲁棒泛化仍是挑战。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent and useful responses but remain prone to hallucinations. We introduce Prompt Embedding Probes (PEP), a white-box method for answer-level hallucination detection from the hidden states of a frozen LLM. PEP extends standard linear probes by augmenting the input with a small number of learnable prompt embeddings. We evaluate PEP on TriviaQA, GSM8K, and MedQA using Qwen3 models at multiple scales. PEP improves hidden-state-based detection over standard linear probes in the main in-distribution setting. We further evaluate PEP for pre-generation prediction, cross-model transfer, and out-of-distribution generalization. PEP remains effective in the pre-generation and cross-model settings, whereas robust cross-dataset transfer remains difficult. These results show that prompt-based adaptation can strengthen hidden-state probing while keeping the backbone frozen and adding only a small number of trainable parameters.

</details>


### [282] [APEX-VW: A Document-Level English-Spanish Post-Editing Dataset in the Healthcare Domain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08059)
*Marie Escribe,Tharindu Ranasinghe,Amal Haddad Haddad,Hansi Hettiarachchi,Damith Premasiri*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了APEX-VW语料库，一个全新的英西（EN-ES）开放数据集，基于NHS虚拟病房文档和专业译员在Trados Studio中的后期编辑构建，包含42k词、七个文档连贯的源文本，由四种不同范式的MT系统翻译后经专业译员进行后期编辑。区别于现有语料库，该数据集保留了文档顺序和CAT工具上下文，适用于术语规范化、修正传播和人机协同翻译支持的研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动后期编辑（APE）研究所需的语料库大多在句子层面运作，或为合成数据，无法研究真实计算机辅助翻译（CAT）工作流中修正如何在文档中传播的问题。特别是在专业化和高重复性的文档中，词法和术语修正往往会跨多个片段重复出现，亟需一个保留文档级上下文和CAT工具环境的真实数据集。

Method: 从NHS虚拟病房文档中选取七个文档连贯的源文本（共计42k词），使用四种代表不同范式的MT系统进行翻译，再由专业译员在Trados Studio中进行后期编辑。语料库构建过程严格设计了MT、术语和质量保证设置，并完整保留文档顺序和CAT工具上下文信息。

Result: 成功构建了APEX-VW语料库，该数据集与WMT APE语料库、eSCAPE、MLQE-PE和LangMark等现有资源不同，具有文档连贯性、真实CAT工作流上下文、专业译员后期编辑等特征，并提供了初始语料统计信息。

Conclusion: APEX-VW语料库定位为文档级APE和传播感知辅助工具研究的基准资源，有望推动术语规范化、修正传播以及人机协同翻译支持等方向的研究进展。

Abstract: Post-Editing (PE) of Machine Translation (MT) output often involves repeating the same lexical and terminological corrections across many segments, especially in specialised and highly repetitive documents. Despite substantial work on Automatic Post-Editing (APE), most available corpora operate at the sentence level, others are synthetic, and overall not designed to study how corrections propagate in realistic Computer-Assisted Translation (CAT) workflows. This paper presents the APEX-VW (Automatic Post-Editing eXperiments on Virtual Wards) Corpus, a new open English-Spanish (EN-ES) dataset built from recent NHS virtual-ward documents and professional PE in Trados Studio, with controlled MT, terminology, and quality assurance settings. The corpus contains seven document-coherent source texts totalling 42k words, translated with four MT systems representing different paradigms and then post-edited by professional translators. Unlike prior resources such as WMT APE corpora, eSCAPE, MLQE-PE, or LangMark, the dataset preserves document order and CAT-tool context, making it suitable for research on terminology normalisation, correction propagation, and human-in-the-loop translation support. The paper describes the corpus design, data preparation, PE setup, and initial corpus statistics, and positions the resource as a benchmark for document-level APE and propagation-aware assistive tools.

</details>


### [283] [DialectS2S: End-to-End Speech Dialogue Modeling for Low-Resource Chinese Dialects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08067)
*Yi Shu,Tianyu Peng,Yingzhuo Deng,Wen Yang,Jun Lin,Changming Xie,Xinyu Yu,Jiajun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: DialectS2S是一个面向中文方言的端到端语音对话模型，通过可扩展的方言数据合成管道和两阶段后训练策略（含自对齐语音监督），解决了低资源方言场景下语音对话模型的语义不一致和稳定性问题，在多个中文方言上显著优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有端到端语音对话模型主要针对主流语言优化，在低资源方言场景下受限。核心问题在于：1）方言语音数据稀缺；2）方言适配过程中模型的语义表示空间不断演化，而传统语音监督保持不变，导致隐藏表示与语音目标之间的语义不一致，降低语音的稳定性和自然度。

Method: 1）提出可扩展的方言语音对话合成管道，用于高效数据构建；2）引入两阶段后训练策略，结合自对齐语音监督，使语音监督的语义内容与模型演化的语义表示对齐，从而提升方言语音生成质量。

Result: 在多个中文方言的语音对话任务中，DialectS2S在方言一致性、响应质量和语音可懂度方面均显著优于现有基线方法。

Conclusion: DialectS2S为低资源方言场景下的端到端语音对话建模提供了高效且可扩展的解决方案，并已全面开源模型检查点、训练数据集和微调代码，以促进后续研究与应用。

Abstract: Current end-to-end speech dialogue models are primarily optimized for mainstream languages and remain limited in low-resource dialect scenarios due to the scarcity of dialect speech data. Moreover, during dialect adaptation, the semantic representation space of speech dialogue models continuously evolves, while conventional speech supervision remains unchanged, leading to semantic inconsistency between hidden representations and speech targets and degrading speech stability and naturalness. To address these issues, we propose DialectS2S, an end-to-end speech dialogue model for Chinese dialects. We first develop a scalable dialect speech dialogue synthesis pipeline for efficient data construction. We further introduce a two-stage post-training strategy with self-aligned speech supervision, which aligns the semantic content of speech supervision with the evolved semantic representations of the model to improve dialect speech generation quality. Experimental results show that DialectS2S consistently outperforms existing baselines across multiple Chinese dialects in speech dialogue, achieving substantial improvements in dialect consistency, response quality, and speech intelligibility. Our work provides an efficient and scalable solution for end-to-end speech dialogue modeling in low-resource dialect scenarios. To facilitate future research and practical applications, we fully open-source the DialectS2S framework, including model checkpoints, training datasets, and fine-tuning code.

</details>


### [284] [Commitment Before Realization: When Classifier-Free Guidance Becomes Unnecessary in Masked Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08082)
*Fan Zhou,Weitian Wang,Tim Van de Cruys*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究掩码扩散语言模型解码中无分类器引导（CFG）的实际需求时机。通过比较部分输出下继续使用CFG与仅用基础模型延续时的约束满足概率，定义了"承诺地平线"（commitment horizon），即从该最早时刻起切换回基础模型不会显著降低最终成功率的临界点。研究发现引导依赖性高度依赖提示词，多数提示无需CFG即可成功，且CFG的收益常集中在早期。在13个子任务上，按各提示在其交叉拟合地平线处冻结解码并不劣于全程CFG，甚至能保持约束成功的同时提升并行度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CFG在掩码扩散语言模型解码中通常全程开启，但其收益随提示和时间变化很大。作者希望搞清楚：CFG到底在什么时刻、对什么提示真正必要？能否在不牺牲约束满足的前提下提前关闭引导，从而获得更高的并行性和更好的效率？

Method: 1) 从任意部分输出出发，比较继续CFG与仅基础模型延续两种情况下的约束满足概率，二者之差定义为引导的剩余价值；2) 定义承诺地平线a*为从该点起切换到基础模型、最终成功率损失不超过容差的最早时刻；3) 利用基础模型下成功概率（committor）是鞅的性质，推导CFG每步效果的一阶近似为引导logit方向与后继committor的协方差；4) 采用交叉拟合方法为每个提示确定个体化地平线，并在13个子任务上比较冻结解码与全程CFG的效果；5) 分析失败轨迹中重新打开已承诺位置对两种失败模式的恢复作用。

Result: 引导依赖性高度提示特异性：许多提示无需CFG即可成功，部分提示下CFG无益甚至有害；有收益的提示其增益多集中在早期。观察到的预终止地平线通常较早出现，且在约束族内比族间变异更大。在预设容差下，按各提示自身的交叉拟合地平线冻结解码在全部13个子任务上不劣于全程CFG，尽管此时许多token仍被掩码。地平线边界还识别出后续区域中更高并行度仅带来微小的约束成功率代价，但流畅性仍随并行宽度下降。对失败轨迹重新打开承诺位置可在两种失败模式下改善恢复。

Conclusion: CFG并非全程必要，其关键价值集中在解码早期。通过识别每个提示的承诺地平线，可以在不损失约束满足的前提下提前切回基础模型解码，从而分离"承诺"与"实现"两个阶段：早期用CFG保证约束方向，后期用基础模型高效并行实现。这一框架提供了对CFG何时有帮助的局部理论解释（以协方差刻画），并为实用化的自适应引导调度提供了依据。

Abstract: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) is usually kept on throughout masked diffusion language model decoding, although its benefit varies across prompts and over time. We study when CFG is actually needed by comparing, from any partial output, the probability of eventual constraint satisfaction under continued CFG and under base-only continuation. Their difference defines the remaining value of guidance. Guidance dependence is highly prompt-specific. Many prompts already succeed without CFG, while for others it provides no measurable benefit or can be harmful. For prompts that do benefit, the gain is often concentrated early. We define the commitment horizon $\astar$ as the earliest point from which switching all remaining decoding to the base model reduces final success by no more than a chosen tolerance. Under the base model, the corresponding success probability, or committor, is a martingale. To first order, CFG's per-step effect is governed by the covariance between the guidance logit direction and the successor committor. This gives a local account of when guidance can help, but it does not by itself locate the horizon. Among prompts with an observed preterminal horizon, $\astar$ is usually early and varies more within constraint families than between them. Freezing each prompt at its own cross-fitted horizon is noninferior to full CFG on all 13 subtasks at the prespecified margin, even while many tokens remain masked. This separates commitment from realization. The boundary also identifies a later region in which higher parallelism adds only a small cost in constraint success, although fluency still degrades with parallel width. For failed trajectories, reopening committed positions improves recovery in both failure modes.

</details>


### [285] [Archer: Adaptive Reuse of Cached Hidden States for Efficient Rollback in Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08086)
*Xuning He,Zinan Sheng,Yongding Tao,Huanyu Liu,Ge Li,Xue Jiang,Yihong Dong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Archer是一种面向可回滚扩散语言模型(DLM)的训练无关KV缓存方法。它不对称地保持可变响应状态与当前假设同步，同时在有界状态邻域内复用提示(prompt)的K/V，从而避免重复计算提示状态。该方法不仅实现了2.57倍的平均加速（最高2.95倍），还意外地通过延迟临时token的反馈提升了生成质量（最佳平均性能33.63%，Pass@1最高提升3.05点）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型通过迭代精炼序列实现回滚能力，但这种能力导致推理成本高昂——每次去噪更新都会改变全局上下文，迫使提示和响应状态都被重新计算，即使只有响应token是可修改的。传统的KV缓存假设历史状态不可变，难以与回滚机制兼容，因此需要一种新的缓存策略来解决这一效率瓶颈。

Method: Archer采用不对称缓存策略：将可变的响应状态与当前假设保持同步（不缓存），而在有界状态邻域内复用提示的K/V（缓存）。尽管双向注意力下提示表示也会变化，但token身份固定，所以有界复用可以摊销重复的提示计算。此外，该方法延迟了临时token的反馈，避免过早强化瞬时高置信度错误，给回滚更多纠正机会。论文还提供了理论分析，将提示复用刻画为可逆性对齐的缓存边界，界定状态依赖近似误差，并给出保留全刷新决策的解码器余量条件。

Result: 在主测试集上，Archer达到最佳平均性能33.63%，同时实现2.57倍平均加速。在不同评估设置下，Pass@1最高提升3.05点，加速最高达2.95倍。控制实验验证了质量提升源于延迟提示反馈，并验证了状态感知刷新的有效性。

Conclusion: Archer证明了在DLM中KV缓存与回滚可以共存，且通过精心设计的缓存边界选择，不仅能加速推理，还能通过延迟反馈改善生成质量，将现有的"质量-速度"权衡前沿向内推进。这为可回滚生成模型的实用化部署提供了新的思路。

Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) iteratively refine a sequence, allowing earlier predictions to be revised as context evolves. This rollback capability distinguishes them from irreversible autoregressive generation, but makes inference costly. Every denoising update alters the global context, forcing both prompt and response states to be recomputed even though only response tokens are revisable. Key-value (KV) caching could reduce this cost, yet conventional caching assumes immutable historical states and is therefore difficult to reconcile with rollback.In this paper, we introduce Adaptive Reuse of Cached Hidden States for Efficient Rollback (Archer), a training-free KV caching method for rollback-capable DLMs. Archer asymmetrically keeps the mutable response synchronized with the current hypothesis while reusing prompt K/V within a bounded state neighborhood. Although prompt representations also change under bidirectional attention, their token identities remain fixed; bounded reuse therefore amortizes repeated prompt computation without caching mutable response states. It also delays feedback from tentative tokens, reducing premature reinforcement of transient high-confidence errors and giving rollback more opportunity to correct them. Our analysis characterizes prompt reuse as a reversibility-aligned cache boundary, bounds its state-dependent approximation error, and gives a decoder-margin condition for preserving full-refresh decisions.Existing DLM acceleration often trades quality for speed. Archer shifts this frontier, attaining the best mean performance of 33.63% together with a 2.57x mean speedup on the main suite. Across evaluated settings, it improves Pass@1 by up to 3.05 points and reaches up to 2.95x speedup. Controlled analyses connect the quality gain to delayed prompt feedback and validate state-aware refresh. Our code is available at https://github.com/Hxnng/Archer.

</details>


### [286] [Wisdom in Unity: The Role of Multilingual Training in Figurative Language Identification in Proverbs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08090)
*Rama Alomair,Remas Alsubaie,Walaa Saifalislam,Rima Alsonbul,Mona Alnajjar,Razan Aldossari,Haya Alibrahim,Abeer Aldayel*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了多语言监督对于比喻语言识别任务的影响，使用742个谚语概念、6,787个翻译实例、七种语言，评估了五种模型在不同多语言监督水平下的表现，并提出了一个涵盖四种互补比喻形式（隐喻、道德/劝诫、因果、文化特定）的多维度标注框架。研究发现约50%的翻译训练数据即可达到近最优性能，综合多种比喻形式表现最佳，且文化特定形式在多语言监督下获益最大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多语言比喻语言识别已不是新课题，但超越单一语言同质训练数据的转变需要更清晰地理解翻译多语言监督的贡献，以及不同比喻形式在多语言监督下的表现差异。

Method: 使用742个谚语概念、6,787个翻译实例覆盖七种语言；评估五种模型（包括多语言编码器和指令微调LLM），在逐步增加的多语言监督水平下进行实验；提出四维度标注框架（Metaphorical、Moral/Advisory、Cause-Effect、Culture Specific）来刻画谚语的互补性比喻形式。

Result: 约50%的翻译多语言训练数据即可达到近最优比喻语言识别性能；结合多种比喻形式可获得最强整体性能；最不常见的Culture Specific形式在多语言监督下获得最大性能提升；Moral/Advisory和Culture Specific形式对指令微调LLM的比喻语言识别贡献最大。

Conclusion: 该研究推动多语言比喻语言识别超越以隐喻为中心的类别体系，转向概念层面的多维度框架，显式建模比喻意义的互补形式。

Abstract: Although multilingual approaches to figurative language identification are not new, the shift beyond language homogeneous training data requires a clearer understanding of the contribution of translated multilingual supervision. We examine this question using 742 proverb concepts across 6,787 translated instances in seven languages. We evaluate five models, including multilingual encoders and instruction tuned LLMs, under progressively increasing levels of multilingual supervision. Moreover, we introduce a multidimensional annotation framework for proverbs that characterizes them through four complementary figurative forms: Metaphorical, Moral/Advisory, Cause-Effect, and Culture Specific.
  Our findings show that approximately 50% of the translated multilingual training data is sufficient to achieve near-optimal figurative language identification performance. We further show that combining diverse figurative forms yields the strongest overall performance. A notable finding is that the least frequent figurative form, Culture Specific, exhibits the largest performance gains under multilingual supervision. Furthermore, the Moral/Advisory and Culture Specific forms contribute most to the performance of instruction-tuned LLMs on figurative language identification. These findings motivate multilingual figurative language identification to move beyond metaphor-centric taxonomies toward concept level multidimensional frameworks that explicitly model complementary forms of figurative meaning.

</details>


### [287] [NeuPAT: Neuron-aware Plasticity Allocation Tuning for Language-Preserving MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08107)
*Jiayue Jin,Jingwei Zhang,Chen Wang,Jing Liu,Longteng Guo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出NeuPAT框架，通过神经元粒度的可塑性分配来解决多模态扩展大语言模型时语言能力退化的问题，在恢复94.5%语言能力损失的同时保持多模态性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态扩展赋予了LLM新的感知能力，但往往以牺牲预训练期间获得的语言智能为代价。现有方法未能从内部适应动态的角度理解这一退化现象。

Method: NeuPAT通过两个关键步骤：1) 利用小型探测阶段估计神经元适应模式，识别语言关键神经元和适应多模态的神经元；2) 在多模态指令微调过程中对神经元分配差异化的更新约束——保护语言敏感神经元，同时通过更可塑的神经元促进多模态适应。该框架轻量且与架构无关。

Result: 在多种LLM家族上的实验表明，NeuPAT在11个语言基准上恢复了由朴素微调导致的94.5%语言能力退化，同时保持了相当的多模态性能。

Conclusion: NeuPAT提供了一种有效的保留能力多模态扩展方法，表明通过神经元的异质可塑性洞察可以实现语言能力保持与多模态适应的平衡。

Abstract: Multimodal expansion of large language models (LLMs) enables new perceptual capabilities but often compromises the language intelligence acquired during pretraining. In this work, we investigate this phenomenon from the perspective of internal adaptation dynamics and discover that neurons in pretrained LLMs exhibit heterogeneous plasticity during multimodal learning: some neurons are critical for preserving language capabilities, while others are more adaptive to multimodal knowledge. Based on this insight, we propose NeuPAT (Neuron-aware Plasticity Allocation Tuning), a lightweight and architecture-agnostic framework that allocates neuron-wise update constraints during multimodal instruction tuning. NeuPAT uses a small-scale probing stage to estimate neuron adaptation patterns and selectively protects language-sensitive neurons while promoting multimodal adaptation through more plastic neurons. Experiments across diverse LLM families demonstrate that NeuPAT recovers 94.5\% of the language capability degradation caused by vanilla tuning on 11 language benchmarks while maintaining comparable multimodal performance, providing an effective approach for capability-preserving multimodal expansion.

</details>


### [288] [Can LLM Agents Stick to the Script? A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Consistency in Interactive Narratives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08160)
*Yingpeng Ma,Jianhao Yan,Bei Shi,Ka Hou Kam,Runnan Wang,Xuebo Liu,Yulong Chen,Yue Zhang,Derek F. Wong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出叙事承诺保持（NCP）问题，并构建NCP-Bench基准（100个基于电影梗概的叙事环境），系统评估LLM在交互式叙事中维持长期逻辑一致性与叙事完整性的能力。实验发现即使最强模型（GPT-5.2）在20轮后存活率仅42%，事实冲突率高达40%-68%，揭示高质量语言输出与逻辑一致性之间存在显著鸿沟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM驱动的AI游戏研究聚焦于开放式互动叙事的生成能力，却忽视了长期逻辑一致性和叙事完整性这一关键挑战。当用户进行不受约束的干预时，模型容易产生逻辑冲突内容，但目前缺乏系统性测量该问题的基准与框架。

Method: 1) 将长期叙事一致性问题形式化为叙事承诺保持（Narrative Commitment Preservation, NCP）；2) 构建NCP-Bench基准，包含100个源自电影梗概的叙事环境；3) 每个环境包含结构化叙事规范（轨迹、承诺、初始事实），可自动检查整个玩家-叙述者交互过程；4) 对多种SOTA LLM进行对抗性干预下的系统评估。

Result: 最佳模型GPT-5.2在20轮后存活率仅42%；各模型事实冲突率介于40%-68%；在100轮限制内，仅零星运行能满足所有成就承诺。高质量语言表达与承诺保持之间存在显著鸿沟。

Conclusion: 现有LLM在交互式叙事的长期一致性方面存在严重不足，该问题值得作为独立的研究方向加以重视。NCP-Bench为评估和改进模型在此维度的表现提供了标准化基准。

Abstract: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) is revolutionizing AI for Games by enabling open-ended and fluid interactive storytelling. However, existing research has largely overlooked the critical challenge of maintaining long-horizon logical consistency and narrative integrity against unconstrained user interventions. To address this, we formulate this challenge as Narrative Commitment Preservation (NCP), and take interactive narrative as our testbed. We introduce NCP-Bench, a benchmark of 100 narrative environments derived from movie synopses. Each environment includes a structured narrative specification (trajectory, commitments, and initial facts) that we can automatically check throughout the interaction between the player agent and the narrator agent. Experiments across state-of-the-art LLMs reveal a substantial long-horizon consistency gap: high linguistic quality does not guarantee commitment preservation; even strong models frequently generate logically conflicting content under adversarial interventions, with the best-performing model (GPT-5.2) achieving only 42% survival rate after 20 turns and fact conflict rates ranging from 40% to 68% across models, and only isolated runs satisfying all achievement commitments within the 100-turn limit.

</details>


### [289] [STEMMA: An Adversarial Multi-Agent Framework for Evaluating Self-Identity Consistency in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08164)
*Nuthakki Siva Gopala Krishna,Kanishka Jain*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文探讨了知识蒸馏过程中教师模型向学生模型传递的不仅是功能性知识，还包括行为模式（尤其是自我身份表达）。作者提出STEMMA框架，一个多模态、多智能体系统，通过角色特定智能体协作探测不同模型的自我识别行为，并设计对抗性提示来评估LLM的身份一致性。结果表明大多数模型在自我表征上存在一定程度的不一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着知识蒸馏在规模和复杂度上的增长，一个重要问题浮现：蒸馏过程中究竟传递了什么样的知识？除了功能性知识外，学生模型是否也继承了教师模型的行为模式（尤其是自我身份表示）？这可能引发输出同质化、模型偏见和问责制等方面的担忧。

Method: 提出了STEMMA（多模态多智能体框架），其中角色特定的智能体协作探测不同模型的自我识别行为；同时贡献了一套手工设计的对抗性提示，用于评估LLM的身份一致性。

Result: 实验结果显示，大多数模型在自我表征方面存在一定程度的不一致性，容易受到身份表达不稳定的影响。

Conclusion: 知识蒸馏不仅传递功能性知识，还会传递行为模式（如自我身份认知），这引发了关于模型同质化、偏见和问责制的伦理与安全问题，需要引起研究社区的关注。

Abstract: Knowledge Distillation is a widely adopted technique in the training and fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) enabling transfer of structured information and functional behavior from a large teacher model to a smaller student model while significantly reducing computational costs. However, as the use of distillation increases in both scale and complexity it raises an important question about what kind of knowledge is really transferred from the teacher model. In this work, we argue that apart from the functional knowledge, student models also learn behavioral patterns, specifically how a model represents its own identity raising concerns about output homogeneity, model biases, and accountability. To address this challenge, we introduce STEMMA, a multi-modal and multi-agent framework in which role specific agents collaboratively probe self identification behavior in different models. We also contribute a set of adversarial prompts designed manually to evaluate identity consistency in LLMs. Our results show that to an extent most models are vulnerable to inconsistencies in self-representations.

</details>


### [290] [Thinking vs. NoThinking: Towards Interpreting Reasoning Mechanisms of Large Language Models via Sparse Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08168)
*Bo Cheng,Qiaolin Lu,Yi Chang,Yuan Wu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文使用Top-K稀疏自编码器（SAEs）分析DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B在思维链（Thinking）与直接回答（NoThinking）两种推理模式下的神经机制差异，通过观察和因果干预揭示两者在特征激活模式、推理策略及对干扰响应上的根本不同。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然思维链推理显著提升了LLM的推理能力，但对其背后的神经机制知之甚少，尤其是显式思考模式与直接回答模式在内部表征层面的区别。理解这一认知过程有助于揭示思维链推理的本质原理。

Method: 应用Top-K Sparse Autoencoders对DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B的中间表征进行稀疏特征分解，在三个不同难度的数学任务上对比两种推理模式。通过总激活量抑制最活跃的三个稀疏特征进行因果干预实验。

Result: 观察层面发现两种模式存在清晰差异：Thinking模式依赖稀疏高强度特征激活驱动言语推理且与问题复杂度无关，而NoThinking模式呈现适应性的弥散模式优先符号操作。因果层面揭示三条原则：推理与句法结构紧密耦合；Thinking模式在受扰后产生补偿性过度生成（更多元认知提示和重复低信息延续）；连贯的思维链行为依赖专业特征间的脆弱协调。

Conclusion: 思维链推理与直接回答在神经机制上存在根本性差异，思维链的连贯性依赖于稀疏特征间的脆弱协调，且推理与格式化输出存在紧密耦合，这为理解LLM推理的内部机制提供了新的视角。

Abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) employing Chain-of-Thought (CoT) exhibit superior reasoning capabilities, the neural mechanisms distinguishing this explicit Thinking mode from direct answer generation (NoThinking mode) remain poorly understood. To deconstruct this cognitive process, we apply Top-K Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to the intermediate representations of DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B and examine the model's divergent behaviors across math-solving tasks of three distinct difficulty levels. Observationally, we identify a clear distinction in how the model functions under two reasoning modes: Thinking mode relies on sparse and high-intensity feature activations driving verbal deduction independent of problem complexity, whereas NoThinking mode exhibits an adaptive and diffuse pattern prioritizing symbolic manipulation. Causally, suppressing the three most active sparse features by Total Activation Volume reveals three principles: (i) reasoning and syntactic structure are tightly coupled, as interventions consistently degrade \LaTeX{} and boxed-solution formatting; (ii) Thinking responds to disruption with compensatory over-generation marked by increased metacognitive cues and repetitive, low-information continuations; and (iii) coherent CoT behavior depends on a fragile coordination among specialized features, yielding distinct failure modes under perturbation but a consistently impaired output structure.

</details>


### [291] [A Grounded and Decomposed Framework for Relation-Level Hallucination Evaluation in Abstractive Summarization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08180)
*Praveen Kumar Katwe,Rakesh Chandra Balabantaray,Kali Prasad Vittala,Naman Kabadi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个改进的关系幻觉评估框架，通过引入依赖感知的关系抽取算法和归一化的关系幻觉指数（RHI），用于更准确、稳定地评估抽象式摘要生成中的关系级幻觉问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 抽象式摘要系统经常生成流畅但不忠实的摘要，会在实体和事件之间捏造或扭曲关系。这种关系级幻觉严重影响生成摘要的可靠性，尤其是在高风险领域，而现有评估方法在这方面存在不足。

Method: 提出依赖感知的关系抽取算法，包含词形归一化、命名实体锚定的主语消解、被动语态施事恢复、否定感知的动词建模、报告动词过滤、名词关系回退、从句传播和系统去重等增强模块。同时引入归一化的RHI公式，将幻觉分解为可解释的组成部分，并聚合为归一化的关系忠实度评分。

Result: 在多个最先进的摘要模型上进行广泛评估，表明这种基于锚定的抽取过程能够产生更稳定、更具区分度的幻觉测量结果。

Conclusion: 该框架推进了自动化的关系级忠实度评估，支持一致性感知和幻觉敏感的模型分析。

Abstract: Abstractive text summarization systems frequently generate fluent yet unfaithful summaries by fabricating or distorting relationships between entities and
  events. Such relation-level hallucinations undermine the reliability of generated summaries, particularly in high-stakes domains. In this work, we present a
  refined and grounded framework for evaluating relation hallucination in abstractive summarization. We present the empirical Relation Hallucination Index (RHI) by
  introducing a dependency-aware relation extraction algorithm that incorporates lemmatization-based normalization, named entity grounded subject resolution,
  passive agent recovery, negation-aware verb modeling, reporting verb filtering, nominal relation fallback, clausal propagation, and systematic deduplication.
  These enhancements improve the structural fidelity of extracted relation triples and reduce spurious matches during evaluation. In addition, we introduce a
  normalized formulation of RHI to ensure scale-invariant comparison between datasets and models. The revised metric decomposes hallucination into interpretable
  components, aggregates relation hallucination metric into a normalized relation faithfulness score. Extensive evaluation across multiple state-of-the-art
  summarization models demonstrates that the grounded extraction process yields more stable and discriminative hallucination measurements. The proposed framework
  advances automated relation-level faithfulness evaluation and supports coherence-aware, hallucination-sensitive model analysis.

</details>


### [292] [Focus particles and scalar inferences across humans and language models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08227)
*Catherine M. Brousse,Nelu D. Radpour*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了人类和大型语言模型（LLMs）在处理"even"和"only"等焦点粒子时是否构建稳定的标量表征。通过约100个项目的数据集，要求参与者和模型进行标量判断，初步结果显示人类和LLM可能通过不同的底层机制产生相似输出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 焦点粒子（如"even"和"only"）是形式语义学中关于替代集合结构表征理论的核心。如果这种标量表征是稳健且可泛化的，应该在跨上下文和系统中产生一致的判断。作者希望检验人类和LLM是否都能构建稳定的标量表征，以理解LLM是否真正掌握了这类语义结构。

Method: 使用包含约100个项目的数据集，分别让人类参与者和LLM对含有焦点粒子的句子进行标量判断，然后比较两者的输出结果。

Result: 初步结果显示，人类和LLM在这些任务上产生了相似的输出，但这些相似性可能源于不同的底层机制。

Conclusion: 人类和LLM虽然在标量判断上表现相似，但各自的认知/计算机制可能不同，这提示表面行为一致性并不能直接推断出内部表征的等价性。

Abstract: Focus particles such as "even" and "only" are central to formal semantic theories that posit structured representations over sets of alternatives. "Even" highlights unexpected or extreme alternatives, while "only" enforces exclusivity. If such scalar representations are robust and generalizable, they should give rise to consistent judgments across contexts and systems. In this work, we test whether humans and large language models (LLMs) construct stable scalar representations from sentences containing these particles. Using a dataset of approximately 100 items, participants and models were asked to make scalar judgments. Preliminary results suggest that similar outputs across humans and LLMs may arise from different underlying mechanisms.

</details>


### [293] [AraSSM: A bidirectional state-space encoder for Arabic masked language modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08256)
*Ahmed Amine Aliane,Hassina Aliane,Nasredine Semmar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了AraSSM，这是首个专门为阿拉伯语预训练的双向Mamba编码器。作者通过掩码语言建模，在阿拉伯语维基百科和CulturaX文本语料上，仅用四块消费级RTX 2080Ti GPU（约10天）从头训练了该模型。在四个阿拉伯语NLU基准（HARD、ANERcorp、ARCD、XNLI-ar）上微调评估后，AraSSM在情感分类上达到或超过现有基础规模Transformer基线（HARD准确率96.37%），在抽取式问答和命名实体识别上具有竞争力，但在自然语言推断上略逊于基线，尽管仅使用消费级硬件训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练的Transformer编码器（如AraBERT、MARBERT、CAMeLBERT）已成为阿拉伯语NLU的标准骨干，但其自注意力机制的计算复杂度随序列长度呈二次方增长，在长文档处理上效率受限。Mamba作为选择性状态空间模型（SSM）提供了一种线性时间序列建模的竞争性替代方案，但目前尚不存在专门为阿拉伯语预训练的双向Mamba编码器。

Method: 作者提出AraSSM，一个双向Mamba编码器。该模型通过掩码语言建模任务进行预训练，训练语料结合了阿拉伯语维基百科和CulturaX文本。训练在四块消费级NVIDIA RTX 2080Ti GPU（11GB显存）上端到端进行，耗时约10天。评估遵循AraBERT引入的每任务评估协议，在四个阿拉伯语NLU基准上进行微调，并使用三个微调种子的均值±标准差报告结果。

Result: 在HARD情感分类上，AraSSM达到96.37%±0.03%的准确率，匹配或超过现有基础规模Transformer基线；在ARCD抽取式问答上达到32.19±1.07的EM和63.79±0.25的F1，具有竞争力；在ANERcorp命名实体识别上达到81.54±0.30的实体级F1，同样具有竞争力；但在XNLI-ar自然语言推断上为72.83±0.07%的准确率，落后于基础规模Transformer基线范围。

Conclusion: AraSSM证明了在消费级硬件上从头训练一个有效的双向Mamba阿拉伯语编码器的可行性，在多个NLU任务上能够匹配或接近Transformer基线的性能。尽管在自然语言推断任务上仍有差距，但考虑到其训练资源仅为四块消费级GPU，整体结果令人鼓舞，为阿拉伯语NLU提供了除Transformer之外的高效替代方案。

Abstract: Pretrained Transformer encoders such as AraBERT, MARBERT, and CAMeLBERT have become the standard backbone for Arabic natural language understanding, but their self-attention mechanism scales quadratically with sequence length, which limits efficiency on long documents. Mamba, a selective state-space model (SSM), offers linear-time sequence modeling as a competitive alternative to attention, yet no dedicated bidirectional Mamba encoder pretrained specifically for Arabic currently exists. We introduce AraSSM, a bidirectional Mamba encoder pretrained via masked language modeling on a corpus combining Arabic Wikipedia and CulturaX text, trained end-to-end on four consumer-grade NVIDIA RTX 2080Ti GPUs (11GB) over approximately ten days. We evaluate AraSSM by fine-tuning on four established Arabic NLU benchmarks covering sentiment classification (HARD), named entity recognition (ANERcorp), extractive question answering (ARCD), and natural language inference (XNLI-ar), following the per-task evaluation protocol introduced by AraBERT, and report results as mean +/- standard deviation across three fine-tuning seeds. AraSSM matches or exceeds published base-sized Transformer baselines on sentiment classification (96.37 +/- 0.03% accuracy on HARD), is competitive on extractive QA (32.19 +/- 1.07 EM, 63.79 +/- 0.25 F1 on ARCD) and named entity recognition (81.54 +/- 0.30 entity-level F1 on ANERcorp), and trails the base-sized Transformer range on natural language inference (72.83 +/- 0.07% accuracy on XNLI-ar), despite being trained entirely from scratch on consumer hardware rather than large-scale accelerator clusters.

</details>


### [294] [Enhancing Scientific Named Entity Recognition via Large Language Models: A Type-driven Multi-task Learning Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08636)
*Tong Bao,Yi Zhao,Heng Zhang,Chengzhi Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出TdSciNER，一种类型驱动的科学命名实体识别方法，通过实体类型过滤模型、多任务辅助分类和基于句子相似度与类型多样性的示例选择策略，有效利用候选实体类型信息提升LLM在科学文本中的NER性能，在三个数据集上达到与全监督模型相当的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在科学NER中虽然展现出潜力，但当提示中包含过多候选实体类型时，模型难以准确识别和标注实体，因为科学领域的实体类型比通用领域更复杂。现有研究虽然强调候选实体类型信息的重要性，但未解决类型过多带来的性能下降问题。

Method: TdSciNER包含三个核心组件：(1)实体类型过滤模型，用于识别句子中最可能出现的实体类型；(2)多任务学习框架，引入辅助的多类别实体类型分类任务以获得更丰富的上下文表示；(3)基于句子相似度和实体类型多样性的新颖示例选择策略，激活LLM的上下文学习能力。

Result: 在三个数据集上的实验表明，TdSciNER达到了与全监督模型相当的性能。进一步的消融分析验证了每个类型驱动组件都对SciNER性能提升有所贡献。

Conclusion: 本文证明了类型驱动方法能有效解决LLM在科学NER中因候选类型过多导致的性能退化问题，为科学文本挖掘中的NER及更广泛的信息抽取任务提供了有价值的见解。

Abstract: Scientific named entity recognition (SciNER) plays a crucial role in information extraction and knowledge discovery from scientific texts. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated the capacity to achieve competitive SciNER performance with minimal human effort. Existing research highlights the importance of incorporating candidate entity type information for accurate entity recognition and classification by LLMs. However, when too many candidate entity types are provided in the prompt, LLMs struggle to accurately recognize and label entities in scientific texts, where entity types are more complex than in general domains. To address this challenge, we propose TdSciNER, a type-driven approach that effectively leverages entity type information to enhance SciNER performance. In TdSciNER, we first design an entity type filter model to identify the most likely entity types present in a given sentence. Subsequently, we introduce an auxiliary multi-class entity typing task within a multi-task learning framework alongside SciNER to obtain richer contextual representations. Then, we develop a novel demonstration selection strategy based on sentence similarity and entity type diversity to activate the in-context learning capabilities of LLMs, thereby improving entity recognition accuracy across diverse scientific domains. Experiments on three datasets demonstrate that our method achieves performance comparable to fully supervised models. Further analysis validates that each entity type-driven component in TdSciNER contributes to the improvement of SciNER performance. This work provides valuable insights for future advancements in SciNER and broader information extraction tasks in scientific text mining.

</details>


### [295] [Do Evaluation Metrics Detect Errors in Classical Chinese to English Translations?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08283)
*Osvaldo Quinjica,Eric Bennett,Xinchen Yang,Andrew Schonebaum,Marine Carpuat*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究现有自动评估指标在古文翻译（以文言文到英文为例）中的可靠性。通过基于最小对（minimal pairs）的诊断框架，测试基于参考和免参考的指标对学术应用中关键错误类型的敏感度及其对有效变异的容忍度。发现所有指标都有盲区，但MetricX24总体表现最佳，凸显了为历史和文化特殊翻译场景开发更鲁棒、可解释指标的必要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在历史语言翻译上表现出人意料的好，但缺乏可靠评估方法限制了其在数字人文学科工作流中的实际应用。现有评估指标主要为现代语言设计，其在古文翻译场景中的可靠性未经检验，需要系统诊断。

Method: 以文言文到英文翻译为测试案例，构建基于最小对（minimal pairs）的诊断框架。该框架捕捉学术应用中突出的错误类型，同时分别探测基于参考（reference-based）与免参考（reference-free）指标的两种能力：错误敏感性以及对有效变异（valid variation）的容忍度。

Result: 所有被测试的自动评估指标均存在盲区（blind spots），未能完全可靠地评估古文翻译质量。其中MetricX24在所有指标中表现最佳。

Conclusion: 现有自动评估指标不足以可靠支撑古文到现代语言的翻译评估，需要开发更鲁棒且可解释的指标，以适应历史和文化上具有特殊性的翻译场景。

Abstract: Although large language models can translate some historical languages surprisingly well, their usefulness in digital humanities workflows is limited by the lack of reliable evaluation. We investigate whether existing automatic evaluation metrics developed for modern languages are reliable in this setting, using translation from Classical Chinese to English as a test case. We introduce a diagnostic framework based on minimal pairs capturing error types salient in scholarly use, probing both reference-based and reference-free metrics for error sensitivity and tolerance to valid variation. We find that all metrics exhibit blind spots, however MetricX24 performs best overall. Our findings highlight the need for more robust and interpretable metrics for historically and culturally distinct translation settings.

</details>


### [296] [Safety Cost of Steering Vectors Is Separable and Reducible](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08383)
*Yuxiao Li,Gjergji Kasneci*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种后处理方法，通过识别并移除转向向量中可分离的、破坏模型安全机制但几乎不贡献转向目标的成分，来缓解转向向量导致的LLM安全性能下降问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 转向向量是一种轻量级的LLM行为控制工具，但已有证据表明它可能意外地削弱模型的安全机制，增加对有害请求的遵从度，而目前缺乏有效的缓解方法。

Method: 将移除安全破坏成分的任务建模为约束优化问题，采用原始-对偶更新求解，约束条件包括保持预期的转向效果和限制假阳性拒绝。优化过程恢复一个单一方向，将其从转向向量中消融即可恢复模型安全性。

Result: 在多个模型、转向行为和攻击套件（包括未见过的攻击类型）上，该方法显著降低了转向导致的安全退化，同时保持了原有的转向效果，且对假阳性拒绝影响极小。

Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种后验修正转向向量安全代价的方案，更广泛地，它为在激活层面进行模型干预而不付出安全代价提供了一般性思路。

Abstract: Steering vectors are a lightweight tool for controlling LLM behavior. However, emerging evidence shows that steering vectors can unintentionally compromise a model's safety mechanisms and increase compliance with harmful requests, while no effective mitigation yet exists. In this work, we show that this safety degradation arises from a separable component in the vector that disrupts the model's safety mechanisms but contributes little to the steering objective. We identify and remove this safety-degrading component, formulating the task as a constrained optimization problem solved through primal-dual updates, subject to preserving the intended steering effect and bounding false refusal. The resulting solution is both interpretable and surgical: the optimization recovers a single direction whose ablation from the steering vector restores model safety with minimal utility cost. Across models, steering behaviors, and attack suites, including unseen attacks types, our method substantially reduces steering-induced safety degradation while preserving the original steering effect with minimal impact on false refusal. Our method offers a post-hoc correction to steering vectors that mitigates their safety cost, and more broadly, it provides a general recipe for applying activation-level model interventions without paying a safety tax.

</details>


### [297] [Hidden Language Consistency Phenomena in Reasoning LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08447)
*Muhammad Ali Shafique,Kelly Marchisio*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过PolyMath基准（8种语言、4个难度级别）系统研究了多语言推理模型在任务难度、准确率、思维语言一致性和回答语言一致性之间的关系，发现了语言一致性崩溃效应、难度导致的语言切换现象以及量化方法对语言一致性的独立影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多语言推理模型的评估仅关注答案是否正确，忽略了推理和回答过程中是否保持预期语言。随着任务难度增加，模型可能切换语言，而这一重要行为在现有评估体系中被掩盖，无法全面刻画模型的多语言能力。

Method: 使用PolyMath基准数据集，涵盖8种语言和4个难度级别，对推理模型进行系统评估，测量四个关键指标：任务难度、任务准确率、思维语言一致性（TC）和回答语言一致性（AC），并探索语言一致性与难度之间的四类行为模式，同时评估量化方法（GPTQ、AWQ、AutoRound）的影响。

Result: 发现四个关键结果：（1）语言一致性在难度增加时呈现四种不同行为模式；（2）识别出"语言一致性崩溃效应"，即难度增加导致输出语言一致性骤降，尤其在低资源和非拉丁字母语言中明显；（3）语言崩溃可伴随准确率保持甚至提升，因为模型切换到其内部主导语言；（4）量化对语言一致性的影响独立于其对准确率的影响，GPTQ和AWQ在容差投票（ε=1.0）下通常优于AutoRound。

Conclusion: 多语言能力不能仅用准确率来表征，可靠的多语言基准评估应联合考虑任务准确率、语言一致性和任务难度三个维度。

Abstract: Multilingual reasoning models are commonly evaluated by whether they arrive at the correct answer, but not by whether they preserve the intended language while reasoning and responding. This omission conceals important multilingual behaviors that emerge as tasks become harder. In this paper, we study task difficulty, task accuracy, thinking-language consistency (TC), and answer-language consistency (AC) across reasoning models using PolyMath benchmark in eight languages and four difficulty levels. We uncover four findings: (1) language consistency exhibits four difficulty-dependent behaviors: output-language consistency remains aligned with input, remains misaligned, degrades gradually, or collapses abruptly. (2) We identify the language consistency breakdown effect, where increasing difficulty can cause a sudden drop in output-language consistency, especially in less strongly represented and non-Latin-script languages. (3) Due to this breakdown effect, accuracy can be preserved or even improved at a harder difficulty level as the model shifts to its internal dominant language. (4) Quantization can improve or degrade output-language consistency independently of its effect on accuracy, with GPTQ and AWQ often outperforming AutoRound under tolerance-based voting with ε = 1.0. These results show that multilingual capability cannot be characterized by accuracy alone; reliable evaluation should jointly consider task accuracy, language consistency, and task difficulty for multilingual benchmarks.

</details>


### [298] [Temporal Misgrounding in Legal RAG: A Versioned-Corpus Benchmark for French Tax Law](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09393)
*Rose Cymbler,Daniel Guez,Laurent Fabre*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文首次系统性地识别并量化了法律RAG中的"时间错位"（temporal misgrounding）问题——即检索和引用法律条文的现行版本而忽略其适用版本。作者构建了FiscalQA Pro基准（法国税法32,436个条文版本，覆盖1938-2031年）和209道时间推理题目，发现标准闭卷和静态RAG的严格准确率仅3.0%和2.7%，而基于多版本索引端到端检索器可达98.3%严格准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准法律RAG将语料视为静态的，但在真实法律问答中，法律条文随时间演变，回答问题时必须检索适用时间版本。现有模型和系统普遍忽视这一时间维度，导致系统性检索和引用错误版本的法律条文（temporal misgrounding），且目前缺乏量化和基准化该问题的系统方法。

Method: 构建FiscalQA Pro：版本化语料库（法国税法32,436条文版本，93年跨度）+ 全模型难度的时间推理基准（209道专家审核题目，跨越33个CGI条文）。评分采用确定性原子"nugget"匹配（正则和数值容差），避免LLM-as-judge（因其会继承时间偏差）。同时提出端到端多版本索引检索器，并发布69,208条版本感知判例链接数据集。

Result: 闭卷参数知识平均严格准确率3.0%（11个模型）；静态当前版本RAG为2.7%，检索到适用版本的成功率为0%；而端到端多版本检索器达到98.3%平均严格准确率，oracle文章消融实验达99.1%，剩余差距主要在首阶段召回而非版本选择。

Conclusion: 法律问答本质上是时间索引的检索问题，标准静态RAG在时间敏感场景下完全失效。多版本索引的检索方案可有效解决temporal misgrounding，达到接近完美的准确率。本文揭示了现有法律AI系统在时间推理上的系统性缺陷，并提供了完整的评估资源和解决方案。

Abstract: We identify and quantify temporal misgrounding: the systematic retrieval and citation of the currently in-force version of a legal article when the applicable version is an earlier or future one. Standard legal RAG treats the corpus as static; we argue legal question answering is a temporally-indexed retrieval problem. We introduce FiscalQA Pro, pairing a versioned corpus of 32,436 article-versions of the French tax code (93 years, 1938-2031) with an all-model-hard temporal-reasoning track: 209 scored, expert-reviewed questions across 33 CGI articles (221 released; twelve flagged out of the answerable scope). At selection time, no evaluated model recovered its date-applicable answer closed-book in any of four sampling draws, and the currently in-force text lacks the gold value for all but one of the scored questions. Answers are scored deterministically via atomic ground-truth "nuggets" (regex and numeric-with-tolerance), never LLM-as-judge: an LLM judge would inherit the temporal bias it is meant to score. Across eleven models (five frontier closed-API systems plus Gemini 2.5 Pro as a substitute entry, and five open-weight), parametric knowledge yields 3.0% mean strict accuracy and RAG over a static current-version corpus 2.7%. Static RAG retrieves the date-applicable version 0% of the time, confidently citing a real but inapplicable version. Our end-to-end retriever over a multi-version index, with no oracle, reaches 98.3% mean strict; an oracle-article ablation reaches 99.1%, locating the residual gap in first-stage recall, not version selection. We additionally release a version-aware jurisprudence dataset of 69,208 citation links, together with the corpus, benchmark, model responses, and pipeline code.

</details>


### [299] [Calling the Bluff: Detecting Ever-Shifting Harmful Chat Dialogue via Ordered Reasoning Chain Regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08451)
*Haojie Yu,Ziyou Jiang,Junjie Wang,Mingyang Li,Yuekai Huang,Jie Huang,Qing Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出BRACE框架，基于有害对话中不变的"有序推理链"(ORC)原理，将其编码为四个可微阶段（主题→指标→严重性→类型），结合原型特征增强和特征路径解耦，实现对不断变化的有害对话进行高准确率的类型识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 有害聊天对话通过类型转换和词汇规避不断演变，传统的基于固定词汇特征的方法难以捕捉其本质。作者发现尽管表面词汇频繁变化，但有害对话共享不变的原则（ORC），即重复主题、危害语言指标、严重性层级和类型特征的有序推理链，这为识别动态变化的有害内容提供了新的契机。

Method: BRACE将ORC编码为四个可微阶段（Topic -> Indicator -> Severity -> Type），每个阶段均有中间监督，作为与直接预测头融合的结构化正则器；同时采用基于原型（prototype）的特征增强和特征路径解耦技术来支持模型训练。

Result: 在4个领域和5种危害类别上，BRACE取得0.934的有害类型宏F1（RoBERTa-wwm-ext，三种子均值），使用解码器骨干（Qwen3-1.7B LoRA）达到0.949。消融实验表明所有组件均有贡献，ORC的结构分解使BRACE能够区分具有语义模糊性的有害类型。

Conclusion: BRACE通过将不变的ORC原理结构化地融入模型设计中，有效应对有害对话的词汇动态变化挑战，并在多个领域和模型中展现出优异性能，其结构化解耦策略尤其有助于区分语义模糊的有害类别。

Abstract: Harmful chat dialogues are ever-shifting through type-shifting and lexical evasion, yet we find they share invariant principles, i.e., an Ordered Reasoning Chain (ORC) of recurring topics, harm language indicators, severity hierarchies, and type characteristics, which can help us capture the key information in the frequently changing lexical expressions. We propose BRACE, which encodes the ORC as four differentiable stages (Topic -> Indicator -> Severity -> Type) with intermediate supervision, serving as a structured regularizer blended with direct heads, and supported by prototype-based feature augmentation and feature path disentanglement. The evaluation results show that, across 4 domains and 5 harm categories, BRACE achieves harm-type macro F1 of 0.934 (RoBERTa-wwm-ext, 3-seed mean), with decoder backbones (Qwen3-1.7B LoRA) reaching 0.949. Ablation studies show that all components contribute to BRACE, and the structural decomposition of ORC enables BRACE to distinguish harmful types with semantic ambiguity. Disclaimer: This paper may contain content that is disturbing to some readers.

</details>


### [300] [SWE-Bench ProMax: Benchmarking Agents on Large-Scale Multilingual Code Refactoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09802)
*Yuling Shi,Jinghan Xu,Kelin Fu,Wenhao Zeng,Shilin He,Lei Zhang,Yue Liu,Zelin Zhao,Terry Yue Zhuo,Jialun Cao,Siyu Ye,Tianyu Liu,Kai Cai,Shing-Chi Cheung,Xiaodong Gu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了SWE-Bench ProMax，一个专家精选的多语言代码重构基准，包含170个来自七个编程语言的真实提交实例。该基准通过严格的多个阶段筛选解决现有基准的质量问题（如缺陷测试和训练数据泄露），每个实例平均涉及11.4个文件和261.6行代码。实验表明最佳前沿模型仅达到41.2%的解决率，证实该基准对当前AI编码代理构成有意义且未饱和的挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI编码代理基准（如SWE-bench Verified）正迅速饱和，且最近审计发现约60%未解决实例存在缺陷测试，前沿模型还能从训练数据中原样复现gold patches。代码重构需要跨多文件的协调、行为保持性修改，是更困难且更现实的代理能力测试，但现有基准对此覆盖不足。

Method: 构建了包含170个实例的多语言重构基准：1) 从Python、Java、TypeScript、Go、C、C++和Rust的真实提交中提取；2) 采用多阶段严格筛选，从零重写问题描述以提供精确无歧义的规格说明；3) 人工审阅测试套件，移除过窄和过宽的测试；4) 过滤掉复杂度不足或跨文件范围有限的实例。每个实例平均修改11.4个文件和261.6行代码，规模远超现有基准。

Result: 在两种代理脚手架下对前沿模型进行实验，最佳模型仅达到41.2%的解决率，证明SWE-Bench ProMax对当前AI编码代理构成有意义且未饱和的挑战。基准已公开在Hugging Face上。

Conclusion: SWE-Bench ProMax通过严格筛选和质量控制，提供了一个规模更大、难度更高、更接近真实场景的代码重构基准，有效解决了现有基准的饱和与质量缺陷问题，为评估下一代AI编码代理提供了可靠的测试平台。

Abstract: As AI coding agents take on increasingly complex, long-horizon software engineering tasks, existing benchmarks are rapidly saturating and their evaluation quality has come under serious scrutiny: a recent audit found that nearly 60% of unsolved SWE-bench Verified instances contain flawed tests -- either overly narrow tests that reject correct solutions or overly broad tests that check unstated requirements -- and that frontier models can verbatim reproduce gold patches from training data. Code refactoring, which requires coordinated, behavior-preserving changes across many files, offers a substantially harder and more realistic test of agent capability, yet remains underserved by current benchmarks. We introduce SWE-Bench ProMax, an expert-curated, multilingual code refactoring benchmark of 170 instances drawn from real commits across seven programming languages (Python, Java, TypeScript, Go, C, C++, and Rust). Every instance undergoes rigorous, multi-stage curation that directly addresses the quality problems identified in prior benchmarks: issue descriptions are rewritten from scratch to provide precise, unambiguous specifications, and test suites are manually reviewed to remove overly narrow and overly broad tests. Tasks with insufficient complexity or limited cross-file scope are filtered out, yielding a benchmark of challenging, large-scale refactoring tasks that average 11.4 modified files and 261.6 lines of code per instance, substantially exceeding the scale of existing benchmarks. Experiments with frontier models under two agent scaffolds show that the best model achieves only 41.2% resolve rate, confirming that SWE-Bench ProMax presents a meaningful and unsaturated challenge for current AI coding agents. Our benchmark is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/swe-bench-promax/SWE-Bench-ProMax.

</details>


### [301] [Beyond Tables: Doc2DB-Bench for Relationally Faithful Document-to-Database Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08459)
*Zhuowen Liang,Zhengxuan Zhang,Jiayang Wang,Jiazhuo Chen,Nan Tang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Doc2DB-Bench是一个用于评估大语言模型将长文档转化为关系数据库能力的基准测试，包含203个长文档实例、42个模式、7个领域组，共计117个实体表、132个关系表、7,341行和41,935个单元格，通过可控的DB-to-Doc合成流水线生成，并经真实性验证与真实文档不可区分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Document-to-Table基准不足以满足实际AI系统需求，因为将证据扁平化为单表会重复实体、模糊多对多关系、产生稀疏记录，且无法检验提取的事实是否构成有效的数据库实例。实际工作流（如金融、医疗、企业运营等）依赖规范化模式、实体身份、键、跨表关系和完整性约束。

Method: 提出Doc2DB-Bench基准，包含203个长文档实例、42个模式和7个领域组，通过可控的DB-to-Doc合成流水线构建，按表内提取和表间推理的分类法组织，并对生成文档进行真实性验证。

Result: Doc2DB-Bench包含117个实体表、132个关系表、7,341行和41,935个单元格；生成的文档通过真实性验证，被证明与真实世界参考文档不可区分。

Conclusion: Doc2DB-Bench为可靠的、可审计的、关系上忠实的LLM数据系统提供了测试平台，将文档理解评估从字段提取范式推进到数据库构建范式。

Abstract: Practical AI systems increasingly need to turn long, heterogeneous documents into queryable relational databases, not isolated spreadsheets. In domains such as finance, healthcare, education, transportation, and enterprise operations, downstream workflows rely on normalized schemas, entity identities, keys, cross-table relationships, and integrity constraints for analytics, compliance, auditing, and SQL-backed decision making. Existing Document-to-Table benchmarks are insufficient for this setting: flattening evidence into single tables can duplicate entities, obscure many-to-many relationships, create sparse records, and avoid testing whether extracted facts form a valid database instance. This creates an urgent need to evaluate document understanding as database construction rather than field extraction. We introduce Doc2DB-Bench, a benchmark for Document-to-Database construction, containing 203 long-document instances across 42 schemas and seven domain groups, with 117 entity tables, 132 relationship tables, 7,341 rows, and 41,935 cells. Built through a controllable DB-to-Doc synthesis pipeline and organized by a taxonomy of intra-table extraction and inter-table reasoning, the generated documents undergo authenticity verification, proving indistinguishable from real-world references. Doc2DB-Bench thus provides a testbed for reliable, auditable, and relationally faithful LLM-based data systems. The benchmark is publicly available at https://github.com/SetonLiang/Doc2DB-Bench.

</details>


### [302] [VectraYX-Vision-1B: A Sub-2B Spanish/LATAM Cybersecurity Vision-Language Model with Structured Visual Reasoning and Native Tool Use](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08477)
*Juan S. Santillana*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍VectraYX-Vision-1B，一个针对西班牙语/拉美网络安全图像的子2B参数视觉语言模型，结合冻结的SigLIP-so400m编码器和1.04B西班牙语安全解码器，支持结构化推理、工具调用和离线部署。但初步视觉定位结果近乎为零（B6得分0.08），模型忽略图像内容，作者报告了这一负面结果并给出修复方案，同时提出3种变异的消融矩阵研究NoPE层的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络安全领域缺乏面向西班牙语/拉美地区的视觉语言模型，现有的VLM通常规模较大且主要支持英语，难以部署在气隙隔离环境中。作者旨在构建一个轻量级（<2B）的专用VLM，能够理解IDA、Ghidra、Wireshark等安全工具的界面图像，并用西班牙语回答。

Method: 使用MLP将冻结的SigLIP-so400m视觉编码器与1.04B参数的西班牙语/拉美安全解码器连接。模型通过原生<|think|>标记进行结构化推理，通过Model Context Protocol调用工具，并导出为llama.cpp的LLaVA mmproj格式以支持离线部署。同时设计了3种位置编码变体的消融矩阵（V0: NoPE-every-4, V1: all-RoPE, V2: NoPE+学习式2D）来研究周期性无位置编码层对729个视觉token注意力机制的影响。

Result: 视觉SFT训练（400-1900步，约16M tokens）后的初步视觉定位结果接近零：工具识别准确率仅0.08，模型基本忽略图像内容。作者识别出一个检查点加载器bug（未去除llm.前缀）可能被误认为训练崩溃。同时提供了文本骨干网的B1-B5分数、文本对照实验、初步B6/B7分数、运行时间、GGUF CPU效率以及跨10个领域的14,596个QA对数据集。

Conclusion: 作者透明地报告了视觉接地失败的负面结果，提出修复方案（更长的SFT、至少60%的重放、更低的学习率），并公开所有代码、配置和权重以优先确立这一架构问题的研究权。核心贡献在于发布一个负面的初步结果和系统的消融框架，而非声称视觉定位成功。

Abstract: We present VectraYX-Vision-1B, a sub-2B vision-language model (VLM) for Spanish/LATAM cybersecurity imagery, coupling a frozen SigLIP-so400m encoder to a 1.04B Spanish/LATAM security decoder via an MLP.
