To address this, our core insight is that robust cognitive search requires a specific confidence trajectory pattern: such methods perform exploratory branching at the beginning, as manifested by low initial confidence, and converge to a high final confidence solution. To implement this insight, we introduce consilience, a novel selection framework that explicitly evaluates the temporal asymmetry of confidence in reasoning. We operationalize this via a combinatorial metric that actively penalizes high initial confidence while strictly demanding final certainty. Extensive experiments covering both graduate-level mathematics problems and free-form code generation demonstrate that consilience effectively outperforms existing baselines, validating our novel perspective on completion confidence.

</details>


### [369] [Decoding-Level Taboo: A Diagnostic Stress Test for LLM Robustness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09900)
*Tadanobu Chuyo Kamijo,Ori Rottenstreich,Javier Conde,Gonzalo Martínez,Pedro Reviriego*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Decoding-Level Taboo，一种零提示的诊断性压力测试方法，通过在运行时直接在logit空间动态屏蔽主要候选token，迫使大语言模型偏离其名义（nominal）生成路径，从而评估模型在真实部署场景下的离路径鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统大语言模型评估只关注名义条件下的性能，忽视了真实部署中系统提示、安全护栏和结构性约束会迫使模型偏离其高度优化的生成路径，导致基准分数与部署性能之间存在偏差。

Method: Taboo是一种零提示诊断压力测试，在解码层面直接在logit空间干预，在词边界动态屏蔽主要候选token，迫使模型进行迂回表述（circumlocution），从而检验模型的离路径鲁棒性。

Result: 在多个开源权重模型家族上的评估表明，离路径鲁棒性受参数规模和事后指令对齐的显著影响，鲁棒性通常随模型规模和对齐程度提高而改善。

Conclusion: Taboo不仅是一种诊断工具，还提供了一种新颖的原语，可用于生成多样化合成数据集、压力测试运行时安全护栏，以及在实际部署前审计模型可靠性。

Abstract: Large language model evaluations typically focus on performance under nominal conditions, creating an illusion of capability where models comfortably walk a narrow, highly optimized generation corridor. In real-world deployments, however, complex system prompts, safety guardrails, and structural constraints continuously force models off this nominal path, driving a divergence between benchmark scores and deployment performance. To address this issue, we introduce Decoding-Level Taboo, a zero-prompt diagnostic stress test that intervenes directly in logit space at runtime, forcing models out of their nominal paths. By dynamically masking primary candidate tokens at word boundaries, Taboo forces machine circumlocution.
  Evaluating Taboo across several open-weight model families reveals that off-path robustness is heavily influenced by both parameter scale and post-training instruction alignment, with robustness generally improving with model size and alignment. Beyond the results presented in this paper, Taboo provides a novel primitive for generating diverse synthetic datasets, stress-testing runtime safety guardrails, and auditing model reliability prior to real-world deployment.

</details>


### [370] [From Values to Benchmarks: Evaluating Large Language Models for Governmental Use in Dutch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09925)
*Laurens Samson,Iva Gornishka,Gossa Lô,Yuki M. Asano,Sennay Ghebreab*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了"Grip on LLMs"评估框架，这是一个针对荷兰政府使用的系统性评估套件，与荷兰市政组织领域专家合作开发。通过顾问委员会、用户研究和公民聊天机器人用户调查，确定了六个评估维度（事实性、诚实性、社会偏见、能源消耗、成本和训练数据透明度），并在30多个多语言和荷兰语特定模型上进行了基准测试。研究发现没有单一模型在所有维度都表现出色，质量提升必然伴随更高的环境影响和成本，而偏见几乎独立于这两者。此外，事实性和诚实性由不同属性决定，高事实性并不意味高诚实性。研究者发布了面向非技术受众的公开模型概览。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型越来越多地被部署在政府环境中，但现有评估框架很少同时反映公共行政的价值观和非英语语境的语言要求。荷兰政府在使用LLM时缺乏系统性的评估工具，需要一套结合公共行政价值与荷兰语语言要求的评估框架。

Method: 通过与荷兰主要市政组织的领域专家合作，采用顾问委员会流程、用户研究和公务员聊天机器人用户调查来确定六个评估维度，并将这些维度操作化为基准套件，在30多个多语言和荷兰语特定模型上进行评估。

Result: 没有单一模型在所有维度上都表现优异，维度间存在不可避免的权衡：更高质量总是带来更大的环境影响和财务成本，而偏见则几乎独立于质量和成本。事实性和诚实性由不同属性决定，高事实性不意味着高诚实性。研究者发布了面向非技术受众的公开模型概览。

Conclusion: 政府LLM选择需要在多个维度间进行权衡，不能依赖单一模型。事实性与诚实性是独立的属性，都需要分别评估。为了惠及政府LLM选择中的各类利益相关者（从工程师到政策制定者），应提供用户友好的模型概览工具。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly being deployed in governmental settings, yet few existing evaluation frameworks jointly reflect the values of public administration and the linguistic requirements of non-English contexts. We present the "Grip on LLMs" framework, a systematic evaluation suite for Dutch governmental use developed in collaboration with domain experts from a major Dutch municipal organisation. Through an advisory board process, user research, and a survey of the users of a civil-servant chatbot, we identify six evaluation dimensions (factuality, honesty, social bias, energy consumption, cost, and training data transparency) and operationalise them into a benchmark suite covering more than 30 multilingual and Dutch-specific models. Our results reveal that no single model excels across all dimensions, and that trade-offs are unavoidable: higher quality consistently comes at greater environmental impact and financial cost, while bias remains largely independent of both. We further find that factuality (whether a model answers correctly) and honesty (whether a model acknowledges what it does not know) are governed by distinct properties, with high factuality not implying high honesty. To make these findings actionable for non-technical audiences, we release a publicly accessible, user-friendly model overview designed for the full range of stakeholders involved in governmental LLM selection, from engineers to policymakers.

</details>


<div id='cs.GT'></div>

# cs.GT [[Back]](#toc)

### [371] [EBGT: Epistemology-aided Bayesian Game Theory for Uplink Power Control in Stochastically Distributed IoT Tiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07745)
*Nirmal D. Wickramasinghe,Indrakshi Dey,Dirk Pesch,John Dooley*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文提出EBGT，一种基于认知论与贝叶斯博弈的统一框架，用于稀疏分布式IoT网络中分散式上行功率最小化。通过PPP建模空间随机干扰，利用双层信念层级进行设备间推理，无需重复节点间反馈即可达到发射功率均衡，并通过随机几何推导出闭式覆盖概率收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 密集异构IoT网络中的上行功率控制在信息不完整CSI和互干扰条件下受到根本限制，而低SWaP设备无法承担传统分布式方案所需的反馈与计算开销，因此需要无需频繁反馈的分散式功率控制方法。

Method: 1) 将干扰用户建模为PPP空间随机过程；2) 构建两层信念层级——关于对手的互认知信念与自我评估的内认知信念；3) 通过随机几何推导闭式覆盖概率收益函数；4) 利用Jensen-Shannon散度量化信念向均衡的收敛；5) 达到无需反复节点间反馈的发射功率均衡。

Result: 蒙特卡洛仿真验证了解析覆盖表达式，表明EBGT在维持目标覆盖概率的同时，相较固定功率控制(FPC)和随机非合作功率控制(SNCPC)基线减少了发射功率，尤其在严格SINR和高密度场景下优势显著。

Conclusion: EBGT框架证明了在缺乏完整CSI和高密度干扰条件下，通过认知辅助的贝叶斯博弈推理可以在无需反复反馈的情况下实现近似最优的低功率传输，为资源受限IoT设备提供了一种可行的分散式功率控制方案。

Abstract: Uplink power control in dense, heterogeneous Internet-of-Things (IoT) tiers is fundamentally limited by incomplete channel-state information (CSI) and mutual interference, while low size, weight, and power (SWaP) devices cannot afford the feedback and computation of conventional distributed schemes. This paper proposes EBGT, an epistemology-aided Bayesian game-theoretic framework for decentralized uplink power minimization in stochastically distributed IoT networks. Interfering users are modeled as spatially random through a Poisson point process (PPP), and each device reasons about its rivals through a two-layer belief hierarchy of inter-epistemic beliefs about opponents and intra-epistemic self-assessment, so that the transmit-power equilibrium is reached without repeated inter-node feedback. We derive a closed-form coverage-probability payoff via stochastic geometry and quantify belief convergence toward equilibrium using the Jensen--Shannon divergence (JSD) of the resulting power distributions. Monte-Carlo simulations validate the analytical coverage expressions and show that EBGT sustains the target coverage probability while reducing transmit power relative to fixed power control (FPC) and stochastic non-cooperative power control (SNCPC) baselines, particularly under stringent SINR and high-density regimes.

</details>


### [372] [Indirect Geoeconomic Influence: A Switching Dynamical Systems Framework for Mechanism Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07940)
*Nikolos Gurney,Boxi Fu,Soham Hans,Volkan Ustun*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个形式化框架来分析间接地缘经济影响力。与直接施压不同，发送国通过重构目标国的内部政治经济结构，让目标国自身公民、企业和机构产生服从压力。框架基于切换动力系统(SDS)，分析宽容模式(permissive)和争议模式(contested)两种运行状态，并通过设计切换向量和组合优化来寻找高性能机制原型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统地缘经济影响研究通常关注直接施压，但现实中存在一种更隐蔽、更持久的影响力形式——发送国并不直接改变目标国政策，而是通过重构目标国的内部政治经济结构，使其自身的社会力量产生服从压力。作者希望建立严格的数学框架来分析和设计这类间接影响力机制。

Method: 采用切换动力系统(SDS)建模目标国政治经济随模式依赖规则的演化。定义两种模式：宽容模式(permissive)下机制有效传压；争议模式(contested)下目标国已检测并归因该机制。核心创新是反转传统体制切换问题——不求估计潜在转移核，而是由设计者主动构造转移核以控制规划期内模式占用。通过结构化切换向量沿离散设计维度分解机制，用组合优化器搜索高性能原型，并计算模式条件均衡及可信度、可见度的比较静态分析。

Result: 推导了模式条件均衡，给出可信度和可见度的比较静态结果，证明可见度惩罚受政府渠道显著性的缩放，并与机制成本归宿相互作用。通过两个简化机制示例、降维切换空间的仿真验证，以及小规模盲审实验验证了可选的LM生成阶段。

Conclusion: 该框架为间接地缘经济影响力提供了形式化的分析基础，将机制设计从被动估计转向主动工程，揭示了可见度惩罚与政府渠道显著性及成本归宿之间的耦合关系，为后续研究提供了可扩展的分析工具。

Abstract: We develop a formal framework for analyzing indirect geoeconomic influence. The influencing state (sender) does not attempt to change a target nation's policy directly. Instead, the sender restructures the target's internal political economy so that its own citizens, firms, and institutions generate the compliance pressure. The framework rests on a switching dynamical system (SDS) in which a target's political economy evolves under mode-dependent rules. We analyze two modes: a permissive mode, in which a mechanism transmits pressure toward the sender's preferred policy, and a contested mode, entered naturally once the target detects and attributes the mechanism. Crucially, the sender's mechanism design shapes the transition into the contested mode rather than paying a static toll for legibility. This inverts the usual regime-switching problem: rather than estimating a latent transition kernel from data, the designer engineers the kernel to steer regime occupancy over a planning horizon. A structured switch vector decomposes any mechanism along discrete design dimensions, and a combinatorial optimizer searches this space for high-performing archetypes scored on compliance, time-to-threshold, and a durability ratio. We characterize mode-conditional equilibria and derive comparative statics on credibility and legibility, showing that the legibility penalty is scaled by the salience of the government channel and therefore interacts with the mechanism's cost incidence. We illustrate the framework with two stylized mechanisms, report a proof-of-concept simulation over a reduced switch space, and report a small blind-audit study of the pipeline's optional language-model generation stage.

</details>


### [373] [Existence and computation of monomial families of near-optimal strategies for recursive games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08017)
*Peter Bro Miltersen*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文针对Everett意义上的有限递归博弈，给出了Frederiksen和Miltersen正则性定理的一个新的初等证明。该定理表明，对于所有足够小的epsilon，两个玩家都存在可被有限个单项式编码的平稳epsilon-最优策略。作者的方法不依赖半代数选择和Puiseux级数，而是通过有向森林多项式和整数权向量来压缩渐近阶。此外，对于具有固定N个活动状态的有理博弈，作者提出了一个确定性的多项式时间算法，能以单个有序实单变量表示精确计算单项式族。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Frederiksen和Miltersen证明了递归博弈中平稳epsilon-最优策略可被有限单项式编码的正则性定理，但其证明依赖半代数选择和Puiseux级数等较重工具。作者希望提供一个更初等、更直接的新证明，并进一步实现算法的确定性多项式时间计算，以便实际构造这些策略。

Method: 证明从Everett单侧区域中保证向量接近值的平稳策略出发，固定其支撑后，将每个纯平稳应对的吸收概率表示为具有非负系数和公共正分母的有向森林多项式之商。每个收益是这些商的固定带符号线性组合。作者随后将有限个森林单项式的渐近阶压缩为一个整数权向量，从而在不使用半代数选择和Puiseux级数的情况下完成证明。对于算法部分，利用有序实单变量表示来精确计算所有代数系数。

Result: 给出了正则性定理的初等证明，完全不依赖半代数选择和Puiseux级数。对于固定数量N个活动状态的有理博弈，提出了确定性多项式时间算法，返回精确的单项式族，其表示长度和运行时间至多为L^{(N+1)^{O(N)}}，其中L为输入长度。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了一个更简洁、更直接的递归博弈正则性定理证明路径，同时将理论结果转化为可计算的算法，使得在固定状态数条件下能够在多项式时间内精确构造epsilon-最优策略的单项式编码，具有理论和算法双重价值。

Abstract: In a finite recursive game in the sense of Everett, both players have stationary epsilon-optimal strategies for every epsilon>0. Frederiksen and Miltersen strengthened this result by showing that the strategies for all sufficiently small epsilon can be encoded by finitely many monomials: at every state, all but possibly one of the action probabilities are constants times integer powers of epsilon. The resulting finite symbolic object specifies a strategy for every sufficiently small accuracy. Their proof uses semialgebraic selection and Puiseux series.
  We give an alternative elementary proof of this regularity theorem for recursive games. We start with stationary strategies that guarantee vectors approaching the value through Everett's one-sided region. After fixing their support, we express, for each pure stationary reply, all absorption probabilities as quotients of directed-forest polynomials with nonnegative coefficients and a common positive denominator. Each payoff is a fixed signed linear combination of these quotients. We then compress the asymptotic orders of the finitely many forest monomials into one integer weight vector. This proof uses neither semialgebraic selection nor Puiseux series. Furthermore, for rational games with a fixed number N of active states, we present a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm that computes a monomial family exactly. It returns all algebraic coefficients in one ordered real univariate representation. The representation length and running time are at most L^{(N+1)^{O(N)}}, where L is the input length.

</details>


### [374] [Does a Toehold Make a Bidder Bolder? Preemption and Multiplicity in Multi-Round Takeover Auctions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08407)
*Zain Naboulsi*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文通过将收购竞标建模为多轮升级出价的博弈论游戏，并借助计算机求解器进行可验证求解，发现"先发制人"的威慑效应在单轮模型中成立，但在多轮竞标中消失，从而解释了实践中toehold（预购股权）稀少的原因。同时警示博弈求解器可能因初始值不同而返回不同但同样收敛的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统理论认为toehold有两个作用：一是算术层面让投标人更愿意加价，二是心理层面威慑竞争者退出。但实践中toehold罕见，这一现象长期令人困惑。作者试图检验第二种威慑效应是否在更符合现实的多轮竞标模型中仍然存在。

Method: 将收购竞标建模为多轮逐步升级出价的博弈，而非经典模型中假设的单次交换。将其转化为计算机可解的博弈游戏，并通过可验证的精度标准让仲裁者（referee）检查求解答案的正确性。

Result: 三个主要发现：(1)拍卖决定了toehold持有者的收益但不决定其出价方式——同一竞标既支持激进开局迫使对手放弃，也支持低价开局对决不退让的对手，且两者利润相同；(2)即使完全移除toehold，激进的先发性出价依然出现，说明其源于公开和轮流出价的机制，而非持有股份；(3)"更大的toehold带来更强威慑"的规律只在单轮竞赛中成立，一旦加入真正的第二轮就失效。

Conclusion: 购买toehold的两个理由命运不同：利润理由成立，威慑理由不成立。这解释了为何实践中toehold比理论预测更罕见（模型未纳入披露和价格冲击等程序性成本）。此外，作者警告博弈求解器可能因不同初始起点而返回不同但同样收敛的结果，并报告了哪些求解器能处理此类竞赛（包括规模过大无法枚举的版本）。

Abstract: A bidder can quietly buy a stake in a company before making an offer for it. That stake, a toehold, is supposed to pay for itself twice: it makes the bidder willing to bid harder, and it frightens rivals into staying out of the fight. The first effect is arithmetic. The second is what would justify the cost and exposure of taking one at all. Yet toeholds are rare in practice, a standing puzzle.
  We ask whether that second effect is there once the contest is modelled as several rounds of escalating offers rather than the single exchange classical models assume. We turn it into a game a computer can solve, and certify the answers to an accuracy a referee can check.
  Three findings. The auction fixes what the toehold-holder earns but not how it bids: the same contest supports a bidder who opens aggressively against a rival who folds, and one who opens cheaply against a rival who does not, with the same profit either way. Aggressive preemptive bidding still appears when the toehold is removed entirely, so it comes from bidding in public and in turns, not from owning the stake. And the tidy "bigger toehold, more deterrence" relationship holds only in a contest cut short after one round; give it a real second round and it stops responding.
  So the two reasons to buy a toehold do not fare alike. The profit reason holds up; the deterrence reason does not, which suggests why toeholds may be rarer than theory predicts, alongside the procedural costs of disclosure and price impact that this model omits.
  A warning follows for anyone computing economics from a game solver: solve this auction once and it returns a confident figure for what a preemptive bid is worth; solve it again from a different start and it returns a different one, equally converged. We also report which solvers cope with contests of this shape, including versions too large to enumerate. Code is released.

</details>


### [375] [Detecting Collusion in Peer Review: Drawing Inspiration from VCG Principle](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08486)
*Itay Rabinovitz,Rica Gonen,Omer Lev,Asaf Samuel*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于"排除异常检测"的新方法，用于检测同行评审中的合谋作弊团伙。该方法借鉴VCG拍卖思想，通过衡量疑似评审组的边际影响力来暴露其作弊特征，即使显式社交图被隐藏也能有效工作。同时提出基于嵌入的发现框架（Embedding Based Discovery Framework），利用连续语义嵌入从评审的语义画像中直接识别潜在合谋社区，无需事先知道团伙成员。实验基于ICLR 2021大规模数据，展示了高灵敏度和严格的Family-Wise Error Rate控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同行评审是科学进步的基础，但日益复杂的合谋团伙系统性地操纵评审结果以偏袒内部成员。现有的检测方法在显式合著图中难以解开模糊化的社会联系，需要一种不依赖显式社交图、且无需预知团伙成员的自适应检测方法。

Method: 1) 排除异常检测（Exclusion Based Anomaly Detection）：借鉴VCG拍卖机制，形式化度量疑似评审组的边际影响力，即使显式社交图被隐藏也能暴露其作弊签名。2) 嵌入发现框架（Embedding Based Discovery Framework）：利用连续语义嵌入从评审的语义画像中隔离潜在的合谋社区，绕过显式网络分析对抗限制。3) 在独立诊断算法之间执行解耦搜索，将结果合并为不同的共识形态，使组织者可动态平衡检测精度与召回率。

Result: 在基于ICLR 2021的大规模数据集上评估，方法能够以高灵敏度识别显式和隐蔽的对抗策略，并严格控制Family-Wise Error Rate（FWER），为会议组织者提供了可扩展、稳健且保护隐私的工具。

Conclusion: 该框架作为一种自动审计工具，不需要预知团伙成员身份，能够有效保障学术出版的科学诚信，是对传统基于启发式的检测方法的重要改进。

Abstract: The peer-review process, the bedrock of scientific advancement, is increasingly undermined by sophisticated collusion rings that systematically manipulate review outcomes to favor in-group members. While existing detection methods struggle to untangle obfuscated social ties in explicit co-authorship graphs, we introduce a new direction: Exclusion Based Anomaly Detection. Similar to the way VCG auctions work, we formally measure the marginal influence of suspected reviewer groups, exposing their signature even when explicit social graphs are hidden. To apply this at scale without prior knowledge of colluding groups, we introduce the Embedding Based Discovery Framework, which leverages continuous semantic embeddings to isolate latent collusive communities directly from their semantic profile, bypassing the adversarial limitations of explicit network analysis. Unlike traditional heuristic-based approaches, our framework functions as an automated auditor, requiring no prior knowledge of group membership. It achieves this by executing a decoupled search across independent diagnostic algorithms and combining their findings into distinct consensus formations, allowing organizers to dynamically balance detection precision and recall. Evaluating our technique with large-scale datasets (based on ICLR 2021) shows our method's capacity to identify both overt and subtle adversarial tactics with high sensitivity and strict Family-Wise Error Rate (FWER) control, effectively providing conference organizers with a scalable, robust, and privacy-preserving tool to secure the scientific integrity of academic publishing.

</details>


### [376] [Complete EFX Allocations Exist for Four Additive Agents and Up to Nine Goods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08590)
*Eyad Alkassar,Mahmoud Fouz,Kurt Mehlhorn*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文证明了在四代理、非负实数可加估值、最多九个不可分割物品的公平分配实例中，总是存在完整的EFXo（强零容忍无嫉妒）分配。这是对以往（m≤n+3）边界的突破，m=9=n+5超出了此前已知的前沿。证明结合了手工证明的归约引理与机器验证的证书语料库，通过覆盖估值多胞形并用量化自由线性算术不可满足性判定来验证分配族充分性。文中还指出问题难度集中在近似相同的估值上，并给出了可能解释一般猜想的证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公平分配是经典问题，EFX（嫉妒-free up to any good）是最受关注的公平概念之一。此前四代理完整EFX的已知前沿仅为m≤n+3（即m≤7），能否在更多物品下保证完整EFX分配是开放问题。本文将这一边界推进至m=9，并尝试解释该问题为何困难。

Method: 结合少量手工证明的归约引理与大规模机器验证的证书语料库。具体做法：(1)将估值多胞形划分为若干更小的多胞形P；(2)对每个P找到包含EFXo分配的分配族F；(3)将"F对P中的所有估值都充分"的检验转化为量化自由线性算术的不可满足性判定，由独立的验证器重新推导并求解，逐子句佐证，并可被第三个独立小型实现重新验证。m=8的情况还通过填充（padding）推论从m=9定理得到。此外通过计数分析揭示困难集中在近似相同估值上。

Result: 成功证明了四代理、至多九个物品的任意可加估值实例均存在完整EFXo分配，突破此前m≤n+3的前沿。m=8用两种独立方式验证（独立项目+填充推论）。并发现仅有约0.14%的4^9个分配在困难区域是EFXo，且存在单个区域内估值对强制相反的必要分配结构，为一般猜想提供了难度解释。

Conclusion: 论文通过人机结合的方式将四代理完整EFX的保证范围从m≤7推进到m=9，建立了更可靠的可验证证明框架。同时揭示了问题的真实难点在于近相同估值情形，这为最终解决一般猜想提供了结构性线索。该成果提升了机器辅助证明在数学定理验证中的可信度和实用性。

Abstract: We prove that every fair-division instance with four agents, additive valuations over the non-negative reals, and at most nine indivisible goods admits a \emph{complete} allocation that is envy-free up to any good in the strong, zero-tolerant sense ($\EFXo$). The case $m=9=n+5$ lies beyond the previously known frontier for complete EFX with four agents ($m\le n+3$). The proof combines a small set of hand-proven reduction lemmas with a machine-verified certificate corpus. The valuation polytope is covered by a collection of smaller polytopes. For each smaller polytope $P$, a family $F$ of allocations is found that contains an $\EFXo$ allocation for every valuation in $P$.
  The check that $F$ suffices for $P$ is a quantifier-free linear-arithmetic unsatisfiability verdict, re-derived and solved from scratch by an independent certifier, corroborated per clause, and re-verifiable by a independent small third implementation. The $m=8$ case is established twice: by an earlier independent project at that size and as a one-paragraph padding corollary of the $m=9$ theorem. We additionally give a possible explanation why the problem is hard: difficulty concentrates on near-identical valuations, where only ${\approx}0.14\%$ of all $4^9$ allocations are $\EFXo$, and explicit valuation pairs inside a single region force opposite mandatory allocation structure, evidence relevant to the general conjecture independently of any solver stack.

</details>


### [377] [Kernel Methods for Refined Prophet Inequalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08662)
*Patrick Loiseau,Mathieu Molina,Vianney Perchet,Sebastian Perez-Salazar,Victor Verdugo*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究单选择先知不等式，通过限制先知值的相对方差引入非参数复杂度度量，并提出通用的核方法将单阈值先知不等式的坏情况分析转化为无限维凸规划，从而精确刻画了有界方差约束下的最优竞争比曲线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典单阈值先知不等式在最坏情况下是最优的，但证明紧性的困难实例高度不规则——先知优势由最大值的稀有巨大实现驱动。作者希望通过施加相对方差的约束来细化最坏情况图景，使分析在确定性实例（可恢复全部先知值）与无约束最坏情况之间插值。

Method: 核心贡献是通用核方法：用最大值的分位函数表示实例，将阈值收益重写为该分位函数的线性核泛函。这使最坏情况分析转变为无限维凸规划，在分位空间恢复强极小极大对偶性，并将有界方差对手问题约简为一参数变分族。

Result: 得到IID有界方差曲线的精确刻画和渐近最优有限时域阈值；非同一固定顺序模型的闭式表达式；先知-秘书下界程序及在每个正有限方差约束下与IID基准的严格分离；以及IID随机时域在凸性条件下的精确公式（涵盖单调风险率时域）。

Conclusion: 该核方法为单阈值先知设置提供了广泛适用的新分析技术，在方差约束下实现了从可利用结构到最坏情况的平滑插值，并具有广泛的应用范围。

Abstract: The single-selection prophet inequality is a canonical Bayesian online selection problem in which independent nonnegative values arrive sequentially and the decision-maker must irrevocably select at most one. Classical single-threshold guarantees are tight in the worst case, but the hard instances that prove tightness are highly irregular: the prophet's advantage is driven by rare, very large realizations of the maximum. We refine this worst-case picture by imposing a bound on the relative variance of the prophet's value, $\mathrm{Var}(\max_{i\in[n]}X_i)/\mathbb E[\max_{i\in[n]}X_i]^2$. This yields a nonparametric complexity measure that interpolates between deterministic instances, where the full prophet value can be recovered, and the unrestricted worst-case regime.
  Our main technical contribution is a general kernel method for single-threshold prophet inequalities. The method represents an instance by the quantile function of the maximum and rewrites the payoff of a threshold as a linear kernel functional of this quantile. This turns the worst-case analysis into an infinite-dimensional convex program, restores strong minimax duality in quantile space, and reduces the bounded-variance adversary's problem to a one-parameter variational family. Applying this framework, we obtain an exact characterization of the IID bounded-variance curve and asymptotically optimal finite-horizon thresholds, a closed-form expression for the fixed-order non-identical model, and a prophet-secretary lower-bound program together with a strict separation from the IID benchmark at every positive finite variance constraint. As a further application of the same kernel viewpoint, we derive an exact formula for IID random horizons under a convexity condition on the horizon pgf, which includes monotone-hazard-rate horizons, highlighting the broad applicability of this new technique for single threshold settings.

</details>


### [378] [A Simple Polynomial-Time EFX Repair for Cancelable Valuations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08864)
*Hannaneh Akrami,Arash Ashuri,Bhaskar Ray Chaudhury,Kurt Mehlhorn,Maksim Soldatov*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究了公平分配中EFX修复过程的多项式时间界限问题。作者证明通过一个确定性的平局打破规则（按单品价值排序，始终转移排名最高的合格物品），可以使得leximin++修复过程在更广泛的cancelable valuations类别上达到多项式复杂度（最多m次转移）。该结果应用于计算受限可加性杂务（restricted additive chores）的分配，在多项式时间内同时实现EFX、(1+ε)-MMS和2-近似最优社会成本，改进了此前4/3-MMS的保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Plaut和Roughgarden提出的leximin++ EFX修复过程虽然保证终止，但标准论证无法给出转移次数的多项式上界，即使对于可加性估值也是如此。核心问题在于：能否找到一个确定性策略使得修复过程在多项式时间内完成？这个问题对公平分配的算法效率至关重要。

Method: 作者提出一个确定性的平局打破规则：固定与单品价值一致的物品排序，总是转移排名最高的合格物品。这样连续转移的物品在该排序中严格递减，从而证明算法至多进行m次转移（m为物品数量）。同时证明该修复过程不会降低最小束价值或增加最大束价值。这一技术被应用于受限可加性杂务的分配问题。

Result: 1. 证明修复过程在cancelable valuations类中是多项式的，最多m次转移；2. 作为应用，对于任意固定ε>0，在多项式时间内计算受限可加性杂务的分配，同时满足EFX、(1+ε)-MMS和2-近似最优社会成本，改进了此前的4/3-MMS保证；3. 构造了一个五物品的单调canCcelable排序，没有可加性表示，证明该扩展超越可加性是实质性的。

Conclusion: 该工作通过一个精巧的确定性平局打破规则，解决了EFX修复过程多项式时间界限的开放问题，并将其推广到更广泛的cancelable valuations类别。应用结果同时改进了杂务分配的MMS保证和社会成本近似比，并通过对非可加性实例的构造证明了理论扩展的真实性。

Abstract: The leximin++ proof of Plaut and Roughgarden for agents with identical monotone valuations gives a natural EFX-repair procedure: starting from an arbitrary partition, repeatedly transfer an eligible item to a minimum-valued bundle. The procedure terminates, but the standard argument gives no polynomial bound on the number of transfers, even for additive valuations.
  We show that a single deterministic tie-breaking rule makes this repair procedure polynomial for the broader class of cancelable valuations. Fix an ordering of the items consistent with their singleton values and always transfer the highest-ranked eligible item. Consecutive transferred items strictly decrease in this ordering, and hence the algorithm performs at most $m$ transfers, where $m$ is the number of items. Moreover, the repair procedure does not decrease the minimum bundle value or increase the maximum bundle value.
  As an application, for every fixed $\varepsilon>0$, we compute in polynomial time an allocation of restricted additive chores that is simultaneously EFX, $(1+\varepsilon)$-MMS, and a $2$-approximation to the optimal social cost. This improves upon the previous polynomial-time $4/3$-MMS guarantee. Finally, we exhibit a monotone cancelable ordering on five items with no additive representation, showing that the extension beyond additivity is genuine.

</details>


### [379] [Voting Method Synthesis on an Infinite Domain: A Possibility Theorem for Positive Involvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08897)
*Wesley H. Holliday*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文利用约束Horn子句推理和多面体计算，在无限域（任意有限选民人数）上合成满足特定社会选择公理的投票方法，并通过SMT和Lean验证其性质。主要结果是一个可能性定理：在四名候选人场景下，存在同时满足Condorcet胜者/败者准则、正参与性和可分辨性的投票方法，而此前已知五名及以上候选人时不存在满足这些公理的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社会选择理论中常见问题是如何判定是否存在满足特定准则的社会选择程序（如投票方法）。计算机辅助方法（如SAT求解）通常只能在有限域上综合投票方法，而实际需求往往是无限域（固定候选人数量、任意有限选民数量），因此需要新的方法在无限域上进行综合与验证。

Method: 采用基于约束Horn子句推理和计算几何（多面体）的方法，在无限域上综合投票方法；随后使用SMT求解器和Lean证明助手验证所合成方法满足的各项属性。

Result: 证明了在四名候选人情况下，存在同时满足Condorcet胜者准则、Condorcet败者准则、正参与性和可分辨性这四个核心公理的投票方法；该结果比前人工作更进一步——此前已知五名及以上候选人时不存在满足这些公理的方法，而四名候选人时若加上额外的不变性公理也不存在。

Conclusion: 本文展示了约束Horn子句与多面体计算相结合的方法能够成功在无限域上综合满足复杂公理组合的投票方法，填补了计算机辅助社会选择研究在无限域综合方面的空白，并为四名候选人的情形提供了新的可能性定理。

Abstract: A common problem in social choice is to determine whether there is a social choice procedure, such as a voting method, satisfying some desired criteria. Computer-aided methods such as SAT solving can sometimes answer these questions. However, under typical encodings, a SAT solver may only synthesize a voting method on a finite domain, while we may want one on an infinite domain, such as the domain of all preference profiles for a fixed number of candidates but any finite number of voters. In this paper, we use an approach based on reasoning with constrained Horn clauses and computation with polyhedra to synthesize a voting method on an infinite domain. We then use SMT and Lean to verify its properties. Our main result is a possibility theorem about four well-known criteria from voting theory: the Condorcet winner and loser criteria, positive involvement, and resolvability. Previous work has shown that for five or more candidates, there is no voting method satisfying these axioms, and that for four candidates, there is no method satisfying these core axioms plus one more invariance axiom. Here we show that for four candidates, there does exist a method satisfying the core axioms and more.

</details>


### [380] [Best-of-Both-Worlds Fairness and Pareto Optimality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08966)
*Haris Aziz*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究不可分割物品的公平分配问题，目标是构造一个彩票（随机分配），使得其诱导的分数分配是无嫉妒的（ex-ante envy-free），同时每个实际实现的具体分配都是"至多一件物品的无嫉妒"（EFX）且帕累托最优。作者证明了两名代理人情况下这种彩票始终存在，并进一步证明存在一种更强的彩票，其每个实现都是EFX且帕累托最优的；对于非负整数可加估值，该彩票可在伪多项式时间内计算。但作者同时证明三名代理人和四件物品的情况下，可能不存在满足条件的彩票。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公平分配不可分割物品是经典且具有挑战性的问题，核心矛盾在于：无嫉妒的分数分配（ex-ante fairness）与离散分配中的近似公平（EFX）及效率（帕累托最优）之间难以同时兼顾。作者希望弥合事前公平与事后公平之间的鸿沟，探索是否存在一种随机机制，在期望层面实现无嫉妒，同时每个确定性输出都满足强公平性和效率保证。

Method: 作者采用构造性方法，针对两名代理人的情形，证明了存在一种彩票机制：其诱导的分数分配满足无嫉妒性，且支撑集中的每个确定性分配都满足EFX和帕累托最优。进一步，作者利用组合优化和算法设计，对非负整数可加估值给出了伪多项式时间算法来构造该彩票。此外，对于三名代理人和四件物品的情形，作者通过反例构造证明了这种理想彩票可能不存在。

Result: 1）两代理人情形下，始终存在满足事前无嫉妒、事后EFX且帕累托最优的彩票；2）对于非负整数估值，该彩票可在伪多项式时间内计算；3）三人四物情形下，可能存在不存在满足条件的彩票的反例。

Conclusion: 作者在事前公平与事后公平之间建立了桥梁，证明了两代理人场景下能够同时实现事前无嫉妒与事后EFX+帕累托最优，但该结果无法推广到三人以上的场景，揭示了多代理人情形下事前与事后公平兼容性的本质困难。

Abstract: We consider fair allocation of indivisible items among agents with non-negative and additive valuations. The goal is to construct a lottery over deterministic allocations whose induced fractional allocation is envy-free, while every realised allocation is envy-free up to one item and Pareto optimal. We show that this is always possible for two agents. We then prove a stronger result that there always exists a lottery over deterministic allocations whose induced fractional allocation is envy-free, while every realised allocation is envy-free up each one item (EFX) and Pareto optimal. For non-negative integral additive valuations, such a lottery can be computed in pseudo-polynomial time. We also prove that for three agents and four items, there may be no ex-ante envy-free lottery that can be supported on allocations that are simultaneously EFX and Pareto optimal.

</details>


### [381] [Decision-Focused Learning in Network Interdiction Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09036)
*Luca M. Hartmann,Parinaz Naghizadeh*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究最短路径网络阻断博弈中的决策聚焦学习（DFL），发现其在此博弈设定下存在结构性失败：训练目标存在广泛的决策等价类，可产生零名义损失但在阻断下失灵的代价估计器。为此提出对抗性DFL（A-DFL），用被阻断场景替代名义训练样本以消除有害等价类，实验证明其恢复DFL优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DFL作为端到端优化框架通常优于朴素的预测聚焦学习（PFL），但在最短路径网络阻断博弈（SPNI）这一Stackelberg博弈设定下，DFL面临根本性结构失败：其训练目标产生大量决策等价类，导致模型在名义数据上表现完美却在网络阻断下失效，逆转了DFL常规优势。

Method: 提出对抗性决策聚焦学习（A-DFL），核心思想是用被阻断（interdicted）的场景替代名义训练样本，以压缩/消除有害的决策等价类，从而使训练目标能够区分在阻断下表现各异的代价估计器，恢复端到端优化的有效性。

Result: 在合成和真实网络上的实验表明，A-DFL恢复了DFL在此类博弈设定中的优势，实现了有效的端到端优化。

Conclusion: DFL在博弈对抗设定下存在结构性弱点，但通过引入对抗性训练场景（A-DFL）可以解决这一局限，为博弈环境下的决策聚焦学习提供了新的方法论方向。

Abstract: We study decision-focused learning (DFL) in shortest-path network interdiction (SPNI) games, a Stackelberg game where an interdictor (leader) strengthens the networks' arcs against attacks, while an evader (follower) who is uncertain about costs of attacking network arcs relies on a machine-learned predictor to identify the shortest path. While DFL is highly effective as an end-to-end optimization framework, we show that it faces a fundamental structural failure when employed in this game setting: its training objective admits a broad decision-equivalence class of cost estimators that achieve zero nominal loss yet fail under interdiction, reversing DFL's usual advantage over a naive prediction-focused learning (PFL) approach. To address this, we propose Adversarial DFL (A-DFL), which replaces nominal training samples with interdicted scenarios to collapse the harmful equivalence class. Experiments on synthetic and real-world networks confirm that A-DFL restores DFL's advantage in this game setting, enabling effective end-to-end optimization.

</details>


### [382] [Repeated-Game Security for Restaking-Based Verifiable Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09055)
*Zhenhang Shang,Yingzhe Yu,Kani Chen*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文揭示了基于Restaking的LLM推理验证协议中，单轮惩罚条件在多轮重复博弈下会高估安全性。作者提出了一种结合历史依赖的挑战机制、声誉加权惩罚和权益归属的部署方案，能在显式折扣因子阈值以上恢复无限时域子博弈完美激励兼容性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的Restaking协议通过单轮削减条件来证明提供者的诚实动机，但该条件忽略了推理服务在相同抵押下被重复提供的情况。作者识别出比例削减导致的重复博弈间隙：检测到的偏差降低了未来的惩罚风险，而成本节省却可以在每轮查询中重复获得，因此单轮条件可能严重高估安全性。

Method: 将可验证推理建模为折扣重复博弈，用闭式解推导了重复博弈间隙；证明该间隙在最小权益驱逐机制下仍然存在，并推广到无状态有界削减协议。提出结合历史依赖挑战、声誉加权削减和权益归属的三合一机制，以恢复无限时域子博弈完美激励兼容性。

Result: 在0.5B到14B参数的9个开源模型对上验证了审计信号的凹可检测性响应。Stackelberg审计预算分析显示，改进信号响应在折扣因子0.95时可将基线审计率降低2.6倍。校准到部署参数后，被调查的协议在折扣因子0.92-0.98之间存在重复博弈偏差，利润占比1.5%-8%，而所提机制可将偏差利润降低31%-54%。

Conclusion: 单轮激励兼容性不足以保障重复推理场景下的协议安全。通过结合历史依赖挑战、声誉加权削减和权益归属的组合机制，可以在不引入每查询密码学验证的前提下，以经济手段恢复长期博弈的激励兼容性，同时保持低延迟特性。

Abstract: Restaking-based protocols enable verifiable LLM inference without the high proving cost of zkML or the hardware trust assumptions of TEEs. Their security is commonly justified by a one-round slashing condition: a rational provider should not cheat when the expected penalty exceeds the cost saving from dishonest inference. This paper shows that this condition can overstate security when inference is supplied repeatedly under the same stake. We model verifiable inference as a discounted repeated game and identify a repeated-game gap caused by proportional slashing: detected deviations reduce future penalty exposure, while cost savings are earned again across queries.
  We derive the gap in closed form, show that it persists under minimum-stake ejection, and extend it to memoryless bounded-slashing protocols covering deployed designs. We propose a deployable mechanism combining history-dependent challenges, reputation-weighted slashing, and stake vesting. The mechanism restores infinite-horizon subgame-perfect incentive compatibility against stationary mixed-strategy deviations above an explicit discount-factor threshold without per-query cryptographic verification.
  Evaluation across nine open-weight model pairs from 0.5B to 14B parameters shows that the audit signal has the required concave detectability response. A Stackelberg audit-budget analysis shows that improved signal responsiveness reduces the baseline audit rate by 2.6x at discount factor 0.95. Calibrated to deployed parameters, surveyed protocols pass one-round incentive compatibility but admit repeated-game deviations for discount factors between 0.92 and 0.98, with deviation-profit fractions of 1.5%--8%. Our mechanism reduces deviation profits by 31%--54% while maintaining low-latency economic verification.

</details>


### [383] [Breaking the 4-Approximation Barrier in Strategyproof Two-Facility Location](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09061)
*Mengfan Ma,Bo Peng*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究无需转移支付的策略证明机制设计，针对度量空间中的双设施选址问题。作者将随机策略证明机制的近似比上界从4改进到11/3（约3.667），适用于所有Ptolemaic度量空间（包含所有欧几里得空间）；同时构造新的双配置实例，将下界从1.045提高到约1.207。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双设施选址问题中，随机策略证明机制的最佳近似比上界（4，由Lu等人2010年提出）和下界（1.045，由Lu等人2009年提出）多年来均未得到改进，即使在线性空间R上也是如此。作者希望通过打破这两个僵局，进一步理解该问题的机制设计边界。

Method: 作者提出一种新的随机化策略证明机制——Global Pair机制，它按与距离成比例的概率抽取一对无序代理人，并在其报告位置开设设施。关键洞察是：Global Pair和已有的Proportional机制各自的最坏情况近似比都为4，但在互补的实例上达到最坏情况，因此对二者进行随机化混合可以有效平衡各自的弱点。作者还构造了一个新的双配置实例来获得更强的下界。

Result: 主要结果为：新机制的近似比为11/3≈3.667，适用于所有Ptolemaic度量空间（包含所有欧几里得空间），打破了4的近似比壁垒；同时构造新实例将下界从1.045提升到(1+√2)/2≈1.207。

Conclusion: 通过利用两种机制在互补实例上达到最坏情况的特性进行随机化混合，成功打破了长期未变的4近似比上界；同时通过新的实例构造显著改善了策略证明机制的下界，为双设施选址问题提供了更紧的边界。

Abstract: We study strategyproof mechanism design without transfers for the two-facility location problem in metric spaces. A mechanism selects two facility locations based on agents' reported locations; each agent incurs her distance to the nearer facility, and the objective is to minimize the expected social cost. A mechanism is strategyproof if no agent ever benefits from misreporting her location. The best approximation ratio achieved by a randomized strategyproof mechanism has been $4$, attained by the Proportional mechanism of Lu, Sun, Wang, and Zhu (EC 2010), and the best lower bound has been $1.045$, due to Lu, Wang, and Zhou (WINE 2009). Neither bound has moved since then, even on the line $\mathbb{R}$.
  We improve both bounds. Our main result is a randomized strategyproof mechanism with approximation ratio $11/3 \approx 3.667$ on every Ptolemaic metric space, a rich class containing all Euclidean spaces. The mechanism randomizes between the Proportional mechanism and a new mechanism that we call Global Pair. Global Pair draws an unordered pair of agents with probability proportional to their distance and opens facilities at their reported locations. Although Global Pair and Proportional each have approximation ratio $4$, the two mechanisms attain their worst-case approximation ratios on complementary instances. Randomizing between them balances these complementary weaknesses and breaks the $4$-approximation barrier. On the lower-bound side, we construct a new two-profile instance that yields a lower bound of $(1+\sqrt{2})/2 \approx 1.207$, improving upon the previous lower bound of $1.045$.

</details>


### [384] [Regret, equilibrium, and learning in games: A guided tour](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09389)
*Panayotis Mertikopoulos*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文是学习博弈论领域的一篇入门综述，围绕两个互补视角展开：单智能体在未知、非平稳、可能对抗环境中的序贯决策，以及多智能体交互环境中各自优化个体收益的学习问题。论文重点分析了一类基于历史最佳响应的正则化学习策略，在单智能体场景给出对抗性多臂老虎机的遗憾界，在多智能体场景给出零和博弈的遍历均衡收敛结果，以及连接纳什均衡与正则化学习吸引点的"民间定理"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习博弈论具有重要的理论价值与广泛的应用前景（从机器学习、数据科学到经济学），需要一个系统的入口点来组织该领域的核心思想。作者希望通过统一的分析框架，整合单智能体与多智能体视角下的正则化学习理论，并探讨其对理性研究的启示。

Method: 论文采用综述式方法，围绕正则化学习策略（基于历史最佳响应加上正则化惩罚以促进探索）展开。通过统一分析框架，同时研究oracle型（可获取完整信息）和bandit型（仅基于收益）两类方法，覆盖从单智能体到多智能体、从对抗性老虎机到零和博弈再到一般博弈的层级递进分析。

Result: 在单智能体对抗性多臂老虎机场景中，给出了正则化学习的基本遗憾界；在多智能体零和博弈中，得到了类似经典虚构博弈论结果的遍历均衡收敛结论；同时建立了连接纳什均衡与正则化学习动力系统吸引点之间关系的"民间定理"。

Conclusion: 本文提供了一个连贯且可理解（虽不全面）的学习博弈论入门概述，突出了正则化学习在单智能体和多智能体场景中的统一性，并讨论了这些结果对理性概念的深层含义。该框架为后续研究者进入该领域提供了清晰的路线图。

Abstract: This note aims to serve as an entry point to the literature on learning in games, a topic with significant theoretical appeal and a wide range of applications -- from machine learning and data science to economics and beyond. Our presentation is structured around two complementary viewpoints: We first consider a single agent -- the learner -- engaged in a sequential decision process in an unknown, non-stationary, and possibly adversarial environment. We then examine what happens when the environment is shaped by the decisions of several interacting agents, not necessarily aware of each other's actions or goals, and all seeking to improve their individual rewards. In this general context, we examine a family of regularized learning policies based on best-responding to the past history of play, up to a regularization penalty intended to encourage exploration and prevent over-commitment to suboptimal choices. In the single-agent setting, we present some basic regret bounds for regularized learning in adversarial multi-armed bandits; in the multi-agent setting, we describe an ergodic equilibrium convergence result for zero-sum games in the spirit of classical results on fictitious play, as well as a "folk theorem" linking strategic and dynamic notions of stability -- Nash equilibria and attracting points of regularized learning, respectively. We pay special attention to the information available to the players and, through a unified analysis framework, we study both oracle- and payoff-based (bandit) methods. Our goal is to provide a coherent and comprehensible -- albeit, by necessity, not comprehensive -- account of some recent ideas in the field, and to discuss their implications for the study of rationality.

</details>


### [385] [Balanced Fair Division for Three Agents under General Valuations and Laminar Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09437)
*Max Dupré la Tour*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究了不可分割物品在一般集合估值下的公平分配问题。作者证明了在三个智能体和任意实值估值下，总存在一个平衡分配满足"直到一件好物和一件坏物的无嫉妒性"（EF1^c_g）；在不要求单调性时，平衡EF1无法保证（给出了三智能体九物品的反例）。在层状拟阵约束下，只要存在完整可行分配，就能找到平衡且EF2^c_g的完整可行分配。文中大部分证明由GPT-5.6辅助完成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公平分配研究中，多数结果依赖估值函数的单调性假设（如单调不减或单调不增），而实际场景中物品可能有互补或替代关系，估值可能是非单调的。作者希望探索在更一般的任意实值估值下，平衡性与无嫉妒性（envy-freeness）能否同时成立，并进一步考虑层状拟阵等实际约束下的推广。

Method: 作者采用构造性和反例相结合的方法。一方面，通过精巧的分配构造，证明在三智能体任意估值下存在平衡的EF1^c_g分配（该结果自动蕴含单调情形下的平衡EF1）。另一方面，构造反例说明非单调估值下平衡EF1不成立。对于层状拟阵约束问题，作者证明存在平衡的EF2^c_g完整可行分配，且每个层状集合中分配给三个智能体的物品数相差至多2。文中证明大量借助GPT-5.6辅助生成并人工验证。

Result: 1) 三智能体任意实值估值下存在平衡的EF1^c_g分配；2) 单调估值下可推出平衡EF1；3) 非单调估值下平衡EF1不可保证（三智能体、九物品、相同非单调估值的反例）；4) 在层状拟阵约束下，若完整可行分配存在，则存在平衡且EF2^c_g的完整可行分配，且每个层状集合内的分配差额至多2。

Conclusion: 本文扩展了公平分配理论中平衡性与无嫉妒性在一般（非单调）估值下的可行性边界：EF1^c_g在任意估值下可实现于平衡分配中，但更强的平衡EF1需要单调性前提；在层状拟阵约束下，可放松至EF2^c_g。此外，作者展示了AI辅助证明（GPT-5.6）在理论计算机科学研究中作为证明生成与验证工具的潜力。

Abstract: We study fair allocations of indivisible items under general set valuations. We prove that every instance with three agents and arbitrary real-valued valuations admits a balanced allocation that is envy-free up to one good and one chore (EF$1^c_g$). This directly implies balanced EF$1$ when each valuation is either monotone nondecreasing or monotone nonincreasing. We also show that balanced EF$1$ cannot be guaranteed without monotonicity: there exists an instance with three agents, nine items, and identical nonmonotone valuations that admits no balanced EF$1$ allocation. We then consider a common laminar matroid constraint. Whenever a complete feasible allocation exists, we prove that there is a complete feasible allocation that is balanced and envy-free up to two goods and two chores (EF$2^c_g$) for arbitrary valuations. The allocation can additionally be chosen so that the numbers of items from every laminar set assigned to the three agents differ by at most two. Most proofs in this paper were obtained using GPT-5.6. We subsequently verified the proofs for correctness and refined their exposition and arguments, also with the aid of GPT-5.6.

</details>


### [386] [Algorithmic Asymmetry in Zero-Sum Games: Unilateral Recovery of Fast Convergence Against a Slow Opponent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09780)
*James P. Bailey,Soham Das*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究零和博弈学习动力学中的算法不对称性。当一方固定使用普通梯度下降（GD）时，另一方可以使用一种名为交替乐观梯度下降（AOGD）的修正乐观更新规则，使联合动力学在偶数迭代上模拟交替梯度下降，从而将时间平均收敛速度从O(1/√T)提升到O(1/T)。这证明快速收敛不需要代理间协调算法选择，一方可以补偿较慢的另一方。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的零和博弈学习动力学分析通常假设算法对称性，即双方使用相同更新规则或来自同一算法族的方法。这与零和博弈的现实本质不符——竞争代理不需要在算法选择上协调。当一方固定使用普通梯度下降时，其基于遗憾的分析只能保证O(1/√T)的遍历收敛速度，本文希望探究这种慢速是否是内在固有限制，以及能否通过另一方的算法调整来恢复快速收敛。

Method: 提出一种名为交替乐观梯度下降（Alternating Optimistic Gradient Descent, AOGD）的修正乐观更新规则。关键洞察是：当一方使用标准GD，另一方使用AOGD时，联合动力学可以在偶数迭代上模拟交替梯度下降（Alternating Gradient Descent）的行为，从而规避GD固有的慢收敛速度限制。

Result: 证明了在GD对AOGD的不对称动力学中，时间平均收敛到纳什均衡的速度为O(1/T)，显著优于GD单独分析所保证的O(1/√T)。这表明GD的慢速率并非内在固有的，而是可以被对手的适应性更新所补偿。

Conclusion: 快速收敛并不一定需要协调的算法选择：一个代理可以通过其更新规则补偿另一个较慢的对手。这一发现将算法不对称性作为理解多代理优化中跨类别（cross-class）交互的重要视角，为更广泛的异构多代理学习系统分析开辟了方向。

Abstract: Learning dynamics in zero-sum games are typically analyzed under algorithmic symmetry: both agents use the same update rule, or methods from a common algorithmic family. This is at odds with the nature of zero-sum games; competing agents need not coordinate on algorithm selection. This paper studies algorithmic asymmetry in learning dynamics in zero-sum games. In particular, we ask whether fast convergence can be recovered when one agent is fixed to vanilla gradient descent, whose standard regret-based analysis certifies, at best, $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ ergodic convergence. We show that the slow rate is not intrinsic. When one agent uses gradient descent, the opposing agent can use a modified optimistic update, which we call Alternating Optimistic Gradient Descent (AOGD), to make the joint dynamics simulate Alternating Gradient Descent on the even iterates. As a result, the time-average of the asymmetric GD vs.\ AOGD dynamics converges to Nash equilibria at rate $O(1/T)$. Our results show that fast convergence need not require coordinated algorithm selection: one agent can compensate for a slower opponent. More broadly, the paper highlights algorithmic asymmetry as a useful lens for understanding cross-class interactions in multiagent optimization.

</details>


### [387] [Competitive mediator games and urban CAV routing markets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09894)
*Grzegorz Jamróz*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文受未来自主路由与驾驶（ARAD）市场的启发，提出了竞争性中介博弈（competitive mediator games）及其均衡概念，该概念推广了（粗）相关均衡。研究发现，在匿名拥塞（路由）博弈的通用设定下，当所有用户对一个中介的偏好弱于其他中介时，所有竞争性中介均衡都是垄断性的。文章将该理论应用于ARAD服务提供商竞争市场，并讨论了这些市场的全面概览及未来机制设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向未来可能出现的自主路由和驾驶（ARAD）服务市场，现有博弈论均衡概念（如Nash均衡）在描述多个竞争性中介（服务提供商）与用户之间的互动时存在局限。相关均衡虽比Nash均衡更具社会效率且是无遗憾学习动态的极限，但尚未被推广到包含多个竞争中介的设定中，亟需新的理论框架来支撑这些新兴市场的分析。

Method: 引入竞争性中介博弈及其均衡概念，将（粗）相关均衡推广到多中介竞争场景；通过理论分析证明在匿名拥塞（路由）博弈的通用设定下，若所有用户对某一中介存在（弱）偏好，则所有竞争性中介均衡均为垄断均衡；将理论结果应用于ARAD服务提供商竞争市场的框架分析与解释。

Result: 证明了在匿名拥塞博弈的通用设定下，只要一个中介被所有用户弱偏好，所有竞争性中介均衡必然导致垄断（即只有一个中介占据全部市场份额）。该结果为ARAD竞争市场中的中介行为和市场结构提供了理论预测，并给出了该新兴市场的全面概述及机制设计方向。

Conclusion: 竞争性中介博弈为理解ARAD市场中多个服务提供商的竞争行为提供了新的理论工具。在用户偏好存在一致性（弱偏好）的条件下，市场必然走向垄断，这对ARAD市场的机制设计具有重要的政策意义，未来需要在机制设计层面应对这一垄断趋势。

Abstract: Inspired by possible future markets of autonomous routing and driving (ARAD), we introduce competitive mediator games and their equilibria which generalize the (coarse) correlated equilibria, which have become a popular research area recently as they not only can be more socially efficient than Nash equilibria but also are limits of algorithmic no-regret multi-agent learning dynamics. We discuss the basic properties of competitive mediator games and prove that in the generic setting of anonymous congestion(routing) games with market-share maximizing mediators all competitive mediator equilibria are monopolies whenever one of the mediators is weakly preferred to other mediators by all users. We apply and interpret these results in the context of new markets of competing ARAD service providers. We also provide a comprehensive overview of these markets and discuss the future mechanism design thereof.

</details>


<div id='cs.NE'></div>

# cs.NE [[Back]](#toc)

### [388] [An evolutionary model of animats with VLM-based subjective evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07537)
*Shota Miyazaki,Takaya Arita,Reiji Suzuki*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文提出一个框架，将视觉语言模型(VLM)的主观评估融入遗传算法的适应度评估与选择过程，用于进化具有柔性形态和运动能力的虚拟软体机器人。通过VLM基于"可爱""怪异"等主观评价术语进行两两比较并作为选择压力，实现形态与运动的联合进化。实验表明VLM主观选择加速了种群收敛，产生了与评价术语对应的独特形态与运动，且与人类评估结果定性相似。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统遗传算法依赖明确、量化的适应度函数，难以捕捉主观、模糊的评价标准（如审美或情感判断）。随着VLM的发展，有必要探索如何将主观语言表达映射到具体表型上，为进化计算和人工生命研究引入基于主观评价的新范式。

Method: 将VLM作为主观评价器集成到遗传算法中：以序列图像呈现两个虚拟软体机器人的运动轨迹，VLM基于"可爱""怪异"等主观术语进行两两比较，比较结果转化为遗传算法的选择压力，驱动形态与运动参数的联合进化。同时进行了人类参与者的辅助对照实验。

Result: 1) VLM主观选择相比随机选择显著加速种群收敛；2) 不同评价术语产生了对应的独特形态与运动模式；3) 人类参与者的个体选择与VLM仅部分一致，但总体形态与运动趋势定性相似；4) 人类重复评估会产生明显疲劳；5) 不同评价术语产生相似进化结果，暗示VLM并非字面理解这些术语，而是将其分解为多个内部评价标准。

Conclusion: 这项工作成功将主观语言表达映射到具身表型的进化过程进行了可视化，为分析VLM中主观判断的结构提供了基础框架。该方法有望推动基于主观评价的进化计算和人工生命研究的新发展。

Abstract: In this study, we propose a framework that incorporates subjective evaluations provided by a Vision-Language Model (VLM) into the fitness evaluation and selection processes of a genetic algorithm. As the target of evolution, we employ virtual soft robots with flexible morphologies and locomotion and present the VLM with sequence images representing the locomotion of two individuals. Selection is performed via pairwise comparisons based on subjective evaluation terms such as adorably and weirdly. The outcomes of these comparisons are used as selection pressure within the genetic algorithm, enabling the simultaneous evolution of morphology and locomotion. Experimental results demonstrate that subjective selection by the VLM accelerates population convergence compared to random selection, while also giving rise to distinctive morphologies and motions corresponding to each evaluation term. An auxiliary experiment with human participants further showed that, although individual pairwise choices only partly agreed with the VLM selections, the resulting morphological and locomotion tendencies were qualitatively similar and repeated human evaluations imposed noticeable fatigue. Moreover, the observation that similar evolutionary outcomes emerged across different evaluation terms suggests that the VLM does not apply these terms in a purely literal manner but instead decomposes them into multiple internal evaluation criteria when making judgments. This work visualizes the evolutionary process through which subjective linguistic expressions are mapped onto embodied phenotypes and provides a foundational framework for analyzing the structure of subjective judgment in VLMs. The proposed approach is expected to contribute to new developments in evolutionary computation and artificial life research based on subjective evaluation.

</details>


### [389] [AutoPSO: A Meta-Framework for Automated Particle Swarm Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07539)
*Xinmeng Yu,Jiaxin Gao,Jianguo Zhang,Dongmei Jiang,Ran Cheng*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: AutoPSO是一个高度自动化的元框架，用于构建定制化的粒子群优化（PSO）算法。它将PSO优化形式化为双层过程：外层搜索探索有效的PSO组件联合空间，内层循环实例化候选变体来求解目标任务并提供反馈。通过利用EvoX进行群体张量化和批量评估，AutoPSO能够在实践时间预算内高效评估数千个粒子。实验表明AutoPSO能持续发现显著优于强基线的新PSO变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PSO变体存在两大根本挑战：(1)大多数方法针对特定问题手工设计，跨任务泛化能力差，设计空间庞大难以导航，阻碍了先前有效机制的系统性复用；(2)主流实现仍受限于CPU，限制了可扩展性并增加了实际应用中的计算成本。

Method: AutoPSO将PSO优化建模为双层过程：外层搜索在开放的组件池中探索有效PSO组件的联合空间（支持灵活替换组件集和外层优化器）；内层循环实例化候选变体以解决目标任务并提供反馈。利用EvoX实现群体张量化和批量评估，以支持大规模粒子评估。

Result: 在数值基准测试和神经进化机器人控制任务上的综合实验表明，AutoPSO能持续发现显著优于强基线的新型PSO变体。消融和可扩展性研究进一步验证了各个算法组件的贡献，并确认AutoPSO在更大群体规模下能获得更显著的性能提升。

Conclusion: AutoPSO提供了一种高度自动化的PSO算法构造方法，解决了现有方法跨任务泛化差和计算成本高的问题，通过元学习框架实现了PSO变体的自动发现与定制。

Abstract: Particle swarm optimization (PSO) is a widely used metaheuristic, prized for its simplicity and small parameter set. Although decades of research have produced numerous PSO variants that improve performance by modifying key components (e.g., parameter schedules, swarm topologies, or updating rules), two fundamental challenges persist. First, most existing approaches are problem-specific and hand-crafted, leading to poor cross-task generalization and forcing practitioners to navigate an impractically large design space, which also hinders systematic reuse of prior effective mechanisms. Second, mainstream implementations remain CPU-bound, constraining scalability and substantially increasing computational cost in real-world applications. To address these challenges, we propose \emph{AutoPSO}, a highly automated meta-framework for constructing customized PSO algorithms. AutoPSO formulates PSO-based optimization as a bi-level process: an outer search explores the joint space of effective PSO components, while an inner loop instantiates candidate variants to solve the target task and provide feedback. The outer search operates over a curated, open-design component pool, supporting flexible replacement of the component set and the outer optimizer. Crucially, by leveraging EvoX for population tensorization and batched evaluations, AutoPSO can efficiently assess thousands of particles within practical time budgets. Comprehensive experiments on numerical benchmarks and neuroevolution robotic control tasks demonstrate that AutoPSO consistently discovers novel PSO variants that significantly outperform strong baselines. Ablation and scalability studies further highlight the contribution of individual algorithmic components and confirm that AutoPSO achieves increasing performance gains with larger swarm sizes. Source code will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [390] [MOSAIC: Adversarial Co-evolution of Specialist Heuristics and Problem Instances for LLM-based Automated Heuristic Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07544)
*Oguzhan Gungordu,Siheng Xiong,Faramarz Fekri*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文提出MOSAIC，一个基于网格的对抗性共进化框架，在Quality-Diversity存档中共同进化问题实例和专家启发式算法。实例暴露当前启发式算法的弱点，启发式算法则专精于新暴露的区域。存档每个单元保存专家启发式算法、代表性实例和区域洞察，形成持续性记忆。决策树识别特征空间中各启发式算法的优势区域，反思型LLM产生多方向洞察以指导交叉和变异。最终通过贪心选择提取互补的组合，在多个COP和LLM骨干上优于现有SOTA方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的自动化启发式设计框架仅优化小型固定数据集上的平均性能，使用标量反馈驱动的"言语梯度"引导搜索。这存在两个问题：没有单一启发式算法能统治所有实例分布，且标量反馈无法告诉LLM启发式算法在实例空间的何处改进以及为何改进。

Method: MOSAIC采用网格结构，索引结构化的实例特征。在QD存档中对抗性共进化：实例进化以暴露当前启发式算法的弱点，启发式算法进化以消除这些弱点。从远处网格区域采样启发式算法对，LLM引导进化循环生成判别性实例，决策树识别各启发式算法的优势特征区域，反思LLM对比两种启发式算法产生多方向洞察并持久化于各区域，指导交叉和变异。存档同时作为判别性实例基准和专家启发式算法池，贪心选择提取紧凑互补组合。

Result: 在多个组合优化问题、测试规模和LLM骨干下，MOSAIC的组合始终优于基于LLM的SOTA AHD方法。共进化的实例相比进化式实例生成基线，实现了更高的特征空间覆盖率和更强的启发式判别能力。

Conclusion: MOSAIC表明，通过对抗性共进化实例和启发式算法，并利用决策树和反思LLM揭示启发式算法的优势区域，可以有效克服单一启发式算法平均性能优化的局限，构建更具鲁棒性和泛化能力的互补启发式组合。

Abstract: Automated heuristic design (AHD) with large language models (LLMs) has produced strong heuristics for combinatorial optimization problems (COPs). Yet existing frameworks optimize for average performance on a small fixed dataset and steer the search with "verbal gradients" distilled from scalar better/worse feedback. No single heuristic dominates across instance distributions, and scalar feedback tells the LLM whether a heuristic improved, but not where in the instance space or why. We propose MOSAIC, a grid-based framework that adversarially co-evolves problem instances and specialist heuristics inside a Quality-Diversity (QD) archive indexed by structural instance features. Instances evolve to expose weaknesses of the current heuristics, and heuristics evolve to eliminate them by specializing to the newly exposed regions. Each archive cell keeps a specialist heuristic, representative instances, and insights explaining what works in its region, forming a persistent memory that accumulates over the evolutionary search. For each heuristic pair sampled from distant grid regions, an LLM-guided evolutionary loop generates discriminative instances, and a decision tree identifies the feature-space regions where each heuristic wins. A reflection LLM then contrasts the two heuristics to produce multi-directional insights that persist in those regions and guide crossover and mutation. The archive is simultaneously a co-evolved benchmark of discriminative instances and a pool of region specialist heuristics, from which greedy selection extracts a compact complementary portfolio. Across COPs, test sizes, and LLM backbones, the portfolio consistently outperforms state-of-the-art LLM-based AHD methods, and the co-evolved instances attain higher feature-space coverage and stronger heuristic discrimination than evolutionary instance-generation baselines.

</details>


### [391] [DarwinX: Evolving Agent Harnesses Through Natural Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07545)
*Yifan Zhang,Yutong Dai,Juntao Tan,Luyu Yang,Rishi Mullur,Thai Hoang,Zhiyuan Hu,James Zhu,Phil Mui,Silvio Savarese,Ran Xu,Zeyuan Chen*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: DarwinX 提出了一种基于群体选择的 LLM 智能体自进化框架，通过保持模型权重冻结，对智能体的"harness"（提示、工具、技能和控制流）进行种群化选择与重组，使单条演化路径转变为多条谱系的保存与扩展，从而在多个基准上实现显著性能提升且不产生回退。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体的能力不仅取决于模型权重，还取决于其 harness（提示、工具、技能、控制流）。现有自改进循环虽能编辑 harness，但单谱系搜索具有路径依赖性和局部最优问题，局部改进往往导致其他任务回退，缺乏全局视角下对智能体能力的系统性演化。

Method: DarwinX 将自进化视为在冻结模型下对 harness 种群的"选择"过程，核心机制包括：(1) preserve-and-extend 契约，只允许在不回退的前提下扩展覆盖范围的变异；(2) 档案机制保留替代谱系用于重组；(3) 失败/教师/自生成的证据共享同一编辑接口；(4) 适应度由各基准自身的验证器计算，无需金标准答案或人工挑选。

Result: 在四个基准上平均提升约 17 分：Terminal-Bench 2.1 在匹配基线上提升 +7.7 至 83.2%，在更强基线上达到 84.7%；TerminalWorld 保留测试分割达到 68.3%，超越所有现成智能体；WebArena-Infinity 真实任务 pass@1 从 43.5% 提升至 93.0%（审计干净）；一个 Terminal-Bench 2.1 的 harness 可直接迁移至 SWE-bench Verified。

Conclusion: 演化产生的是通用的智能体能力而非基准特定的补丁，其能力可跨任务、验证器和基础模型迁移。冻结的模型无需是固定的智能体——通过 harness 选择可将评估计算转化为持久的智能体能力。

Abstract: An LLM agent's capability depends not only on model weights but on its harness: prompts, tools, skills, and control flow. Self-improvement loops already edit harnesses, yet single-lineage search is path-dependent and local wins often regress other tasks. We introduce DarwinX, which treats self-evolution as selection over a population of harnesses with the model frozen: a preserve-and-extend contract admits only variants that extend coverage without regressing, an archive keeps alternative lineages for recombination, and failure-, teacher-, and self-derived evidence share one edit interface. Fitness comes from each benchmark's own verifier: no gold solutions, no hand-picked winners. Across four benchmarks that progressively separate the evolution signal from the test, one loop adds about 17 points on average: Terminal-Bench 2.1 rises +7.7 to 83.2% on a matched base and to the verified frontier at 84.7% on a stronger one; TerminalWorld's held-out split reaches 68.3%, ahead of every off-the-shelf agent; WebArena-Infinity real-task pass@1 rises from 43.5% to 93.0% audit-clean; and a Terminal-Bench 2.1 harness transfers unchanged to SWE-bench Verified. What evolves is general agent competence, not benchmark-specific patches, so it survives changes of task, verifier, and base model. A frozen model need not be a fixed agent: harness selection turns evaluation compute into durable capability.

</details>


### [392] [HPSO: Particle Swarm Optimization with Hypergraph-Based Topology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07587)
*Wenbin Pei,Xi Luo,Bing Xue,Mengjie Zhang,Qiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于超图建模粒子群拓扑的新型PSO变体（HPSO），通过超边连接多个粒子实现高阶交互，并引入自适应超图更新策略维持种群多样性，在CEC'17基准测试中表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准PSO及其变体（如Ring和Star拓扑）可视为普通图结构，每条边仅连接两个粒子，只能支持成对粒子间的直接交互，无法直接捕获探索复杂搜索空间所需的高阶社会关系。

Method: 提出HPSO：1）用超图建模粒子拓扑，超边可连接多个粒子，实现多粒子直接交互；2）设计基于累积平均粒子位移的自适应超图更新策略，周期性重构拓扑以维持演化过程中的种群多样性。

Result: 在IEEE CEC'17基准测试套件上验证了HPSO的有效性，在各种类型函数上均取得有前景的性能；消融实验表明HPSO具有优秀的搜索能力。

Conclusion: 基于超图的高阶拓扑建模能够有效提升PSO在复杂优化问题上的搜索性能，自适应拓扑更新策略是维持种群多样性的关键因素。

Abstract: Particle swarm optimization (PSO) has been widely applied to solve complex optimization problems from real-world applications due to its efficient exploration of large solution spaces and the ability to converge towards optimal solutions without requiring gradient information. Common swarm topologies in standard PSO and its variants, e.g., Ring and Star, can be regarded as graphs, where each edge connects only two particles. Such topology structures allow direct interactions only between connected particle pairs, and thus often fail to directly capture the higher-order social relationships that are necessary for navigating complex search landscapes. Therefore, this article proposes a novel PSO variant termed Hypergraph-assisted Particle Swarm Optimization (HPSO). In HPSO, the topology of the particles in a swarm is modeled by a hypergraph, in which hyperedges are used to connect multiple particles. This allows multiple particles within a hyperedge to interact directly. Furthermore, an adaptive hypergraph updating strategy is designed to periodically reconstruct the topology based on cumulative average particle displacement, thereby maintaining swarm diversity throughout the evolutionary process. In the experiments, the effectiveness of HPSO is verified on the IEEE CEC'17 benchmark suite, and the results demonstrate that HPSO achieves promising performance across various types of functions. Furthermore, the ablation experiment demonstrates that HPSO has excellent search capabilities.

</details>


### [393] [Phase State Space Models: Parallel, Surrogate-Free Training of Spiking Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07754)
*Wilkie Olin-Ammentorp*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种将状态空间模型（SSMs）应用于共振-放电（R&F）脉冲神经网络的新解释框架，该框架兼容真实输入和脉冲输入、支持并行与循环执行，与超维计算（HD computing）有清晰联系，并保持生物合理性。作者实现了一个将STFT、循环记忆和注意力特征集成于单一脉冲兼容网络中的系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 状态空间模型为递归网络的并行训练提供了强大的理论框架，但此前将SSM适配到脉冲神经网络的工作有限。作者希望扩展这一方向，为共振-放电神经网络提供新的理论解释，使其既能利用SSM的并行训练优势，又能保持生物合理性的脉冲特征。

Method: 论文提出一种将SSM框架适配到R&F脉冲神经网络的创新解释方法，该方法：(1) 同时兼容真实值输入与脉冲输入；(2) 支持并行和循环两种执行模式；(3) 建立了与超维计算的理论联系；(4) 保留生物合理性。作者设计了一个将短时傅里叶变换（STFT）、循环记忆和注意力机制整合在同一脉冲兼容网络中的实现方案。

Result: 论文展示了所提出方法的具体实现，成功将STFT、循环记忆和注意力特征集成于单个脉冲兼容网络中，证明了该框架的理论可行性和实际可实现性。

Conclusion: 该工作为脉冲神经网络中的SSM应用提供了新的理论视角，并展示了在单一网络中整合多种计算特征的可能性，为后续脉冲计算和神经形态计算的研究奠定了基础。

Abstract: State-space models (SSMs) provide a powerful theoretical framework to enable parallel training of recurrent networks. We expand on previous work adapting SSMs to spiking models to provide a novel interpretation of resonate-and-fire (R\&F) neural networks which is compatible both with real and spiking inputs, parallel and recurrent execution, has clear connections to hyperdimensional (HD) computing, and maintains biologically-realistic features. We demonstrate an implementation of this approach which integrates an STFT, recurrent memory, and attentional features within a single spike-compatible network.

</details>


### [394] [RotaryQuant: Fitting 120B MoE Models on Consumer Hardware via Fused Compressed-Space Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08081)
*Anthony. Lui,Mohamed. Elsaied,N. P. Savani*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: RotaryQuant 是一个三轴压缩系统，通过混合精度权重量化、LRU专家卸载和IsoQuant KV缓存压缩三大机制，使26-120B参数的MoE大语言模型能在16-32GB内存的消费级设备上交互式运行（9-19 tok/s），且困惑度几乎无退化（ΔPPL ≤ +0.0012），并在32K上下文中保持100%检索准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型MoE语言模型（26-120B参数）超出消费级设备内存容量，面临三重压力：常驻权重矩阵、随上下文线性增长的KV缓存状态、以及需要按需分页的数十个专家子层。需要一种同时解决这三方面压力的压缩方案。

Method: 三轴压缩系统：(1) 混合精度权重量化——按架构角色分配位宽（稠密层4-bit、路由专家2-bit、共享专家8-bit，因其高激活峰度抵抗激进压缩）；(2) LRU专家卸载——在真实内存压力下将非驻留专家分页到磁盘；(3) IsoQuant KV缓存压缩——应用Walsh-Hadamard变换加块对角SO(4)旋转来各向同性化激活分布，再进行3-bit标量量化，仅需O(d log d)运算和每头256个存储参数。另配一个融合四内核Metal GPU流水线，直接在打包的3-bit张量上执行注意力，无需物化全精度KV状态。

Result: Gemma 4-26B-A4B和Qwen3-30B-A3B可装入16GB预算内，Nemotron-H 120B可装入32GB预算内，交互式运行速度为9-19 tok/s，困惑度退化接近零（ΔPPL ≤ +0.0012），32K上下文检索准确率达100%。

Conclusion: RotaryQuant通过三轴联合压缩策略，证明了大型MoE模型可以在消费级硬件上以交互速度运行而不损失质量，其中IsoQuant作为新颖的KV缓存压缩方法，以更低的计算复杂度和存储开销（相比稠密旋转方法的O(d²)和16384参数）实现了有效的各向同性化。

Abstract: Large mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models with 26--120 billion parameters exceed the memory capacity of consumer devices through three simultaneous pressures: resident weight matrices, key-value (KV) cache state that grows linearly with context, and dozens of expert sublayers that must be paged on demand. We present RotaryQuant, a three-axis compression system that addresses all three. Mixed-precision weight quantization assigns bit-widths by architectural role: 4-bit for dense layers, 2-bit for routed experts, and 8-bit for the shared expert whose high activation kurtosis resists aggressive compression. LRU expert offloading pages non-resident experts to disk under genuine memory pressure. The novel axis is IsoQuant, a KV cache compression method that applies a Walsh--Hadamard transform followed by block-diagonal SO(4) rotations to isotropize activation distributions before 3-bit scalar quantization, requiring $O(d \log d)$ operations and 256 stored parameters per head versus $O(d^2)$ and 16{,}384 for dense rotation methods. A fused four-kernel Metal GPU pipeline performs attention directly on packed 3-bit tensors without materializing full-precision KV state---a different execution model, not just a quantization scheme. The combined system fits Gemma 4-26B-A4B and Qwen3-30B-A3B within a 16\,GB budget and Nemotron-H 120B within 32\,GB, running interactively at 9--19 tok/s with near-zero perplexity degradation ($Δ$PPL $\leq +0.0012$) and 100\% retrieval accuracy at 32K context.

</details>


### [395] [SuperNeuroMAT: An Efficient Matrix-based Simulator for Spiking Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08479)
*Prasanna Date,Kevin Zhu,Shruti Kulkarni,Ashish Gautam,Chathika Gunaratne,Robert Patton,Tyler Nitzsche,Ian Mulet,Zachary Johnson-Scott,Addison Helms,Duncan Rowden,Simon Weston,Maryam Parsa,Catherine Schuman,Thomas Potok*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文介绍了SuperNeuroMAT，一个基于Python的开源、可扩展、高效的脉冲神经网络（SNN）模拟器。它采用新颖的矩阵方法模拟LIF神经元动力学，原生支持稠密和稀疏两种执行模式，在标准笔记本/台式机上可模拟约1万（稠密）至10万（稀疏）个神经元。该模拟器在速度和内存上均优于NEST、Brian2、BindsNET和snnTorch四种现有模拟器，并适用于机器学习基准、神经形态事件视觉任务及通用计算任务（如最短路径算法和算术运算）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SNN具有能源效率和类脑计算的潜力，但缺乏快速、易用且多功能的仿真框架，严重阻碍了其广泛应用与普及。

Method: 提出基于矩阵的LIF神经元动力学建模方法，支持稠密与稀疏两种原生执行模式，以纯Python实现高性能仿真，并可通过PyPI安装降低使用门槛。

Result: 在标准硬件上支持约10,000（稠密）/100,000（稀疏）个神经元的快速仿真；在执行速度和峰值内存两项指标上均优于NEST、Brian2、BindsNET和snnTorch，覆盖多种网络规模和连接概率；在Digits、citation network、N-CARS、ASL-DVS等数据集上验证了广泛适用性，并成功实现神经形态最短路径算法及加法/乘法等通用计算任务。

Conclusion: SuperNeuroMAT通过高效的矩阵方法、稠密/稀疏双模式支持和易安装性，显著降低了神经形态计算领域的入门门槛，有望加速SNN算法与应用的广泛发展。

Abstract: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) offer a promising pathway to energy-efficient AI and brain-inspired computing. However, their widespread adoption is hindered by a lack of fast, accessible, and versatile simulation frameworks. In this paper, we introduce SuperNeuroMAT, an open-source, scalable, and highly efficient Python-based SNN simulator. We devise a novel matrix-based approach to model the leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) neuron dynamics and natively support dense and sparse execution modes. This enables fast simulation of approximately 10,000 neurons in dense mode and 100,000 neurons in sparse mode on standard laptops and desktops without requiring specialized hardware. We demonstrate that SuperNeuroMAT consistently outperforms four established SNN simulators---NEST, Brian2, BindsNET, and snnTorch---on two performance metrics (execution speed and peak resident memory) and across various network sizes and connection probabilities. Furthermore, we demonstrate SuperNeuroMAT's applicability across a diverse set of problems. SuperNeuroMAT can efficiently handle conventional machine learning benchmarks such as the Digits and citation network datasets as well as neuromorphic event-based vision tasks such as N-CARS and ASL-DVS. Moreover, it can be extended beyond machine learning workloads and facilitate general-purpose workloads. We validated this by implementing the neuromorphic shortest path algorithm and two arithmetic primitives (addition and multiplication). SuperNeuroMAT can be installed via the Python Package Index (PyPI), thereby lowering the barrier to entry into the field of neuromorphic computing and accelerating the broader development of neuromorphic algorithms.

</details>


### [396] [A New Approach to Characterising Optimisation Problems Using Programmatic Representation and Complexity Measures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08898)
*Marcus Gallagher,Katherine M. Malan*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于程序代码表示的问题特征描述方法，利用Halstead体积和熵作为代码复杂性度量，用于刻画优化问题实例的复杂性。该方法无需搜索空间采样，计算快速且对变换具有不变性，在BBOB问题集和神经网络训练任务上验证了其与算法性能的负相关性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 优化问题实例的特征描述是理解算法行为、性能以及进行算法选择的关键基础。现有的问题特征描述方法通常需要对搜索空间进行采样，计算成本高且可能受变换影响，因此需要一种更高效、更通用的问题特征化方法。

Method: 将优化问题实例表示为程序代码，以Halstead体积作为代码复杂性度量（可视为程序熵的简化版），利用现有库快速计算目标函数代码实现的Halstead体积和熵，作为问题复杂度的代理指标。

Result: 在BBOB优化问题套件和前馈神经网络训练任务上进行了验证，结果表明所提出的复杂性能度量与算法性能呈负相关，显示出作为算法选择的预测性元特征的潜力。

Conclusion: 该度量可作为现有问题特征化方法的补充，其优势在于无需搜索空间采样、对变换具有不变性、计算非常快速且可自动完成，有潜力用于算法选择和问题分析。

Abstract: Characterising optimisation problem instances is a fundamental part of understanding the behaviour and performance of different algorithms as well as providing information for algorithm selection and configuration. In this paper we propose a novel approach to problem characterisation based on the representation of instances when implemented as a program. The intuition is that the complexity of the code required to express an objective function should relate to the complexity of the search landscape. We identify the Halstead volume as a measure of code complexity, which can be seen as a simplified version of the entropy of the program. Given a code implementation of the objective function, the Halstead volume and entropy can be quickly calculated using existing libraries. We apply the proposed complexity measures to the well-known BBOB optimisation problem suite and the simple feed-forward neural network training task. We also show that the measures are negatively correlated with algorithm performance and therefore show potential as predictive meta-features for algorithm selection and other problem analysis. We envisage the proposed measures as complementary to other problem characterisation approaches, but with the advantages of not requiring any sampling of the search space, being invariant to transformations, and being very quick to calculate automatically.

</details>


### [397] [Identifying potentiating events in evolutionary search using replay experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09833)
*Austin J. Ferguson,Alexander Lalejini*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文首次将"回放实验"（replay experiments）这一源自实验室进化生物学的概念引入进化计算领域。通过从不同历史时间点重新启动种群进化，回放实验可以采样种群在不同时间点可能演化出的结果分布，从而量化种群历史如何影响其达成不同进化结果的潜能。作者提供了设计回放实验的逐步指南，并通过一个遗传编程种群的示例实验证明：解决问题的潜能提升并不一定对应种群适应度的提升。作者认为该方法是拓展进化计算理论基础的强大工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 进化计算领域长期以来缺乏一种有效的实证方法来研究种群历史如何塑造其未来的进化潜能。实验室进化生物学中的回放实验为识别"促进事件"（potentiating events）提供了成熟的经验手段，但这一方法论尚未被引入进化计算社区。作者希望通过引入回放实验，为进化计算提供一种可量化的、系统性的分析工具，以更好地理解种群历史与进化结果之间的因果关系。

Method: 作者首先提供了设计回放实验的分步指南，涵盖实验设计的关键要素（如历史时间点选择、重播次数、结果测量等）。随后，作者以进化遗传编程种群为对象，开展了一个示范性的回放实验：从种群进化轨迹中选取不同历史时间点重新启动进化，测量种群在解决问题（problem-solving success）上的潜能如何随历史进程变化，并将其与种群适应度的变化进行对比分析。

Result: 示范实验结果显示，遗传编程种群在解决问题潜能上的增长与种群适应度的增长并不一致——适应度提升并不必然意味着进化成功的潜能增加。这揭示了传统适应度指标可能掩盖种群潜在进化能力的真实变化，证明回放实验能提供超越表面适应度的深层洞察。

Conclusion: 回放实验是拓展进化计算理论基础的有力工具，它使研究者能够实证地考察种群历史如何影响未来的进化可能性。作者建议将其推广到更多进化计算研究场景，并指出若干有前景的未来研究方向（如研究不同选择压力、变异算子等对种群潜能的影响）。

Abstract: In this work, we introduce analytical replay experiments to the evolutionary computing community. Replay experiments originated in the context of laboratory experimental evolution as an empirical approach to identifying potentiating events that increased the likelihood of an observed evolutionary outcome. By restarting a population's evolution from different historical time points, replay experiments sample the distribution of what could have evolved from different points in time, which allows us to quantify how a population's potential for different evolutionary outcomes changed as a result of that population's history. In this work, we give a step-by-step guide to designing replay experiments for evolutionary computing systems. We then provide a demonstrative example replay experiment that measures how potentiation for problem-solving success changed in an evolved genetic programming population, showing that increases in potential for success do not necessarily correspond with increases in a population's fitness. Broadly, we argue that analytical replay experiments can be a powerful tool for expanding the theoretical foundations of evolutionary computing, and we offer suggestions for promising future research directions enabled by replay experiments.

</details>


### [398] [BDH-CQ: In-Context Learning with Recurrent Latent Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09888)
*Björn Engdahl,Adrian Kosowski,Jan Chorowski,Zuzanna Stamirowska,Przemysław Uznański,Junlin Jiang,Rohan Phadke,Remigiusz Kinas,Richard Zhong*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文提出BDH-CQ，一种结合上下文学习与循环潜在推理的推理模型。它通过输入持续更新循环记忆，并在高维潜在空间中迭代计算求解查询，不进行中间推理的语言输出。150M参数配置在ARC-AGI-1上达到29.5% pass@2，单任务推理成本仅$0.0007，突破了该基准的性价比前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理模型在ARC-AGI-1等抽象推理基准上通常成本高昂，且许多方法依赖显式的链式思维（CoT）输出中间推理，既增加计算开销又可能限制推理灵活性与效率。作者希望探索一种更高效的推理范式——将上下文学习与循环潜在推理相结合，在不语言化中间推理的前提下实现强推理性能。

Method: BDH-CQ模型将输入在推理时持续注入到循环记忆中，使模型能够动态整合演示信息（in-context learning），随后通过在潜在（高维隐空间）中的迭代计算来求解查询，全程不产生显式的中间推理文本。作者还设计了受控的ARC风格干预实验，以分析模型从演示中学习的内容、应用推断变换的一致性以及未能掌握的难点概念。

Result: 150M参数配置在公共ARC-AGI-1评测集上达到29.5% pass@2，单个任务的推理计算成本仅为$0.0007。该结果突破了先前报道的ARC-AGI-1成本-准确率帕累托前沿，建立了新的基准成本效率最优。

Conclusion: BDH-CQ证明了将上下文学习与循环潜在推理相结合的范式能够在极低推理成本下取得具有竞争力的ARC-AGI-1性能，开辟了兼顾准确率与效率的推理模型设计新方向，并为理解演示学习机制与推理局限提供了可控的实验分析框架。

Abstract: We introduce BDH-CQ, a reasoning model that combines in-context learning with recurrent latent reasoning. Inputs presented at inference time continuously update the model's recurrent memory; the model then solves a query through iterative computation in a high-dimensional latent space, without verbalizing its intermediate reasoning. We evaluate the model on the public ARC-AGI-1 evaluation set and use controlled ARC-like interventions to study what it learns from demonstrations, how consistently it applies an inferred transformation, and which concepts remain difficult. A 150M-parameter configuration reaches 29.5% pass@2 at a computed inference cost of \$0.0007 per task. This operating point breaks through the previously reported ARC-AGI-1 cost-accuracy Pareto frontier, establishing a new state of the art in benchmark cost efficiency.

</details>

### [399] [World Simulator: Queer Erotica and the Absurdity of AI Video Models That Promise the World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07510)
*Adam Cole,Mick Grierson*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一件名为"World Simulator"的视频装置艺术作品，该作品将同志情色影像输入AI视频模型，利用模型在缺乏相关训练数据时产生的幻觉性输出，揭示AI"世界模拟器"宣称与现实之间的根本矛盾，并对模拟本身的感官表现价值提出质疑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI视频模型被广泛宣传为"世界模拟器"，宣称能够模拟无限现实，但这些模型系统地排除了具身人类经验的重要方面（尤其是性）。作者希望通过艺术实践揭示这种宣称的傲慢与其结构性盲区之间的矛盾。

Method: 将显性同志情色影像输入AI视频到视频（video-to-video）管线，观察系统因缺乏训练数据而产生的幻觉性重构——将亲密行为转化为厨房电器、奇异建筑和抽象肉体的荒诞场景，从而可视化合成知识的边界。

Result: 系统无法识别这些输入图像，产生了幻觉性的超现实替代，将亲密行为扭曲为平庸的日常场景和抽象形态，直观展示了AI模型在处理其训练数据盲区时的不稳定性与变形能力。

Conclusion: 该作品挑战了"世界模拟器"标签的傲慢，质疑一个基于大规模过滤视频数据集训练的系统在结构性失明于身体的情况下如何声称能模拟世界；同时提出对模拟价值本身的反思，追问何种感官表征形式能提供更广阔、更具生命肯定性的可能性。

Abstract: Increasingly, AI video models are marketed as "world simulators," suggesting their ability to model infinite realities. Despite such claims, these models systematically exclude significant aspects of embodied human experience, particularly sexuality. World Simulator is a video installation exploring the poetic friction between these universal claims and the models' inherent blindness. To do so, the work feeds explicit gay erotica into an AI video-to-video pipeline. Lacking the training data to recognize these images, the system hallucinates surreal alternatives, transforming intimate acts into banal scenes of kitchen appliances, strange architectures, and abstract flesh. By visualizing the limits of synthetic knowledge, the work challenges the hubris of the "world simulator" label, asking how a system, trained primarily on large filtered video datasets, can claim to simulate the world while remaining structurally blind to the body. Beyond this critique, we question the value of simulation itself, asking what forms of sensual representation might offer more expansive, life-affirming possibilities.

</details>


### [400] [SAMOT: State-Aware Step Modulation and Optimal Transport Matching for Audio-Visual Instance Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08147)
*Kai Peng,Yunzhe Shen,Miao Zhang,Leiye Liu,Wei Ji,Jingjing Li,Yongri Piao,Huchuan Lu*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于音视频实例分割（AVIS）的框架，包含自适应动态步长调制（ADSM）和基于最优传输的匹配调制（OT-MM），在AVIS基准上取得了最先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AVIS任务面临两个关键挑战：（1）模态状态变化复杂，破坏长距离建模；（2）模态间结构与分布差异大，阻碍实例级关联。现有方法（固定步长Transformer和递归Mamba）缺乏对模态状态变化的适应性，且隐式匹配忽略了分布不一致性。

Method: 提出两个核心模块：ADSM利用时间变化、跨模态差异和历史上下文自适应调节Mamba步长，在响应模态状态变化与稳定长距离建模之间取得平衡；OT-MM将实例级跨模态匹配显式建模为熵正则化最优传输问题，通过log-domain Sinkhorn迭代求解，并用MMD正则化器增强分布级一致性。

Result: 在AVIS基准上取得最先进性能：FSLA提升+3.76，HOTA提升+2.75，mAP提升+2.58，并通过全面的定性可视化验证。

Conclusion: ADSM与OT-MM分别解决了模态状态变化适应性和分布不一致性问题，共同推动了音视频实例分割的性能提升，代码和模型已开源。

Abstract: Audio-Visual Instance Segmentation (AVIS) aims to simultaneously classify, segment, and track sounding objects within video sequences. Unlike Audio-Visual Semantic Segmentation (AVS), AVIS involves instance-level modeling across longer video sequences, introducing two key challenges: (1) complex modality-state changes disrupt long-range modeling, and (2) substantial structural and distributional discrepancies between modalities hinder precise instance-level association. Existing methods rely on fixed-step Transformers and recursive Mamba models, lacking adaptability to modality-state changes. In addition, methods performing implicit matching ignore the inherent distributional inconsistencies. To address these issues, we propose a framework with Adaptive Dynamic Step Modulation (ADSM) and Optimal Transport-based Matching Modulation (OT-MM). ADSM adaptively modulates Mamba step sizes using temporal variation, cross-modal discrepancy, and historical context, balancing rapid response to modality-state changes with stable long-range modeling. OT-MM explicitly formulates instance-level cross-modal matching as an entropy-regularized optimal transport problem solved via log-domain Sinkhorn iterations, and further enforces distribution-level coherence with an MMD regularizer. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on the AVIS benchmark (+3.76 FSLA, +2.75 HOTA, +2.58 mAP), verified through comprehensive qualitative visualizations. The code and model are available at https://github.com/happylife-pk/SAMOT.

</details>


<div id='cs.IR'></div>

# cs.IR [[Back]](#toc)

### [401] [Preserving Item Semantics for Free: Rethinking Token Initialization in LLM-Based Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07816)
*Donald Loveland,Liam Collins,Bhuvesh Kumar,Danai Koutra,Neil Shah*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文针对生成式推荐系统中语义ID（SID）token嵌入的初始化问题，发现标准随机初始化会导致嵌入围绕物品流行度而非语义组织，且昂贵的持续预训练（CPT）也无法可靠恢复语义几何。作者提出一种零参数干预方案——直接从语义嵌入空间的质心初始化SID token嵌入，仅需几行代码且无额外训练/推理开销，即可提升纯SFT Recall@5最高16%，冷物品Recall@5提升最高60%，并减少高达40%的SFT步数和一半的CPT轮数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式推荐系统利用LLM作为骨干模型，物品通过语义ID（SID）表示为特殊token。理想情况下SID应赋予物品token表示语义先验以改善泛化，但标准词汇扩展采用随机高斯初始化，丢弃了SID潜在的连续几何结构，迫使LLM从交互数据中重新学习token关系，导致嵌入围绕物品流行度而非语义组织，且CPT无法可靠恢复语义几何。

Method: 提出一种简单、无需参数的干预方法：用SID对应语义嵌入空间中的质心直接初始化SID token嵌入。该方法作为即插即用（drop-in）方案，仅需修改少量代码，不引入额外训练或推理开销。

Result: 实验结果表明：纯SFT场景下Recall@5最高提升16%，峰值性能所需SFT步数减少高达40%，冷物品Recall@5最高提升60%；在需要额外CPT的数据集上，质心初始化只需一半CPT轮数即可达到可比性能。

Conclusion: 研究证明在LLM生成式推荐中，保留SID的几何结构（超越共享前缀结构）能提供简单有效的语义先验，同时指出标准随机初始化和CPT在恢复语义几何方面的局限性，为LLM-based GR的token初始化提供了新的设计原则。

Abstract: Recent advances in generative recommendation (GR) leverage large language models (LLMs) as recommender backbones, enabling LLMs to directly generate recommendations conditioned on item-interaction histories. In these systems, items are often represented through semantic IDs (SIDs) added to the LLM vocabulary as special tokens. Ideally, SIDs imbue item token representations with semantic priors, thereby improving model generalization. However, standard vocabulary expansion typically initializes these tokens as random Gaussian vectors, discarding the SIDs' underlying continuous geometry and forcing the LLM to relearn token relationships from interaction data. To demonstrate the consequences of this design, we first show that training from this initialization tends to organize SID embeddings around item popularity rather than semantics. We further show that, despite partially reducing the reliance on popularity and improving cold item performance, the computationally expensive process of continual pretraining (CPT) fails to reliably recover the original semantic geometry. To address these findings, we propose a simple, parameter-free intervention that initializes SID token embeddings directly from their corresponding centroids in the semantic embedding space. Requiring only a few lines of code and no additional training or inference overhead, this drop-in approach improves pure-SFT Recall@5 by up to 16%, reaches peak performance with up to 40% fewer SFT steps, and improves cold-item Recall@5 by up to 60%. Moreover, on datasets that benefit from additional CPT, centroid initialization reaches comparable performance while requiring half as many CPT epochs.
