Together, our findings show that preserving SID geometry, beyond shared-prefix structure, provides a simple and effective semantic prior for LLM-based GR.

</details>


### [402] [PushDualGen: Enabling LLMs to Generate Semantic IDs with Interpretable Copy for Industrial Push Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07989)
*Manjia Lin,Da Li,Yan Wang,Yong Jin,Zheming Ding,Wei Yuan,Lei Yan,Yanan Xia,Lu Zhang,Fan Yang,Xuanping Li,Yanan Niu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Error


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Error

Method: Error

Result: Error

Conclusion: Error

Abstract: Push recommendation in KuaiShou proactively delivers personalized content to nearly one billion users to facilitate their engagement. Recently, generative recommendation has achieved end-to-end user personalization through semantic ID. However, their black- box characteristics make recommendation logics difficult to trace, hindering their deployment. OneRec-Thinking addresses this by incorporating CoT before generating SIDs, but this significantly increases inference cost. To support large-scale industrial applications, we propose PushDualGen, a lightweight generator, which first generates the SID and then produces a copy as a skippable explanation. PushDualGen has been deployed in Kuaishou's push recommendation system. Online A/B tests demonstrate the effectiveness of PushDualGen, delivering significant improvements in both user attraction and satisfaction. The effective play rate for videos recommended to users has relatively increased by 8.50%, while the dissatisfaction rate has relatively fallen by 37.70%. In the long term, PushDualGen optimises the content ecosystem, providing more exposure for long-tail videos.

</details>


### [403] [Give the Long-tail More SPACE: Promoting Provider Fairness in Next POI Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07998)
*Anran Zhang,Jiaqi Jiang,jiahui Jin,Yuhan Zhao*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: SPACE是一个模型无关的框架，通过虚拟用户生成来改善POI推荐中的长尾曝光公平性问题，同时考虑用户的物理执行约束和POI的资源供给约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流POI推荐模型往往过度曝光热门地点，导致长尾商户系统性曝光不足。现有提供方公平性技术不适用于POI推荐，因为(i)用户面临物理执行约束（如地理距离、可达性），(ii)POI面临资源供给约束（如接待能力）。

Method: SPACE包含三个阶段：(1)社区推断，捕捉异构用户执行约束；(2)非平衡最优传输分配，在POI特定供给预算下决定各尾POI应从哪些社区获得多少虚拟用户；(3)约束引导的潜空间扩散模型，生成POI条件、社区一致的虚拟用户嵌入。生成的用户-POI对可直接用于训练现有推荐器。

Result: 在三个真实数据集上的大量实验表明，SPACE在多个骨干模型上显著提升提供方公平性，同时保持甚至提高推荐准确性。

Conclusion: SPACE通过在生成虚拟用户时显式控制可行性和供给条件，有效解决了POI推荐中的长尾曝光公平性问题，且无需修改现有推荐器架构，具有较好的通用性和实用性。

Abstract: Next point-of-interest (POI) recommendation predicts users' future destinations from historical mobility sequences and has become a key component of location-based services. However, mainstream models often concentrate exposure on a small set of popular POIs, leaving long-tail merchants systematically under-exposed. While provider fairness has recently attracted increasing attention, directly applying existing provider-fairness techniques to POI recommendation is problematic: (i) users face execution constraints; and (ii) POIs face resource supply constraints. To address this, we propose SPACE (Supply- and Physics-Aware Conditional Embedding generation), a model-agnostic framework that improves long-tail POI exposure via virtual user generation under explicit feasibility and supply control. SPACE consists of three stages: (1) community inference to capture heterogeneous user execution constraints; (2) unbalanced optimal-transport allocation to decide how many virtual users each tail POI should receive from which communities under POI-specific supply budgets; and (3) constraint-guided latent diffusion to generate POI-conditional, community-consistent virtual user embeddings. The generated user-POI pairs can be seamlessly used to train existing recommenders without modifying their architectures. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate that SPACE substantially improves provider fairness while maintaining and often improving recommendation accuracy across multiple backbone models. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Anniran1/SPACE-main.

</details>


### [404] [Search over the Visual World: Persistent Visual Memory, Layered Indexes, and Source-Grounded Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08075)
*Sankalp Nagaonkar,Rohit Garg,Ankit Raj,Ashish Choithani,Ashutosh Trivedi*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出将视频检索视为基础设施问题，而非简单的文件排序问题。作者开发了基于分析器定义场景、持久理解工件、视觉记忆和索引的正式模型，并通过VideoDB数据格式（VDB）在工业中实现。在9800+查询的对比中，通用组件流水线在Recall@1/@3/@10上优于商业视频原生引擎。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统视频检索系统假设有界语料库并返回排序文件或时间戳，但面向摄像头、屏幕、流和档案的智能体面临不同问题：观测持续到达、模型以不同时间粒度解释、上下文选择不能重放完整视觉记录、结果必须连接到可检查的证据源。作者认为搜索视觉世界是一个基础设施问题，不能简化为视频文件排序，批评视频原生基础模型作为固定API的方式。

Method: 构建搜索视觉世界的概念和正式模型，包含：分析器定义场景、持久理解工件、视觉记忆作为共享源时间上的共存场景空间、能力声明索引。区分记忆（保留的一切）、上下文（为任务选择的）和证据（作为基础的源区间）。通过VideoDB数据格式（VDB）实现该模型，提供类型化搜索界面，涵盖计划检索、状态调查、直接访问和基于证据的综合。该基础设施是模型无关的，分段、采样、模型选择、嵌入和排序都是系统决策，实时流是头等来源。

Result: 在语义检索对比中，针对四个公共数据集9800+查询，通用组件流水线在宏平均Recall@1/@3/@10上分别为73.09/83.39/91.20，优于商业视频原生引擎的65.75/77.13/89.10；仅在Recall@50上基线更高（96.42对96.07）。

Conclusion: 视觉世界的检索质量目前更多由系统设计决定而非视频特定预训练，视觉记忆基础设施可以在保持可播放、源基础证据为首要的同时实现高质量检索。

Abstract: Most video-retrieval systems assume a bounded corpus and return ranked files or timestamps. Agents operating over cameras, screens, streams, and archives face a different systems problem: observations arrive continuously; models interpret them at different temporal granularities; context must be selected without replaying the complete visual record; and results must stay connected to inspectable source evidence. We argue that search over such a corpus is an infrastructure problem that cannot be reduced to ranking video files. We develop a conceptual and formal model of search over the visual world built on analyzer-defined scenes, persistent understanding artifacts, visual memory as coexisting scene spaces over shared source time, and capability-declared indexes, distinguishing memory (everything retained), context (what is selected for a task), and evidence (the source intervals that ground it). The VideoDB data format (VDB) realizes this model in production, exposed through a typed search surface spanning planned retrieval, stateful investigation, direct access, and grounded synthesis. We contrast this model-agnostic infrastructure, where segmentation, sampling, model choice, embeddings, and ranking are system decisions and live streams are first-class sources, with video-native foundation models offered as fixed APIs. In a semantic-retrieval comparison against a commercial video-native engine spanning 9,800+ queries over four public datasets, a pipeline of general-purpose components achieves higher macro-averaged Recall@1/@3/@10 (73.09/83.39/91.20 versus 65.75/77.13/89.10), while the baseline is higher at Recall@50 (96.42 versus 96.07). Retrieval quality over the visual world is today governed more by system design than by video-specific pretraining, and visual-memory infrastructure can deliver it while keeping playable, source-grounded evidence first-class.

</details>


### [405] [DS@GT ARC at Touché: Large Language Models for Retrieval-Augmented Debate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08143)
*Anthony Miyaguchi,Conor Johnston*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文扩展了DS@GT ARC团队在Touché 2025检索增强辩论（RAD）任务上的工作，该任务包含两个子任务：在模拟辩论中生成下一句发言，以及根据Grice准则（数量、质量、关系、方式）评估辩论回应。团队使用六个来自三家提供商的领先LLM，通过检索增强提示流水线完成提交。论文分析了多LLM评估器一致性是否能作为官方评估表现的可靠代理，发现前沿LLM是强大的回应生成器，评估时在同一模型家族内一致性高，但这种共识不能可靠反映官方评估目标，尤其在质量准则上差距最大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多LLM评估场景中，评估器之间的一致性是否能够替代官方评估指标尚未得到充分验证。作者希望探究多LLM评估器共识能否作为官方评估表现的可靠代理，以指导实际评估策略。

Method: 采用检索增强提示流水线，使用六个来自三个不同提供商的领先LLM完成Touché 2025 RAD任务的两个子任务（辩论回应生成与Grice准则评估），并通过比较多LLM评估器一致性与官方评估结果来检验其作为代理指标的可靠性。

Result: 前沿LLM系统在回应生成上表现强劲；作为评估器时，同一模型家族内的评估结果高度一致，但这种共识并不能可靠地与官方评估目标对齐，其中在质量（Quality）准则上的偏差最大。

Conclusion: 多LLM评估器的一致性不应被视为官方评估表现的可靠代理指标，尤其是在质量准则方面需要谨慎对待。研究开源了相关代码以供复现和进一步分析。

Abstract: We extend the DS@GT ARC working-note submission to the Touché 2025 Retrieval-Augmented Debate task. The task has two subtasks: generating the next utterance in a simulated debate, and evaluating debate responses according to the Gricean maxims of Quantity, Quality, Relation, and Manner. The DS@GT ARC submission consisted of six leading LLMs from three providers through a retrieval-augmented prompting pipeline. We summarize the results from the working paper and explore whether multi-LLM evaluator agreement is a reliable proxy for official evaluation performance. The analysis shows that frontier LLM systems are strong response generators, and as evaluators they agree strongly within model families. However this consensus does not reliably track the official evaluation target, with the largest gap on the Quality maxim. The accompanying source code for this paper is located at https://github.com/dsgt-arc/touche-2025-rad and https://github.com/dsgt-arc/touche-2025-rad-analysis.

</details>


### [406] [Personalized Communication Skills for Agentic Recommender Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08417)
*Zongwei Wang,Min Gao,Guangyu Hu,Xinyi Gao,Junliang Yu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: AgentCom提出了一个面向智能体推荐系统的个性化沟通技能框架，通过组织"为什么-是什么-怎么做-谁"技能库，并结合个性化技能路由与失败驱动的技能进化机制，解决用户智能体在孤立推理中产生的视角狭窄问题，实验证明其在传统、社交和智能体推荐器上均能提升推荐性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于大语言模型的用户智能体在评估候选物品时通常基于有限的个人历史进行孤立推理，导致视角狭窄（perspective narrowing），即从局部不完整的视角评估候选物品，忽略相关的偏好维度，从而产生不准确的判断。引入其他用户作为顾问智能体是自然的解决思路，但通用的用户-顾问通信过程不足，因为不同用户的决策状态需要不同形式的外部建议。

Method: AgentCom框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 共享的"为什么-是什么-怎么做-谁"技能库（why标识决策缺陷，what指定信息任务，how确定顾问交互协议，who检索能执行协议的顾问）；(2) 个性化技能路由：针对每位用户和推荐上下文顺序选择合适技能构建通信路径；(3) 失败驱动技能进化：从失败沟通案例中学习，丰富共享技能库以应对此前未覆盖的沟通需求。

Result: 实验表明AgentCom在传统推荐器、社交推荐器和智能体推荐器上均能一致地提升推荐性能。

Conclusion: AgentCom通过将沟通技能组织为可复用、可个性化且可进化的技能库，有效缓解了用户智能体的视角狭窄问题，验证了定制化外部建议机制对提升智能体推荐系统性能的重要价值。

Abstract: Agentic recommender systems increasingly employ large language model-based UserAgents to evaluate candidate items through simulated feedback before recommendations are delivered. However, existing UserAgents typically reason in isolation based on limited personal histories, which may lead to perspective narrowing: the agent evaluates candidates from a local and incomplete view, overlooks relevant preference facets, and consequently produces inaccurate judgments. A natural way to alleviate this problem is to introduce other users as advisor agents, whose diverse histories provide complementary evidence that helps the target user reconsider overlooked preference signals. Nevertheless, a generic user-advisor communication process is insufficient, as different user decision states require different forms of external advice. Based on this insight, we propose AgentCom, a personalized communication skill framework for agentic recommender systems. AgentCom organizes reusable communication skills into a shared why--what--how--who skill bank: why identifies the decision deficiency that necessitates communication, what specifies the information task, how determines the advisor interaction protocol, and who retrieves advisors capable of executing that protocol. To make the shared skill bank personalized at use time and adaptive over time, AgentCom introduces two complementary mechanisms: personalized skill routing and failure-driven skill evolution. Personalized skill routing constructs a communication path by sequentially selecting suitable skills for each user and recommendation context. Failure-driven skill evolution learns from unsuccessful communication cases and enriches the shared bank with reusable skills that address previously uncovered communication needs. Experiments show that AgentCom consistently improves recommendation performance across traditional, social, and agentic recommenders.

</details>


### [407] [Structure-Preserving Projection for Mitigating Modality Bias in LLM-Based Sequential Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08583)
*Tzu-Wei Chiu,Song-Duo Ma,Hsin-Yu Lin,Pu-Jen Cheng*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种结构保持投影方法，通过在投影过程中引入专门的结构保持损失，维持协同嵌入的关系几何结构，从而避免LLM推荐系统中投影带来的模态偏差，提升推荐性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LLM推荐系统将协同嵌入投影到LLM的嵌入空间中，但这种投影会引入模态偏差（modality bias），扭曲底层的协同结构，限制了投影嵌入的效用。

Method: 提出一种结构保持投影（structure-preserving projection）方法，通过专门设计的结构保持损失（structure-preserving losses）来维持协同嵌入的关系几何结构（relational geometry），在投影过程中保护原有的协同关系。

Result: 综合实验表明，该方法在推荐性能上持续优于基线方法，为LLM推荐提供了更可靠的路径。

Conclusion: 结构保持投影能够有效缓解模态偏差问题，保护协同结构的完整性，是提升LLM推荐系统性能的有效且可靠的方案。

Abstract: Recent LLM-based recommenders integrate textual and collaborative signals by projecting collaborative embeddings into the embedding space of the LLM. However, this projection can introduce modality bias that distorts the underlying collaborative structure and limits the usefulness of projected embeddings. To address this issue, we propose a novel structure-preserving projection approach that maintains the relational geometry of collaborative embeddings through dedicated structure-preserving losses. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our approach consistently improves recommendation performance, providing a more reliable path for LLM-based recommendation.

</details>


### [408] [BOUND: Brief-Guided Corrective Preference Distillation at Search-Control Boundaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08768)
*Qingying Niu,Ruiyang Ren,Wayne Xin Zhao,Yaliang Li*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: BOUND是一个基于简报引导的纠正性偏好蒸馏框架，用于解决大规模语言模型深度搜索智能体在迭代检索与推理中的持续性搜索漂移问题（包括错误锚点漂移、约束漂移和局部主题漂移）。该方法通过构建教师端搜索状态简报，判断学生行为是否存在可纠正的局部搜索控制错误，并生成状态匹配的偏好对，利用DPO进行蒸馏，在多个基准上取得领先性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法监督轨迹、结果或步骤，但很少能区分与任务一致的延续和强化漂移的局部合理延续。局部相关证据会导致深度搜索智能体持续出现错误锚点漂移、约束漂移或局部主题漂移，需要一种能识别并纠正这些漂移的方法。

Method: 对于每个学生诱导的决策时状态，构建保留原始搜索目标和关键约束的教师端搜索简报，同时总结已确认证据、缺失信息和漂移状态。教师基于简报判断学生的延续是否包含可纠正的局部搜索控制错误，并结合滚动结果决定构建纠正对比（学生特定修正与原延续）或终止对比（受支持答案与不必要检索延续）。每个验证的状态匹配偏好对操作化一个搜索控制边界，通过DPO蒸馏到学生中，简报和教师端计算仅限训练阶段。

Result: 在四个多跳QA基准和三个深度搜索基准上评估BOUND。在重新运行基线的六个基准中，BOUND在五个数据集和14个指标中的12个上领先。在相同搜索控制接口和匹配设置下，BOUND在Bamboogle上超越Trajectory SFT 5.6个EM点，在BrowseComp-Plus上超越4.8个准确率点。

Conclusion: BOUND通过简报引导的方式有效区分任务对齐延续与局部合理但强化漂移的延续，构建精确定位的搜索控制边界偏好，显著提升了深度搜索智能体的性能。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based deep search agents solve tasks through iterative retrieval and reasoning, but locally relevant evidence can cause persistent wrong-anchor drift, constraint drift, or local-topic drift. Existing methods supervise trajectories, outcomes, or steps, but rarely distinguish task-aligned continuations from locally plausible ones that reinforce drift. We propose BOUND, a brief-guided corrective preference distillation framework for persistent search drift. For each student-induced decision-time state, BOUND constructs a teacher-side search-state brief that preserves the original search target and key constraints while summarizing confirmed evidence, missing information, and drift status. Guided by the brief, the teacher determines whether the student's continuation contains a correctable local search-control error likely to affect subsequent decisions. Together with the rollout outcome, this assessment determines whether to construct a corrective contrast between a student-specific correction and the original continuation, or a termination contrast between a supported answer and an unnecessary retrieval continuation. Each validated state-matched preference pair operationalizes a search-control boundary. Direct preference optimization (DPO) distills these preferences into the student, while the brief and teacher-side computation remain confined to training. We evaluate BOUND on four multi-hop QA benchmarks and three deep-search benchmarks. Across the six benchmarks for which we reran baselines, BOUND leads on five datasets and 12 of 14 metrics. Under the same search-control interface and matched settings, BOUND outperforms Trajectory SFT by 5.6 EM points on Bamboogle and 4.8 accuracy points on BrowseComp-Plus. Code is available at https://github.com/RUCAIBox/BOUND.

</details>


### [409] [A Symmetric Layer-Union Audit of Component Collapse in Hierarchical Procedural Corpora](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08892)
*Jiuyi Zheng,Gan Xu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文对六个层次化程序性语料库进行对称审计，研究组件分离的泄漏控制问题，发现MyFixit和Doc2Dial在单独层通过但联合层失败的"单层通过/联合失败"模式，同时报告了预测因子与对照无法区分、机制无法识别的负面结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组件分离的泄漏控制需要按内容相似性、层次隶属或两者结合来分组语料单元。前人的工作显示合并关系类型可能产生阻碍分裂的巨大组件，本文希望以更严格的对称审计方式审视这一现象，而不将其作为新发现宣称。

Method: 对固定的六个层次化程序性语料库面板，对称审计三个层面：内容近重复层、公共容器层及其并集。采用一致的操作标准进行评估，并预设了桥接特异性预测因子与已注册的联合密度对照进行比较，同时进行阈值敏感性、标注覆盖率和词汇线索的次级诊断。

Result: MyFixit和Doc2Dial在同一个操作标准下呈现出"单层通过/联合失败"模式，得到六分之二的比率。该比率只是针对精心构建的面板，而非流行率估计。桥接特异性预测因子与联合密度对照未能区分，因此面板无法识别桥接特有机制。

Conclusion: 本文的贡献在于有界测量与审计：保持关系家族可见、对称评估各层及其联合组件结构、报告负面案例和机制局限。它既不提出新的分裂算法，也不对关系联合提出普遍性因果主张。

Abstract: Component-disjoint leakage control can group corpus units by content similarity, hierarchical membership, or both. Guvenilir and Dogan previously showed that merging relation types can create a giant component that obstructs splitting; we do not claim this phenomenon as new. We examine it through a symmetric audit of a content-near-duplicate layer, a common-container layer, and their union in a fixed panel of six hierarchical procedural corpora. MyFixit and Doc2Dial exhibit the individual-layer-pass/union-fail pattern under the same operational criteria. The resulting two-of-six fraction describes this deliberately constructed panel and is not a prevalence estimate. A prespecified bridge-specific predictor is associated with the pattern, but it is not distinguished from a registered union-density control; the panel therefore does not identify a bridge-specific mechanism. Secondary diagnostics bound the interpretation of threshold sensitivity, annotation coverage, and lexical cues without extending those findings beyond their recorded sources and definitions. The paper's contribution is a bounded measurement and audit: it keeps relation families visible, evaluates their individual and union component structures symmetrically, and reports negative cases and mechanism limits. It proposes neither a new splitting algorithm nor a general causal claim about relation unions.

</details>


### [410] [Difficulty-Gated Fusion of Reasoning Views for Temporal Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08940)
*Jamie Holdcroft,Abdelrahman Abdallah,Adam Jatowt*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出查询难度门控的推理视角融合方法（query-difficulty-gated fusion of reasoning views），用于时序检索任务。通过将查询扩展为多个显式表达时序意图的重述，并为每个重述生成八维分数分布特征签名，用一个约千参数的门控网络学习每查询的视角权重，无需相关标签、重排序或检索器微调即可完成融合排名。在Tempo基准上显著提升六种检索器性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理密集型时序检索需要匹配语义时序推理而非词汇重叠的查询与文档。虽可通过查询重述来提供推理，但等权重融合各重述结果会浪费准确性——对任意单一查询而言，只有部分重述是可靠的。

Method: 从每个重述视角读取八维分数分布签名（基于查询性能预测量，如softmax熵、分数间隙和离散度），由一个约一千参数的门控网络将这签名映射为每查询的视角权重。训练采用留一任务方式（leave-one-task-out），推理时无需相关标签、重排序或检索器微调。

Result: 在Tempo基准上，该方法提升了全部六种检索器（从BERT编码器到7B解码器检索器），对较弱骨干网络提升最大。最强检索器达到0.297和0.303的nDCG@10，每查询相比原始查询的提升经配对bootstrap检验显著（p<0.001）。理想oracle可达0.364，而实际为0.297，暴露了改进空间。

Conclusion: 查询难度门控的推理视角融合方法有效且轻量，无需重排序或微调检索器即可显著提升时序检索性能。每查询视角选择（per-query view selection）被识别为具体的下一步研究方向，存在从0.297到0.364的提升空间。

Abstract: Reasoning-intensive temporal retrieval requires matching a query to documents whose relevance depends on shared temporal reasoning rather than lexical overlap. Expanding a query into several reformulations that make its temporal intent explicit, and retrieving with each, supplies this reasoning, but fusing the resulting rankings with equal weights wastes accuracy: for any single query, only some reformulations are reliable. We propose query-difficulty-gated fusion of reasoning views. From each view we read an eight-dimensional signature of its score distribution, built from query-performance-prediction quantities such as softmax entropy, score gaps, and dispersion, and a gate of roughly one thousand parameters maps these signatures to per-query view weights. The fused ranking uses no relevance labels at inference, no re-ranking, and no fine-tuning of the retriever; the gate is trained leave-one-task-out. On the \textsc{Tempo} benchmark, the method improves all six retrievers we evaluate, from BERT encoders to 7B decoder retrievers, with the largest gains on the weaker backbones. The strongest retrievers reach $0.297$ and $0.303$ nDCG@10, and the per-query gain over the original query is significant under a paired bootstrap ($p<0.001$). A per-query oracle reaches $0.364$ against our realized $0.297$, exposing headroom that identifies per-query view selection as a concrete next step.

</details>


### [411] [What Would Fix This RAG Failure? Auditing Counterfactual Response with Paired Evidence Interventions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08944)
*Wenzhang Du*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出Pair-ID，一种离线审计方法，用于衡量RAG（检索增强生成）失败答案在面对证据修复（添加缺失支持和删除已验证的非支持）时的反事实响应。通过19,981个基准查询的完整漏斗，筛选出1,200个合格失败案例，发现支撑添加可修复32.8%的JOINT案例，删除可修复13.6%的案例，但这种修复效果仅部分可预测且依赖于具体reader模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG系统失败后的证据修复可能产生多种不可见的响应结果，但缺乏系统性的方法来量化这种"同失败-多响应"的反事实空间，阻碍了对RAG失败可修复性的理解。

Method: 采用对照实验设计：固定query、检索状态和reader，交叉两种操作（添加缺失支持和删除已验证非支持），基于SHA-256排序前瞻性选择1,200个失败案例，生成反事实响应向量，并与长度和位置匹配的sham对照组对比。

Result: 在1,190个可重新生成的有效失败案例中，支撑添加修复197/600 JOINT案例（32.8%），删除修复162/1,190案例（13.6%）；原始观测仅携带部分预测信号（宏AUROC 0.678），精确向量准确率0.637未超过多数向量基线0.646；跨四个reader的向量一致性为0.675-0.765，JOINT-only仅0.538-0.691。

Conclusion: 证据敏感性在哈希选择的合格失败样本中以有意义的频率出现，但仅部分可从观测失败中预测，且高度依赖具体reader。研究支持框架范围的离线响应审计方法，而非信息论不可能性结论、reader无关分类法或运行时修复策略。

Abstract: A failed retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) answer can be consistent with several unseen responses to evidence repair. We introduce Pair-ID, an offline audit that holds one query, retrieval state, and reader constant, then crosses two operations, adding missing support and deleting verified nonsupport, to measure a same-failure counterfactual response vector. A complete funnel over 19,981 benchmark queries identifies 11,105 eligible Qwen failures, from which a prospectively fixed SHA-256 ordering selects 1,200 before generating any sampled response. Among 1,190 regenerated-valid failures, support addition repairs 197/600 JOINT cases (0.328, 95% CI [0.292, 0.367]), and deletion repairs 162/1,190 cases (0.136, 95% CI [0.117, 0.155]); length- and position-matched shams retain semantic contrasts of 0.223 and 0.101. The original view carries partial predictive signal for individual response cells (macro AUROC 0.678; Brier 0.152 versus 0.160 for a marginal baseline), but exact-vector accuracy, 0.637, does not exceed the 0.646 majority-vector baseline, and vector macro-F1 is 0.170. Across four readers, both marginal sensitivities recur, while pooled exact-vector agreement is 0.675-0.765 and JOINT-only agreement falls to 0.538-0.691. These results show that evidence sensitivity occurs at meaningful rates in the hash-selected eligible-failure sample, is only partially predictable from the observed failure, and is conditional on the reader. The evidence supports a frame-scoped offline response audit, not an information-theoretic impossibility result, reader-independent taxonomy, or runtime repair policy.

</details>


### [412] [Guardian Crawler: Retrieval-First Knowledge Discovery with Bounded LLM Augmentation for Noisy Web Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08994)
*Joshua Castillo,Santosh Nukavarapu,Ravi Mukkamala*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Guardian Crawler是一个可复现的检索优先测试平台，用于在合成网页语料上进行知识发现和基于证据的摘要实验。它结合BM25检索与风险感知、嵌入增强和混合重排序，以及带引用的受约束RAG生成。在900篇文档、10个查询的实验中，风险感知重排序表现最佳（P@10=1.00，NDCG@10=0.94），但作者承认结果不具统计优越性，也未经过人工验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从嘈杂网页数据中检索相关证据具有挑战性，尤其在敏感领域存在不完整报告、异构语言和不相关内容。需要一个可控、可复现的测试环境来系统评估知识发现和证据接地摘要方法。

Method: 构建合成网页语料库测试平台，采用三层架构：(1) BM25基础检索；(2) 风险感知、嵌入增强和混合三种重排序策略；(3) 带显式文档引用的受约束RAG生成。使用合成900文档语料库和10个查询进行实验评估。

Result: 风险感知重排序在描述性检索指标上最优（P@10=1.00，NDCG@10=0.94），优于BM25基线（0.94和0.81）。混合配置达到NDCG@10=0.94，BM25+语义配置为0.88。41条可评估生成要点中，36条被AI法官判定为受支持，1条部分支持，4条不支持。

Conclusion: Guardian Crawler作为受控测试平台可行，但结果不构成统计优越性证明，未经过人工验证的忠实性确认，也不保证能迁移到实时网络调查环境。需要进一步的人类评估和现实场景测试。

Abstract: Retrieving relevant evidence from noisy web data is challenging, particularly in sensitive domains containing incomplete reports, heterogeneous language, and irrelevant content. We present Guardian Crawler, a reproducible retrieval-first testbed for controlled experiments on knowledge discovery and evidence-grounded summarization over synthetic web-like corpora. The architecture combines BM25 retrieval with risk-aware, embedding-augmented, and hybrid reranking, followed by constrained retrieval-augmented generation with explicit document citations. Experiments on a synthetic 900-document corpus and 10 queries produced the highest descriptive retrieval scores under risk-based reranking, with P@10 = 1.00 and NDCG@10 = 0.94, compared with 0.94 and 0.81 for BM25. The best hybrid and BM25+Semantic configurations reached NDCG@10 values of 0.94 and 0.88, respectively. All 41 evaluable generated bullets passed the lexical coverage threshold; an automated LLM judge classified 36 as supported, one as partially supported, and four as unsupported. These results demonstrate the feasibility of Guardian Crawler as a controlled testbed but do not establish statistical superiority, human-validated faithfulness, or transfer to live-web investigative environments.

</details>


### [413] [PreGress: Ranking-Native Pre-training and Prompting for Graph Node Ranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09016)
*Lujie Ban,Jiasheng shi,Yingli Zhou,Kaiwen Xue,Daiyin Wang,Xubin Li,Shuanghua Li,Chenhao Ma*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出PreGress，首个排名原生的预训练与提示框架，通过多任务预训练（度中心性预测+属性重构）和轻量级任务特定提示模块，在冻结的排名骨干网络上适配多种节点排名任务，无需完整重训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GNN排名方法虽可扩展但通常针对单一排名标准定制且需为每个下游任务重训练，缺乏可迁移性；图预训练方法的学习目标与节点排名不对齐，导致排名应用适应性差。

Method: 设计多任务预训练目标（度中心性预测和属性重构）联合捕获结构与属性信息；设计轻量级任务特定提示模块，使冻结的排名骨干能适配不同排名标准的下游任务。

Result: 在六个公开图和两个真实查询-物品基准（Yelp2018和MovieLens-100K）以及受控的五标准图访问研究中，展示了强排名质量且任务特定状态开销低。

Conclusion: PreGress通过排名原生的预训练与提示机制，实现了跨多种节点排名任务的高效迁移，平衡了排名质量与计算开销。

Abstract: Node ranking is a fundamental problem in graph information retrieval, measuring the relative importance of nodes and supporting a wide range of applications such as influence analysis, recommendation, and graph-based retrieval augmented generation. However, exact computation of graph-based ranking measures is often computationally prohibitive at scale. Existing GNN-based ranking methods provide scalable approximations, but they are typically tailored to individual ranking criteria and require retraining for each downstream task, which limits their transferability and efficiency. Recent graph pre-training approaches aim to enable knowledge transfer across tasks, yet their learning objectives are largely misaligned with node ranking, resulting in suboptimal adaptability to ranking-oriented applications. To address these limitations, we propose PreGress, the first ranking-native pre-training and prompting framework for supporting a wide range of node ranking tasks. PreGress performs multi-task pre-training using our carefully designed objectives, including degree centrality prediction and attribute reconstruction, to jointly capture structural and attribute information. To support heterogeneous ranking criteria, we design lightweight, task-specific prompt modules that adapt a frozen ranking backbone to downstream tasks without full retraining. Experiments on six public graphs and two real-world query-to-item benchmarks---Yelp2018 and MovieLens-100K---together with a controlled five-criterion graph-access study demonstrate strong ranking quality with low task-specific state overhead.

</details>


### [414] [RVANNS: Mixed-Precision Indexing and Locality-Aware Graph Traversal on RISC-V](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09077)
*Chengying Huan,Yudong Liu,Jianguo Wang,Lizheng Chen,Renling Yin,Weijia Chen,Ji Qi,Jiageng Yu,Junjie Xu,Jie Zhang,Chen Tian,Yanjun Wu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出RVANNS，一个面向RISC-V向量扩展（RVV）的近似最近邻搜索引擎，通过混合精度多层索引（MPMI）和Reorder图局部性优化，在CPU上实现了显著的ANNS加速，并已集成到Milvus中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CPU上的ANNS性能瓶颈已从峰值算术吞吐量转向候选向量的移动与解码开销。RVV虽然提供向量长度无关执行和LMUL寄存器分组，但通用低精度解码存在转换开销，且不规则图遍历产生的散乱访问会损害缓存局部性和内存级并行度。

Method: RVANNS包含两大核心组件：(1) MPMI混合精度多层索引——每个向量用密集8位仿射基向量加稀疏FP16/FP32残差表示，将重建与距离累加融合，并对齐LMUL大小的寄存器组以支持加宽操作；(2) ROrder图局部性优化——将可能共同访问的图节点共置，并重排邻接表，将散乱的有效载荷探测转换为更密集且主要前向移动的地址流。

Result: 集成到Milvus后，在实际128位和256位RVV处理器上，相对标量执行分别获得3.39倍和4.94倍加速。在受控HNSW配置下，相对RVV SIMD+FP32基线提升2.27-2.76倍吞吐量，相对AVX-512和SVE基线提升1.18-1.59倍。在Cohere10M数据集上，QPS/W比评估的GPU基线高1.82-2.27倍。

Conclusion: RVANNS通过联合优化向量表示（MPMI）和图局部性（ROrder），有效解决了RVV平台上ANNS的存储带宽和访问模式瓶颈，证明了CPU（特别是RVV架构）在能效和性能上相比GPU的竞争力。

Abstract: Approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS) on CPUs is increasingly constrained by candidate-vector movement and decoding rather than peak arithmetic throughput. Although the RISC-V Vector Extension (RVV) provides vector-length-agnostic execution and LMUL-based register grouping, generic low-precision decoding still incurs conversion overhead, while irregular graph traversal generates scattered accesses that degrade cache locality and memory-level parallelism.
  We present RVANNS, an RVV-oriented ANNS engine that jointly optimizes vector representation and graph locality. Its Mixed-Precision Multi-Layer Index (MPMI) represents each vector with a dense 8-bit affine base and sparse FP16/FP32 residuals, fusing reconstruction with distance accumulation and aligning widening with LMUL-sized register groups. ROrder co-locates likely co-visited graph nodes and sorts remapped adjacency lists, transforming scattered payload probes into denser, predominantly forward-moving address streams.
  Integrated into Milvus, RVANNS achieves 3.39x and 4.94x speedups over scalar execution on real 128-bit and 256-bit RVV processors, respectively. Under controlled HNSW configurations, it improves throughput by 2.27--2.76x over RVV SIMD+FP32 and by 1.18--1.59x over the corresponding AVX-512 and SVE baselines. On Cohere10M, it further delivers 1.82--2.27x higher QPS/W than the evaluated GPU baselines.

</details>


### [415] [DREAM Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09408)
*Bin Zhang,Bowen Zheng,Chao Yi,Chengyu Lai,Dian Chen,Dimin Wang,Gaoyang Guo,Jialin Zhu,Jian Wu,Jing Yu,Jiuning Lin,Lingqing Zhang,Lingyun Zheng,Mao Zhang,Mingming Pan,Ruiquan Lan,Shuai Zhong,Wen Chen,Wendong Zhang,Xiaodong Zhu,Xuan Chen,Xunke Xi,Yifan Lu,Yiheng Wang,Yue Zeng,Yujie Luo,Yuning Jiang,Zhe Hu,Zhibo Xiao,Zihong Huang,Binbin Cao,Bo Zheng,Danning Wang,Dixuan Wang,Ge Fan,Haixia Wu,Han Zhu,Hao Fang,Haoming Chen,Huiping Chu,Jian Wang,Jianjun Wu,Jiawei Wu,Jiaxin Yu,Jingwen Liu,Jinzhe Shan,Kai Meng,Kai Zhang,Keqin Xu,Kewei Zhu,Lang Tian,Leihui Chen,Li Chen,Licheng Xu,Lide Xiao,Ruitong Zhang,Shiyao Peng,Silu Zhou,Tao Wang,Wei Shi,Wenjun Yang,Xiang Chen,Xiang Gao,Xiao Ren,Xu Liu,Xuwen Wang,Yang Li,Yeqiu Yang,Yi Hu,Yinnan Song,Yuan Liu,Yunqi Gao,Zhiliang Huang,Zhujin Gao,Zongyuan Wu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出DREAM（基于智能体方法的推荐引擎开发），一种自主优化控制架构，在现有推荐流水线之上增加感知层、可编排层和可审计的策略层，无需替换现有模块。核心包括三层意图引擎（L0/L1/L2）和元引擎（MetaModel进行M1到M3分层推理），通过奖励双回路持续优化，在淘宝首页的大规模A/B测试中显著提升IPV、Core IPV和GMV。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工业推荐系统采用级联的召回-排序-重排流水线，虽然高效但存在信息碎片化、目标割裂、依赖刚性规则、实时意图感知不足等缺陷，导致浏览、比较、购买等会话级行为转移未被充分处理。需要一个在不替换现有流水线的前提下实现自主优化的控制层。

Method: DREAM架构包含两个核心组件：1) 三层意图引擎：融合端侧信号生成结构化的L0/L1/L2意图表示，边云触发链将上报量降至约8.7%；2) 元引擎：使用MetaModel进行分层推理（M1意图总结、M2策略规划（借助策略记忆）、M3参数翻译），通过带安全护栏的统一出口下发参数。此外，奖励双回路（Reward Dual Loop）结合离线模拟（策略空间探索）与在线反馈（结果校准），形成生成-执行-评估-经验积累的闭环。

Result: 在淘宝首页信息流的大规模A/B测试中：仅控制重排阶段即可使IPV提升2.06%、Core IPV提升2.39%、GMV提升0.88%；将控制扩展到精排后，提升分别达到2.71%、3.06%和1.31%，同时PV持续提升超过1%。这些增益无需替换流水线模型，也不牺牲服务稳定性。

Conclusion: 智能体元控制（agentic meta-control）是工业推荐系统中一种可行且有效的范式，能够在不破坏现有基础架构的前提下，通过对现有流水线进行可审计、可编排的自主策略调优来实现显著的商业指标提升。

Abstract: Industrial recommender systems commonly use cascaded retrieval, ranking, and re-ranking pipelines. Although efficient, these pipelines fragment information and objectives across modules, rely on rigid rules, and have limited awareness of real-time intent, leaving session-level shifts among browsing, comparison, and purchase insufficiently addressed. We present DREAM (Developing Recommender Engine with Agentic Methods), an autonomous optimization control architecture that adds a perception-aware, orchestrable, and auditable policy layer atop existing pipelines without replacing them. DREAM has two core components. First, a three-tier Intent Engine fuses on-device signals into structured L0/L1/L2 intent representations; its edge-cloud trigger chain reduces reporting volume to approximately 8.7%. Second, a Meta Engine uses a MetaModel for layered M1-to-M2-to-M3 reasoning: intent summarization, strategy planning informed by Strategy Memory, and parameter translation. It dispatches the resulting parameters through a unified outlet with safety guardrails. A Reward Dual Loop continuously optimizes both components by combining offline simulation for strategy-space exploration with online feedback for outcome calibration, forming a cycle of generation, execution, evaluation, and experience accumulation. Large-scale A/B tests on Taobao's homepage feed show that re-ranking control alone improves IPV by 2.06%, Core IPV by 2.39%, and GMV by 0.88%. Extending control to fine ranking raises these gains to 2.71%, 3.06%, and 1.31%, respectively, while consistently improving PV by more than 1%. These gains require neither replacement of pipeline models nor compromise of serving stability, supporting agentic meta-control as a viable paradigm for industrial recommendation.

</details>


### [416] [MetaStrategy: Generative Ranking with Executable LLM Strategies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09440)
*Chengyu Lai,Jiuning Lin,Zhibo Xiao,Xiaodong Zhu,Ruiquan Lan,Bin Zhang,Zihong Huang,Wendong Zhang,Chuxin Chen,Yinjiang Cai,Shuai Zhong,Lingqing Zhang,Dimin Wang,Jialin Zhu,Han Zhu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: MetaStrategy是一个用于工业推荐系统的生成式排序框架，它不直接生成物品序列，而是由大语言模型生成结构化的JSON排序策略（包含目标权重、内容偏好、体验约束和位置策略），通过确定性验证器和编译器实例化独立的Generator，与现有预测模型和运营规则无缝集成。该框架在淘宝首页"猜你喜欢"场景部署，在线A/B测试显示点击PV提升2.11%，商品详情页浏览提升3.12%，交易额提升2.83%，且无响应时间增加。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式排序方法直接构造物品序列，难以与成熟的预测模型、运营规则和字段级护栏集成。工业推荐系统需要同时优化用户、商业、商家和体验等多重目标，需要一个既能利用LLM生成能力又能在现有系统架构中落地的方案。

Method: 1) LLM策略模型基于请求上下文生成类型化JSON捆绑包，控制目标权重、内容/品类偏好、体验约束和位置策略；2) 确定性验证器和编译器将策略实例化为隔离的Generator，与现有系统在Generator-Evaluator架构下原子竞争；3) 在生产路径重放环境中训练策略（无用户暴露）；4) 结合选择、相对排序和基线提升奖励；5) 自竞争课程学习将频繁策略作为竞争者输入；6) Evaluator引导的奖励增强在线策略蒸馏，将4B参数教师模型知识迁移到0.8B参数学生模型。

Result: 在淘宝首页"猜你喜欢"七天用户随机在线A/B测试中：MetaStrategy赢得27.93%的治疗侧GE调用；点击PV提升2.11%，商品详情页浏览(IPV)提升3.12%，交易额提升2.83%；通过diff触发的近线生成，LLM推理不占用同步排序路径，响应时间无可见增加。

Conclusion: 通过生成可执行的排序策略而非直接生成物品序列，MetaStrategy成功地将LLM的生成能力融入工业推荐系统，同时保持了与现有预测模型、运营规则和护栏的兼容性。紧凑的学生模型（0.8B）通过蒸馏实现了接近教师的能力，证明了该方法在生产环境中的可行性和可扩展性。

Abstract: Industrial recommender systems rank heterogeneous content under coupled user, business, commercial, and experience objectives. Existing generative ranking methods typically construct item sequences directly, making them difficult to integrate with mature predictive models, operational rules, and field-level guardrails. We present MetaStrategy, a framework that instead generates a structured, executable ranking strategy. Conditioned on request context, a large language model (LLM) policy emits a typed JSON bundle controlling objective weights, content and category preferences, experience constraints, and position policies. A deterministic validator and compiler instantiate an isolated Generator that competes atomically with incumbents under the list-level Evaluator of the Generator-Evaluator (GE) architecture. We train the policy in a production-path replay environment that re-executes logged requests through the current re-ranking stack without user exposure. The method combines selection, relative-rank, and baseline-lift rewards, a self-competitive curriculum that feeds frequent strategies back as competitors, and Evaluator-routed reward-augmented on-policy distillation that transfers complementary 4B-parameter Teachers into a compact 0.8B-parameter Student. We deploy MetaStrategy in Taobao Homepage Guess You Like through diff-triggered nearline generation; LLM inference remains outside synchronous ranking, with no observable increase in response time (RT). In a seven-day user-randomized online A/B test, MetaStrategy wins 27.93% of treatment-side GE calls and significantly improves click page views (click PV) by 2.11%, item-detail page views (IPV) by 3.12%, and transaction amount by 2.83%.

</details>


### [417] [TSPORec: Token Selection via Preference Optimization for LLM-Based Sequential Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09605)
*Wenqiao Zhu,Chao Xu,Haipang Wu,Ji Liu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出TSPORec方法，通过三阶段流水线从完整文本中精准选择信息性token，用于LLM-based序列推荐中的偏好优化，在提升推荐性能的同时大幅降低推理成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM-based序列推荐虽然强大，但由于模型规模大、架构深，推理成本高昂导致投资回报率低。现有方法通常只使用物品描述的前几个token，丢失了完整文本中的宝贵信息，导致推荐性能次优。

Method: 提出TSPORec方法，设计三阶段流水线来选择信息性token，并引入新的代理奖励（proxy reward）来促进实现，从而在整个文本内容中精准定位信息性token。

Result: 在两种模型和数据集上，与六种基线方法相比，TSPORec在推荐性能上提升高达31.25%，计算效率提升高达63.4%。

Conclusion: TSPORec不仅提升了推荐性能，还改善了计算效率，为LLM-based推荐系统中成本与性能的权衡提供了新思路。代码已开源。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful tools for improving recommendation systems. The effectiveness of LLMs arises from their ability to harness rich textual information and their capacity to model heterogeneous user preferences based on users' interaction history. However, due to the large-scale and deep architectures, LLM-based sequential recommendation approaches generally incur high inference costs, resulting in a low return on investment. To mitigate this cost, many existing approaches resort to using only the first few tokens of item descriptions, which inadvertently discards valuable information contained in the full text, thereby leading to suboptimal recommendation performance. To address this limitation, we propose a novel Token Selection approach for Preference Optimization in LLM-based sequential Recommendation, i.e., TSPORec, which accurately pinpoints informative tokens throughout the entire textual content to improve recommendation performance. Specifically, we design a three-stage pipeline to select informative tokens and introduce a novel proxy reward to facilitate the implementation. TSPORec not only enhances recommendation performance but also improves computational efficiency. Extensive experiments across two models and datasets demonstrate the superb performance (up to 31.25%) and efficiency (up to 63.4%) of our approach compared with six baseline approaches. Code is available at https://github.com/WNQzhu/TSPORec.git.

</details>


### [418] [IntHQ: Task-Interactive Hierarchical Query on Dual-Stream Representations for Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09634)
*Junjie Sun,Longfei Xu,Huimin Yan,Wei Luo,Kaikui Liu,Xiangxiang Chu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出IntHQ，一个多任务生成式推荐系统，通过三个组件（双流解耦、任务交互建模、层级查询）分别缓解多任务学习中的三类坍塌问题（源坍塌、关系坍塌、层级坍塌），在离线评估和Amap线上部署中均取得显著效果提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式推荐系统中的多任务学习仍未被充分探索。无论是判别式还是生成式范式，现有方法都从单一任务无关表示中提取特征，并将任务接线到预定义转换漏斗中，这固有地导致三类坍塌：源坍塌（任务特定信号注入过晚且被稀释）、关系坍塌（任务依赖被隐式吸收或静态固定）、层级坍塌（任务依赖不同尺度的特征且随训练阶段变化）。

Method: IntHQ包含三个组件：(1) 双流解耦（DSD）——早期注入任务身份到计算流，将共享上下文流与任务特定流分离，缓解信号稀释；(2) 任务交互建模（TIM）——用显式跨任务交互替代预定义漏斗，让每个任务以学习到的、输入自适应的强度条件于其前驱任务的已实现结果；(3) 层级查询（HQ）——让每个任务在不同训练阶段跨层收集多尺度信息。

Result: 离线评估中，IntHQ在四种代表性任务头配置下一致优于竞争性编码器骨干；在Amap上部署服务数亿用户的旅行推荐场景中，取得1.60%的相对UVCTR提升。

Conclusion: IntHQ通过解耦任务信号注入、显式建模任务依赖以及自适应多尺度信息收集，有效解决了生成式多任务推荐中的三类坍塌问题，展示了在实际大规模推荐系统中的可行性与效果。

Abstract: Multi-task learning over heterogeneous data is fundamental to modern recommendation, while generative models are emerging as the backbone of next-generation recommenders. However, the integration of multi-task learning into the generative paradigm remains largely unexplored. Existing multi-task recommenders, in both discriminative and generative paradigms, extract task-relevant features from a single task-agnostic representation and wire tasks into a predefined conversion funnel. We show that this scheme is inherently prone to a threefold collapse. Source collapse, where task-specific signals are injected late and diluted in the shared latent space. Relational collapse, where task dependencies are either implicitly absorbed by the backbone or statically fixed by predefined funnels. Hierarchical collapse, where tasks depend on features at different scales and shift across training stages. We propose IntHQ, a multi-task generative recommender with three components, each alleviating one collapse. Dual-Stream Decoupling (DSD) injects task identity into computation stream early and separates the shared context stream from the task-specific stream, alleviating signal dilution. Task-Interactive Modeling (TIM) replaces the predefined funnel with explicit cross-task interaction, letting each task condition on the realized outcomes of its predecessors with learned, input-adaptive strength. Hierarchical Querying (HQ) lets each task gather multi-scale information across different layers at different training stages. In offline evaluations, IntHQ consistently outperforms competitive encoder backbones under four representative task-head configurations. Deployed in production on Amap, serving hundreds of millions of users for travel recommendation, IntHQ yields a 1.60\% relative UVCTR lift.

</details>


### [419] [Listwise Cross-Encoder Fine-Tuning vs. Agentic Instruction Tuning for LLM Rerankers: A Systematic Study in Medical Procedure Reranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09650)
*Matan Fainzilber,Shlomit Plavner*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文系统比较了两种用于医疗程序重排序的范式：小型交叉编码器（如109M参数的MedCPT/MiniLM-L12微调ListNet）与4B参数的指令重排序模型（Qwen3-Reranker-4B）。结果显示，109M参数的交叉编码器在NDCG@3上以2.6个百分点、Spearman相关性上以13.3个百分点的优势超越4B模型，且参数量少了37倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗保险信息检索中，将医疗程序与患者查询进行重排序是生产环境的关键任务，但患者语言与临床术语之间存在显著的词汇鸿沟。作者希望系统比较两种不同的重排序范式，以找到在效率和效果上更优的解决方案。

Method: 研究对比了两种重排序范式：(1) 小型交叉编码器（MedCPT、MiniLM-L12）使用listwise学习排序目标（ListNet）微调，并探索不同层冻结配置；(2) Qwen3-Reranker-4B，一个40亿参数的指令重排序模型，其提示词通过GPT-4.1驱动的智能体优化循环迭代改进。实验基于包含2,647个查询、708个保险服务的专用数据集。

Result: 109M参数的交叉编码器经ListNet微调后，在NDCG@3上领先4B模型2.6个百分点，在Spearman相关性上领先13.3个百分点，且参数量减少37倍。研究还提供了实用的发现、基于LLM的可扩展数据集构建流程以及部署权衡分析。

Conclusion: 对于生产环境的医疗程序重排序任务，小规模交叉编码器在效率和效果上均优于大规模指令重排序模型。作者公开了代码和样例数据集以支持可复现性和跨领域适配。

Abstract: Reranking medical procedures against patient queries is a critical component of health insurance information retrieval, complicated by a substantial lexical gap between patient language and clinical nomenclature. We present a systematic comparison of two reranking paradigms for this production task: (1) small cross-encoders (MedCPT, MiniLM-L12) fine-tuned with listwise learning-to-rank objectives across layer freezing configurations, and (2) Qwen3-Reranker-4B, a 4B-parameter instruction reranker whose prompt is iteratively refined via an agentic optimization loop driven by GPT-4.1. On a purpose-built dataset of 2,647 queries across 708 insurance services, we find that a 109M-parameter cross-encoder fine-tuned with ListNet outperforms the 4B-parameter model by 2.6 percentage points on NDCG@3 and 13.3 points on Spearman correlation - at 37x fewer parameters. We report practical findings, a scalable LLM based dataset construction pipeline, and deployment trade-offs relevant to production reranking systems. We release our code and a sample dataset to support reproducibility and adaptation to other domains.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [420] [Application of Artificial Intelligence for Fraudulent Banking Operations Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07471)
*Bohdan Mytnyk,Oleksandr Tkachyk,Nataliya Shakhovska,Solomiia Fedushko,Yuriy Syerov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究探讨了利用人工智能和机器学习算法识别银行欺诈交易的问题，开发了基于人工神经网络的欺诈检测模型，并对比了多种算法（其中逻辑回归AUC约0.946，堆叠泛化达到0.954），同时详细介绍了处理不平衡数据集、特征工程等提高检测精度的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新冠疫情导致大量银行业务转移到线上平台，同时催生了大量慈善基金等可被犯罪分子利用的诈骗渠道，银行欺诈问题日益严重，亟需有效的自动化欺诈检测方法。

Method: 采用多种机器学习算法（包括人工神经网络、逻辑回归等）识别欺诈性银行交易，并提出了银行数据预处理技术，包括处理高度不平衡数据集、特征变换和特征工程等方法，同时采用堆叠泛化（stacked generalization）集成策略提升检测性能。

Result: 逻辑回归算法表现最佳，AUC值约为0.946；堆叠泛化方法进一步提升了性能，AUC达到0.954。

Conclusion: 人工智能算法（尤其是堆叠泛化集成方法）能够有效提升银行欺诈交易检测的准确性，该研究对数字社会中的金融安全具有重要意义。

Abstract: This study considers the task of applying artificial intelligence to recognize bank fraud. In recent years, due to the COVID19 pandemic, bank fraud has become even more common due to the massive transition of many operations to online platforms and the creation of many charitable funds that criminals can use to deceive users. The present work focuses on machine learning algorithms as a tool well suited for analyzing and recognizing online banking transactions. The study`s scientific novelty is the development of machine learning models for identifying fraudulent banking transactions and techniques for preprocessing bank data for further comparison and selection of the best results. This paper also details various methods for improving detection accuracy, i.e., handling highly imbalanced datasets, feature transformation, and feature engineering. The proposed model, which is based on an artificial neural network, effectively improves the accuracy of fraudulent transaction detection. The results of the different algorithms are visualized, and the logistic regression algorithm performs the best, with an output AUC value of approximately 0,946. The stacked generalization shows a better AUC of 0.954. The recognition of banking fraud using artificial intelligence algorithms is a topical issue in our digital society.

</details>


### [421] [Data-Driven Fire-Zone Segmentation for Improved Short-Term Wildfire Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07472)
*Nicolas Caron,Christophe Guyeux,Hassan Noura,Benjamin Aynes*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于流域检测与K-means聚类的无监督火灾分区分割算法，取代传统均匀网格划分来定义预测单元。在法国六个省份和六种预测模型上的实验表明，火灾分区方法比网格方法一致性地提升IoU 3-6%，且计算轻量（<10秒/配置）可并行化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有野火预测模型将研究区域离散化为均匀网格，忽略了火源在空间上的异质性分布。作者挑战了这一范式，认为数据离散化方式比模型选择对预测效果的影响更大。

Method: 提出无监督火灾分区分割算法，结合流域检测（watershed detection）与K-means聚类，直接从历史火灾模式中定义预测单元，替代均匀网格。

Result: 在法国六个省份和六种预测模型上的实验显示，火灾分区方法一致性地优于网格方法，平均IoU提升3-6%（取决于空间尺度）；计算轻量（每配置<10秒），且完全可并行。

Conclusion: 优化空间离散化能带来显著且可复现的短期野火预测性能提升，数据分区方式的选择比模型选择更为关键。

Abstract: Wildfire prediction models typically discretize study areas into uniform grids, ignoring the heterogeneous spatial distribution of ignitions. We challenge this paradigm by showing that how data is discretized matters more than which model is used. We propose an unsupervised fire-zone segmentation algorithm combining watershed detection with K-means clustering to define prediction units directly from historical fire patterns. Experiments across six French departments and six forecasting models show that fire-zone segmentation consistently outperforms grid-based approaches, with mean IoU improvements of +3--6% depending on spatial scale. The method is computationally lightweight (<10s per configuration) and fully parallelizable. Our results demonstrate that optimizing spatial discretization yields significant, reproducible performance gains for short-term wildfire forecasting.

</details>


### [422] [Evolving Safety Landscape of Multi-modal Large Language Models: A Survey of Emerging Threats and Safeguards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07535)
*Xi Li,Shu Zhao,Xiaohan Zou,Fei Zhao,Fuxiao Liu,Yusen Zhang,Cheng Han,Yushun Dong,Jiaqi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）安全性的系统综述，提出了一种多模态接地（multimodal grounded）的安全威胁分类体系，涵盖对抗攻击、数据投毒、越狱和幻觉四类威胁，并总结了相应的安全策略及未来研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型通过模态对齐和融合整合异构数据，增强了理解和推理能力，但这种架构转变重塑了机器学习的安全格局。模型复杂性和跨模态交互的增加带来了新威胁（如受损的模态整合、模态错位、融合安全风险），而现有的基于单模态学习的框架无法充分捕捉这些新约束，因此亟需系统性的安全分析。

Method: 本文采用系统性综述方法：首先提出一种多模态接地的安全威胁分类体系，分析威胁模型的转变（覆盖对抗攻击、数据投毒、越狱和幻觉四类威胁）；随后总结更新后的安全假设，并据此组织近期的MLLM安全策略；最后讨论开放挑战和未来方向。

Result: 形成了系统化的多模态安全威胁分类框架，明确了威胁模型的转变方向，归纳了对应的安全策略体系，并识别了开放挑战与未来研究方向。

Conclusion: 多模态大语言模型的安全问题需要新的原则性和可扩展的安全机制，现有单模态框架已不足以应对多模态架构下的新型威胁，未来研究应朝着更系统的多模态安全设计方向推进。

Abstract: Multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) integrate heterogeneous modalities through modality alignment and fusion, enabling stronger understanding and reasoning. However, this architectural shift reshapes the safety landscape of machine learning. Increased model complexity and cross-modal interactions give rise to novel threats, including compromised modality integration, modality misalignment, and fused safety risks, reflecting shifts in threat modeling beyond uni-modal assumptions. These shifts, in turn, impose new constraints on safety solutions not captured by existing frameworks rooted in uni-modal learning. Motivated by these challenges, this survey provides a systematic analysis of the evolving safety landscape of MLLMs. We first propose a multimodal grounded taxonomy of safety threats and analyze shifts in threat models, covering adversarial attacks, data poisoning, jailbreaks, and hallucinations. We then summarize updated safety assumptions and organize recent advances in MLLM safety strategies accordingly. Finally, we discuss open challenges and future directions to inform the development of more principled and scalable safety mechanisms for multimodal systems.

</details>


### [423] [Tracing sources of epistemic uncertainty in deep learning predictions: homo- and hetero-scedastic linearized estimators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07630)
*Pierre Nodet,Thomas George*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文改进了两种经典统计估计器，用于量化深度学习中的不确定性，区分了偶然不确定性（aleatoric）和数据稀缺（epistemic）两类来源，并借助近似Fisher信息矩阵实现大规模架构上的应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习模型的不确定性量化很重要，但现有方法难以清晰地分离不确定性来源（数据本身的噪声 vs 局部数据稀缺），作者希望提供更清晰的insights。

Method: 将两种经典统计估计器适配到现代深度学习框架，利用近似Fisher信息矩阵的最新进展，使估计器能够扩展到实际规模的神经网络架构。

Result: 实验表明每个测试点受两类不确定性来源的影响程度不同，验证了估计器在实际应用中的实用价值，有助于提升模型鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 该方法能够有效区分并量化偶然不确定性和认知不确定性，为改进真实世界应用的鲁棒性提供了实用工具。

Abstract: We adapt two classical statistical estimators for quantifying uncertainty to modern deep learning, in order to provide clearer insights into uncertainty attributable to two sources : aleatoric uncertainty, or locally scarce data. Our approach leverages recent advances in approximate Fisher Information Matrices, to enable scaling to actual architectures. Experimental results demonstrate how each test points is differentially impacted by both sources, highlighting the practical utility of our estimators in improving the robustness of real-world applications.

</details>


### [424] [SkillConsist: Detecting Inconsistencies in Agent Skills via Bidirectional Graph Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07639)
*Chaofan Meng,Yuhang Zheng,Yingnan Zhou,Sihan Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SkillConsist框架，用于检测LLM Agent技能（Skill）在声明与实现之间的不一致性。该方法先用LLM将声明和实现内容分离为行为记录，构建双端行为图，再通过双向图对齐和差分识别冲突，在633个Skill基准上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agent Skill的不一致可能暴露未声明的危险行为或导致错误的Skill选择。现有方法依赖预定义类别或声明范围进行评估，且未能有效处理声明与实现行为混合在文本和代码中、以及简短声明对应多个连接实现步骤的挑战。

Method: 1) 使用LLM将声明和实现内容分离为行为记录，并用静态分析补充实现记录；2) 分别构建声明侧和实现侧的行为图；3) 从任一侧的行为记录出发，通过双向图对齐在另一侧搜索候选子图，并沿行为关系扩展直到完整表达源侧行为；4) 通过图差分识别对齐子图间的冲突并输出检测结果。

Result: 构建了包含633个Skill的基准（来自ClawHub前500个最常下载的Skill和133个Skill-Inject包），含319个不一致和314个一致的Skill。SkillConsist在包级检测上达到86.85%精确率、89.03%召回率和87.93% F1，比最优基线提升20.43个百分点；在局部化检测上达到67.60%精确率、58.14%召回率和62.52% F1。

Conclusion: SkillConsist通过行为图构建与双向图对齐能够有效捕获跨文本和代码的声明-实现不一致性，为Agent Skill安全性和可靠性提供了更强大的检测手段。

Abstract: Agent Skills provide reusable capabilities to LLM agents. Agent Skill inconsistencies can expose undisclosed dangerous behavior or cause wrong Skill selection. Recent Agent Skill research has increasingly examined Agent Skill consistency detection. Existing methods evaluate behaviors or security-property graphs against predefined categories or declared scopes. More recently, PL-HCL uses an LLM-based model to learn consistency across metadata, instructions, and resources. However, declaration and implementation behavior can be mixed across text and code, and a concise declaration can correspond to multiple connected implementation steps. We present SkillConsist to address both challenges. An LLM separates declaration and implementation content into behavior records on the implementation and declaration sides, while static analysis supplements implementation records. These records form declaration and implementation behavior graphs, respectively. Starting from a behavior record on either side, bidirectional graph alignment searches the other graph for a candidate subgraph and expands it along behavior relations until it completely expresses the source-side behavior. Graph differencing identifies conflicts between aligned subgraphs and outputs the detection results. We construct a 633-Skill benchmark from ClawHub's 500 most-downloaded public Skills and 133 Skill-Inject packages. The benchmark contains 319 inconsistent and 314 consistent Skills and 442 localized inconsistency annotations. On this benchmark, SkillConsist achieves 86.85% precision, 89.03% recall, and 87.93% F1 for package-level detection, improving F1 over the best baseline by 20.43 percentage points. For localization, it achieves 67.60% precision, 58.14% recall, and 62.52% F1.

</details>


### [425] [PhysAttNet: Enhancing Predictive Performance in Industrial and Astrophysical Time Series via Physics-Informed Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07681)
*Amal Saadallah,Julia Tjus,Petra Wiederkeher,Wolfgang Rhode*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PhysAttNet，一种物理信息引导的注意力框架，用于时间序列预测。它通过三种正则化约束（对齐、平滑、稀疏）将物理信号的领域知识引入轻量级CNN预测器的注意力机制中，在铣削切削力预测和耀变体耀斑预测两个应用中提升了预测精度和泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的CNN时间序列预测模型虽然计算高效且表征能力强，但其学到的时序注意力模式往往不稳定或与物理规律不一致，导致鲁棒性、泛化性和可解释性不足。本文旨在通过引入物理知识来改善这一问题。

Method: PhysAttNet在轻量级CNN预测器上增加一个注意力头，并引入三种可微的正则化约束：1) 对齐正则化——鼓励注意力遵循从输入信号中提取的平滑、峰中心化的时间结构；2) 平滑正则化——强制时间演化的连续性；3) 稀疏正则化——促进对信息丰富区间的选择性关注。这些约束无需人工标注或注释即可注入物理引导的归纳偏置。

Result: 在两个不同的应用中（铣削过程中的切削力预测和耀变体时间序列中的耀斑预测），PhysAttNet展示了优于基线方法的预测精度、泛化能力提升，并在结构重要事件上的预测表现更佳。

Conclusion: 通过物理信息正则化约束注意力机制，可以在不增加标注负担的情况下有效提升时间序列预测的准确性和鲁棒性，验证了物理引导的归纳偏置在深度学习时序预测中的价值。

Abstract: Accurate and robust time series forecasting is essential in many applications involving physical processes, such as manufacturing monitoring and astrophysical event detection. In these settings, predictive models must remain reliable under noise, variability, and measurement uncertainty while capturing temporally localized structures corresponding to physically meaningful events. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are widely used for such tasks due to their computational efficiency and strong representational capacity. However, their learned temporal representations often exhibit unstable or physically inconsistent attention patterns, reducing robustness, generalization, and interpretability. This paper introduces PhysAttNet, a physics-informed attention framework for time series forecasting. PhysAttNet augments a lightweight CNN forecaster with an attention head guided by domain-informed regularization reflecting the structural properties of physical signals. Specifically, three complementary constraints are imposed during training: an alignment regularization that encourages attention to follow smooth, peak-centered temporal structures derived from the input signal, a smoothness regularization that enforces continuous temporal evolution, and a sparsity regularization that promotes selective focus on informative intervals. These differentiable regularization terms introduce physics-guided inductive bias without requiring annotated explanations or manual supervision. Experiments on two distinct applications, namely predicting cutting forces during milling and forecasting flares in blazar time series, demonstrate that PhysAttNet improves forecasting accuracy, generalization, and prediction performance on structurally important events.

</details>


### [426] [CODS: Iterative Bellman-Residual Data Selection for Reusable Offline Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07719)
*Ibne Farabi Shihab,Sanjeda Akter,Abu Sa-Adat Mohamed Moon-Im Al Ahsan,Md Najmus Swaqeeb,Anuj Sharma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CODS（批评者引导的选择器），一种离线强化学习中可复用的数据子集选择方法。它通过交替拟合算法匹配的批评者和获取高残差转换来迭代选择数据子集，在10%的数据预算下保留了96.6%的完整池性能，并在D4RL基准的20个任务-算法组合中全面优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线强化学习从固定转换池中反复训练策略，导致跨随机种子和超参数的冗余数据成本高昂；而朴素子采样可能移除长时程信用分配所需的稀有转换。现有方法存在局限：优先经验回放产生动态工件而非静态数据子集，一次性残差选择无法随批评者变化刷新分数。

Method: CODS交替执行两个步骤：(1) 拟合与目标算法匹配的批评者；(2) 获取高残差（预测误差大）的转换进入子集，然后冻结可复用于集。与优先回放不同，CODS产生静态工件；与一次性残差选择不同，它随批评者演变刷新评分。还引入了整条轨迹扩展版本，以及多轮获取策略。

Result: 在10%预算下，CODS在20个有效的D4RL任务-算法单元中保留96.6%的合格池性能；在19/20个单元上超越ReDOR和OPER，在20/20个单元上超越其他子集基线；所有六个子集优势在预先声明的层级推断和Holm校正下保持显著。固定选择器更新次数时，五轮获取比一轮提升11.23分并趋于饱和。等遍数与等时钟评估表明计算优势来自复用而非单次运行加速。机制和腐败干预显示其既有稀疏回报增强的效用，也对异常值敏感。整条轨迹扩展在ALFWorld保留95.4%成功率、GSM8K保留96.5%精确匹配率。

Conclusion: CODS是一种可复用的选择程序而非形式上保证的核集（coreset）。它通过批评者引导的多轮残差选择，在极小数据预算下接近完整数据池性能，并且支持跨种子和超参数的复用，从而在计算效率上优于单次运行加速方案。

Abstract: Offline reinforcement learning repeatedly trains policies from a fixed transition pool, making redundant data costly across seeds and hyperparameters, while naive subsampling can remove rare transitions needed for long-horizon credit assignment. We introduce CODS, a critic-guided selector that alternates between fitting an algorithm-matched critic and acquiring high-residual transitions before freezing a reusable subset. Unlike prioritized replay, CODS produces a static artifact; unlike one-shot residual selection, it refreshes scores as the critic changes. At a 10\% budget, CODS retains 96.6\% of eligible-pool performance across 20 valid D4RL task--algorithm cells. It exceeds ReDOR and OPER on 19/20 cells and every other subset baseline on 20/20; all six subset advantages remain significant under predeclared hierarchical inference with Holm correction. Holding total selector updates fixed, five acquisition rounds improve four representative cells by 11.23 points over one round and saturate thereafter. Equal-pass and equal-hour evaluations clarify that reuse, rather than a single-run speedup, creates the compute advantage. Mechanism and corruption interventions expose both useful sparse-reward enrichment and sensitivity to outliers. Finally, a whole-trace extension retains 95.4\% of pooled ALFWorld success and 96.5\% of pooled GSM8K exact match. CODS is therefore a reusable selection procedure, not a formal coreset guarantee.

</details>


### [427] [Loss-Resilient Wireless Video Token Communication over Block Fading Channels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08698)
*Bingyan Xie,Yongjeong Oh,Zihan Chen,Jihong Park,Yongpeng Wu,Wenjun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出WVTC框架，针对无线视频令牌通信中块衰落导致重要或相关令牌丢失的问题，通过令牌重要性评估、混洗I/P令牌打包、基于当前CSI的在线调度以及微调解令牌器重建缺失内容，在不重传的情况下提升视频重建质量和优雅降级性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频令牌通信中，令牌在重建重要性和时间依赖性上存在差异，无线传输中的块衰落可能导致多个重要或相关令牌同时丢失，严重损害视频重建质量。现有方法未充分考虑令牌的预测结构和相关性来设计鲁棒的传输方案。

Method: 1) 从视频令牌的固有预测结构评估令牌重要性，赋予结构I令牌高优先级，并通过时间邻域新颖性度量P令牌重要性；2) 采用混洗混合I/P令牌打包方案，将结构锚点和相关时间区域分散到不同数据包中；3) 仅利用当前块信道状态信息，在线调度器联合考虑包重要性密度、MCS相关解码可靠性、块容量和重要性集中度来分配数据包到衰落块；4) 接收端使用微调的解令牌器从幸存令牌重建缺失内容，无需重传。

Result: 数值结果表明，所提方法在包错误率增加时实现了更好的感知质量和更优雅的性能降级。

Conclusion: 通过令牌级感知的打包和调度策略结合接收端无重传重建，WVTC有效提升了无线视频令牌通信在衰落信道下的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Video token communication represents video content as discrete tokens that differ in their importance to reconstruction and exhibit temporal dependencies. When these tokens are packetized for wireless transmission, block fading can cause multiple important or correlated tokens to be lost together, severely degrading video reconstruction. To address this issue, we propose a loss-resilient wireless video token communication (WVTC) framework. WVTC evaluates token importance from the intrinsic predictive structure of video tokens, assigning high priority to structural I-tokens and measuring P-token importance by temporal neighborhood novelty. A shuffled mixed I/P-token packetization scheme disperses structural anchors and correlated temporal regions across packets. Using only current block channel state information, an online scheduler jointly considers packet importance density, MCS-dependent decoding reliability, block capacity, and importance concentration when allocating packets to fading blocks. At the receiver, a fine-tuned detokenizer reconstructs missing content from surviving tokens without retransmission. Numerical results demonstrate improved perceptual quality and more graceful degradation under increasing packet error rates.

</details>


### [428] [Neural Operators for Immersed-Boundary Soft Swimmers Locomotion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07722)
*Mohammad Sadegh Eshaghi,Yizheng Wang,Navid Valizadeh,Xiaoying Zhuang,Timon Rabczuk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文开发了神经算子代理模型，用于预测平面和三维鳗鱼游泳者周围的水动力场，以解决高保真浸没边界模拟计算成本过高的问题。平面模型在所有预测场上的全局相对L²误差为3.51%，三维模型的速度、涡量和压力误差分别为3.44%、5.58%和19.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高保真浸没边界模拟虽然能精确解析变形游泳者与其周围流体的耦合运动，但计算成本过高，限制了其在工程设计、参数研究和控制中的重复评估效率。

Method: 开发基于神经算子的代理模型，在自适应流固耦合模拟导出的规则网格场上进行训练，以游泳者几何形状和雷诺数作为条件输入。平面模型联合预测速度分量、涡量和压力；三维模型采用三个独立的目标特定模型分别预测速度、涡量和压力，共享多通道输入。

Result: 平面模型在五个留出的高雷诺数轨迹上实现3.51%的全域全局相对L²误差；三维模型在五个留出的范围内轨迹上分别实现3.44%（速度）、5.58%（涡量）和19.2%（压力）的误差。

Conclusion: 结果表明场解析神经代理模型用于移动边界游泳者流动是可行的，但压力精度和物理一致性是需要进一步改进的优先方向。

Abstract: High-fidelity immersed-boundary simulation resolves the coupled motion of a deforming swimmer and its surrounding flow, but the resulting cost limits repeated evaluations for engineering design, parameter studies, and control. We develop neural-operator surrogates for temporal prediction of the hydrodynamic fields generated by planar and volumetric eel swimmers. The surrogates are trained on regular-grid fields exported from adaptive fluid--structure simulations and are conditioned on swimmer geometry and Reynolds number. The planar model jointly predicts two velocity components, scalar vorticity, and pressure. On five held-out high-Reynolds-number trajectories, its full-domain global relative L^2 error is 3.51 %. The volumetric formulation uses three target-specific models with a common multichannel input: one model predicts three-dimensional velocity, one predicts vorticity, and one predicts pressure. Their full-domain global relative L^2 errors on five held-out within-range trajectories are 3.44 %, 5.58 %, and 19.2 %. Together, the results demonstrate the feasibility of field-resolved neural surrogates for moving-boundary swimmer flows while identifying pressure accuracy and physical consistency as priorities for further development.

</details>


### [429] [Finite Constant Frontiers and Auditable Regret Certificates for Average-Reward Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07725)
*Ibne Farabi Shihab,Abu Sa-Adat Mohamed Moon-Im Al Ahsan,Md Najmus Swaqeeb*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种常数感知的比较协议,用于量化比较平均奖励强化学习中的遗憾界下界常数。作者构造了一个由两状态块组成的二叉树下界证书,将发布的下界系数从0.015提升到最多0.0291(提升94%),并推导出极限系数为(1/32)√((A-3)/A)。对于上界,作者给出了可审计的组合规则,但不宣称常数,因为自适应方向方差和规划证书仍待解决。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 平均奖励强化学习的遗憾界在log因子意义下已知,但已发布的保证在数值内容上难以比较,因为概率模式、结构参数、log归一化、先验信息和规划假设各不相同。需要引入常数感知的比较协议,并推导显式的有限下界证书。

Method: 构造一个由两状态块组成的二叉树作为下界证书;证明使用精确的轨迹级Bernoulli KL散度,并显式追踪动作预算、直径、占用率、导航成本和终端偏差。引入常数感知比较协议,推导封闭形式包络以改进已发布的0.015系数。对于上界,给出跨度约束乐观学习者的可审计组合规则。

Result: 将下界系数从0.015提升到:中等场景下0.0200,在更强动作、直径和时限条件下最高达0.0291(提升94%)。极限系数为(1/32)√((A-3)/A)。上界不宣称具体常数,但提供了可审计的组合规则。进行了控制诊断测试,包括直径依赖、宽度交互的奖励、跨度误规范和有限下界证书在其精确族上的验证。

Conclusion: 本文建立了常数层面的比较框架,显著改进下界常数,并明确了上界常数计算的开放问题。形式化了有效的期望转换和常数可比性,为后续在常数精确层面比较强化学习算法提供了方法论基础。

Abstract: Average-reward reinforcement-learning regret is known up to logarithmic factors, but the numerical content of published guarantees is difficult to compare because probability mode, structural parameter, logarithmic normalization, prior information, and planning assumptions differ. We introduce a constant-aware comparison protocol and derive an explicit finite lower certificate for communicating MDPs. The construction is a binary tree of two-state blocks; its proof uses exact trajectory-level Bernoulli KL divergence and keeps action budget, diameter, occupancy, navigation cost, and terminal bias explicit. A common closed-form envelope improves the published coefficient $0.015$ across a finite frontier: $0.0200$ in a moderate regime and up to $0.0291$ under stronger action, diameter, and horizon conditions, a $94\%$ increase. The limiting coefficient is $\frac1{32}\sqrt{(A-3)/A}$. For upper bounds, we give an auditable composition rule for a span-constrained optimistic learner, but do not claim a coefficient while adaptive directional-variance and planning certificates remain open. We also formalize valid expectation conversion and constant comparability. Controlled diagnostics test diameter dependence, bonus-by-width interactions, span misspecification, and the finite lower certificate on its exact family.

</details>


### [430] [LUCID: Latent-Skill Unified Control via Imagined Dynamics for Long-Horizon Humanoid Loco-Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07746)
*Cheng Guo,Mingzhe Ni,Angelo Cangelosi,Arash Ajoudani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了LUCID，一种层级模型强化学习框架，通过潜在条件化的低级策略和宏动力学世界模型，在想象推演中规划可复用技能，用于长时程人形机器人移动操作任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法依赖脚本化规划器、有限状态机或任务特定的无模型策略来协调预训练技能，难以处理复杂的任务序列。需要一个能灵活组合多种全身技能并做出可靠高层决策的框架。

Method: LUCID采用层级结构：1) 通过对抗模仿训练结构化的潜在条件化低级策略；2) 冻结低级策略，联合学习高层策略和宏动力学世界模型；3) 世界模型预测由潜在决策引起的时间扩展状态转移，使高层策略能通过想象推演进行优化。

Result: 在多种模拟多物体重排场景中，LUCID相比基线方法在完整任务成功率和部分完成率上均有提升，证明了其在复杂序列移动操作任务中的有效性。

Conclusion: LUCID通过将可复用技能与世界模型驱动的规划相结合，为长时程人形机器人移动操作提供了一种可扩展且有效的层级决策框架。

Abstract: Long-horizon humanoid loco-manipulation requires composing versatile whole-body skills and reliable high-level decision making. Existing methods often coordinate pretrained skills with scripted planners, finite-state machines or task-specific model-free policies, restricting their ability to handle complex task sequences. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{LUCID}, a hierarchical model-based reinforcement learning framework that plans over reusable skills through imagined rollouts of a learned dynamics model. LUCID first trains a structured latent-conditioned low-level policy via adversarial imitation and then freezes it while jointly learning a high-level policy and macro-dynamics world model. The world model predicts the temporally extended state transitions induced by latent decisions, enabling high-level policy optimization through imagined rollouts. We evaluate our framework across various simulated multi-object rearrangement scenarios. Experimental results show that LUCID improves the full-task success and partial-completion rates compared to prior baseline methods, demonstrating its effectiveness in complex sequential loco-manipulation tasks.

</details>


### [431] [From Benchmark Performance to Tool Deployment: Human-in-the-Loop Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07770)
*Mike Szklarzewski,CJ George,Gavin Smithson,Christopher Stokes,Dakota Fulp,William M. Jones,Benjamin Wynn,Alexander Ur,Agit Yesiloz,Clint Kallenbach,Mark Swartz,Nathan DeBardeleben,Sharmistha Chakrabarti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文评估了19个无监督异常检测模型在真实工业制造数据集BowTie上的表现，发现其性能远不如在MVTec AD等学术基准上稳定，对预处理高度敏感且无单一方法表现鲁棒。基于此发现，作者开发并部署了一个统一的人机协同检测框架，结合图像标注、AI辅助缺陷检测和集成验证引擎，替代了先前的人工目视检测流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有异常检测方法在学术基准上表现优异，但在真实工业条件下的行为尚不明确。作者希望通过评估模型在实际制造场景中的表现，揭示基准性能与部署现实之间的差距，并提供实用的解决方案。

Method: 首先在BowTie数据集上系统评估19种无监督异常检测模型，考察其性能稳定性、预处理敏感性和跨条件一致性。随后基于评估发现，开发了一个包含图像标注、AI辅助检测、SAM细化候选区域、掩膜评估和审查历史追踪的人机协同（human-in-the-loop）检测框架。

Result: 模型在BowTie数据集上的性能不如基准测试稳定，对预处理高度敏感且跨条件表现不一致，无单一方法展现统一鲁棒性；共识审计进一步表明名义数据质量影响部署。所开发的人机协同框架已初步部署，支持热力图引导的缺陷审查、SAM细化、审查者接受/拒绝/边界调整及审查一致性追踪。

Conclusion: 研究结果凸显了学术基准性能与工业部署现实之间的显著差距，并提供了一个实用的框架来弥合这一鸿沟——通过人机协同方式提升制造部件检测的可靠性和可审计性。

Abstract: Automated anomaly detection methods often report strong performance on curated academic benchmarks, but their behavior under real-world industrial conditions is less clear. In this work, we evaluate 19 unsupervised anomaly detection models on the BowTie dataset, a challenging manufacturing dataset with reflective surfaces, subtle defects, and profile-specific variation. In contrast to benchmark results, we observe that model performance is less stable than typically reported on standard benchmarks such as MVTec AD, highly sensitive to preprocessing, and inconsistent across conditions, with no single approach emerging as uniformly robust; a consensus audit further indicates that nominal-data quality affects deployment.
  Motivated by these findings, we developed and initially deployed a unified human-in-the-loop framework for manufactured-part inspection that combines image annotation, AI-assisted defect detection, and an integrated validation engine, replacing a prior manual visual inspection and documentation workflow. The system supports heatmap-guided defect review, SAM-refined candidate regions for inspector acceptance, rejection, or boundary adjustment, mask evaluation where annotations exist, and review history for inspector consistency and onboarding. Together, the results highlight the gap between benchmark performance and deployment reality, and provide a practical framework for addressing it.

</details>


### [432] [A Hybrid Nested Harness for Decoupling Structure and Parameters in LLM-Driven Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08156)
*Víctor Gallego*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出混合嵌套搜索框架，将LLM驱动的进化算法拆分为外层结构搜索（LLM提出带数值空缺的草图）和内层数值优化（CMA-ES、梯度法或MCMC进行参数调优），解决了纯LLM同时优化结构和参数时效率低下的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纯LLM驱动的进化算法中，LLM同时作为单一算子更新结构组件和连续参数，但LLM在结构优化方面表现好，在数值参数调优方面效率低下，浪费token进行试错。因此需要将结构搜索与数值优化分离，各司其职。

Method: 提出混合嵌套搜索框架：外层循环由LLM提出带数值空缺的结构草图，内层循环使用数值优化器（CMA-ES、梯度优化或MCMC采样器）调优空缺参数。外内求解器均为可插拔设计，支持任意文本优化器与零阶/一阶/采样优化器的组合。

Result: 在三个科学领域的验证中（闭式测试函数的元优化器、系统研究与社会困境的代码策略、近似贝叶斯推断任务），混合优化器均优于纯LLM驱动搜索和纯数值优化基线。

Conclusion: 混合嵌套搜索有效结合了LLM的结构生成能力与传统数值优化器的参数精调能力，在多个科学领域中表现卓越，且框架具有高度灵活性和可扩展性。

Abstract: In evolutionary algorithms powered by language models, the LLM acts as a single operator that simultaneously updates structural components (like control flow) and continuous parameters. While LLMs can be good at the first, they are not efficient at the second, wasting tokens taking discrete jumps inside a trial and error loop. We resolve this by formalizing a hybrid nested search, in which an outer loop has the LLM propose a structural sketch, with numeric gaps, and an inner numerical optimizer tunes the sketch. Both the outer and inner solvers are pluggable: any text-based optimizer can be combined with a zero-order optimizer (CMA-ES), gradient-based routines, or MCMC samplers. We validate our framework across three scientific domains: (i) meta-optimizers on closed-form test functions, (ii) code-based policies for systems research and social dilemmas; and (iii) approximate Bayesian inference tasks. Across all three, the hybrid optimizer is superior to both vanilla LLM-driven search and pure numerical optimization baselines. Code at: https://github.com/vicgalle/hybrid-nested-search

</details>


### [433] [The Sample Complexity of Policy Learning with Mu-Resets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07772)
*Gene Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了在μ-resets交互协议下的基于策略的强化学习。该协议允许学习者除了从起始分布采样外，还能从探索性重置分布μ中采样轨迹。作者解决了关于策略可实现性在样本复杂度中作用的问题，并发现对水平线H的依赖由重置分布的覆盖概念决定：在有界全策略集中性下样本复杂度下界为exp(Ω(H))，而在有界前推集中性下对H的依赖精确刻画为exp(Θ(√H))。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者旨在解决Kakade和Langford提出的μ-resets交互协议下的策略强化学习样本复杂度问题，并回应KLS25提出的关于策略可实现性角色的疑问。关键在于理解不同覆盖假设下，水平线H对样本复杂度的影响程度，从而为理论强化学习提供更精确的刻画。

Method: 论文从理论分析角度出发，对比了两种不同的覆盖假设：（1）有界全策略集中性（bounded all-policy concentrability），在此下证明exp(Ω(H))的样本复杂度下界；（2）有界前推集中性（bounded pushforward concentrability），在此下证明水平线依赖被精确刻画为exp(Θ(√H))。

Result: 主要结果包括两个紧密的界：在假设有界全策略集中性时，样本复杂度存在exp(Ω(H))的下界；而在有界前推集中性假设下，对水平线的依赖被严格刻画为exp(Θ(√H))，给出了匹配的上界和下界。

Conclusion: 本文完整解决了μ-resets协议下策略强化学习的样本复杂度问题，阐明了覆盖假设的选择如何从根本上决定水平线H对样本复杂度的影响。这为理解和设计在探索性重置分布下的高效策略学习算法提供了理论基础。

Abstract: We study policy-based reinforcement learning under the $μ$-resets interaction protocol of Kakade and Langford [KL02]. This interaction protocol enables the learner to sample trajectories from a given exploratory reset distribution $μ$, in addition to the starting distribution. We resolve the question raised by [KLS25] on the role of policy realizability for the sample complexity of this problem. Critically, the dependence on horizon $H$ is governed by the notion of coverage assumed of the reset distribution. Under bounded all-policy concentrability, we show a $\exp(Ω(H))$ sample complexity lower bound; with bounded pushforward concentrability, we show the dependence on horizon is tightly characterized as $\exp(Θ(\sqrt H))$.

</details>


### [434] [Shape Mutating Expert Compression:LorExperts and BTExperts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07814)
*Inesh Chakrabarti,Sourjya Roy,Bowen Bao,Thiago Crepaldi,Spandan Tiwari,Ashish Sirasao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 LorExperts，一种保留路由器的 MoE 专家压缩方法。通过聚类专家、为每簇保留一个全精度主导专家，并将其余专家表示为对局部主导专家的低秩修正，该方法在约 50% 压缩率下优于 D^2-MoE 等基线，且性能优势随专家数量增加而扩大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE 语言模型虽然计算高效，但部署时需要压缩大量专家权重矩阵。现有方法存在局限：专家剪枝（如 REAP）和合并损失精度且需重训路由器；低秩 delta 分解（如 D^2-MoE）虽然保留全部专家和路由器，但当专家数量增长时，单一共享组件无法逼近大量近正交专家，导致性能严重下降。

Method: LorExperts 的核心思想是：尽管 MoE 专家权重近正交，但专家会组织成功能性的共激活社区，且这些社区与权重相似性解耦。方法分为：1) 对专家进行聚类；2) 每簇保留一个全精度主导专家；3) 将簇内其余专家表示为对该主导专家的低秩修正。同时提出重建微调程序和 BTExperts（树状组织主导专家与修正，支持推理时共享计算的分摊）。

Result: 在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 和 Gemma-4-26B-A4B 上，约 50% 专家压缩率下，LorExperts 在大多数任务上比基线更好地保持了下游准确率和困惑度；相对于 D^2-MoE 的优势随专家数量 E 的增长而扩大。

Conclusion: LorExperts 通过利用专家共激活社区结构，实现了无需重训路由器的 MoE 压缩，在保持精度方面优于现有方法，尤其在专家数量多的场景下优势明显，为大规模 MoE 部署提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models deliver high capacity at low per-token compute, but deploying them cheaply requires compressing their many expert weight matrices. Expert pruning (e.g., REAP) and merging reduce cost but sacrifice accuracy and require retraining the router; low-rank delta decomposition of experts (e.g., D^2-MoE) preserves all experts and the router, but degrades sharply as the expert count grows because a single shared component cannot approximate many near-orthogonal experts.
  Because MoE expert weights are near-orthogonal, a single shared component (as in prior delta decomposition) scales poorly with the expert count; we show that experts nonetheless organize into functional co-activation communities that are decoupled from weight similarity. Building on this, we introduce LorExperts, a router-preserving compression method that clusters experts, keeps one full-precision dominant per cluster, and represents the remaining members as low-rank corrections to their local dominant. LorExperts retains all experts and the original router (no router retraining). At ~50% expert compression on Qwen3-30B-A3B and Gemma-4-26B-A4B, LorExperts preserves downstream accuracy and perplexity better than the baselines on most of the tasks; the margin over D^2-MoE grows with expert count E. We further give a reconstruction fine-tuning procedure for LorExperts, and BTExperts, a tree organization of dominants and corrections that enables inference-time amortization of shared computation.

</details>


### [435] [From token probabilities to calibrated confidence: An empirical study of mathematical question answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07827)
*Avery Ma,Lorne Schell,Vin Bhaskara,Leila Pishdad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了大语言模型在数学问答任务中的置信度估计与校准问题。研究发现，虽然单个token概率往往过度自信，但聚合整个序列的token概率能捕捉到正确与错误生成之间的细微差异。多遍估计方法（如自验证和蒙特卡洛Dropout）能产生校准良好的置信度估计。后处理校准方法（Platt缩放和等渗回归）虽能显著降低域内校准误差，但其数据效率受数据集难度影响，且校准映射在不同数据集和模型间的迁移具有不对称性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型的置信度估计对可靠决策至关重要，但先前研究表明token概率往往过度自信。作者希望探究这些现成的信号是否仍能用于数学问答场景下提供良好校准的置信度估计。

Method: 比较了单遍估计（复用原始生成的token概率并聚合整个序列）与多遍估计（通过验证重提示或随机前向传播获取额外置信信号，包括自验证、低成本的in-situ变体及蒙特卡洛Dropout），并评估了Platt缩放和等渗回归两种后处理校准方法。

Result: 聚合整个序列的token概率能捕捉正确与错误生成间小而一致的差异，产生更具信息量的置信估计。多遍方法可产生校准良好的置信度。两种后处理校准方法均显著降低域内校准误差，但数据效率随数据集难度变化，校准映射在不同数据集和模型间呈不对称迁移。

Conclusion: 聚合token概率作为单遍估计信号有一定价值，多遍方法更可靠地实现校准；后处理校准有效但存在跨域和跨模型迁移的不对称性挑战。

Abstract: Confidence estimation for large language models (LLMs) aims to estimate the probability that a generated answer is correct, while calibration aligns these estimates with empirical accuracy. Prior work has shown that token probabilities are often overconfident, we investigate whether these readily available signals can nevertheless provide well-calibrated confidence estimation for mathematical question answering. We compare single-pass estimators, which reuse token probabilities from the original generation, with multi-pass estimators, which obtain additional confidence signals through verification or stochastic forward passes. While individual token probabilities can be highly saturated, we find that aggregating token probabilities over the full sequence captures small but consistent differences between correct and incorrect generations, yielding more informative confidence estimates. Multi-pass methods can yield calibrated confidence estimates. We study two such approaches: self-verification through re-prompting, including a lower-cost in-situ variant, and Monte Carlo Dropout, which derives confidence from variation across stochastic forward passes. We further evaluate two post-hoc calibration methods, Platt scaling and isotonic regression, both of which substantially reduce in-domain calibration error. However, their data efficiency varies with dataset difficulty, and the calibration mappings often transfer asymmetrically across datasets and models.

</details>


### [436] [TEMPER: Tensorized Efficient Manifold-constrained Parameterization for Expressive Residual Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07851)
*Yuxuan Gu,Wuyang Zhou,Huijun Xing,Danilo Mandic*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TEMPER方法，利用张量网络将超连接（Hyper-connections）中的生成器参数化为多路张量，在保持流形约束路由接口的同时大幅减少参数增长，实现性能与参数效率的更好权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有残差连接增强方法（如超连接HC和流形约束变体mHC）虽然提升了路由表达力，但其生成器采用稠密无结构参数化，导致参数量随残差流数量快速增长，存在生成器层面的瓶颈。

Method: 提出TEMPER，将预分支聚合、残差混合和后分支重分配中的生成器表示为输入流、特征、输出流三个模式上的多路张量，并使用张量网络（tensor networks）进行结构化低秩参数化。

Result: 在语言建模和常识推理任务上，TEMPER匹配或超越现有方法。在8个残差流时，TEMPER达到最佳CORE分数，同时比mHC减少约84%的额外参数，展现出更强的性能-参数效率权衡。

Conclusion: 张量化低秩参数化能在保持流形约束路由性能和可解释性的同时显著降低参数开销。张量秩控制路由子空间维度，全秩可恢复稠密路由；生成器近似误差界定了路由logits和块输出的差异。

Abstract: Residual connections rely on a static residual pathway, and are essential for training deep neural networks. Hyper-connections (HC) increase the expressivity of residual routing by incorporating multiple residual streams and learning dynamic information flow, while manifold-constrained (mHC) variants stabilize training through doubly stochastic residual mixing. However, a generator-level bottleneck remains in existing methods: they use dense, unstructured generators for pre-branch aggregation, residual mixing, and post-branch redistribution, which results in parameter count growing rapidly with the number of streams. To address this issue, we propose \underline{\textbf{T}}ensorized \underline{\textbf{E}}fficient \underline{\textbf{M}}anifold-constrained \underline{\textbf{P}}arameterization for \underline{\textbf{E}}xpressive Residual \underline{\textbf{R}}outing (\textbf{TEMPER}), which represents these generators as multi-way tensors over the input-stream, feature, and output-stream modes, and parameterizes them using tensor networks. Such a structured low-rank formulation is shown to preserve token-dependent manifold-constrained routing interface while substantially reducing parameter growth.
