We argue that a contributing root cause is limited adoption of software tooling and practices that make development in other mature domains - particularly web engineering - reliably composable and reproducible: package management, typed namespaces, canonical interchange formats, service composition protocols, reproducible pipelines, and lifecycle governance. Against this backdrop, eight open engineering challenges for biomedical data integration are catalogued, each with partial solutions but no universally adopted stack. Crucially, the article shifts emphasis from describing deployed KG instances toward the reproducible process of assembling them: reusable build pipelines, versioned dependencies, and engineering practices that let others compile and customize a KG from source rather than consuming a static artifact. Together, the two perspectives provide domain grounding for newcomers and a research agenda for software engineers seeking to make transformative contributions to biomedical knowledge infrastructure.

</details>


### [607] [Independent Patch Verification for Coding Agents with a Bidirectional Reconstruct-and-Verify Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08950)
*Chenglin Li,Yisen Xu,Zehao Wang,Shin Hwei Tan,Tse-Hsun,Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: RETRACE是一个无需训练的补丁后验证框架，通过前向重建（从问题和agent轨迹构建修复理由）和后向重建（仅从补丁与轨迹独立推断问题描述）及调和阶段，生成明确的验证信号来评估补丁正确性，在SWE-bench Verified上使Pass@1提升7.0%和3.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型驱动的自主编码智能体能够直接从bug报告生成代码补丁，但存在根本性缺口：补丁生成后没有独立机制验证其是否真正解决了所报告的问题。现有方法要么在产生补丁的同一解释下审查补丁（存在偏差），要么扩大候选生成而不验证单个补丁，均未提供明确的验证信号来评估补丁正确性。

Method: RETRACE采用双向重建与调和机制：(1) 前向重建：从问题和agent轨迹构建明确的修复理由；(2) 后向重建：仅从补丁及其轨迹独立推断该补丁似乎要解决的问题描述，并与原始问题比较产出对齐判定；(3) 调和阶段：检查前向理由与补丁间的一致性，诊断任何不对齐的来源，并提交补丁或生成针对性的修订指导。

Result: 在SWE-bench Verified上使用两个骨干模型（GPT-5-mini和MiniMax-2.5）评估，RETRACE在mini-SWE-agent脚手架上分别将Pass@1提升7.0%和3.6%，在OpenHands上无需修改也能获得可比增益。消融实验表明前向和后向阶段均有贡献，加入调和阶段可进一步获得收益。

Conclusion: RETRACE通过双向重建与调和提供了一个显式的验证信号，弥合了补丁生成与正确性验证之间的鸿沟，是一种无需训练且跨脚手架有效的通用补丁验证框架。

Abstract: Autonomous coding agents powered by large language models can now generate code patches directly from bug reports, but a fundamental gap remains: once a patch is produced, no mechanism independently verifies whether it truly resolves the reported problem. Prior work has sought to address this through iterative self-refinement and inference-time scaling, but these approaches either review the patch under the same interpretation that produced it or broaden candidate generation without verifying individual patches, and neither provides an explicit verification signal for assessing patch correctness. We propose RETRACE, a training-free post-generation verification framework that derives such a signal through bidirectional reconstruction and reconciliation. When a coding agent generates a candidate patch for an issue, RETRACE performs forward reconstruction to build an explicit repair rationale from the issue and the agent's trajectory; backward reconstruction then independently infers, from the patch and its trajectory alone and without access to the original issue, a description of the problem the patch appears to address, and compares this reconstruction against the original issue to produce an alignment verdict; a reconciliation stage then checks the consistency between the forward rationale and the patch, diagnoses the source of any misalignment, and either submits the patch or produces targeted revision guidance. Evaluated on SWE-bench Verified with two backbones (GPT-5-mini and MiniMax-2.5), RETRACE lifts Pass@1 by 7.0% and 3.6% respectively on the mini-SWE-agent scaffold, and delivers comparable gains on OpenHands without modification. Ablation experiments show that both the forward and backward stages contribute to the overall improvement and that adding reconciliation yields further gains.

</details>


### [608] [GALA: Graph-Augmented LLM Agents for Root Cause Analysis and Incident Response in Microservices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08968)
*Yifang Tian,Yaming Liu,Zichun Chong,Zihang Huang,Yiran Li,Hans-Arno Jacobsen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出了GALA+，一个图增强的LLM智能体框架，用于微服务根因分析（RCA）。它利用服务依赖图约束探索、结合多模态证据进行诊断，并输出排名诊断、事件摘要和分层的行动建议。同时引入SURE-Score评估框架，在基准测试上超越最佳LLM基线25个百分点以上的AC@1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RCA方法存在三大局限：依赖单一遥测模态、LLM方法存在无约束探索和幻觉问题、大多数系统仅做故障排名而不生成可操作的响应建议。

Method: GALA+框架以服务依赖图为中心引导调查过程，用图约束LLM探索边界；结合STRIX模块（基于轨迹和图结构感知的评分模块）融合互补遥测信号生成初始假设；输出排名诊断、事件摘要和分层行动建议；并引入SURE-Score（与SRE专家共同开发的人工引导评估框架）衡量RCA输出质量。

Result: 在两个微服务基准上，GALA+取得最强综合结果，AC@1指标上超越最佳LLM基线超过25个百分点，并在SURE-Score和独立人类SRE评估中均获得最高评分。

Conclusion: 图引导的探索加LLM智能体能力能显著提升微服务根因分析的准确性和实用性，且需要专门的RCA评估框架来全面衡量输出质量。

Abstract: Microservice root cause analysis (RCA) requires correlating failures across heterogeneous telemetry within complex service dependency graphs. Existing methods often rely on a single telemetry modality; recent LLM-based approaches can suffer from unconstrained exploration and hallucination; and most systems stop at fault ranking without producing actionable incident response. We present GALA+, a graph-augmented LLM agentic framework centered on graph-guided investigation, which uses service dependencies to bound exploration and refine diagnosis through localized multi-modal evidence. For initial hypothesis generation, GALA+ combines complementary telemetry signals with STRIX, a novel trace- and graph-structure-aware scoring module. GALA+ then produces ranked diagnoses, incident summaries, and stratified action recommendations. We further introduce SURE-Score, a human-guided evaluation framework co-developed with industry SRE experts for assessing RCA-specific output quality beyond conventional text similarity metrics. On two microservice benchmarks, GALA+ consistently achieves the strongest overall results, surpassing the best LLM-based baseline by more than 25 percentage points in AC@1, while also receiving the highest ratings from both SURE-Score and independent human SRE evaluation.

</details>


### [609] [Pseudo2CodeQA: A Benchmark for LLM-Based Structured Algorithmic Reasoning in Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09068)
*Shadikur Rahman,Umme Ayman Koana,Syed Muhammad Danish*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了Pseudo2Code基准测试，系统评估结构化伪代码对代码生成质量和算法忠实度的影响，并提出了Pseudo2Code Agentic Framework多阶段流水线，实验表明该框架在多个指标上优于现有最强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管大型语言模型在自然语言到代码生成方面表现出色，但其遵循结构化算法推理的能力尚未被充分理解，需要系统性的基准和方法来研究伪代码作为中间推理表示的作用。

Method: 构建包含300个真实编程任务的Pseudo2Code基准（含问题描述、结构化伪代码、参考实现和测试套件），采用双阶段人工验证确保可靠性；提出Pseudo2Code Agentic Framework多阶段流水线，将伪代码作为显式中间推理表示；采用基于rubric的评估框架（覆盖正确性、完整性、相关性、清晰度、推理质量和伪代码遵循度）并结合执行测试进行评估。

Result: Pseudo2Code Agentic Pipeline在总体得分4.78上优于最强基线模型的4.31；100个任务的人类评估研究显示人工判断与自动化评估高度一致；实验证明结构化伪代码提升了功能正确性、推理质量和算法忠实度。

Conclusion: 结构化伪代码能有效提升代码生成的功能正确性、推理质量和算法忠实度，Pseudo2Code基准和框架为可解释代码生成及可靠AI辅助软件开发提供了实证支持和研究基础。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved impressive performance in natural language-to-code generation; however, their ability to follow structured algorithmic reasoning remains insufficiently understood. We introduce Pseudo2Code, a benchmark designed to systematically evaluate the impact of structured pseudocode on code generation quality and algorithmic faithfulness. The benchmark consists of 300 manually validated real-world programming tasks spanning multiple domains and three difficulty levels (Easy, Medium, and Hard). Each task contains a problem description, structured pseudocode, reference implementation, and executable test suite. To ensure benchmark reliability, we adopt a dual-stage human validation protocol and release fully executable benchmark instances. Beyond the benchmark, we propose the Pseudo2Code Agentic Framework, a multi-stage pipeline that leverages pseudocode as an explicit intermediate reasoning representation for code generation. We evaluate both commercial and open-source language models using a rubric-based evaluation framework that measures correctness, completeness, relevance, clarity, reasoning quality, and pseudocode adherence, complemented by execution-based testing. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed Pseudo2Code Agentic Pipeline consistently outperforms strong commercial and open-source baselines, achieving an overall score of 4.78 compared to 4.31 for the strongest baseline model. Furthermore, a human evaluation study involving 100 benchmark tasks shows strong agreement between human judgments and automated assessments. Our findings provide empirical evidence that structured pseudocode improves functional correctness, reasoning quality, and algorithmic faithfulness in code generation. We release Pseudo2Code to support future research on structured reasoning, interpretable code generation, and reliable AI-assisted software development.

</details>


### [610] [A Unified Issue Resolution Benchmark for Requirement Clarification, Planning, and Code Generation for Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09072)
*Xin Zhou,Chun Yong Chong,Kisub Kim,Yun Peng,Rui Shu,Zihan Wu,Xu Han,Guowen Yuan,Zeyang Zhuang,Jounghoon Kim,Jeongjin Ju,Seongmin Ju,Taein Yoon,David Lo*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: SWE-RPG是一个仓库级基准测试，结合可执行补丁评估与经过验证的中间参考（需求澄清和实现规划），用于诊断编码智能体的完整轨迹。包含来自31个Python/Java仓库的163个任务，评估结果显示主流编码智能体平均仅31.5%的解决率，隐含需求恢复是主要瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有仓库级基准测试仅评估最终补丁是否通过测试，无法刻画失败轨迹在需求澄清、实现规划等中间环节如何偏离正确路径。为了深入诊断编码智能体的失败原因，需要引入中间步骤的参考标准。

Method: 构建SWE-RPG基准：(1) 包含163个任务（113个bug修复+50个功能添加），来自31个Python和Java仓库；(2) 不仅提供可执行补丁评估，还提供两类经过验证的中间参考GT——需求澄清和实现规划；(3) 支持对完整智能体轨迹（澄清、规划、代码生成、工提交）进行回顾性、与GT对齐的诊断；(4) 评估3种编码智能体（Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode）搭配6种LLM后端。

Result: 主流编码智能体在SWE-RPG上平均解决率仅31.5%。中间GT诊断发现隐含需求恢复是主要瓶颈，占智能体运行失败原因的24.5%-46.0%。

Conclusion: 隐含需求恢复是改进编码智能体的关键方向；SWE-RPG提供的中间参考标准为编码智能体的细粒度诊断和改进提供了有效工具。

Abstract: Large language model-powered coding agents are increasingly used to modify existing code repositories, for example, by adding features or fixing bugs. Yet existing repository-level benchmarks typically evaluate only whether the final patch passes tests. Satisfying a user request requires a long chain of interdependent reasoning and decisions: an agent must recover explicit and implicit requirements, formulate a repository-grounded implementation plan, and translate it into correct code. A pass/fail outcome cannot characterize how an unsuccessful trajectory diverges from the requirements and implementation process needed for a correct patch. To address this gap, we introduce SWE-RPG, a repository-level benchmark that combines executable patch evaluation with validated ground-truth references (GTs) for (1) Requirement Clarification and (2) Implementation Planning. These intermediate GTs support retrospective, GT-aligned diagnosis of complete coding-agent trajectories across clarification, planning, code generation, and artifact submission. SWE-RPG comprises 163 tasks from 31 Python and Java repositories, including 113 bug fixes and 50 feature additions. We evaluate 3 coding agents, including Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode, with 6 large language model backends, including Claude-Sonnet-5 and GPT-5.6-Terra. Results show that the evaluated popular coding agents still struggle to implement user requests in existing repositories, achieving an average resolved rate of only 31.5% on SWE-RPG. Intermediate-GT diagnosis further identifies implicit requirement recovery as the main bottleneck, accounting for 24.5%--46.0% of agent runs. This result suggests implicit-requirement recovery as a key candidate direction for improving coding agents. The benchmark data and evaluation code are available at https://github.com/Xin-Zhou-smu/SWE-RPG-Bench.

</details>


### [611] [Memoir: Learning, Verifying, and Evolving False-Positive Memories for Static Application Security Testing Tools](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09181)
*Shenyuan Guan,Qiaodan Hou,Yanjun Chen,Xincheng Wen,Jia Feng,Keke Lian,Cuiyun Gao*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Memoir是一个基于记忆驱动的SAST误报（FP）识别框架，通过将历史误报转化为可复用的语义记忆，解决了现有方法难以学习跨工具/跨漏洞类别的模式以及知识静态不更新的两大挑战。在CWE-Bench-Java上达到99.43%的F1分数，且工业案例表明其记忆库可跨不同SAST工具泛化而无需重新训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAST工具在现代安全软件开发中至关重要，但会产生大量误报，导致高昂的人工审查成本和开发者信任度下降。现有FP归约方法面临两大挑战：（1）SAST工具和漏洞类别差异巨大，难以学习历史误报中的可复用模式；（2）方法所用知识是静态的，无法随新验证案例的积累而更新。

Method: Memoir框架包含两个关键模块：（1）历史语义记忆构建模块，通过LLM引导的标注、模式聚类和记忆合成，将历史误报转换为结构化的语义记忆；（2）记忆驱动的识别与演化模块，检索相关记忆并进行语义验证（包括分类一致性检查和安全不变量验证）后做出最终预测，然后将验证过的预测反馈回记忆库，使知识库随新案例积累而持续演化。

Result: 在CWE-Bench-Java上的评估显示，Memoir达到99.43%的F1分数、98.88%的召回率和完美的精确率，优于所有基线方法。来自顶级IT公司的生产软件系统的工业案例研究表明，学到的记忆库无需重新训练即可在不同SAST工具间有效泛化。

Conclusion: Memoir通过将历史误报转化为可演化的语义记忆，有效解决了SAST误报归约中的模式学习困难与知识静态性问题，并在真实世界安全分析和工业环境中展现了优越的性能和跨工具泛化能力。

Abstract: Static Application Security Testing (SAST) tools have become indispensable in modern secure software devel- opment. However, these tools often generate false-positive (FP) alerts, imposing substantial manual inspection costs and reducing the trust from developers. Existing FP reduction methods still face two primary challenges. First, the large differences among SAST tools and vulnerability categories make it difficult for these methods to learn recurring patterns in historical false positives. Moreover, the knowledge used by these methods are largely static and cannot be updated as newly validated cases accumulate. To address these challenges, we propose Memoir, a memory- driven framework for identifying false positives by transform- ing historical FP alerts into reusable semantic memories. It consists of two key modules. First, historical semantic memory construction converts historical FP alerts into structured semantic memories through LLM-guided annotation, pattern clustering, and memory synthesis to capture reusable behavioral patterns. Moreover, memory-driven identification and evolution retrieves relevant memories and performs semantic verification against taxonomy consistency and security invariants before making the final prediction. It then incorporates verified predictions back into the memory repository, allowing the knowledge base to evolve as new cases accumulate. We evaluate Memoir on CWE- Bench-Java to demonstrate its effectiveness in real-world security analysis. Specifically, Memoir achieves an F1-score of 99.43% with a Recall of 98.88% and perfect Precision, consistently outperforming other baselines. Furthermore, an industrial case study on production software systems from a top IT company shows that the learned memory base generalizes effectively across different SAST tools without retraining.

</details>


### [612] [Software Engineering for and with GUI Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09278)
*Shengcheng Yu,Yuchen Ling,Junyang Xing,Quan Zhou,Chunrong Fang,Zhenyu Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对2018年1月至2026年4月间的336篇GUI智能体论文进行了系统综述，从软件工程视角审视该领域。研究发现该领域自2024年起急剧扩张，移动端和网页端占据主导；架构虽日益模块化（感知-推理-执行循环），但恢复机制、人工升级、安全执行和可审计性仍欠发展；评估偏向任务成功率且难以跨协议比较；观测性、隐私工程和系统性人工监督亦不完善。结论是仅靠能力提升不足以确保部署就绪，未来需将可靠执行与生命周期测试、可复现评估、权限隐私控制及成本感知的人本治理相结合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GUI智能体领域发展迅速，涌现大量框架、基准和应用，但增长已超越领域成熟度——智能体在技术上仍然脆弱、工程不完整、缺乏充分的真实世界验证。该领域正演变为闭环软件系统（模型推理与界面感知、执行反馈、恢复、人工监督耦合），亟需软件工程视角审视，而现有研究普遍缺失这一维度。

Method: 系统综述方法：审查了2018年1月至2026年4月间的336篇GUI智能体论文，围绕五个研究问题展开：研究格局、架构、评估、软件生命周期关注点及未来机遇。

Result: （1）领域自2024年起急剧扩张，移动端和网页端设置仍占主导；（2）架构日益采用模块化感知-推理-执行循环，但恢复、人工升级、安全执行和可审计性仍不成熟；（3）评估更趋交互性，但聚焦任务成功率且难以跨协议比较；（4）现有研究对超越基准的测试和发布后的维护支持有限；（5）观测性、隐私工程和系统性人工监督均不发达。

Conclusion: 能力提升本身无法保证部署就绪。未来研究应将可靠执行与生命周期中心的测试、可复现评估相结合，并将权限与隐私控制整合进成本感知、人本治理框架中，以构建可靠、可维护、安全且可部署的GUI智能体系统。

Abstract: GUI agents have advanced rapidly, producing a growing body of frameworks, benchmarks, and applications. However, this growth has outpaced the maturity of the field. GUI agents remain technically brittle, incompletely engineered, and insufficiently validated for sustained real-world use. They are evolving into closed-loop software systems. Within these systems, model reasoning is coupled with interface perception, execution feedback, recovery, and human oversight. This evolution calls for a software engineering perspective that remains largely absent from existing research. We address this gap by reviewing 336 GUI-agent papers from January 2018 to April 2026. Five research questions examine the research landscape, architectures, evaluation, software lifecycle concerns, and future opportunities. Our findings show that the field has expanded sharply since 2024, while mobile and web settings remain dominant. Architectures increasingly adopt modular perceive-reason-act loops, but recovery, human escalation, safety enforcement, and auditability remain underdeveloped. This architectural imbalance extends to evaluation. Evaluations are becoming more interactive, but they remain centered on task success and are difficult to compare across protocols. More broadly, existing studies provide limited support for testing beyond benchmarks and for maintaining agents after release. Observability, privacy engineering, and systematic human oversight are also underdeveloped. Together, these findings show that capability improvements alone cannot ensure deployment readiness. Future research should connect dependable execution with lifecycle-centered testing and reproducible evaluation. It should also integrate permission and privacy controls with cost-aware, human-centered governance. This integration is necessary to build dependable, maintainable, secure, and deployable GUI-agent systems.

</details>


### [613] [OpenCodeReview: Determinism over Non-Determinism for Cost-Effective Agent-Based Code Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09290)
*Zhengfeng Li,Lei Zhang,Xianwei Wu,Zhengqi Zhuang,Yingjie Xu,Boge Wang,Shaofei Zhu,Chuan Wang,Guoping Rong*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: OpenCodeReview 是一个基于确定性工程构建的 LLM 代码审查代理，通过规则引导调度、受限文件审查和独立反思三个关键管道点注入确定性，解决了当前代码审查代理的非确定性和上下文局部性问题，在 AACR-Bench 基准上以 5-15 倍更少的 token 消耗实现最高 2.17 倍的 SEM-F1 提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的代码审查代理存在两个相互交织的弱点：(1) 非确定性——无限制的工具使用导致审查结果不稳定；(2) 上下文局部性——审查者只能访问 diff，限制了可发现问题的深度。这两者引发了上下文检索错位、多文件 PR 中的连贯性-效率权衡，以及削弱信任的幻觉评论三大挑战。

Method: OpenCodeReview 采用"为不确定代理构建确定性工程"的思路，在三个关键管道点注入确定性：(1) Rule-Guided Dispatch 使用多层规则系统确定性地选择文件和审查标准；(2) Grounded File Review 通过 ReAct 循环暴露精选工具集，文件级并行 SubAgents 在上下文连贯性和效率间取得平衡；(3) Independent Reflection 引入基于证伪的过滤器，采用不对称信息边界（反射器只看到 diff），去除幻觉评论而不产生自我强化偏差。

Result: 在 AACR-Bench（200 个真实 PR，10 种语言，1,505 条专家验证评论）上，OpenCodeReview 在六个 LLM 后端上均优于主流编码代理（如 Claude Code 和 Codex），SEM-F1 最高提升 2.17 倍（25.10% vs 11.57%），同时节省 5-15 倍 token 消耗。

Conclusion: 在代码审查代理中，适度限制代理自由度并策略性地注入确定性，比给予最大自由能带来更稳定、更准确且更高效的审查结果，同时通过不对称信息边界的独立反思机制有效缓解幻觉问题，为可信赖的自动化代码审查系统提供了新范式。

Abstract: LLM-based code review agents promise scalable, always-on review, yet current systems suffer from two intertwined weaknesses: (1) non-determinism--unbounded tool use makes review outcomes unstable, and (2) context locality--the reviewer's access remains bounded to the diff, capping discoverable issue depth. Both give rise to three challenges: misaligned context retrieval, a coherence-efficiency trade-off in multi-file pull requests, and hallucinated comments that erode trust. To address these, we introduce OpenCodeReview, built on deterministic engineering for uncertain agents: rather than granting maximal freedom, we inject determinism at three deliberate pipeline points. Rule-Guided Dispatch uses a multi-layer rule system to deterministically select files and review criteria, eliminating variability of agent-driven triage. Grounded File Review replaces free-form exploration with a curated tool set exposed through a ReAct loop, while file-level parallel SubAgents balance context coherence against efficiency and recover cross-file dependencies on demand. Independent Reflection introduces a falsification-first filter under an asymmetric information boundary--the reflector sees only the diff, not the agent's tool-augmented exploration--removing hallucinated comments without self-reinforcing bias, improving precision while preserving recall. On AACR-Bench (200 real-world PRs, 10 languages, 1,505 expert-verified comments), OpenCodeReview outperforms mainstream coding agents (e.g., Claude Code and Codex) across six LLM backends, achieving up to 2.17x higher SEM-F1 (25.10% vs. 11.57%) while consuming 5-15x fewer tokens. We open-source OpenCodeReview at https://github.com/alibaba/open-code-review.

</details>


### [614] [Search-Based Generation of Undetected Quantum Circuit Mutants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09318)
*Eñaut Mendiluze Usandizaga,Thomas Laurent,Paolo Arcaini,Shaukat Ali*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出QUMUG，一种基于搜索的量子变异分析工具，利用可参数化量子门生成难以检测的变异体，以更有效地评估测试套件质量。实验表明其生成的变异体比现有工具难测三倍，遗传算法表现最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有量子变异分析工具使用固定的门级变异，产生的变异体容易被检测出来，导致它们在评估测试套件质量方面效果不佳，限制了其有效性。

Method: 提出QUMUG方法，利用可参数化量子门结合搜索算法（包括遗传算法等四种）来优化变异参数，从而生成通过给定测试套件的非等效变异体（即难以检测的变异体）。

Result: 在30个量子程序上的评估中，QUMUG生成的变异体比现有工具难测三倍；遗传算法最有效，每个程序平均生成494个未检测变异体，成功率99.67%，非等效率94.3%；生成的变异体需要比现有工具多五倍的测试用例才能覆盖。

Conclusion: 一阶变异对增强测试套件更有效，而高阶变异揭示了需要新的独特测试用例的需求，为量子软件测试提供了更深入的见解。

Abstract: Quantum mutation analysis is emerging as an essential technique for evaluating test suites due to the limited availability of real faulty quantum programs. However, existing quantum mutation analysis tools use fixed gate-based mutations, resulting in easy-to-detect mutants, which reduces their effectiveness in assessing the quality of test suites. We propose QUMUG, a search-based approach for generating challenging mutants by utilising parameterisable quantum gates. QUMUG employs search algorithms to optimise mutation parameters and find non-equivalent mutants passing a given test suite. In our evaluation over 30 quantum programs, QUMUG produced mutants that are three times more challenging than the mutants generated by existing tools. Among the four evaluated search algorithms, the genetic algorithm was the most effective, generating an average of 494 undetected mutants per program with a 99.67% success rate and 94.3% non-equivalent ratio. The generated mutants demonstrated their effectiveness by requiring the addition of five times more test cases to the test suite than the mutants generated by existing tools. We also analysed the behaviour of higher order mutants in quantum circuits, and showed that while first order mutations are more effective for enhancing the test suite, higher order mutants highlight the need for new unique test cases.

</details>


### [615] [White paper: A perspective on civilian-to-defence research transfer to SDD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09349)
*Rute C. Sofia,Daniel Mendez,Simon Barner,Hao Shen,Julian Woermann,Andrea Stocco,Axel von Arnim,Holger Pfeifer,Alexander Pretschner*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出"生命周期悖论"（lifecycle paradox）概念，指出国防平台以十年为周期采购，而其搭载的软件和AI模型需在数天或数小时内演进，这是软件定义国防（SDD）必须解决的核心问题。论文提出基于民用技术的持续DevOps式循环路径，涵盖系统工程、AI工程和连接性基础设施三个维度，并给出短中长期三阶段建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 军事能力日益由软件决定，但国防平台的采购周期长达数十年，与软件和AI模型数天或数小时级的演进需求严重不匹配，这一根本性矛盾是软件定义国防面临的核心挑战。

Method: 提出SDD三个维度：软件与系统工程（设计、采购、认证）、AI工程（主权与信任）、连接与基础设施工程。采用持续DevOps式循环：基于模型的系统工程与仿真测试前置设计与验证；战术连接与低功耗边缘计算将设计带入对抗性环境；持续合规、保障与可变性管理作为横切关注点。

Result: 论证了该循环在汽车、制造、航天和能源领域已被验证的能力基础上是可持续的，下一步需在对抗性或国防认证条件下验证，并给出短中长期三阶段路径：短期对抗性测试与连接试点、中期渐进式认证管道、长期在作战条件下闭环验证。

Conclusion: 缩小SDD差距是分布式责任：研究者需将方法转向对抗条件，工业界需将工具暴露于作战需求，政策制定者需塑造监管工具，国防机构需与操作者验证结果——同时保持公民利益。

Abstract: Military capability is increasingly determined by software. Yet defence platforms are procured on decade-long timescales, while the software and AI models they carry must evolve in days or hours. This paper calls this mismatch the lifecycle paradox, and argues it is the central problem Software-Defined Defence (SDD) must solve.
  SDD rests on three dimensions: software and systems engineering (design, procurement, certification), AI engineering (sovereignty and trust of learned components), and connectivity and infrastructure engineering (timely exchange of information among sensors, AI, and operators). The proposed path to resilient SDD starts from civilian technologies, addressed through a continuous, DevOps-style loop: model-based systems engineering and simulation-based testing front-load design and verification; tactical connectivity and low-power edge execution carry that design into contested operation; continuous compliance, assurance, and variability management run as cross-cutting concerns. This loop is sustainable given capabilities already proven in automotive, manufacturing, space, and energy. The next step is validating them under adversarial or defence-certified conditions, with short-, medium-, and long-term paths to closing gaps.
  Closing the SDD gap while preserving civic benefits is a distributed responsibility: researchers must redirect methods toward adversarial conditions; industry must expose tooling to operational needs; policymakers must shape regulatory instruments; and defence agencies must validate results with operators. Recommendations span three horizons: a short-term baseline of adversarial testing and connectivity pilots; a medium-term pipeline of incremental certification; and a long-term validation closing the loop under operational conditions.

</details>


### [616] [SmellCC: A Tool for Automated Code Smells Remediation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09477)
*Xiaoting Zhang,Yujie Zhang,Zhipeng Gao,Xing Hu,Xin Xia*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了SmellCC，一个基于LLM的Visual Studio Code扩展，通过Chain-of-Thought和few-shot学习自动检测并重构Python代码异味，实现了96.8%的清理率和91.3%的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码异味严重威胁软件可维护性并积累技术债务，但开发者在紧张的发布计划下缺乏资源手动处理这些问题。现有的静态分析工具（如SonarQube）虽然能提供精确检测，但本质上是被动警报系统，重构负担仍然落在开发者身上。

Method: SmellCC是一个Visual Studio Code扩展，将SonarQube与基于LLM的流水线相结合，采用Chain-of-Thought（CoT）和few-shot学习技术，针对十大最频繁的代码异味提供原地一键式修复。

Result: 定量评估显示SmellCC具有96.8%的清理率，91.3%的高准确率，且重构后的代码保持语法正确和行为不变。

Conclusion: SmellCC能有效帮助开发者在开发过程中消除代码异味，防止技术债务积累，从而显著提升软件长期可维护性。

Abstract: Code smells significantly threaten software maintainability by accumulating technical debt, yet developers often lack the resources to manually address these flaws under tight release schedules. While static analysis tools like SonarQube provide precise detection, they function largely as passive alert systems, leaving the burden of refactoring on developers. To bridge this gap, we present a novel cleaning tool, namely SmellCC, a Visual Studio Code extension that augments SonarQube with an LLM-based pipeline to automatically detect and refactor Python code smells. By employing Chain-of-Thought (CoT) and few-shot learning, SmellCC provides in-place, one-click remediation for the top-10 most frequent smells, effectively preventing the accumulation of technical debt during development. Our quantitative evaluation demonstrates that our SmellCC is promising in helping developers effectively eliminate code smells (96.8\% cleaning rate) with high accuracy (i.e., 91.3\%), ensuring that the refactored code remains syntactically correct and behavior-preserving, thereby significantly improving long-term software maintainability.

</details>


### [617] [The Unseen Delta: Characterizing the Compiler Optimization Landscape via Top-Down Differential Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09530)
*Zhibo Liu,Huaijin Wang,Shuai Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种自顶向下的差分分析方法，通过细粒度分层微架构指标校准编译器优化差异，并采用基于采样的方法精确定位导致性能差异的关键代码片段。实证评估揭示了GCC和Clang生成的二进制之间存在显著且令人惊讶的性能差异，并通过二进制修补框架移植竞争编译器的优质代码来修复性能问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有编译器优化缺陷检测方法采用自底向上的方式，关注特定低级代码属性且局限于已知优化规则，难以量化问题的整体影响并容易忽视关键的微架构低效问题。作者观察到不同编译器对相同源代码生成二进制存在显著性能差异，但根本原因尚未被充分探索。

Method: 提出一种自顶向下的差分分析方法：1) 用细粒度、分层的微架构指标校准编译器优化差异；2) 采用基于采样的方法高效定位导致性能差异的关键代码片段，实现针对性的根因分析；3) 开发二进制修补框架，通过移植竞争编译器中的优质代码序列来修复识别的性能问题。

Result: 实证评估发现了GCC和Clang生成二进制之间实质且令人惊讶的性能差异，并通过根因分类揭示了编译器优化中的系统性挑战。二进制修补框架成功地定量验证了研究发现并展示了实际影响。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了一种理解与分析编译器优化缺陷的新视角，通过差分分析和代码移植的方式为编译器性能优化提供了系统性方法。

Abstract: Compiler optimizations are essential for achieving high performance in modern software. However, recent studies highlight the persistence of performance bugs, i.e., subtle defects where the compiler generates functionally correct but computationally inefficient code, leading to significant performance degradation. Existing detection and testing methods typically employ a bottom-up approach, focusing on specific low-level code properties and remaining confined to known optimization rules. Consequently, they struggle to quantify the holistic impact of identified issues and often overlook critical microarchitectural inefficiencies.
  We observe a key indicator of untapped potential: different compilers often produce binaries with significant performance differences for identical source code. However, the root causes of these discrepancies remain largely unexplored and difficult to pinpoint using current techniques. To bridge this gap, we introduce a top-down differential analysis methodology. This approach calibrates compiler optimization differences with fine-grained, hierarchical microarchitectural metrics, offering a comprehensive view of runtime behavior. Using a sampling-based approach, this method efficiently pinpoints the critical code snippets responsible for performance differences, enabling targeted root cause analysis.
  Our empirical evaluation uncovers substantial and often surprising performance differences between binaries generated by GCC and Clang. A categorization of root causes reveals systemic challenges in compiler optimizations. To quantitatively validate our findings and demonstrate practical impact, we developed a binary patching framework that fixes identified performance issues by transplanting superior code sequences from competing compilers. This work provides a novel lens for understanding and analyzing optimization defects.

</details>


### [618] [Representative Dataset Generation Framework for AI-based Failure Analysis during real-time Validation of Automotive Software Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09651)
*Mohammad Abboush,Christoph Knieke,Andreas Rausch*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于硬件在环（HIL）仿真和实时故障注入（FI）的新方法，用于在系统验证阶段为机器学习应用生成和收集单故障及同时多故障下的数据样本（包括时序数据和文本故障日志），实验结果证明了该框架在模拟和捕获系统组件故障行为方面的适用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据驱动方法在系统开发生命周期的实时验证中表现优异，但缺乏具有代表性的故障数据集是主要挑战。现有的基于模型和基于信号的方法难以解决此问题，因此需要探索针对不同工程应用生成代表性故障数据的新方案。

Method: 提出基于硬件在环（HIL）仿真与实时故障注入（FI）相结合的框架，能够在系统验证阶段生成单故障和多故障同时发生条件下的数据样本，既生成时序数据也生成包含故障日志的文本数据。

Result: 实验结果表明，所提出的框架能够有效模拟和捕获系统组件在故障状态下的行为，验证了该方法的可行性。

Conclusion: 该HIL+FI框架为系统验证阶段生成代表性故障数据提供了可行的新途径，可支持机器学习应用对故障数据的需求。

Abstract: Recently, thanks to its ability to extract knowledge from historical datasets, the data-driven approach has been widely used in various phases of the system development life cycle. During real-time system validation, remarkable achievements have been accomplished in developing an intelligent failure analysis based on historical data. However, despite its superiority over other conventional approaches, e.g., model-based and signal-based, the availability of representative datasets persists as a major challenge. Thus, for different engineering applications, new solutions to generate representative faulty data in different forms should be explored. Therefore, in this study, a novel approach based on Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) simulation and real-time Fault Injection (FI) method is proposed to generate and collect data samples under single and simultaneous faults for Machine Learning (ML) applications during system validation phases. The developed framework can generate not only sequential data, but also textual data including fault logs. The results show the applicability of the proposed framework in simulating and capturing the system behaviour under faults within the system components.

</details>


### [619] [Security Tests as Executable Specifications for LLM Code Generation: Benefits, Trade-offs, and Coverage Limits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09740)
*Yunhao Liang,Chengguang Gan,Ruixuan Ying*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文研究将安全测试作为可执行规范，在代码生成前和迭代修复中提供测试反馈。通过SecTDD框架分离三个因素（测试是否预先展示、失败执行是否触发修订、失败选择与表示方式），在2705条轨迹、31个任务、三个安全代码基准、16个CWE类别和两个模型家族上评估。结果显示预先展示所有可见测试平均提升19.3个百分点，但结构化反馈修复80个候选无联合回归，原始反馈修复83个但有3个回归，且通过所有可见测试的候选仍会在隐藏行为族上失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型能生成功能可用但存在安全漏洞的代码，而安全导向的干预可能破坏预期功能。现有研究缺乏对测试反馈在安全代码生成中作用的系统化、受控分析，需要厘清测试展示时机、失败触发修订和反馈表示方式这三个因素各自的贡献。

Method: 开发SecTDD测试反馈脚手架，分离三个因素：测试是否预先展示、失败执行是否触发修订、失败如何选择与表示。使用行为划分的可见/隐藏测试及字节级相同的初始候选进行修复对比，在多个模型和基准上进行大规模评估。

Result: 预先展示所有可见测试使隐藏功能与安全联合成功率平均提升19.3个百分点，但仅改善9个基准-模型条件中的7个，对2个有害。共享候选对比中，结构化反馈修复80个初始不成功候选且无联合回归；固定原始反馈修复83个但造成3个回归。两者头对头几乎无差异（6胜6负453平）。所有常见机制下，通过全部可见测试的候选仍会失败于隐藏行为族。

Conclusion: 可执行反馈确实能修复安全代码生成，但其收益高度依赖模型、任务、反馈入口点尤其是测试覆盖率。测试反馈并非普适的灵丹妙药，需要谨慎设计测试覆盖策略以最大化安全代码生成的联合成功率。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate functionally useful code that remains vulnerable, while security-focused interventions may break intended behavior. We investigate security tests as executable specifications both before generation and during iterative repair. We develop SecTDD, a controlled test-feedback scaffold that separates three factors: whether tests are shown upfront, whether failed executions trigger revision, and how failures are selected and represented. The evaluation uses behavior-partitioned visible and hidden tests and byte-identical initial candidates for repair comparisons. Across 2,705 trajectories, 31 task instances, three secure-code benchmarks, 16 CWE categories, and two model families, showing all visible tests upfront increases hidden functional-and-security joint success by 19.3 percentage points on average, but improves only seven of nine benchmark-model conditions and harms two. In shared-candidate comparisons, structured feedback repairs 80 initially unsuccessful candidates with no joint regressions; fixed raw feedback repairs 83 but causes three regressions. Structured and raw feedback are otherwise nearly indistinguishable head-to-head (six wins, six losses, and 453 ties). Candidates that pass all visible tests still fail hidden behavior families under every common regime. These results show that executable feedback can repair secure-code generation, but its benefits depend on the model, task, feedback entry point, and especially test coverage.

</details>


### [620] [SpecPath: Testing Coding Agents Across Contract-Equivalent Specification Histories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09799)
*Yangfan Wu,Haozhe Wang,Huanyu Yang,Jianmin Ji,Fangzhen Lin*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出"规范路径敏感性"（specification-path sensitivity）这一失败模式：即使最终需求含义相同，不同修订历史会导致同一编码智能体产生行为不同的程序。作者引入SpecPath诊断评测框架，通过固定仓库、最终契约、验证器、智能体系统和执行预算，仅改变到达契约的修订路径来检验智能体是否对规范路径具有不变性。实验发现14种编码智能体配置在5个软件任务上，35/100的成功块在直接规范上成功但在等价历史路径上失败，证明实现成功并不保证规范路径不变性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代编码智能体越来越擅长遵循复杂软件需求，但其成功存在关键歧义：它们究竟是解决了实际的规范（active specification），还是仅仅遵循了表述规范时最显著的路径？现有的进化需求评估方式未能区分这两种情况，因此需要一种新的评测视角——将进化需求评估重新定义为"活动契约解析"（active-contract resolution），即在写代码前智能体必须判断哪些需求仍然有效。

Method: 作者提出SpecPath诊断评测框架：在保持仓库、最终契约、验证器、智能体系统、执行预算完全不变的前提下，仅改变到达最终契约的修订路径（revision path）。区别于将每个补丁视为孤立通过/失败的传统评测，SpecPath使用配对的可执行结果来揭示智能体是否在契约等价的历史路径上实现相同的被测试行为。

Result: 在5个校准后的软件任务和14种编码智能体配置上，直接规范和修订历史的聚合准确率几乎不变；然而，100个在直接规范上成功的完整块中，有35个在至少一个等价历史路径上失败。这表明在整合需求上的实现成功并不能保证规范路径不变性。

Conclusion: 评估进化需求需要受控测试，检验智能体是否对规范成为最终形态的路径具有鲁棒性。传统以最终聚合请求为唯一基准的评测方式存在盲区，无法捕捉智能体对需求表述路径的敏感性这一关键失败模式。

Abstract: Modern coding agents increasingly appear capable of following complex software requirements, yet their success leaves a critical ambiguity: do they resolve the active specification, or merely follow the most salient path by which it was stated? We identify specification-path sensitivity, a failure mode in which requirement histories that are equivalent in their final meaning lead the same agent system to produce behaviorally different programs. This reframes evolving-requirement evaluation as active-contract resolution: before writing code, an agent must determine which requirements still count.
  Building on this view, we introduce SpecPath, a diagnostic evaluation that holds the repository, final contract, verifier, agent system, and execution budget fixed while changing only the revision path that leads to the contract. Rather than treating each patch as an isolated pass or failure, SpecPath uses paired executable outcomes to reveal whether an agent realizes the same tested behavior across contract-equivalent histories. Across five calibrated software tasks and fourteen coding-agent configurations, aggregate direct and revision-history accuracy is nearly unchanged; nevertheless, 35 of 100 complete blocks that succeed on the direct specification fail on at least one equivalent history. These results show that implementation success on a consolidated request does not guarantee specification-path invariance. Evaluating evolving requirements therefore calls for controlled tests of whether agents are robust to the path by which a specification becomes final.

</details>


### [621] [Comprehending Python Repetition Structures: An Eye-Tracking Study with Novice Developers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09875)
*José Júnior Silva da Costa,Rohit Gheyi,José Aldo Silva da Costa,Márcio Ribeiro*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 通过眼动追踪实验（32名有Python经验的本科生），比较了Python中for循环、while循环、递归和列表推导式四种重复结构在代码理解时的认知负担差异。结果显示for循环视觉努力最低；while循环在AOI注视时长和回归次数上显著增加（最多97%和114%）；递归回归次数增加50%；列表推导式在AOI时间和注视时长上分别增加62.5%和80.9%。非for结构的整体比较在所有眼动指标上均显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码理解是软件维护和演化的核心，但不同Python重复结构可能对认知产生不同负担。现有研究缺乏基于过程性证据（如眼动）的系统比较，因此需要通过实验量化不同重复结构的视觉/认知努力差异，为可读性、代码审查、重构等提供实证依据。

Method: 采用受控眼动追踪实验，招募32名有Python经验的本科生。被试在拉丁方设计中完成6个代码理解任务，测量完成行为及两类指标：(1)完整代码片段层面；(2)构造特异区域（AOIs）层面。比较对象包括for循环、while循环、递归和列表推导式。

Result: for循环视觉努力最低。与for相比：while循环AOI注视时长增加最多97%、回归次数增加114%，回归集中在计数器管理区域；递归回归次数描述性增加50%，主要出现在基准情形和递归调用之间；列表推导式AOI时间增加62.5%、注视时长增加80.9%，水平回归暗示逐token密集解析。列表推导式对比产生最清晰的统计显著差异，且所有非for结构与for的综合比较在所有眼动指标上均显著。

Conclusion: 研究提供了过程层面的证据，表明Python重复结构确实引发不同的视觉努力模式。该发现对代码可读性、代码审查、重构、新手入职培训和可维护性具有重要启示。

Abstract: Code comprehension is central to software maintenance and evolution, yet different Python repetition structures may impose distinct cognitive demands. We conducted a controlled eye-tracking experiment with 32 undergraduate students with prior Python experience to compare comprehension of for loops, while loops, recursion, and list comprehensions (LCs). Participants solved six comprehension tasks in a Latin Square design while we measured completion behavior and eye-tracking metrics over full snippets and construct-specific Areas of Interest (AOIs). for loops showed the lowest visual effort. Relative to for, while loops increased AOI fixation duration by up to 97% and regression count by 114%, with regressions concentrated around counter management. Recursion showed a descriptive 50% increase in regressions, mainly between the base case and recursive call. LCs increased AOI time by 62.5% and fixation duration by 80.9%, with horizontal regressions suggesting dense token-by-token parsing. LC comparisons yielded the clearest statistically significant pairwise differences, while the combined comparison of all non-for structures was significant across all eye-tracking metrics. These findings provide process-level evidence that Python repetition structures induce distinct visual-effort patterns, with implications for readability, code review, refactoring, onboarding, and maintainability.

</details>


### [622] [Detecting Behavioral Changes in Python Refactoring Implementations with Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09919)
*Jonhnanthan Oliveira,Rohit Gheyi,Márcio Ribeiro,Alessandro Garcia*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于基础模型（foundation model）作为oracle的方法，通过分析git风格的diff来识别Python重构过程中引入的行为变化。在Rope重构工具上评估，分析217个转换对，发现13个不同的bug，其中12个被开发者接受。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Python虽然被广泛使用，但其自动化重构仍然具有挑战性。重构过程中引入的行为变化会损害软件可靠性并降低开发者生产力，因此理解这些行为变化至关重要。

Method: 提出一种基于foundation model oracle的方法，通过分析git风格的diff来识别Python重构引入的行为变化。实验复用了先前研究的1,152个重构尝试，对217个转换对使用该oracle进行分析。

Result: 在研究的7种重构类型中发现了13个不同的bug。所有bug均已提交给开发者，其中12个issue报告被接受。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明需要改进当前Python重构工具的鲁棒性，以确保自动化代码转换的正确性，支持可靠的软件维护。

Abstract: Python is a widely adopted programming language, valued for its simplicity and flexibility. However, automated refactoring for Python remains challenging, even though refactoring is an essential practice in software evolution aimed at improving internal code structure without changing external behavior. Understanding how behavioral changes are introduced during refactoring is crucial, as such issues can compromise software reliability and reduce developer productivity. We propose an approach based on a foundation model oracle that analyzes git-style diffs to identify behavioral changes introduced by Python refactorings. We evaluated our technique on Rope refactoring implementations, reusing 1,152 refactoring attempts from a prior study and analyzing 217 resulting transformation pairs with the oracle. Our model-based analysis uncovered 13 distinct bugs among the seven refactoring types studied. All reported bugs were submitted to the respective developers, and 12 of the 13 resulting issue reports were accepted according to issue-tracker evidence. These results highlight the need to improve the robustness of current Python refactoring tools to ensure the correctness of automated code transformations and support reliable software maintenance.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [623] [Towards an Argumentative Foundation for Evaluative AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07473)
*Xiang Yin,Tim Miller,Nico Potyka,Antonio Rago,Francesca Toni*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出将计算论证（computational argumentation）作为评估式AI（Evaluative AI, EAI）的形式化基础，主张用论证框架来呈现竞争性假设及其支持/反对证据，而非单一推荐，从而构建可解释、可质疑的分布式人本AI系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的AI决策支持系统通常只提供单一推荐，缺乏透明度且难以被人类质疑。评估式AI（EAI）作为一种新范式，通过呈现竞争性假设及正反证据来支持人类决策，但其缺乏一个形式化、可计算的理论基础，因此需要寻找合适的范式来支撑其可解释性和可质疑性。

Method: 本文是一篇立场论文（position paper），主张将计算论证（computational argumentation）作为EAI的形式化基础。论证框架天然适合表示竞争性假设以及支持/反对各自立场的证据，并且提供了可形式化推理与冲突消解的机制，从而为可解释和可质疑的AI系统奠定基础。

Result: 论文提出并论证了计算论证范式与EAI目标之间的契合性，指出该范式能够为EAI提供形式化、可计算的基础，并为面向分布式和人本中心的EAI系统设立了长期研究议程。

Conclusion: 计算论证是支撑评估式AI的合适理论基础，能够使EAI系统具备可解释性和可争议性，为未来构建更透明、更以人为中心的AI决策支持系统指明研究方向。

Abstract: Evaluative AI (EAI) has been recently proposed as a way to support human decision-making, not by producing a single recommendation, but by presenting competing hypotheses together with evidence for and against each. In this position paper, we advocate (computational) argumentation as a particularly suitable paradigm to provide a formal, computable foundation for forms of EAI that are explainable and contestable, setting the ground for a long-term research agenda towards distributed and human-centred EAI systems.

</details>


### [624] [Flow-by-Flow:Content-Judgment Bypass for Governing AI Output in High-Loss Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07474)
*Hiroki Naito*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"Flow-by-Flow"治理范式，用于解决高损失领域中AI输出速度与人类认知能力不匹配的问题。核心约束是V×L（速度×认知负荷），而非单纯速度V。作者论证了AI能力提升如何重构而非减少认知负荷，并提出通过基于形式化可计数特征的费用与制度容量上限来绕过内容判断的监督方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前研究表明，当AI输出速度V超过人类认知容量C_max时，人在回路监督在结构上变得不可行。然而实际约束是V×L而非仅V。更关键的是，L（每项认知负荷）由分诊、判断和响应三部分组成，它们对AI能力提升的响应不对称：分诊成本不会因模型更强而降（语义不确定性是通用设计固有的），响应成本对准确性改进不敏感，只有判断成本面临下行压力且往往通过省略而非真正减少实现。因此需要一种不依赖内容评价的治理机制。

Method: 提出Flow-by-Flow治理范式：1) 基于形式化可计数特征（如篇幅、复杂度、频率）的认知成本评分，对高产量输出施加非线性成本；2) 制度性容量上限将处理量限制在C_max内。推导出四条设计不变量：无内容判断、不可规模化消耗审查能力、身份绑定每应用摩擦、无批量放行。通过一个参考实现证明这些不变量可同时满足，并用Monte Carlo模拟验证。

Result: Monte Carlo分析（1000组参数抽样）表明，复合多指标流量控制在90.8%的试验中优于单纯监督强化。参考实现证明四条设计不变量可以联合满足，但文章也明确承认其实际应用困难。

Conclusion: AI能力提升重构认知负荷结构（L）而非简单减少它。传统的"评估AI输出是否正确"的治理机制陷入两难：委托给AI则继承幻觉风险，委托给人类则面临V×L上限。Flow-by-Flow范式通过完全绕过内容判断来控制监督负荷，提供了一种结构性的替代路径，但实际部署仍面临挑战。

Abstract: Prior work showed that human-in-the-loop oversight becomes structurally untenable in high-loss domains when AI output velocity V exceeds human cognitive capacity C_max. The operative constraint, however, is not V alone but V x L, where L denotes per-item cognitive load. L consists of triage, judgment, and response, which respond asymmetrically to AI capability improvement. Triage cost does not decline as models become more capable, because semantic indeterminacy is inherent in general-purpose design. Response cost is invariant to accuracy improvements. Only judgment cost faces downward pressure, and this pressure often operates by inducing omission rather than genuine reduction. Capability improvement therefore restructures L rather than reducing it. Governance mechanisms based on evaluating whether AI output is correct either delegate that evaluation to AI and inherit hallucination risk, or delegate it to humans and face the V x L ceiling. We propose Flow-by-Flow, a governance paradigm that controls supervisory load without evaluating content. A cognitive cost score based on formal, countable features imposes nonlinear costs on high-volume production, while an institutional capacity cap keeps processing volume within C_max. We derive four design invariants for any content-judgment-bypass exceedance pathway: no content judgment, no scalable consumption of examiner capacity, identity-bound per-application friction, and no batch clearance. One reference implementation is discussed to show that these invariants are jointly satisfiable, while its practical difficulties are explicitly acknowledged. An illustrative Monte Carlo analysis across 1,000 parameter draws suggests that composite multi-metric flow control outperforms supervision reinforcement alone in 90.8% of trials.

</details>


### [625] [Determinization in Structure Theories: A Unified Framework via Closure, Comparability, and Joint Admissibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07476)
*Hai Hai Fu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个形式化框架，用于从多元结构理论中构建规范解释，区分了三种规范化层次（闭包稳定化、全局完成、确定化），并分类了两种非确定性类型（Epistemic 型与 Structural 型），同时提供了两种规范化机制（基于算子的完成与基于选择器的构造）及其充分条件，并将该框架应用于 LLM 辅助推理中幻觉现象的建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多元结构理论中如何构建规范（canonical）解释缺乏统一的数学框架。现有方法无法系统地区分不同类型的非确定性，也无法明确给出在何种结构条件下规范化机制存在，因此需要一个形式化框架来统一描述和分类规范化过程。

Method: 论文定义了结构理论 T = (Σ, A, I) 的三元组，引入可容许解释族的概念。提出了三个规范化层次：闭包稳定化（per-seed 收敛）、全局完成（seed 无关收敛）和确定化（唯一可容许解释）。将非确定性分类为 Type E（认知多元性）与 Type S（结构多元性），并细分出 Type S-strong 子类（特征为无公共上界）。提出了基于算子和基于选择器两种规范化机制，证明了纯推理型完成在正非收缩规则及附加可靠性条件下可约简为饱和闭包算子。对 Type E 理论证明了闭包稳定化，对 Type S-strong 理论通过规范选择实现确定化。还展示了多级规范化通过分段算子形成结构性非交换系统，并给出了条件分类定理。最后将该框架应用于 LLM 推理中幻觉的建模。

Result: 建立了结构理论中规范解释的完整形式化框架；证明了纯推理型完成在特定条件下可约简为饱和闭包算子；对 Type E 理论建立了闭包稳定化，对 Type S-strong 理论实现确定化；证明了多级规范化系统的非交换性；提供了将理论内在机制归约为闭包或选择的分类定理；并将框架成功应用于 LLM 幻觉现象的建模。

Conclusion: 该文提供了一个统一的、分层的规范解释构建理论，为理解不同来源的非确定性和不同层次的规范化机制提供了数学基础。同时，Type E 理论的完全确定化依赖于一个尚未解决的全局合流性质，这为未来研究留出了开放问题；框架对 LLM 幻觉的解释也为 AI 推理的可靠性分析提供了理论视角。

Abstract: We develop a formal framework for constructing canonical interpretations from plural structure theories. A structure theory is a triple T = (Σ, A, I) consisting of a signature, axioms, and an inference policy, whose admissible interpretation family collects all globally consistent assignments of structural conclusions.
  We distinguish three levels of canonicalization: closure stabilization (per-seed convergence), global completion (seed-independent convergence), and determinization (a unique admissible interpretation). Non-determinism is classified into epistemic plurality (Type E) and structural plurality (Type S), with a refined Type S-strong subclass characterized by the absence of common upper bounds.
  Two canonicalization mechanisms arise: operator-based completion and selector-based construction. We provide sufficient structural conditions under which these mechanisms exist, and show that pure inference-based completion reduces to a saturated closure operator under positive, non-retractive rules with an additional soundness condition. For Type E theories, closure stabilization is established, while full determinization depends on a global confluence property that remains open. For Type S-strong theories, determinization is achieved via canonical selection.
  We further show that multi-level canonicalization forms a structurally non-commutative system via staged operators, and provide a conditional classification theorem reducing theory-intrinsic mechanisms to closure or selection. The framework also applies to LLM-assisted reasoning, where hallucination can be viewed as unsupported canonicalization.

</details>


### [626] [Emotion in an active inference model of human driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07480)
*Julian F. Schumann,Johan Engström,Ran Wei,Jens Kober,Martijn Wisse,Arkady Zgonnikov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种从连续状态空间下的主动推断驾驶模型中提取效价（valence）与唤醒度（arousal）情绪信号的扩展公式，通过不仅依赖当前状态还依赖预测的未来结果来条件化情绪估计，并在两个交互驾驶场景中验证了情绪信号与真实场景中的情感模式一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的主动推断驾驶模型未考虑情感状态对决策的重要影响，而此前在非交通领域探索情绪建模的主动推断工作仅局限于简化的离散状态空间，无法应用于更复杂的连续状态驾驶场景。

Method: 提出效价与唤醒度的扩展公式，从具有连续状态空间的复杂主动推断驾驶模型中提取情绪信号，将情感估计条件化于当前状态以及预测的未来结果之上。

Result: 在两个交互式驾驶场景中评估了所提方法，结果表明生成的情绪信号与类似场景中报告的典型情感模式相吻合。

Conclusion: 扩展的情绪公式成功将情感建模引入连续状态空间的主动推断驾驶框架，能够生成与实际驾驶场景一致的情感信号，为更逼真的智能体行为建模提供了基础。

Abstract: Active inference has emerged as a principled framework for modeling adaptive behavior by balancing goal-directed action with uncertainty reduction. It has been successfully applied across biological and artificial systems, including recent work on human driving. However, existing active inference models of driving have yet to address an important determinant of behavior in traffic: affective state, which significantly influences decision-making. Prior work in non-traffic domains has explored active inference agents in which emotions are represented along the axes of valence and arousal in the circumplex model. However, this work has been limited to simplified settings with discrete state spaces. In this work, we propose an expanded formulation of valence and arousal that can be extracted from a more complex active inference model of driving with continuous states. In particular, we condition affective estimates not only on the current state but also on predicted future outcomes. We evaluate the proposed approach in two interactive driving scenarios and show that the resulting emotion signals correspond to affective patterns reported in similar scenarios.

</details>


### [627] [Training Variable Long Sequences with Data-Centric Parallel](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07524)
*Geng Zhang,Xuanlei Zhao,Kai Wang,Yang You*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Data-Centric Parallel (DCP)，一个以数据驱动运行时的分布式训练方法，用于处理可变长序列。DCP根据每个batch的序列长度动态调整运行时设置（如并行大小、梯度累积、重计算），在32块H200 GPU上实现最高2.88倍加速，且仅需10行代码即可集成到任意模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练可变长序列的深度学习模型面临计算挑战，现有方法在效率和易用性之间难以兼顾：简单方法使用静态配置导致工作负载不均衡和低效率，复杂方法则引入大量复杂性和代码改动。

Method: DCP的核心原则是让数据本身驱动运行时，通过根据每个batch的序列长度动态调整直接运行时设置（平行大小、梯度累积、重计算）来打破效率与易用性之间的权衡。

Result: 在32块H200 GPU上实现最高2.88倍加速，且只需10行代码即可集成到任意模型，具有良好的泛化性。

Conclusion: 这种简单而有效的方法有望作为分布式训练可变长序列领域的稳健基线，促进未来研究进展。

Abstract: Training deep learning models on variable long sequences poses significant computational challenges. Existing methods force a difficult trade-off between efficiency and ease-of-use. Simple approaches use static configurations that cause workload imbalance low efficiency, while complex methods introduces significant complexity and code change for new models. To break this trade-off, we introduce Data-Centric Parallel (DCP). Its core principle is to let the data itself drive the runtime. It achieves this by dynamically adjusting direct runtime settings (e.g., parallel size, gradient accumulation, recomputation) based on each batch's sequence length. Empirical results demonstrate that our method achieves up to a 2.88$\times$ speedup on 32 H200 GPUs. Designed for generalization, it can be integrated into any model with 10 lines of code. We anticipate this simple yet effective approach will serve as a robust baseline and facilitate future advancements in distributed training for variable long sequences.

</details>


### [628] [The Knowing-Saying Gap: When Probes See Errors that Confidence Misses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07528)
*Jyotin Goel,Ipshita Bandyopadhyay,Justin Shenk*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型的线性探针在检测上下文损坏时几乎完美准确，但无法可靠预测最终答案的正确性。探针检测与失败预测之间存在解离现象，跨多个模型家族（包括推理模型）普遍存在。研究发现基于探针的干预措施高度依赖模型和错误类型，没有单一干预方法占优，部署时应采用模型感知和错误类型感知的路由策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管线性探针能够以接近完美的准确率检测语言模型中上下文的损坏，但这种检测能力并未转化为可靠的失败预测。这一解离现象对部署监控有直接影响，理解探针检测与真实失败之间的关系对于开发可靠的监控和干预机制至关重要。

Method: 研究跨多跳算术链进行实验，使用线性探针检测上下文损坏，分析探针检测与最终答案正确性之间的关联。测试三种干预策略：分支选择（branch-and-pick）、重新提示（reprompt）和替换先前（replace-prior），并检验预注册的"持久性胜过峰值"假设。

Result: 1) 检测损坏的探针对最终答案正确性无信息；2) 结构化置信度格式被压缩为两个错误率无法区分的数值；3) 探针跨跳的持久性无法区分正确与错误结果，否定了预注册假设；4) 干预效果因模型和错误类型而异：分支选择在所有模型上净正向且对Llama-3.1-8B唯一非破坏性（4拯救、0破坏），而重提示和替换先前破坏与拯救率大致相当。

Conclusion: 基于探针的监控是口头置信度表达的必要补充，但没有单一干预方法占优。可部署的答案应是模型感知和错误类型感知的路由策略，在不同场景下动态选择最合适的干预方式。

Abstract: Linear probes detect corrupted context in language models with near-perfect accuracy, yet this does not translate into reliable failure prediction. The result is a dissociation with direct implications for deployment monitoring. Across multi-hop arithmetic chains, probes that detect corruption turn out to be uninformative about final answer correctness; models forced into structured confidence formats collapse to two values with indistinguishable error rates; and probe persistence across hops fails to separate correct from incorrect outcomes, refuting our pre-registered "persistence beats peak" hypothesis. This pattern of knowing but not saying generalises across model families including reasoning models. As a real-time monitor, probe-based interventions are sharply model and error-type dependent: branch-and-pick is net-positive across models and uniquely non-breaking on Llama-3.1-8B (4 rescued, 0 broken), while reprompt and replace-prior break correct traces at roughly the rate they rescue wrong ones. Probe-based monitoring is a necessary complement to verbalised confidence, but no single intervention dominates, and the deployable answer is model-aware, error-type-aware routing.

</details>


### [629] [NL2SHACL-Bench: A Benchmark Suite for Natural Language to SHACL Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07530)
*Yuchen Zhou,Niels Bobet,Maribel Acosta*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了NL2SHACL-Bench，这是首个专门用于评估自然语言到SHACL翻译任务的基准测试套件。该基准支持超越字符串比较的语义等价评估，并基于此评估了四种先进的大语言模型在SHACL生成任务上的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SHACL是验证RDF知识图谱一致性的核心技术，但编写SHACL形状需要专业技术知识，领域专家难以掌握。将自然语言需求转化为SHACL可以降低这一门槛，然而此前缺乏专门的NL2SHACL基准，且评估生成形状需要超越字符串比较的方法，因为语义等价的形状可能在序列化和结构上有所不同。

Method: 作者构建了NL2SHACL-Bench基准套件，用于自然语言到SHACL翻译任务的系统评估。该基准被用来评估四种先进的大语言模型（LLMs）在该任务上的表现。

Result: 评估结果显示，当前的大语言模型能够高效生成语法有效的SHACL代码，但在处理复杂的逻辑和结构模式时，仍然难以生成语义等价的约束条件。

Conclusion: NL2SHACL-Bench为衡量NL2SHACL领域的发展进步提供了有意义的基础，揭示了当前LLM在该任务上的能力边界。

Abstract: SHACL is a core technology for validating the conformance of RDF knowledge graphs (KGs). Yet, authoring SHACL shapes requires technical expertise that most domain experts lack. Translating natural language requirements into SHACL (NL2SHACL) would lower this barrier. However, there is no dedicated benchmark for NL2SHACL, and evaluating generated shapes requires methods beyond string comparison, as semantically equivalent shapes can differ in serialisation and structure. To tackle these challenges, we present NL2SHACL-Bench, a benchmark suite for natural language to SHACL translation. Using NL2SHACL-Bench, we evaluate four state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) for this task. Our results show that current LLMs are highly capable of generating syntactically valid SHACL, but still struggle to produce semantically equivalent constraints for complex logical and structural patterns. This indicates that NL2SHACL-Bench provides a meaningful basis for measuring advances in the NL2SHACL state of the art.

</details>


### [630] [Dynamic Coalition Formation and Communication Pricing in Skill-Based Agentic AI Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07532)
*Mojtaba Eslami*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出将多智能体LLM系统中的智能体选择与通信建模为带任务条件净效用的合作博弈，通过边际值激活规则和贪心路由优化智能体激活与通信边，避免全广播带来的成本与冗余问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体AI系统要么预先固定通信结构，要么允许全广播，两者都因token成本、延迟、冗余和错误传播随活跃智能体与通信链路数量增加而效率低下，亟需动态智能体选择与通信优化。

Method: 将智能体选择与通信建模为合作博弈，定义净效用U(C|x)=V(C|x)-∑c_i（区分联盟级成本与激活成本）；提出边际值激活规则与贪心路由器；扩展模型优化通信边（每边成本）；用估计的Shapley值预测执行前后哪些智能体值得联系；将问题与子模最大化建立联系并证明两类有限保证。

Result: 合成实验中贪心路由达到暴力搜索最优效用的99.5%，平均激活8个智能体中的1.96个，相比全广播的38.8%更优；对激活成本与冗余权重鲁棒，但在子模性严重违背或有噪声价值估计时降至66%。

Conclusion: 该框架与Shapley定价、hedonic联盟形成和通信图剪枝相区分，建议在真实多智能体LLM基准上进一步评估，主路由器仍为启发式，理论保证不直接适用。

Abstract: Modern agentic AI systems combine multiple large language model agents with heterogeneous skills, yet most architectures either fix communication in advance or allow full broadcast. Both can be inefficient because token cost, latency, redundancy, and error propagation increase with the number of active agents and communication links. We model agent selection and communication as a cooperative game with task-conditioned net utility $U(C\mid x)=V(C\mid x)-\sum_{i\in C}c_i$, separating coalition-level costs from agent activation costs. We propose a marginal-value activation rule and greedy router, extend the model to optimize communication edges with per-edge costs, and use estimated Shapley values to predict which agents are worth contacting before and during execution. We connect the problem to submodular maximization and prove two limited guarantees: a curvature-refined bound for a monotone, cardinality-constrained special case, and a tight $1/2$-approximation, with a correction for signed objectives, for an unconstrained non-monotone case via double greedy. Neither guarantee applies directly to the main router, which remains a heuristic. We also prove a Shapley-submodularity sandwich bound linking the error of marginal-value routing to a per-agent diminishing-returns quantity. In synthetic experiments, greedy routing achieves $99.5%$ of brute-force-optimal utility while activating $1.96$ of $8$ agents on average, compared with $38.8%$ for full broadcast. Performance is robust to activation cost and redundancy weight but falls to $66%$ under strong violations of submodularity or noisy value estimates. We distinguish the framework from Shapley pricing, hedonic coalition formation, and communication-graph pruning, and propose evaluation on real multi-agent LLM benchmarks.

</details>


### [631] [Deferred Audio Pruning with Local Audio-Visual Dynamics for Omni-LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08794)
*Kyeongyoon Lee,Hongyeob Kim,Youngeun Kim,Sungeun Hong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出A-PACK，一个两阶段的omni-modal LLM压缩框架，通过延迟音频剪枝直到query条件化的多模态交互出现，并在LLM内部渐进式剪枝低相关性的音频/视觉token及其KV-cache，在Qwen2.5-Omni-7B/3B上实现最优性能，同时减少最多78%的prefill FLOPs并提升2.21倍解码吞吐量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有omni-modal压缩方法主要集中于pre-LLM的token减少，而忽视了跨LLM边界的模态特定压缩。作者发现音频token相比视频具有更高的任务相关信息密度和表征多样性，且局部音视频动态比token级匹配更能有效指导视觉选择，因此需要一种更精细化的跨模态压缩策略。

Method: A-PACK采用两阶段框架：(1)在LLM之前保留音频并利用局部音视频动态压缩视频；(2)在LLM内部逐步剪枝低相关性的音频和视觉token及其对应的KV-cache条目，基于query条件化的多模态交互进行选择。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-Omni-7B/3B上跨越四个基准测试，A-PACK在评估的先前方法中取得了最强的平均性能，同时将prefill FLOPs降低高达78%，并将解码吞吐量提高最多2.21倍。

Conclusion: A-PACK证明了延迟音频剪枝至多模态交互产生之后，并结合跨LLM边界的渐进式token/KV-cache剪枝，能够在保持甚至提升任务性能的同时显著降低计算开销，为omni-modal LLM的高效推理提供了新的范式。

Abstract: Omni-modal LLMs jointly process audio, video, and text, but long multimodal sequences incur substantial prefill and KV-cache costs. Existing omni-modal compression methods primarily focus on pre-LLM token reduction, leaving modality-specific compression across the LLM boundary underexplored. We propose A-PACK, a two-stage framework that defers audio pruning until query-conditioned multimodal interactions emerge. Our analysis shows that audio exhibits higher task-relevant information density and representational diversity per token than video. We further find that local audio-visual dynamics provide a more effective cue for visual selection than token-wise matching. We therefore preserve audio and compress video with local dynamics before the LLM, then progressively prune low-relevance audio and visual tokens and their KV-cache entries inside the LLM. Across four benchmarks on Qwen2.5-Omni-7B/3B, A-PACK achieves the strongest average performance among the evaluated prior methods while reducing prefill FLOPs by up to 78% and improving decoding throughput by up to 2.21x.

</details>


### [632] [MetaSpace: Metamorphic Testing for Spatial Cognition in Embodied Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07533)
*Gengyang Xu,Dongwei Xiao,Yiteng Peng,Shuai Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出MetaSpace框架，一种基于蜕变测试原理的具身智能体空间认知评估方法。通过将逻辑规则和物理定律编码为Prolog可执行规则，自动从真实执行轨迹中生成测试用例，检测智能体的空间认知缺陷。实验发现SOTA多模态大模型驱动的智能体平均空间认知得分仅0.44-0.52，远低于人类基准0.96，共检测出90,422个空间认知错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有具身智能体评估存在两大缺陷：(1)人工标注的VQA对成本高且标注质量不稳定；(2)高层面任务完成指标可能掩盖关键漏洞，允许智能体通过次优方式或违反安全规则完成任务，从而隐藏安全风险和低效问题。由于空间认知是执行具身任务的基石，亟需一种能评估智能体在任务执行过程中空间认知鲁棒性的新方法。

Method: 借鉴软件工程中的蜕变测试原理，提出MetaSpace框架。核心思路是：利用真实执行轨迹中的时空多模态状态，基于逻辑规则和物理定律预定义蜕变关系（MRs），将这些MRs编码为Prolog中的可执行规则，自动生成测试用例。如果智能体的行为违反了这些蜕变关系，则判定其存在空间认知失败。同时引入空间认知（SC）分数来量化评估性能。

Result: 在三个具身场景的实证评估中，MetaSpace成功检测出SOTA MLLM驱动智能体中的90,422个空间认知错误。所有SOTA智能体的平均SC得分仅为0.44至0.52，显著低于人类基准的0.96。

Conclusion: 当前最先进的具身智能体在空间认知方面仍存在显著短板，远未达到人类水平。MetaSpace提供了一种自动化的、无需人工标注的评估框架，能够有效暴露智能体在空间推理上的缺陷，为具身AI的安全性和可靠性评估提供了新的方法论。

Abstract: An embodied agent is an intelligent entity that interacts with its environment through a physical body. Currently, the evaluation of embodied agents primarily relies on two paradigms: (1) manually annotated Visual Question Answering (VQA) pairs and (2) high-level task completion metrics, such as success in navigation or manipulation. The former is labor-intensive and subject to variability in annotation quality. The latter may obscure critical vulnerabilities, allowing agents to complete tasks through suboptimal means or safety violations, thereby concealing safety risks and inefficiencies. Given that spatial cognition is the cornerstone for executing embodied tasks, there is a pressing need to assess whether embodied agents possess robust spatial cognition during task execution.
  Inspired by metamorphic testing principles in software engineering, we propose MetaSpace, a novel framework designed to evaluate the spatial cognition of agents. By leveraging spatiotemporal multimodal states derived from real execution trajectories, MetaSpace automatically generates test cases based on predefined metamorphic relations (MRs) grounded in logical rules and physical laws. Crucially, we encode these MRs as executable rules in a logic programming language (Prolog). Violations of these relations indicate failures in spatial cognition. Our empirical evaluation across three embodied scenarios demonstrates that MetaSpace successfully detects 90,422 spatial cognition errors in state-of-the-art (SOTA) MLLM-driven agents. We introduce the Spatial Cognition (SC) score to quantify performance. Results indicate that all SOTA agents achieve average scores between 0.44 and 0.52, significantly lower than the human benchmark of 0.96.

</details>


### [633] [When LLM Agents Negotiate: Private Information and Dynamic Bargaining in Supply Chains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07538)
*Chen Liang,Fasheng Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文在典型供应链讨价还价情境中,通过9,840次LLM对LLM谈判,对九个来自OpenAI、Google和Alibaba的LLM进行了均衡参照审计。研究发现能力决定价值创造(达成率98.9%,但谈判轮次延迟侵蚀21-34%剩余)、供应商身份比能力排名更能预测剩余分配(自博弈中OpenAI买家占40%、Google 50%、Qwen 70%)、提示词是战略性杠杆(委托人经济耐心与代理人的提示式策略耐心分离是最强分配驱动因素)。据此建立沿折扣效率、分配画像和运营可靠性三个维度的AI代理审计框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM代理从决策支持转向自主采购,企业需要知道被委托的谈判者能否创造价值、可预测地分配价值,并避免签订亏损合同。现有研究缺乏在均衡参照下对AI代理谈判能力的系统性审计。

Method: 在经典供应链讨价还价问题中——买方拥有私有需求信息,与不知情的卖方谈判数量-支付合同——将九个LLM(OpenAI、Google、Alibaba)与经过验证的完美贝叶斯均衡(PBE)对照,进行9,840次LLM对LLM谈判实验。

Result: 三组核心发现:(1)能力主导价值创造——98.9%达成协议、捕获95.4%无折扣的一阶最优剩余,但平均2.98轮对基准1.25轮,延迟侵蚀21-34%剩余;基线模型19.2%接受个体非理性合同,而中高端为0.0-0.6%。(2)剩余捕获具有关系性——供应商身份比能力排名更能预测剩余分配(OpenAI 40%、Google 50%、Qwen 70%),逆转买卖方身份改变分配7-18个百分点。(3)提示词是战略杠杆——委托人经济耐心与代理人的提示式策略耐心分离是最强分配驱动因素,解释90%的方差。

Conclusion: 研究建立了以均衡为参照的AI代理审计框架,涵盖折扣效率、分配画像和运营可靠性三个维度,并揭示供应商选择和提示词设计是一阶的分布性决策,自动化利润验证是低能力模型的关键护栏。

Abstract: As LLM agents move from decision support to autonomous procurement, firms need to know whether delegated negotiators create value, divide it predictably, and avoid money-losing contracts. We study this in a canonical supply chain bargaining problem: a buyer with private demand information negotiates a quantity-payment contract with an uninformed seller. We benchmark nine LLMs from OpenAI, Google, and Alibaba against a validated Perfect Bayesian Equilibrium across 9,840 LLM-to-LLM negotiations. First, capability governs value creation. Agents agree in 98.9% of negotiations and capture 95.4% of first-best surplus undiscounted, but average 2.98 rounds against the benchmark's 1.25, and this delay erodes 21-34% of surplus. Capability also governs reliability: baseline models accept individually irrational contracts in 19.2% of cases, versus 0.0-0.6% at mid-tier and flagship, making automated profit verification the binding guardrail below that threshold. Second, surplus capture is relational. Provider identity predicts who captures surplus better than capability rank: self-play buyer shares average 40% for OpenAI, 50% for Google, and 70% for Alibaba's Qwen, an ordering that survives restricted communication and no discounting. Reversing which provider sells moves the division by 7-18 percentage points, and the capable Qwen flagship is the weakest cross-family seller: vendor choice is a first-order distributional decision. Third, the prompt is a strategic lever. Delegation separates the principal's economic patience from the agent's prompted strategic patience, a free deployment choice that is the single strongest driver of surplus division (90% of explained variance). Together these establish an equilibrium-referenced audit of AI agents along three dimensions: discounted efficiency, distributional profile, and operational reliability.

</details>


### [634] [TREAT: Evaluating Access to Formal Knowledge across Equivalent Mathematical Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07540)
*Fateme Mazdarani,Carlos Toxtli*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍TREAT基准，用于评估大语言模型在等价保持的公式变换下能否识别已知定理身份。该基准包含737个定理身份和29,480个变换后的表达式，测试显示最佳模型仅有60.73%的准确率，表明LLM对定理知识的访问在等价表示变化下是脆弱的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI系统在灵活输入表示与下游工具使用的形式对象之间运作，关键挑战是识别不熟悉的公式化表述是否表示已知的形式对象。现有研究多关注文本层面的释义，而忽略了数学形式本身的变化，需要系统性评估模型在等价变换下恢复定理身份的能力。

Method: 作者构建TREAT基准：从网页抓取定理页面，筛选具有可用数学表达式的条目，提取标准定理条件，然后通过残差方程、见证语句、优化恒等式、集合关系、算子形式和证明中间特征等多种等价变换方式生成变体，并记录假设条件和逆映射用于可审计评分。

Result: TREAT包含737个定理身份和29,480个变换行。在测试集上，最佳模型仅达到60.73%的正确检索率，其他系统表现出弃权、错误检测和格式错误等不同失败模式。

Conclusion: 定理知识在等价表示变化下是脆弱的，TREAT为评估表示鲁棒的形式知识访问提供了一个受控测试平台，其方法论可推广到需要稳定目标对象、显式等价关系、验证程序和可审计评分的更广泛领域。

Abstract: AI systems increasingly operate between flexible input representations and formal objects used by downstream tools. A key challenge is recognizing when an unfamiliar formulation denotes a known formal object. We study this challenge through theorem recognition: given an equivalence-preserving transformation of a theorem condition, a model must recover the theorem identity associated with the standard statement. We introduce TREAT, a benchmark for evaluating whether large language models can recover known theorem identities from equivalence-preserving formula-level transformations. Rather than paraphrasing theorem text, TREAT changes the mathematical form of theorem conditions themselves, expressing known results through residual equations, witness statements, optimization identities, set relations, operator forms, and proof-intermediate characterizations. Starting from scraped theorem pages, we filter for entries with usable mathematical expression forms, extract canonical theorem conditions, and generate transformed variants with recorded assumptions and inverse mappings. The final corpus contains 737 theorem identities and 29,480 transformed rows. On a test panel, the best model retrieves the correct theorem identity in only 60.73% of cases. Other systems reveal different failure modes, including abstention, wrong detection, and malformed outputs. These suggest that theorem knowledge can be fragile under equivalent changes in representation. TREAT therefore provides a controlled testbed for evaluating representation-robust access to formal knowledge, with broader relevance to domains that require stable target objects, explicit equivalence relations, validation procedures, and auditable scoring.

</details>


### [635] [An AI Scientist that Doesn't Drift: Taste, Structure, and Falsifiable Findings in a Quadruped Navigation Research Loop](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07542)
*Yiwen Zhang,Eloise Zeng,Jaeha Lee,Tony Yue Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于研究四足机器人导航策略泛化能力的AI科学家系统，通过不变的实验卡片、专业子代理和kkanbu偏好预言机三个组件，解决自主研究循环中局部漂移的问题，使循环保持诚实并引导研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模语言模型驱动的自主研究循环虽然在规模上可以运行机器学习实验，但倾向于对优化指标进行局部改进，而不是测试驱动实验的假设。这种结构性缺陷导致研究偏离原始动机，需要结构性解决方案来保持研究方向与假设一致。

Method: 基于Karpathy的自研范式，增加三个组件：1) 不可变的实验卡片，以固定模式配对每次迭代的预测与结果，防止伪造已证伪的假设；2) 限制为机械角色的专业子代理；3) kkanbu，一个以类型化知识图谱保存用户研究品味的偏好预言机，是唯一允许进行主观判断的组件。

Result: 在11个研究流中分别运行有kkanbu和无kkanbu的相同循环。两个分支都没有漂移，各自证伪了约四分之三的自己的假设。最佳训练策略来自无预言机分支。预言机改变的是方向而非分数：它独自探索了测试时自适应，在领先的分支中创作了获胜设计，并跨研究流传递经验。

Conclusion: 框架（scaffold）保持循环的诚实性，kkanbu决定研究方向的探寻。预言机的作用是引导研究方向，而非提升最终得分，这种结构分离使得研究循环既能保持假设验证的严谨性，又能拥有主观的品味引导。

Abstract: Autonomous research loops driven by large language models can run machine-learning experiments at scale but tend to drift toward local refinements of whichever metric they optimise rather than testing the hypotheses that motivate the experiments. We address this structurally and present an AI Scientist for studying generalisation in quadruped robot navigation policies in simulation. Building on the autoresearch paradigm of Karpathy, our loop adds three components: an immutable experiment card that pairs each iteration's prediction with its outcome under a fixed schema, so a falsified hypothesis cannot be retconned; specialised subagents restricted to mechanical roles; and kkanbu, a preference oracle that holds the user's research taste as a typed knowledge graph and is the only component permitted to make subjective judgements. To isolate the oracle we run the identical loop twice across eleven research streams, with and without kkanbu. Neither arm drifts: both falsify roughly three quarters of their own hypotheses, and the best trained policy comes from the oracle-less arm. What the oracle changes is direction, not score: it alone explores test-time adaptation, it authored the winning designs where its arm led, and it carried lessons across streams that the other arm repeatedly re-derived. The scaffold keeps the loop honest; kkanbu decides where it looks.

</details>


### [636] [The Field Knows: Cross-Dimensional Geometry from Navigation to Black Holes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07566)
*Chenghao Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种连续度量场框架，通过单一因果对比损失进行训练，将场景编码为固定对称矩阵基的系数，组装成李代数元素并指数化为黎曼或洛伦兹度量。该框架在不同维度上发现了完整的几何结构谱系：从机器人导航中的避障测地线到黑洞事件视界。零样本泛化研究表明该场捕获了可迁移的几何结构而非记忆特定配置。在黑洞设定中，因果损失自发演化出具有正确洛伦兹符号的真实黑洞结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索是否可以用单一统一的因果对比学习框架，在不同维度、不同物理场景下自发涌现出正确的几何结构（如避障测地线和黑洞事件视界），从而证明几何与物理之间的内在联系。

Method: 将场景编码为固定对称矩阵基的系数，组装成李代数元素，通过矩阵指数化得到黎曼或洛伦兹度量。训练使用单一的因果对比损失函数，统一应用于机器人导航（平面和机械臂配置空间）以及黑洞时空等场景。

Result: 该框架在不同维度下发现完整的几何结构：平面和机械臂配置空间中生成避障测地线，洛伦兹时空中自发涌现具有正确符号的黑洞事件视界结构。零样本泛化实验证明模型捕获了可迁移的几何结构而非记忆特定配置。

Conclusion: 相同的损失、架构和训练协议在不同维度上产生了完整的几何现象谱系，表明度量场真正"理解"了几何的本质，而几何又蕴含了物理规律。

Abstract: We introduce a continuous metric field framework trained by a single causal contrastive loss. The framework encodes a scene into coefficients of a fixed symmetric matrix basis, assembles them into a Lie algebra element, and exponentiates the result to a Riemannian or Lorentzian metric. Across dimensions, this field discovers the full spectrum of geometric structures: from obstacle-avoiding geodesics in robot navigation across planar and manipulator configuration spaces, to event horizons of black holes in Lorentzian spacetime. Extensive zero-shot generalization studies demonstrate that the field captures transferable geometric structure rather than memorizing specific configurations. In the black hole setting, the causal loss spontaneously evolves genuine black-hole-like structures with the correct Lorentzian signature. The same loss, the same architecture, and the same training protocol produce the full range of geometric phenomena across dimensions. The field knows geometry, and geometry knows physics.

</details>


### [637] [DSLE: A Learning Environment for Dark Souls Boss Encounters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09902)
*Derin Gezgin,Jim O'Connor,Tanner Goodwin,Gary B. Parker*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Dark Souls学习环境（DSLE），一个基于容器化的游戏智能体基准平台，涵盖《黑暗之魂：重制版》全部22个Boss战，通过Gymnasium接口提供实时战斗、高维视觉输入和稀疏终端奖励。作者定义DSLE-5作为代表性子集，并评估了随机策略、专家系统、进化基线和PPO/DQN等五种方法。结果显示只有专家系统和进化基线能击败教程Boss，其余方法均无法学习，揭示了当前强化学习算法在真实高难度游戏中的局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有游戏智能体基准（如Atari）与真实世界游戏玩法之间存在巨大差距，缺乏能够反映实时战斗、视觉复杂性和稀疏奖励挑战的平台。作者希望提供一个更接近真实游戏难度的基准环境，以检验当前强化学习算法在极具挑战性的动作游戏上的实际表现。

Method: 构建一个Gymnasium风格的容器化游戏环境DSLE，包含全部22个Boss战；定义DSLE-5五Boss代表性子集（涵盖近战、空间受限、环境危害、多目标和快速最终Boss五种场景）；利用专用工具链从游戏画面提取状态，通过真实游戏动作执行每个环境步骤；评估包括随机策略、专家系统、进化算法、PPO和DQN在内的五种方法，并报告胜率、生存时间和造成伤害等多元指标。

Result: 专家系统（63%）和进化基线（43%）能击败教程Boss（Asylum Demon），但五种方法均无法击败其余四个DSLE-5 Boss；PPO和DQN几乎无学习效果（教程Boss最多0.33%胜率，其余0%）；扩展到全部22个Boss，进化基线在有利条件下仅能赢得少数早期Boss；失败模式包括拥挤多目标场景中10秒内死亡和长达一分钟几乎无伤害的僵持。

Conclusion: DSLE构成了一个远超当前强化学习算法能力的困难基准，揭示了现有方法在真实复杂游戏环境中的根本性局限。作者建议用生存时间和伤害输出等细粒度指标补充胜率指标来评估智能体进展，并呼吁社区开发更强健的算法来应对实时战斗游戏中的挑战。

Abstract: We introduce the Dark Souls Learning Environment (DSLE), a containerized platform that presents all 22 boss encounters of Dark Souls: Remastered as game-playing agent benchmarks through a Gymnasium-style interface. DSLE combines real-time combat, high-dimensional visual input, and sparse terminal rewards, with each environment step being a real action executed against the running game. To support controlled comparison, we define DSLE-5, a representative five-boss subset, spanning a melee fight, a spatially constrained arena, an environmental-hazard fight, a multi-target fight, and a fast final-boss fight, that we recommend as the starting suite for agents built on DSLE. On DSLE-5 we evaluate a random policy, an expert system, an evolutionary baseline, and PPO and DQN agents trained from visual input. The expert system and the evolutionary baseline each defeat the Asylum Demon, the game's tutorial boss (63% and 43% peak win rates), but none of the five methods defeats the other four DSLE-5 bosses; PPO and DQN show no measurable learning (at most 0.33% win rate on the tutorial boss, 0% elsewhere) within a budget that already costs tens of wall-clock hours per run. A broader study running the evolutionary baseline across all 22 encounters under advantaged all level-50 stats yields wins on only a handful of additional early-game bosses and leaves the rest unwon. The failure cases range from sub-10-second deaths in cramped, multi-target encounters to minute-long stalemates that inflict almost no damage, and we report them through survival time and damage dealt rather than win rate alone.

</details>


### [638] [TeXFix-Bench: An Empirically Grounded Multi-Format Benchmark for LLM-Based Document Source Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07617)
*Prajwal S. Venkateshmurthy*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 TeXFix-Bench，一个基于实证挖掘故障分类学的多格式（LaTeX/Typst/Markdown）文档修复基准。通过扎根理论从 168 个已验证的 LaTeX 崩溃故障中归纳出 18 类故障分类学，并实例化为包含 48 个 AST 感知操作符的 DocMut 变异工具。在 743 个开源文档上构建 10,437 个实例，评估 7 个 LLM，共 48,651 次尝试，成本约 200 美元。关键发现：DocMut 故障比模式化变异难修复 5.6-9.2 个百分点；编译成功率会高估修复质量（13.6-18.5% 的编译成功修复实质上改变了文档文本）；恢复排名与编译排名存在分歧。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文档修复评测使用缺乏经验故障模型的临时编辑来注入缺陷，无法真实反映实际文档损坏情况。需要一个基于真实故障模式的多格式文档修复基准来公正评估 LLM 的修复能力。

Method: 1) 扎根理论方法：对 TeX Stack Exchange、GitHub 提交和包文档中的局部硬崩溃 LaTeX 故障进行双人开放编码（κ=0.34），得到 18 类故障分类学；2) 将分类学实例化为 DocMut：48 个跨三种格式的 AST 感知变异算子；3) 构建 10,437 个修复实例；4) 在固定零样本协议下评估 7 个 LLM，共 48,651 次尝试；5) 引入恢复 oracle 评估编译成功修复是否实质上改变文档文本。

Result: DocMut 故障比模式化变异难修复 5.6-9.2 个百分点。真实错误案例研究实现 67.0% 修复成功率。7 模型 × 6,613 实例平衡矩阵确认排名。编译成功率范围 56.7-84.2%（27.5 点意图治疗差距）。Typst 比 LaTeX 和 Markdown 更难。13.6-18.5% 的编译成功修复实质改变文档文本。恢复排名与编译排名分歧——编译率最低的模型在其成功修复中文本恢复最好。

Conclusion: 编译成功本身会高估修复质量，应结合文本恢复指标评估。DocMut 生成更具挑战性的故障基准。作者开源了分类学、DocMut 和所有实验工件，为未来文档修复研究提供坚实基础。

Abstract: Scientific and technical writing depends on markup sources that must compile: LaTeX, Typst, and Markdown pipelines fail on missing delimiters, mismatched environments, broken imports, or package conflicts. Existing document-repair evaluations inject faults with ad-hoc edits that lack an empirical fault model. We present TeXFix-Bench, a multi-format benchmark for LLM-based full-source document repair grounded in a mined fault taxonomy. A Grounded-Theory study of localized hard-crash LaTeX faults from TeX Stack Exchange, GitHub commits, and package documentation (168 verified faults, dual open coding at $κ$=0.34) yields an 18-category taxonomy instantiated as DocMut: 48 AST-aware operators across three formats. A three-model cross-benchmark shows DocMut faults are 5.6-9.2 pp harder to repair than pattern-based mutations on the same seeds, and a real-error case study (88 mined human crashes, 67.0% repair success) brackets both synthetic sets from below. We construct 10,437 instances from 743 openly licensed seeds and evaluate seven LLMs under a fixed zero-shot protocol with provider-pinned routing, collecting 48,651 attempts at about USD 200 total inference cost. A complete 6,613-instance x 7-model balanced matrix confirms all rankings. A pinned engine gate yields a 27.5-point intention-to-treat compile spread (56.7-84.2%). Typst is markedly harder than LaTeX and Markdown. A restoration oracle over 28,129 compiling repairs shows that 13.6-18.5% of compiling repairs materially alter document text, and restoration rank diverges from compile rank: the model with the lowest compile rate restores content best among its successes. Compile success alone overstates repair quality. We release the taxonomy, DocMut, and all campaign artifacts.

</details>


### [639] [CMU-Drive and V2V-VLA: Cooperative Multi-agent Unified Driving with Reasoning Benchmark and Vehicle-to-Vehicle Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07621)
*Hsu-kuang Chiu,Stephen F. Smith*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CMU-Drive，一个面向多智能体协同自动驾驶的闭环端到端基准测试平台，并进一步提出V2V-VLA协同VLA模型，通过单次前向传播同时生成驾驶动作、未来路径点、语言推理和通信策略，为协同VLA自动驾驶研究奠定基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型主要用于单一自动驾驶智能体，缺乏对多车协同感知、推理与规划的支持，亟需一个面向联网自动驾驶车辆（CAVs）的协同驾驶基准与模型。

Method: 1) 构建CMU-Drive闭环端到端基准测试平台，包含多辆联网自动驾驶车辆在安全关键场景中与背景交通参与者协同驾驶；2) 提出V2V-VLA协同VLA模型，在单次前向传播中联合生成驾驶动作、未来路径点、语言推理及通信策略。

Result: 在CMU-Drive上建立了首个协同VLA驾驶基准与基线，验证了所提方法在协同驾驶场景中的有效性，为后续多智能体闭环端到端协同自动驾驶研究提供基础。

Conclusion: 该工作填补了协同VLA自动驾驶领域的空白，通过开源代码、基准和模型权重促进开放式研究，推动多智能体协同自动驾驶的发展。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently achieved impressive performance for end-to-end autonomous driving, yet existing approaches are primarily designed for an individual single autonomous driving agent with limited support for cooperative perception, reasoning, and planning.
