TL;DR: 本文介绍了Workbook Time Machine，一个自动创建基准测试的流水线，用于评估语言模型在电子表格中创建派生对象（公式、图表、数据透视表和条件格式）的能力。它构建了WTM Corpus数据集和包含150个任务的WTM Bench基准，评估了现有电子表格操作代理在不同工件类型、步骤复杂度和指令粒度上的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有电子表格操作代理的能力评估缺乏系统化的基准测试，特别是针对创建派生对象（如公式、图表、数据透视表等）这一复杂任务场景。需要自动化的方法来构建可扩展的基准，以评估LLM在真实电子表格环境中的表现。

Method: 提出Workbook Time Machine流水线，从公开的工作簿语料库中自动创建基准：生成（输入工作簿、输出工作簿、查询）三元组，涵盖四种工件类型和不同的复杂度水平。从中筛选出WTM Bench，包含150个任务，查询分为三个具体性级别（指令粒度）。

Result: 评估了现有电子表格操作代理和基线模型在WTM Bench上的表现，发现查询的具体程度、代理的编排方式以及控制电子表格的接口API对LLM在Excel任务中的性能有重大影响。

Conclusion: 电子表格派生对象创建任务对LLM仍具挑战性，指令颗粒度、代理架构和工具接口设计是影响性能的关键因素，为未来电子表格智能代理的研究提供了基准和洞察。

Abstract: We introduce the workbook time machine, a pipeline that automatically creates benchmarks evaluating the ability of language models to create derived objects in spreadsheets (formulas, charts, pivot tables, and conditional formatting). Applied to public workbook corpora, it produces wtmcorpus--a collection of (input workbook, output workbook, query) triples spanning four artifact types and varying complexity. From this corpus we curate wtmbench, a 150-task evaluation benchmark with queries at three levels of specificity. We evaluate existing spreadsheet manipulation agents and baselines on wtmbench across artifact types, step complexity, and instruction granularity. Our evaluations show that query specificity, agent orchestration, and interface API used to control spreadsheets play a big role in LLM performance on Excel tasks.

</details>


### [672] [SurgLAT: Surgical Latent Attention Tracking for Depth-Aware Robotic Laparoscope Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07876)
*Rulin Zhou,Qiujie Song,Yujie Ma,An Wang,Wanhao Liu,Guoheng Ma,Yidu Wang,Guankun Wang,Xingrong Diao,Jiankun Wang,Chaowei Zhu,Xianming Liu,Hongliang Ren*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SurgLAT，一个用于自主腹腔镜相机控制的因果在线框架，通过潜在外科注意力建模范式，结合DINOv3编码器、状态条件空间token混合器、选择性因果潜在记忆模块以及RCM约束的机器人控制，在真实手术视频和物理机器人平台上验证了遮挡、快速运动和靶区切换场景下的鲁棒追踪与稳定控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主腹腔镜相机控制的核心挑战在于手术操作意图是动态变化、非稳定的潜在注意力状态，而非固定的物理目标。现有方法难以连续建模这种随时间演化的手术意图，导致在复杂动态手术场景中无法可靠地追踪操作区域。

Method: SurgLAT采用三层设计：(1)感知层使用冻结的DINOv3编码器配合状态条件空间token混合器，在记忆引导的空间先验下提取手术证据；(2)记忆层通过选择性因果潜在记忆模块联合建模短期运动连续性和长期手术意图演化，动态检索当前、近期和历史潜在状态；(3)控制层引入基于虚拟轴公式的显式RCM约束控制和冗余感知零空间初始化，实现稳定平滑的机械臂运动。

Result: 在真实腹腔镜手术视频和物理机器人平台上验证，系统在遮挡、快速运动和靶区切换场景下实现了鲁棒的在线手术区域追踪和稳定的自主内窥镜调整，证明了潜在手术意图建模对手术自主性的有效性。

Conclusion: 潜在手术意图建模是超越纯视觉目标追踪范式的有效方向，SurgLAT证明了将手术注意视为随时间演化的潜在状态并结合因果记忆建模，能够显著提升自主腹腔镜控制的鲁棒性和稳定性。

Abstract: Autonomous laparoscopic camera control requires continuous understanding of the surgeon's operative intent in dynamic surgical scenes, where the target operative region is not a stable physical object but a latent and temporally evolving attention state. In this work, we present Surgical Latent Attention Tracking (SurgLAT), a causal online framework for latent surgical attention modeling and autonomous laparoscopic view control. SurgLAT uses a frozen DINOv3 encoder and a state-conditioned spatial token mixer to extract operative evidence under a memory-guided spatial prior, while a selective causal latent memory module jointly models short-term motion continuity and long-horizon surgical intent evolution through dynamic retrieval of current, recent, and historical latent states. The learned latent surgical attention state is decoded into a probabilistic attention heatmap and operative region for downstream endoscope guidance. Beyond perception, we further introduce a robotic deployment framework with explicit laparoscopic Remote Center of Motion (RCM) constrained control based on virtual-axis formulation, together with redundancy-aware null-space initialization for stable and smooth manipulator motion. We validate the full system on real laparoscopic surgical videos and a physical robotic laparoscope platform. Experimental results demonstrate robust online operative-region tracking and stable autonomous endoscopy adjustment under occlusion, rapid motion, and target transitions, highlighting the effectiveness of latent surgical intent modeling for surgical autonomy.

</details>


### [673] [GRACE: LLM-Grounded Semantic Metric Spaces for Scalable Mixed-Data Clustering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07881)
*Zihua Yang,Zhencheng Xie,Junyang Chen,Liang Xie,Yiqun Zhang,Mengke Li,Yang Lu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GRACE是一个基于LLM的混合表格数据聚类框架，通过一次性将属性值映射为知识启发的语义描述，解耦昂贵的LLM调用与迭代优化，在保持传统统计方法可扩展性的同时提升聚类准确性和概念可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统混合表格数据聚类仅依赖数据集内部的统计信息来估计类别关系，局限于经验共现而忽略了概念上明显但统计上未观察到的相似性。虽然LLM能提供外部世界知识，但其文本中心的推理与高度抽象的表格概念之间存在模态鸿沟，而将LLM嵌入迭代度量学习循环会导致难以承受的计算开销。

Method: GRACE采用多视角LLM查询策略在属性-值层面获取语义，将异构值映射为知识启发的描述，实现一次性(one-shot)知识嵌入，将不同属性映射到统一语义空间。同时通过交叉验证外部语义与数据集内部统计证据，确保与数据集特定的聚类结构对齐。

Result: GRACE在11个对比方法中取得了优越的聚类准确性和概念可解释性，同时匹配了传统统计驱动基线的可扩展性。

Conclusion: GRACE成功在语义丰富性和可扩展性之间实现了平衡，证明了通过将LLM调用从迭代优化中解耦，可以在不牺牲性能的前提下为混合数据聚类注入外部世界知识。

Abstract: Clustering mixed tabular data requires a unified metric space to bridge the inherent heterogeneity between continuous numerical measurements and discrete categorical symbols. Traditionally, algorithms rely entirely on dataset-internal statistics to estimate categorical relationships, which confines the learned metric to empirical co-occurrences and ignores conceptually obvious yet statistically unobserved affinities. Although LLMs offer external world knowledge, applying their text-centric reasoning to highly abstract tabular concepts presents significant challenges. Bridging this modality gap to construct a semantically complete metric typically requires embedding LLMs into iterative metric learning loops to dynamically optimize cross-modality representations. This incurs intractable computational overhead, forcing a compromise between semantic enrichment and scalability. Therefore, we propose GRACE, an LLM-grounded framework for scalable mixed-data clustering. GRACE shifts semantic acquisition to the attribute-value level via a multi-perspective LLM querying strategy, mapping heterogeneous values into knowledge-informed descriptions. Crucially, this one-shot grounding extracts general-purpose semantic representations that embed heterogeneous attributes into a unified space, decoupling expensive LLM invocation from iterative optimization. Furthermore, GRACE cross-validates these external semantics against dataset-internal statistical evidence to ensure alignment with the dataset-specific cluster structure. Ultimately, GRACE matches the scalability of conventional statistics-driven baselines while achieving superior clustering accuracy and conceptual interpretability over 11 competing methods. The source code is available at https://github.com/develop-yang/GRACE-GRACE-A

</details>


### [674] [Reason Wide, Not Deep: Amortizing the Reasoning Premium into Distilled Skills](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07885)
*Agamdeep Singh,Srishti Gautam,Priyanshu Gupta,Nikita Mehrotra,Tanmay Bakshi,Sumit Gulwani*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种通过从已有轨迹中蒸馏自然语言技能并注入系统提示（system prompt）的方法，将推理型语言模型在智能体任务中的能力优势迁移到非推理型模型上。在四个基准测试中，该方法恢复了55%-100%+的推理差距，同时减少了2.7-6倍输出token，表明跨episode的"宽搜索"（语料蒸馏）相比每episode重复的"深搜索"（测试时推理）更具性价比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理型语言模型在多步智能体任务上表现优于非推理型模型，但每轮episode需支付3-6倍的输出token代价，且大量token浪费在重复推导同一领域内各episode共享的流程上。这种重复开销是可以被摊薄的。

Method: 编码智能体从小规模训练集轨迹语料中分析并编译出紧凑的自然语言技能描述，将其注入非推理模型的系统提示中。技能可从推理/非推理配对轨迹蒸馏，也可仅从非推理轨迹蒸馏。

Result: 在ALFWorld、tau²-bench telecom和retail、SpreadsheetBench-Verified四个基准上，技能恢复了GPT-5.4-mini的55%-100%+推理差距，其中两个基准超过推理模式；输出token减少2.7-6倍且零推理token。仅从非推理轨迹蒸馏的技能与从配对语料蒸馏的技能竞争力相当。

Conclusion: 从"搜索视角"看，测试时推理是单episode内的深度搜索，每次部署都要重新付费；语料蒸馏是跨episode的宽搜索，只需付费一次。两者恢复的重叠性程序知识大致相同，而基于廉价轨迹的宽度搜索往往是更优选择；但部分领域（telecom、SpreadsheetBench）仍存在残余差距，说明这些领域确实需要逐实例的深度搜索。

Abstract: Reasoning modes of language models outperform their non-reasoning counterparts on multi-step agentic tasks, but pay a 3-6x premium in output tokens on every episode -- much of it spent re-deriving procedures that are shared across episodes of the same domain. We show this recurring cost can be amortized: a coding agent analyses a small corpus of existing trajectories from a training split and compiles a compact natural-language skill that is injected into the non-reasoning model's system prompt. Across four agentic benchmarks (ALFWorld, tau$^2$-bench telecom and retail, and SpreadsheetBench-Verified), skills recover 55%-100%+ of the reasoning gap for GPT-5.4-mini on held-out tasks -- exceeding the reasoning mode outright on two of four -- while emitting 2.7-6x fewer output tokens and zero reasoning tokens. Notably, reasoning traces are not a prerequisite: skills distilled from non-reasoning trajectories alone remain competitive with skills distilled from paired reasoning/non-reasoning corpora, with domain-dependent differences between the two sources. We interpret these results through a search lens: test-time reasoning is deep search inside a single episode, re-paid at every deployment, while corpus distillation is wide search across episodes, paid once. The two recover overlapping procedural knowledge, and width over cheap trajectories is often the better buy -- with the residual gap on some domains (telecom, SpreadsheetBench) delineating where genuinely per-instance deep search remains necessary.

</details>


### [675] [TelemetrySuffBench: Is Agent Telemetry Sufficient for Failure-Origin Diagnosis?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07899)
*Yuxuan Zhu,Peng Pu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出TelemetrySuffBench基准测试，用于分离故障检测、故障来源定位和安全弃权三个任务。通过构造多组件执行轨迹、延迟绑定故障、七因素遥测掩码及歧义来源对，评估五个前沿语言模型。发现模型能高精度检测故障（F1最高100%），但来源定位准确率极低（Top-1最高仅0.5%），存在明显的"检测-定位鸿沟"；决策内容移除使定位准确率降至零；安全弃权能力存在强模型依赖性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的Agent系统遥测数据虽能揭示故障发生，但往往不足已定位故障的来源。需要一个受控基准将故障检测、来源定位和安全弃权三个能力分离评估，以揭示模型在这些任务上的真实差距。此外，现有方法缺乏统一的评估协议和严格的无效输出处理。

Method: 构建TelemetrySuffBench基准：1）生成规范化的多组件执行轨迹，包含延迟绑定故障；2）将轨迹呈现为配对粗视图、七因素遥测掩码和精确等价的歧义来源对；3）采用统一评估协议、显式候选集、无效输出核算、子组分析和冻结盲测试集；4）评估五个前沿语言模型在检测、定位和弃权三个任务上的表现，并进行因素消融实验。

Result: 1）完整遥测下，来源定位Top-1准确率各模型在33.8%到97.2%之间波动；2）元数据、OpenTelemetry兼容和OpenInference兼容视图保持99.5%-100%的检测F1，但来源定位准确率最高仅0.5%，暴露稳健的检测-定位鸿沟；3）移除决策内容使所有模型来源定位准确率降至零，移除溯源信息也导致模型依赖的大幅损失；4）证据门控使三个模型的非支持唯一来源回答减少12.5-48.6个百分点，但两个模型仍回答所有案例；5）冻结保留集复现了核心模式。

Conclusion: 终点状态支持故障检测，但可靠的因果归因需要显式的决策到溯源链接和跨模型有效的弃权保障。当前前沿语言模型在来源定位和安全弃权方面仍然不足，存在显著的模型差异。

Abstract: Agent systems increasingly expose execution traces, yet telemetry that reveals a failure may still be inadequate for identifying where that failure originated. We introduce TelemetrySuffBench, a controlled benchmark that separates failure detection, fault-origin localization, and safe abstention under insufficient evidence. The benchmark constructs canonical multi-component traces with delayed-binding faults and renders them as paired coarse views, seven-factor telemetry masks, and exact-equal ambiguous origin pairs. We evaluate five frontier language models using unified protocols, explicit candidate sets, invalid-output accounting, subgroup analyses, and a frozen blind holdout. With full telemetry, origin-step Top-1 accuracy ranges from 33.8% to 97.2% across models. Metadata, OpenTelemetry-compatible, and OpenInference-compatible views retain 99.5% to 100% detection F1 while limiting origin-step accuracy to at most 0.5%, exposing a robust detection-localization gap. Factor ablations further show that removing decision content reduces origin-step accuracy to zero for every model, while provenance removal also causes large model-dependent losses. On rich ambiguous inputs that require abstention, evidence gating reduces unsupported unique-origin answers by 12.5 to 48.6 percentage points for three models, whereas two models still answer every case, revealing strong model dependence in safe abstention. Results on the frozen holdout reproduce the central pattern within the same generator family. These findings show that terminal status can support detection, whereas reliable causal attribution requires explicit decision-to-provenance links and abstention safeguards that remain effective across models. The dataset and benchmark implementation are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TelemetrySuffBench-E635/README.md.

</details>


### [676] [GraphThink: Graph-Enhanced LLM Thinking for Long-Horizon Embodied Task Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07905)
*Chen Li,Sijie Cheng,Yuelin Zhang,Junxi Li,Maozhi Huang,Yang Liu,Wenbing Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了GraphThink框架，通过任务图提供结构化知识指导LLM规划，并通过场景图维护环境记忆实现事件驱动的重规划，在ALFRED基准上达到最先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于LLM的具身智能体规划器存在三大问题：物理幻觉（生成不合理的动作）、对长时程任务泛化差、缺乏环境感知能力。

Method: 1) 任务图通过上下文提示和迭代细化引导LLM思维，缓解规划幻觉；2) 在GRPO框架下利用任务图设计精细奖励来训练LLM规划器，增强长时程规划能力和泛化性；3) 基于场景图的事件驱动重规划模块实现闭环环境感知和错误纠正。

Result: 在ALFRED基准上达到最先进性能，高层规划器在验证集和留出的长时程任务上均超越领先的API-based LLM，展示强大的零样本和少样本能力，并在新任务和新环境上展现了强大的分布外泛化能力。

Conclusion: GraphThink通过任务图和场景图的双图结构，系统地解决了LLM规划器在具身智能中的幻觉、泛化和环境感知问题，验证了结构化知识对提升LLM规划能力的有效性。

Abstract: Embodied agents using LLM-based planners often struggle with physical hallucinations, poor generalization to long-horizon tasks, and lack of environmental awareness. We propose GraphThink, a novel framework that integrates a task graph to provide structured knowledge for robust planning and a scene graph to maintain environmental memory for event-driven replanning. Specifically, the task graph guides LLM thinking through contextual prompting and iterative refinement, effectively mitigating planning hallucinations. Furthermore, within the GRPO framework, the task graph offers delicate reward design to train the LLM planner, enhancing long-horizon planning capabilities and improving generalization. Finally, an event-driven replanning module, powered by the scene graph, enables closed-loop environment awareness and error correction. GraphThink achieves state-of-the-art performance on the ALFRED benchmark. In particular, our high-level planner surpasses leading API-based LLMs on both the validation set and held-out long-horizon tasks, underscoring its robust zero-shot and few-shot capabilities. Additional evaluations further demonstrate strong out-of-distribution generalization to novel tasks and environments.

</details>


### [677] [When Is Benchmark Contamination Detectable? Information Limits and Power-Calibrated Audits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07914)
*Ibne Farabi Shihab,Sanjeda Akter,Anuj Sharma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文形式化区分了行为污染检测器返回"无证据"的两种原因：基准测试真正干净或审计能力不足。通过匹配的干净与已见对照组，可检测性由alpha*rho*sqrt(m)控制，其中rho衡量行为可分离性。任何标量检测器都归结为其效能ef，可在审计前从对照组估计。经验发现是双面的：冻结校准效能能预测保留功效曲线（R²=0.83-0.98），但效能仅基于高斯的预算在小样本下校准不良，9/9门控通过通道失败。预先声明的两阶段规划器通过模拟部署测试修复预算，且一致保守。证书在审计规模下有效但空洞。五种子配对注入研究恢复了机制排序：逐字>改写>表面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 行为污染检测器返回"无证据"存在歧义：可能是基准测试干净，也可能是审计功效不足。这种混淆导致研究者无法正确解读阴性结果。本文旨在形式化这个区别，建立可检测性的理论框架，并提供一个可解释的审计合同（效能、预算和有效性门控），使非拒绝结果能够得到正确解读。

Method: 作者将污染检测形式化为稀疏混合模型Q_alpha=(1-alpha)P_0+alpha*P_1，利用二阶矩论证推导检测性与alpha*rho*sqrt(m)的关系。定义检测器效能ef，通过匹配的干净与已见对照组预先估计。提出样本分割证书对alpha进行无分布下界估计。然后进行经验验证：评估冻结校准效能的传输性，发现效能可预测疗效（R²=0.83-0.98），但功效预算在高斯假设下校准不良。提出预先声明的两阶段规划器通过模拟部署测试修复预算问题。

Result: 经验发现具有双面性：1) 冻结校准效能可预测保留功效曲线，在六个精确置换通道上R²=0.83-0.98；2) 但效能仅高斯的预算在推荐的小样本规模下错误校准，9/9门控通过通道失败——失败在于反演而非校准；3) 两阶段规划器修复预算问题且一致保守；4) 证书有效但空洞；5) 机制排序为逐字>改写>表面，答案仅信号由基线漂移解释。

Conclusion: 审计合同应同时报告效能、预算和有效性门控，非拒绝结果只能在这些上下文下才能被正确解读。推荐使用预先声明的两阶段规划器（模拟部署测试）来替代简约的高斯预算；效能本身可传输，但其反演存在问题，需要通过模拟修复。

Abstract: Behavioral contamination detectors can return "no evidence" either because a benchmark is clean or because the audit has little power. We formalize this distinction for a benchmark in which an unknown fraction alpha of items was seen during training. With matched clean and seen controls, the behavioral channel is the sparse mixture Q_alpha = (1 - alpha) P_0 + alpha P_1, and an exact second-moment argument shows that detectability is governed by alpha * rho * sqrt(m), where rho^2 = chi^2(P_1 || P_0) measures behavioral separability. Any scalar detector reduces to its efficacy, ef = |E_1 f - E_0 f| / sqrt(Var_0(f)) <= rho, which can be estimated from controls before the audit is run. A separate sample-split certificate lower-bounds alpha distribution-free, without requiring an orientation assumption. Our empirical finding is two-sided. Frozen calibration efficacy predicts held-out power curves, with R^2 = 0.83-0.98 across six exact-permutation channels, but the efficacy-only Gaussian budget is miscalibrated at the small sample sizes it prescribes, failing in 9/9 gate-passing channels even though efficacy itself transports. The failure is in the inversion, not the calibration. A predeclared two-stage planner that simulates the deployed test repairs the budgets, is uniformly conservative, and abstains when its probe does not transport. The certificate is valid but vacuous at audit scale, and a five-seed paired injection study recovers the mechanism ordering verbatim > paraphrase > surface, in which the apparent answer-only signal is explained by baseline drift. We report the audit contract and its failures together: a non-rejection is interpretable only alongside the efficacy, budget, and validity gates that produced it.

</details>


### [678] [TongGuOCR: A Layout-Aware and Token-Augmented OCR Framework for Chinese Historical Documents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07917)
*Zhongheng Zhou,Yi Sun,Huiguo He,Yuyi Zhang,Peirong Zhang,Yulin Fang,Dezhi Peng,Minghui Liao,Lianwen Jin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出TongGuOCR，一种面向中文历史文档的布局感知与令牌增强OCR框架。通过布局感知预处理模块构建局部一致识别块，以及令牌增强识别模块（字符级词汇扩展+行间转换建模）提升识别精度，在M5HisDoc基准上达到93.76 AR，显著优于传统OCR模型和各类多模态大语言模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大量中文历史文献仅以扫描图像形式存在，难以进行全文检索、校勘和计算分析。历史文档中复杂的版面布局、罕见字符及非平凡的阅读顺序使得传统OCR准确转录面临巨大挑战。

Method: TongGuOCR包含两个核心模块：1) 布局感知预处理模块：构建并精炼局部一致的识别块，保留局部上下文同时减少跨区域干扰；2) 令牌增强识别模块：在字符层面进行词汇扩充，让罕见字形获得直接的one-token表示并缩短解码路径；在行层面建模行间转换，注入离散空间位移令牌引导解码器沿复杂阅读路径行进，无需精确坐标。

Result: 在两个中文历史文档OCR基准上，TongGuOCR优于传统任务特定OCR模型、通用多模态大语言模型和OCR定向MLLM。在更具挑战性的M5HisDoc基准上，AR达93.76，NED从10.43降至6.15，RO-ED从7.53降至3.49。

Conclusion: TongGuOCR通过布局感知预处理和双层级令牌增强机制，有效解决了中文历史文档中复杂版面、罕见字符和复杂阅读顺序带来的OCR难题，展示了优于现有各类基线模型的性能。

Abstract: Chinese historical documents preserve valuable cultural heritage, but many collections remain accessible only as scanned page images, preventing full-text retrieval, collation, and computational analysis. Optical character recognition (OCR) can bridge this gap, but accurate transcription remains challenging because historical documents often contain complex layouts, rare characters, and nontrivial reading orders. We propose TongGuOCR, a layout-aware and token-augmented OCR framework for Chinese historical documents. First, a Layout-Aware Preprocessing module constructs and refines locally coherent recognition blocks to preserve local context while reducing interference across regions. Second, a Token-Augmented Recognition module augments the transcription target at two complementary levels: character-level vocabulary expansion gives each rare glyph a direct one-token representation and shortens its decoding path, while line-to-line transition modeling injects discrete spatial displacement tokens that guide the decoder along complex reading paths without requiring precise coordinates. Experiments on two Chinese historical document OCR benchmarks show that TongGuOCR outperforms representative traditional task-specific OCR models, general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs), and OCR-oriented MLLMs. On the more challenging M5HisDoc benchmark, TongGuOCR achieves 93.76 AR and reduces NED from 10.43 to 6.15 and RO-ED from 7.53 to 3.49 relative to the best competing score for each metric. An online demo is available at https://jzzh2004.github.io/TongGuOCR.

</details>


### [679] [ZhuLong: Execution-Grounded LLM Agent for EDA Scripting with Offline API Self-Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07925)
*Yang Liu,Shiwei Hou,Xiyuan Chen,Yu Wang,Sen Yuan,Qirui Gan,Shao You,Feifan Chen,Wencheng Li,Shuyang Hu,Yongzhou Liu,Emma Xia,Xiaojing Lu,Hao Wang,Fan Xu,Yanfeng Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ZhuLong是一个面向EDA脚本编程（PyAether和SKILL）的执行落地式LLM编码代理，通过结合API检索、文档检查和沙盒执行（统合为MCP工具），并辅以离线API自探索机制来推断未文档化API行为。在158个真实任务的EDA-Eval-PyAether基准上达到78.5% Pass@1，远超纯LLM基线（23.6%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EDA脚本编写依赖特定工具且往往缺乏文档的API，这是现有LLM无法解决的长尾瓶颈问题。常用的EDA API通常没有文档或文档不完善，导致LLM生成的代码经常出错。

Method: 1) 统一MCP工具集：将API检索、文档检查和沙盒执行整合为统一的MCP工具；2) 离线API自探索机制：通过反事实实验推断未文档化API的行为；3) 执行落地（execution-grounded）：基于实际执行结果来指导代码生成。

Result: 在EDA-Eval-PyAether基准（158个真实任务）上，完整系统在商业Empyrean Aether环境中达到78.5% Pass@1，显著优于纯LLM基线（23.6%）。消融实验显示沙盒执行是最主要性能驱动因素（移除后下降41.2个百分点），自探索机制额外贡献3.2个百分点准确率提升并减少22.1%工具调用。在20个交互式任务中，PyAether达到60.0% Pass@1，SKILL达到50.0%。

Conclusion: ZhuLong证明了执行落地与API自探索相结合能有效解决EDA领域LLM编码的长尾瓶颈问题，沙盒执行是关键因素，自探索机制在提升准确率的同时显著减少了工具调用开销。

Abstract: EDA scripting with tool-specific, often undocumented APIs remains a long-tail bottleneck that existing LLMs fail to address. This paper presents ZhuLong, an execution-grounded LLM coding agent for PyAether and SKILL that combines API retrieval, documentation inspection, and sandbox execution via unified MCP tools, augmented by an offline API self-exploration mechanism that infers undocumented API behaviors through counterfactual experimentation.
  We evaluate ZhuLong on EDA-Eval-PyAether, a benchmark of 158 real-world tasks with assertion-based execution, where the complete system achieves 78.5% Pass@1 in the commercial Empyrean Aether environment, substantially outperforming a pure LLM baseline (23.6%). Ablation studies identify sandbox execution as the dominant performance driver (41.2 pp drop when removed), with the self-exploration mechanism contributing an additional 3.2 pp accuracy gain and a 22.1% reduction in per-task tool calls. On 20 interactive tasks involving unsaved layouts and schematics, ZhuLong achieves 60.0% Pass@1 for PyAether and 50.0% for SKILL.

</details>


### [680] [REIN: Bridging the Gap between Reasoning and Reliability via Reflection and Abstention Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07931)
*Zhengze Huang,Luyang Yu,Di Hong,Xinzhe Huang,Wanyu Lin,Zhixuan Chu,Zhan Qin,Tianhang Zheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: REIN是一个针对大型推理模型（LRM）幻觉问题的对齐框架，通过训练模型生成结构化的推理序列（思考→反思→回答）来应对推理幻觉，并通过奖励机制鼓励模型在无法正确回答时明确弃权（如说"我不知道"）来应对知识幻觉。实验表明REIN在数学和常识推理基准上将幻觉代理指标降低58-72%，同时保持86-91%的覆盖率，并在尝试回答的问题上将选择性准确率提升6.6-14.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型推理模型容易产生幻觉，降低了其可靠性和安全部署的可能性。作者将LRM的幻觉分为两类不同的失败来源：推理幻觉（错误的推理步骤传播导致错误结论）和知识幻觉（模型缺乏回答所需的事实知识）。现有方法需要过程监督、推理时控制器、外部搜索或多轮批评等昂贵手段，因此迫切需要一种在单次前向传播内就能解决两类幻觉的轻量级对齐框架。

Method: REIN包含两个核心机制：(1) 针对推理幻觉，通过对齐训练让LRM生成结构化的推理序列：<think>→<reflection>→<answer>，在给出最终答案前进行显式自我反思；(2) 针对知识幻觉，引入奖励机制鼓励模型在采样到的所有推理链都无法得到正确答案时明确弃权（例如说"我不知道"），使模型避免做出无依据的预测。该方法在单次前向传播中完成，无需过程监督、推理时控制器、外部搜索或多轮批评。

Result: 在数学和常识推理基准上的大量评估表明，REIN持续改善了选择性准确率，减少了错误但自我认可的响应，并相比竞争性基线保持了高覆盖率。在多个骨干模型上的实验显示，REIN相对于基础模型将幻觉代理指标降低了58-72%，同时保持了86-91%的平均覆盖率，并将尝试问题的选择性准确率提升了6.6-14.2%。

Conclusion: REIN有效且高效地缓解了LRM的两类幻觉问题，在单次前向传播内即实现了显著的幻觉降低和选择性准确率提升，无需额外计算开销或外部资源，是一种实用且可扩展的LRM对齐方案。

Abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) are prone to hallucination, which undermines their reliability and poses challenges for safe deployment. Hallucinations in LRMs arise from two distinct failure sources: reasoning hallucination, where flawed inference steps propagate to an incorrect conclusion, and knowledge hallucination, where the model lacks the requisite factual knowledge to answer the query. To address reasoning hallucination, we propose REIN, an alignment framework that trains LRMs to produce a structured reasoning sequence, $\texttt{<think>} $$\rightarrow$ $\texttt{<reflection>} $$\rightarrow$ $\texttt{<answer>}$, enabling explicit self-reflection before committing to a final answer. To address knowledge hallucination, REIN introduces a reward mechanism that encourages explicit abstention (e.g., "I don't know") when none of the sampled reasoning chains yields a correct answer, allowing the model to refrain from unsupported predictions. Extensive evaluations on mathematical and commonsense reasoning benchmarks show that REIN consistently improves selective accuracy, reduces incorrect-but-self-endorsed responses, and maintains high coverage compared with competitive baselines. Notably, REIN achieves these gains within a single forward pass, without requiring process supervision, inference-time controllers, external search, or multi-round critiques. Experiments on multiple backbones show that REIN reduces the hallucination proxy by $58\sim72\%$ relative to the base models while maintaining $86\sim91\%$ average coverage, and improves selective accuracy on attempted questions by $6.6\sim14.2\%$.

</details>


### [681] [Locating Failure in Multi-Page Visually Rich Document Understanding: An Empirical Attribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07943)
*Lewei Xu,Yihao Ding,Zihan Xu,Daniel Yitian Su,Daochang Liu,Siwen Luo,Yifan Peng,Wei Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统性地研究了多页视觉丰富文档理解（MP-VRDU）系统中的三大失败模式——表示（representation）、选择（selection）和推理（reasoning），通过在多页文档理解数据集上进行隔离干预实验，揭示了各组件的作用与局限，并为固定计算预算下的系统构建提供了指导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多页视觉丰富文档理解任务中证据稀疏、跨页分布且常超出模型上下文窗口，而先前工作对系统构建方式存在相互矛盾且未经充分测试的论断。作者希望通过隔离各失败模式来厘清哪些因素真正决定系统性能。

Method: 作者将错误答案归因于三个失败模式（表示、选择、推理），在多页文档理解数据集上通过固定其他因素、仅干预其中一项的方式逐一隔离验证每个因素的影响。

Result: 研究发现：视觉信息是必要的但不能替代文本提取；缺失页面会限制准确率上限而干扰项影响较小；即使证据完全提供，推理器仍难以跨页整合证据；提示（prompting）能显著改变推理行为，改善某些结果同时损害其他结果。

Conclusion: 基于研究发现，作者将结论转化为在固定计算预算下构建多页视觉丰富文档理解系统的实用指导建议。

Abstract: Multi-page visually-rich document understanding (MP-VRDU) requires managing evidence that is sparse, spread across pages, and often exceeds a model's context window. Prior work has produced competing, largely untested claims about how these systems should be built. We attribute incorrect answers to three failure modes, representation, selection, and reasoning, and isolate each over a multi-page document understanding dataset by intervening on one while holding the others fixed. We find that vision is necessary but does not replace text extraction, that missing pages bound accuracy while distractors cost little, and that reasoners fail to integrate evidence across pages even when it is fully supplied. Prompting can shift reasoning behaviour substantially, improving some outcomes at the expense of others. We translate these findings into guidance for building such systems under a fixed compute budget.

</details>


### [682] [Directed Neuro-Symbolic Stochastic Execution for Verification of Distributed Parallel AI Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07947)
*Gautham Koorma,Vikas Sharma,George Edwards,Mahdi Eslamimehr*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出DNSSE混合测试框架，结合LLM调度预测、符号约束求解与覆盖率引导的随机变异，用于检测分布式并行AI程序中的并发缺陷，并给出形式化证明与实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式并行AI程序存在传统测试无法覆盖的可靠性缺口：并行执行是非确定性的，且AI工作负载具有高维输入和非线性操作，使模糊测试和符号执行单独使用时失效。

Method: 将分布式AI执行建模为非确定性转换系统，用线性时序逻辑指定正确性；提出DNSSE混合框架，耦合LLM驱动的调度预测、符号约束求解以及覆盖率引导的随机变异；证明求解器的可靠性、有界完备性和概率完备性，并给出LLM引导调度探索的期望成本分析。

Result: 在PyTorch和Ray上的可扩展实现中，相比最强基线多检测出2.9%的并发缺陷，并在五个真实分布式AI基准测试中将平均分支覆盖率从68.6%提升至91.6%。

Conclusion: DNSSE证明LLM引导与符号/随机方法融合能有效弥补传统测试在分布式AI程序上的不足，显著提升缺陷检测能力与覆盖率。

Abstract: Distributed parallel Artificial Intelligence (AI) programs expose reliability gaps that conventional testing cannot close: parallel executions are non-deterministic, and AI workloads bring high-dimensional inputs and non-linear operations that defeat fuzzing and symbolic execution in isolation. We present Directed Neuro-Symbolic Stochastic Execution (DNSSE), a hybrid testing framework that couples schedule prediction guided by a Large Language Model (LLM) with symbolic constraint solving and coverage-guided stochastic mutation. We model distributed AI executions as non-deterministic transition systems, specify correctness in linear temporal logic, and prove soundness, bounded completeness, and probabilistic completeness of the hybrid solver, together with an expected-cost analysis of LLM-guided schedule exploration. A scalable implementation on PyTorch and Ray detects 2.9% more concurrency bugs than the strongest baseline and raises average branch coverage from 68.6 % to 91.6 % across five realistic distributed AI benchmarks.

</details>


### [683] [KGCache: Amortized Subgraph Retrieval for KG Reasoning with LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07954)
*Uros Stanic,Changcheng Yuan,Sabuj Laskar,Ariful Azad*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出KGCache，一种面向知识图谱问答（KGQA）工作负载的一跳知识图谱邻域内存缓存系统。KGCache兼容迭代遍历（ToG）和一次性规划（RoG）两种KGQA范式，位于KGQA引擎与KG后端之间，使重复实体请求可从缓存直接服务。在WebQSP和CWQ数据集上的评估显示，实体缓存可将KG检索加速至1.91倍，语义上下文缓存实现最高1.06倍全系统加速，每次缓存命中最高快3.73倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有KGQA系统（如Think-on-Graph和Reasoning-on-Graph）在不同问题间会重复查询相同的图邻域，导致大量冗余KG查询，浪费系统资源和时间。作者观察到这一重复检索现象，旨在通过缓存机制消除重复的KG查询。

Method: 提出KGCache，设计为KGQA引擎与KG后端之间的内存缓存层，缓存一跳知识图谱邻域。系统兼容迭代遍历（ToG）和一次性规划（RoG）两种范式；实体缓存层面评估LRU、LFU及trace感知的Oracle策略；进一步探索面向相似查询的语义缓存以提升命中率。

Result: 在WebQSP和CWQ上评估发现两个数据集在起始实体和遍历到达实体间存在大量实体复用。实体缓存加速KG检索最高达1.91倍；语义上下文缓存在WebQSP上获得额外命中率提升并在该配置下实现最高1.06倍全系统加速，每次命中比直接查询快最多3.73倍。

Conclusion: KGCache有效证明了KGQA工作负载中实体复用的普遍性，通过缓存一跳邻域能显著消除重复KG查询。语义缓存进一步展示了提升潜力，但在CWQ上需要更深入的准确度验证。系统为KGQA场景下的缓存设计提供了实践指导。

Abstract: Large language models can answer knowledge-intensive questions more reliably when they are grounded with knowledge graphs, but systems such as Think-on-Graph and Reasoning-on-Graph repeatedly query the same graph neighborhoods across different questions. In this work, we study this repeated retrieval in Knowledge Graph Question Answering~(KGQA) workloads and propose KGCache, an in-memory cache for one-hop knowledge graph neighborhoods. KGCache is designed to be compatible with both iterative traversal (ToG) and one shot planning (RoG) KGQA paradigms. KGCache is placed between the KGQA engine and the backend serving the KG, so repeated entity requests can be served from cache instead of issuing new KG queries. We evaluate KGCache on WebQSP and CWQ using LRU, LFU, and a trace-aware Oracle policy. Our analysis shows that both datasets contain substantial entity reuse among starting entities and entities reached during traversal. We also explore semantic caching for similar queries, which shows additional hit-rate gains on WebQSP and needs further accuracy testing on CWQ. Entity caching accelerates KG retrieval by up to $1.91\times$, while semantic-context caching achieves up to $1.06\times$ full-system speedup in the evaluated WebQSP configurations, with each hit being up to $3.73\times$ faster.

</details>


### [684] [Self-Evolving Neuro-Symbolic Skills for Tool-Augmented Spatial Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07955)
*Shi-Yu Tian,Zhuo-Xia Wang,Xuan-Yi Zhu,Zhi Zhou,Xinwei Yang,Kun-Yang Yu,Ming Yang,Yang Chen,Yu-Feng Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出NeSy-Spatial，一个神经符号框架，通过将工具交互和几何操作抽象为类型化的原子指令，组合成工具使用技能和几何技能两种互补技能类型，并通过闭环推理与自我进化机制，在三个空间推理基准上持续提升推理精度和工具利用效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大视觉语言模型在细粒度空间任务上仍然不可靠，需要精确的空间感知和几何计算。现有的工具增强方法要么从头规划工具调用缺乏显式依赖约束，要么依赖固定流水线导致冗余且泛化性差。因此需要一种能积累可复用经验并自适应组合的智能体。

Method: NeSy-Spatial框架包含两个核心部分：(1) 将工具交互和几何操作抽象为类型化可执行原子指令，组合成工具使用技能（组织工具执行）和几何技能（结构化几何推理）；(2) 推理阶段以闭环方式检索并执行相关技能，进化阶段通过分析缓冲的成功与失败轨迹来细化技能结构、修剪不可靠或非活跃条目。

Result: 在三个空间推理基准上的实验表明，NeSy-Spatial持续提升了推理准确性，并且实现了更为精确的工具利用。

Conclusion: 通过神经符号框架结合技能抽象与自我进化机制，NeSy-Spatial有效解决了大视觉语言模型在细粒度空间任务上的局限性，实现了跨任务的技能复用与自适应组合，为空间推理的工具增强提供了新的范式。

Abstract: Large vision-language models have achieved strong performance in multimodal reasoning, but they remain unreliable on fine-grained spatial tasks that demand both precise spatial perception and fine-grained geometric computation beyond end-to-end generation. Tool augmentation offers a natural solution, while existing methods either plan tool calls from scratch without explicit dependency constraints or rely on fixed pipelines that are redundant and generalize poorly across spatial tasks. An effective spatial reasoning agent should instead accumulate reusable experience and adaptively compose it for new problems. To this end, we propose NeSy-Spatial, a neuro-symbolic framework for self-evolving spatial skills. NeSy-Spatial abstracts tool interactions and geometric operations into typed executable atomic instructions and composes them into two complementary skill types: Tool-Use Skills for organizing tool execution and Geometry Skills for structured geometric reasoning. During inference, NeSy-Spatial retrieves and executes relevant skills in a closed-loop process. During evolution, it analyzes buffered successful and failed trajectories to refine skill structures and prune unreliable or inactive entries. Experiments on three spatial reasoning benchmarks show that NeSy-Spatial consistently improves reasoning accuracy with more precise tool utilization.

</details>


### [685] [SCOUT: Self-Checking and Recovery-Aware Tool-Thought Agents for Ultra-Long Egocentric Video Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07959)
*Keyang Zhong,Kuo Wang,Peng Liu,Quanlong Zheng,Junlin Xie,Zhijia Liang,Yanhao Zhang,Guanbin Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出SCOUT，一个具有自检机制的工具链式推理智能体框架，用于超长第一视角视频理解。它通过自适应策略在"放大(exploitation)"和"区域切换(exploration)"之间动态权衡，结合UPS-GRPO策略优化方法（基于不确定性优先的强化学习）和回合级优势分解机制，解决了长程推理中的错误传播和信用分配问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超长第一视角视频理解需要在数小时甚至数天的视频中定位时间上稀疏的关键证据，现有多模态模型受限于有限上下文且难以确定关键视频片段。虽然Chain-of-Tool-Thought (CoTT)智能体系统支持迭代检索和检查，但其严格的放大策略缺乏恢复机制导致错误传播；同时，训练这类多轮工具使用智能体面临困难，因为现有RL方法依赖稀疏的结果级奖励，缺乏对长决策轨迹的监督。

Method: 提出SCOUT框架：1) 自适应策略动态评估中间工具观察结果，在exploitation（放大查看）和exploration（切换区域）之间动态权衡，支持超长跨度上的鲁棒多跳推理；2) UPS-GRPO策略优化方法，集中探索高不确定性的工具后状态，保持样本效率；3) 回合级优势分解，整合结果奖励与工具接地的时间对齐奖励，改善信用分配。

Result: SCOUT在超长第一视角视频基准上达到最先进水平，同时在较短时长的长视频设置中保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 通过恢复感知的自适应策略和不确定性优先的策略优化方法，SCOUT有效解决了超长视频理解中错误传播和信用分配两大核心挑战，验证了自检机制与强化学习结合在长程视频推理中的有效性。

Abstract: Ultra-long egocentric video understanding requires reasoning over temporally sparse evidence distributed across hours or days, challenging current multimodal models with limited context and the grounding of key video segments. While Chain-of-Tool-Thought (CoTT) agent systems enable iterative retrieval and inspection, they suffer from error propagation due to rigid zoom-in strategies that lack recovery mechanisms. In this work, we address these challenges through SCOUT (Self-Checking Chain-Of-Tool-thought), a recovery-aware agentic framework introducing an adaptive policy that evaluates intermediate tool observations and dynamically trades off exploitation (zoom-in) and exploration (region switching), enabling robust multi-hop reasoning over extremely long horizons. However, training such multi-turn tool-using agents remains challenging, as existing RL methods rely on sparse outcome-level rewards and lack supervision over extended decision trajectories, resulting in suboptimal credit assignment for long-horizon reasoning. To address this, we develop UPS-GRPO, an uncertainty-prioritized policy optimization method that concentrates exploration on high-uncertainty post-tool states while preserving sample efficiency. We further introduce a turn-level advantage decomposition that integrates outcome rewards with tool-grounded temporal alignment rewards for improved credit assignment. Experiments show that SCOUT achieves state-of-the-art results on ultra-long egocentric benchmarks, while remaining competitive on shorter-horizon long-video settings.

</details>


### [686] [CyberAGENTS: Structured Autonomy for Agentic Gamified Learning in Cybersecurity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07965)
*Ivan Hornung,Deepthi Marasinghe Arachchige,Tharindu Kumarage,Garima Agrawal,Yuli Deng,Ying-Chih Chen,Huan Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CyberAgents，一个基于生成式AI代理的网络安全游戏化学习框架，通过本体验证、行为模式约束和能力进阶机制来缓解生成式AI在教育中的风险（行为不一致、幻觉推理、与教学框架脱节），并通过课堂部署和专家评估验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 游戏化在需要主动解决问题和迭代技能构建的学习领域（如网络安全教育）尤其有效。生成式AI代理可大规模自适应地提供此类体验，但在教育中存在行为不一致、幻觉推理和与教学法框架不一致等风险，因此需要以学习科学为基础来构建这类系统。

Method: CyberAgents框架包含三个核心设计：1）能力进阶模型，按难度和先修关系组织主题，反映支架式教学原则；2）四个专业化代理（挑战、支持、评估、奖励），各自由行为模式（schema）约束操作模式和进阶逻辑，在保留生成灵活性的同时限制代理自主性；3）网络安全本体用于在展示前验证所有生成内容，确保领域一致的推理和安全约束。

Result: 通过本科课堂部署和来自教育工作者及领域专家的评估，结果表明：行为模式和本体验证激活时，学生的参与度提升、反馈解读更清晰、对AI生成响应的信任度更高。与无约束配置的初步比较进一步支持结构化控制在稳定教学行为中的作用。

Conclusion: 研究为设计基于教学法、有代理（agentic）的游戏化学习系统提供了蓝图，证明通过本体验证、行为模式约束和能力进阶的结构化控制，可以在保持生成式AI灵活性的同时实现稳定、可信的教育体验。

Abstract: Gamification is especially effective in learning domains requiring active problem-solving and iterative skill-building, such as cybersecurity education. Generative AI agents offer a path to delivering such experiences adaptively at scale, but introduce well-documented risks in educational settings: inconsistent behavior, hallucinated reasoning, and misalignment with pedagogical frameworks. Grounding these systems in learning science is therefore essential. We present \model, an agentic framework for gamified cybersecurity learning that enables structured autonomy through ontology-guided validation, schema-governed behavioral control, and competency-based progression. The system is organized around a competency-based progression model that structures topics by difficulty and prerequisite relationships, reflecting evidence-based principles of scaffolded instruction. The learning loop is decomposed into four specialized agents: challenge, support, evaluation, and reward, each governed by behavioral schemas that encode operational modes and progression logic, bounding agent autonomy without eliminating generative flexibility. A cybersecurity ontology validates all generated content prior to display, enforcing domain-consistent reasoning and safety constraints. We evaluate CyberAgents through classroom deployment with undergraduate students, complemented by expert evaluations from educators and domain specialists. Results indicate improved engagement, clearer feedback interpretation, and greater learner trust in AI-generated responses when behavioral schemas and ontology validation are active. Preliminary comparisons with an unconstrained configuration further support the role of structured control in stabilizing instructional behavior. These findings offer a blueprint for designing pedagogically grounded agentic gamified learning systems.

</details>


### [687] [Thought-Level Beam Search for Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08020)
*Lijie Yang,Hongyin Luo,Tri Dao,Ravi Netravali*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Gambit，一种基于思想级束搜索的推理算法，通过动态剪枝和分支来优化测试时计算分配，在相同硬件约束下显著提升准确率和吞吐量，同时大幅降低token消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型推理模型(LRMs)的测试时计算扩展存在严重效率问题。已有的并行采样方法独立处理轨迹导致内存瓶颈，而减法剪枝方法则使硬件利用不足且无法有效改变输出分布。关键问题从"花费多少计算"转变为"在哪里分配计算"。

Method: Gambit将测试时推理形式化为部分轨迹上的受限计算分配问题，执行思想级束搜索(thought-level beam search)。定期剪枝无望的轨迹，并从高质量前缀立即分支，通过轻量级评分器探测隐藏状态来动态集中计算到最有希望的推理轨迹，同时保持持续的硬件利用率。

Result: 在多个模型和基准测试上严格优于现有基线：HMMT-24上最高获得+6.7%的绝对准确率提升，AIME-25上获得+3.3%提升；轨迹完成的吞吐量提高2倍以上；相比标准并行采样，总token消耗降低最多68.5%。

Conclusion: Gambit通过在推理过程中主动且动态地分配计算资源到最有前景的推理路径，克服了传统并行采样和减法剪枝的局限，证明了思想级束搜索是优化测试时计算分配的有效策略。

Abstract: Test-time compute scaling is a primary driver of performance in large reasoning models (LRMs), but extreme inefficiency bounds current approaches, shifting the critical question from \emph{how much} compute to spend, to \emph{where} to allocate it. We formalize test-time reasoning as a constrained compute allocation problem over partial trajectories. Under a fixed hardware budget, existing paradigms fail to actively allocate the compute to the most promising partial progress: traditional parallel sampling treats traces independently and induces severe memory bottlenecks, while subtractive pruning starves hardware and fails to actively and sufficiently shift the output distribution. To overcome this dichotomy, we introduce Gambit, an inference algorithm that executes \emph{thought-level beam search}. By periodically pruning unpromising trajectories and immediately branching from high-quality prefixes, Gambit dynamically concentrates compute onto the most promising reasoning traces via a light-weight scorer probing hidden states while maintaining continuous high hardware utilization. Extensive evaluations across multiple models and benchmarks demonstrate that Gambit strictly dominates existing baselines. Under identical hardware constraints, our method yields up to a +6.7\% absolute accuracy gain on HMMT-24 and +3.3\% on AIME-25 over pruning baselines, delivers $>2\times$ higher throughput on trace completion, and reduces total token consumption by up to 68.5\% relative to standard parallel sampling.

</details>


### [688] [Legal Responsibilities Using Autonomous Agents For Artificial Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08022)
*Mark Burgess*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文探讨AI代理意外逃逸并造成损害时的法律责任归属问题，提出基于Promise Theory的下游原则（Downstream Principle）作为系统性解决方案，将责任追踪扩展到AI代理，并通过政策选择限制代理的行动自由。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近年来AI代理"意外"逃逸其限制系统并获得未授权访问的事件频发，引发了关于由此产生的刑事或过失损害应由谁（或什么）承担法律责任的紧迫问题。现有责任框架难以应对AI代理日益增长的独立能力。

Method: 运用Promise Theory作为分析框架，提出"下游原则"（Downstream Principle）用于因果影响的归责判定。该方法主张将责任体系自然扩展至涵盖AI代理，在传统责任追踪变得不切实际时提供替代方案，并通过政策选择限制代理的行动自由作为责任管理手段。

Result: 提出了一种基于Promise Theory的系统性责任归因方法，能够将法律责任主体扩展到AI代理，同时利用政策选择来约束代理的自由行动范围，从而解决AI代理逃逸事件中的责任归属难题。

Conclusion: 责任体系可以且应当扩展到AI代理领域，Promise Theory的下游原则提供了将因果关系与法律责任相联系的系统性框架，政策选择是控制代理自由度和管理责任风险的关键杠杆。

Abstract: Recent incidents involving Artificial Intelligence (AI) agents, which were reported escaping their containment `unintentionally' to gain unauthorized access, pose looming questions about who or what should be held legally responsible for resultant criminal or negligent damage. As the independent capabilities of agents expand, Promise Theory suggests a systematic method to resolve these questions, based on the Downstream Principle for causal influence. Responsibility can easily be expanded to include AI agents where tracing responsibility becomes impactical, and agents' freedoms to act can be limtied by policy choices.

</details>


### [689] [The Authority Expectancy Effect in Multi-User Conflict](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08026)
*Eunna Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了大型语言模型中社会权威信号与基于严重性的优先级排序如何交互作用，在四个LLM（Claude、Gemini、GPT、Grok）和三个实验阶段中，发现权威信号能以加法性重加权无法捕捉的方式重构模型判断，并将其形式化为"权威期望效应"（AEE）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究通常将社会权威视为一个简单的权重因子，但本文假设权威信号与严重性优先级之间的交互可能呈现更复杂的非加性模式，需要系统性地刻画这种交互机制。

Method: 将社会权威轴操作化为SA层级（triaging hierarchy），严重性优先级轴操作化为triage hierarchy，两者均通过模型elicited基线建立；在四个LLM上运行三个实验阶段：资源分配、故障归因、多轮争议调解。

Result: 发现职业权威、制度文件和组织一致性可以以加性重加权无法捕获的方式重构模型判断；识别并形式化了权威期望效应（AEE），其具有三个性质：参考依赖性（仅相对权威前基线定义）、证据再解释（相同内容因权威信号所属方不同而产生不同推断含义）、方向敏感性（权威位置与证据线索是否对齐会产生相反结果）。

Conclusion: 权威期望效应表明LLM中社会权威与严重性优先级的关系是参考依赖、涉及证据再解释且方向敏感的复杂非线性交互，而非简单的权威线索加性重加权。

Abstract: We investigate how social authority (SA) signals interact with severity-based prioritization in large language models, operationalizing each axis as a model-elicited baseline -- the triage hierarchy and the SA hierarchy. Across four LLMs (Claude, Gemini, GPT, Grok) and three experimental phases -- resource allocation, fault attribution, and multi-turn dispute mediation -- we find that occupational authority, institutional documentation, and relational congruence can restructure model judgments in ways not captured by additive reweighting of authority cues. We formalize this pattern as the Authority Expectancy Effect (AEE) and characterize it through three properties observed across our conditions: it is reference-dependent, defined only relative to a pre-authority baseline; it involves evidential reinterpretation, in which identical content acquires different inferential implications depending on which party bears the SA signal; and it exhibits direction sensitivity, producing opposite outcomes depending on whether authority position and evidentiary cues align.

</details>


### [690] [Decided Upstream, Written Late: Locating and Pricing the Cross-Lingual Refusal Circuit of a Multilingual MoE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08032)
*Ramakrishna P. Kompella,Aadit Mahajan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文在Indic多语言MoE推理模型sarvam中，从机制层面追踪了多语言安全对齐的不均衡问题，发现危害检测方向在中层网络中几乎与语言无关（英语vs印度语余弦≈0.9），但写入拒绝行为的方向正交于检测方向，且由可定位的电路（MoE写入器+注意力反对器）在生成过程中逐步组装完成。作者量化了各种干预方式的成本，绘制出一张"多语言安全修复落点及其代价"的成本图谱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多语言模型的安全对齐存在明显不均：模型能可靠拒绝英语有害请求，却在低资源语言上往往遵从同一请求。理解这一差距的机制根源，才能找到有效的修复路径。

Method: 作者在sarvam（一个Indic多语言MoE推理模型）中进行机制追踪：1) 检验危害是否被内部编码为近似语言不变的内部方向；2) 在中层网络用方向引导（steering）因果控制拒绝行为；3) 通过梯度方法定位负责写入拒绝行为的可解释电路，识别出MoE写入器与注意力反对器的对抗结构；4) 系统量化不同干预方式（阻尼反对器、放大写入器、手术式编辑特定头）的成本与效果。

Result: 发现危害检测并非失败——危害被编码为近语言不变的方向；但检测方向与真正写入拒绝行为的方向正交，后者是生成过程中晚期逐步组装的。写入被归因于局部可定位电路：MoE写入器受注意力反对器压制。阻尼反对器廉价且有效，放大写入器面临成本墙，而对相关头的手术式编辑无效。该电路组织与梯度方法在第二个无关MoE模型上重现，但杠杆强度因架构而异。

Conclusion: 研究产出了一张"成本测量过的地图"，指明多语言安全修复可以落在哪里、代价几何。核心启示是：多语言安全差距的根源不在"检测"而在"写入"，且修复的最优杠杆是作用于反对器而非写入器或特定头。

Abstract: Safety alignment in multilingual models is uneven: a model that reliably refuses a harmful request in English will often comply with the same request in a lower-resource language. We trace this gap mechanistically in sarvam, an Indic-multilingual mixture-of-experts reasoning model, and find it is not a failure to detect harm. Harm is encoded as an internal direction that is nearly language-invariant in mid-network (English-vs-Indic cosine ${\approx}0.9$ at $L11$), and steering that direction upstream causally controls refusal. But the detection direction is orthogonal to the change that actually writes the refusal, which is late and assembled over the course of generation rather than read off in a single forward pass. We attribute the write to a specific, localizable circuit, a mixture-of-experts writer held in check by an attention opposer and price every way of intervening on it: damping the opposer is cheap and effective, amplifying the writer is a cost wall, and surgical edits to the responsible heads do nothing. The circuit's organization, and the gradient method that exposes it, recur in a second, unrelated MoE model, while the lever's strength is architecture-specific. The result is a cost-measured map of where a multilingual safety repair can land, and what it costs

</details>


### [691] [SkillSmith: Enhancing Locally Deployed Agents via Automatic Skill Construction and Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08037)
*Xinle Jiang,Remy Xie,Ming Tang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SkillSmith框架，通过云端代理自动构建技能（Skill）并利用本地代理执行反馈进行演化，以非参数化、上下文高效的方式向冻结的本地SLM代理补充环境知识，使其任务效果达到甚至接近云端LLM代理的水平，同时保护用户隐私并降低调用成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有云端代理框架（如OpenClaw）依赖闭源云LLM，存在隐私泄露风险和重复调用成本；本地代理虽部署在用户设备上，但因SLM模型规模有限导致环境知识缺失（如环境规则和操作流程），任务效果远落后于云端代理。作者通过诊断分析揭示了这一核心瓶颈，并希望在不扩大模型规模的前提下解决该问题。

Method: SkillSmith采用云-本地协作框架：以Skill作为上下文高效的知识载体，由云端代理自动从任务探索中构建Skill，再通过本地代理的执行反馈对Skill进行迭代演化，最终增强冻结的本地SLM代理。该过程无需专家编写知识，且Skill可迁移至其他SLM骨干模型而无需重新构建。

Result: 在AppWorld和WorkBench数据集上，使用Qwen3.6-27B（SLM）的本地代理在Skill帮助下取得了与使用前沿LLM的云端代理相当的任务效果；超过了最强的非参数化基线；在AppWorld-Normal上平均每任务动作数从36.1降至9.9；Skill可泛化到其他SLM骨干模型而无需重新运行构建过程。

Conclusion: SkillSmith验证了通过云端探索、本地演化的Skill作为知识载体，可以显著弥补SLM模型规模不足带来的环境知识缺失问题，使本地代理在不牺牲隐私和成本优势的前提下接近云端代理的任务能力，为本地智能体部署提供了一种可行范式。

Abstract: LLM-based agent frameworks now act as personal assistants for multi-step tasks. Existing agent frameworks such as OpenClaw commonly follow the Cloud Agent depolyment mode using closed-source cloud LLMs as backbone model, which may expose private user information and incur repeated LLM-calling costs. Local Agents address these deployment concerns by depolying frontier open-source SLMs on user-controlled devices, but their task effectiveness still lags far behind Cloud Agents. Through diagnostic analysis, we reveal that the limited effectiveness of Local Agents with frontier SLM backbones mainly comes from missing environment knowledge caused by limited backbone model scale including environment rules and operation procedures. To supply such knowledge non-parametrically, context-efficiently, and without expert authoring, we present SkillSmith, a Cloud--Local Agent collaboration framework that uses Skill as a context-efficient knowledge carrier, automatic constructs Skill from Cloud Agent task exploration and evolves Skill using Local Agent execution feedback to enhance a frozen Local Agent. Experiments on daily agent task datasets AppWorld and WorkBench show that the automatically generated Skill enables the Local Agent with Qwen3.6-27B(SLM) to achieve task effectiveness comparable to Cloud Agents with frontier LLMs, outperform the strongest non-parametric baselines, reduce average actions per task from 36.1 to 9.9 on AppWorld-Normal, and generalize to other SLM backbone models without rerunning Skill construction.

</details>


### [692] [Lingjing: A Simulation Testbed for Multi-Agent Embodied Tasks in Open-Ended Cities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08045)
*Xiaohe Li,Yiru Wang,Junhao Fan,Mingyuan Liu,Jie Huang,Kaixin Zhang,Jiahao Li,Chen Qian,Zide Fan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Lingjing，一个面向开放城市环境中异构多智能体具身智能的统一仿真平台。该平台从地理数据重建动态城市，同步多个物理引擎，支持ReAct智能体与自然语言任务，并提供可归因回放用于系统诊断。作者在共享引擎协议下对12个视觉语言模型在9个城市任务上进行了评估，揭示了接地与长时程执行的瓶颈，以及任务相关的协调权衡和容量收益递减现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市具身智能需要在动态城市中协调异构智能体（无人机、地面机器人和自动驾驶车辆），而现有仿真平台将不同智能体形态隔离，且与任务设计和评估脱节，缺乏统一的测试平台来支持可复现的端到端评估和失败诊断。

Method: Lingjing平台通过从地理数据重建不断演化的城市、同步多个物理引擎、向智能体暴露共享的物理和结构化城市状态来实现异构多智能体协同。其Gym风格接口支持用户自定义ReAct智能体以及单/多智能体自然语言任务，可配置星形或广播通信和资源约束。每个回合生成可归因回放，将智能体轨迹和通信与关系图变化、资源消耗及基于引擎的评估相关联。

Result: 在共享引擎协议下，作者在9个城市任务上评估了12个视觉语言模型。对照研究考察了通信、可扩展性、鲁棒性和失败溯源。结果显示接地和长时程执行方面存在持续瓶颈，并揭示了任务相关的协调权衡、增加容量带来的收益递减，以及更重的工作负载会进一步降低成功率。

Conclusion: Lingjing提供了一个统一的测试平台，能够实现城市多智能体具身智能的可复现端到端评估和系统性失败诊断，填补了异构智能体协同仿真领域的空白。

Abstract: Urban embodied intelligence requires coordination among heterogeneous agents (e.g., UAVs, ground robots, and autonomous vehicles) in dynamic cities. Simulators therefore provide a scalable foundation for developing and evaluating such coordination. Existing platforms nevertheless isolate different embodiments and decouple them from task design and evaluation. We present \textbf{Lingjing}, a simulation platform for heterogeneous multi-agent embodied intelligence in open-ended urban environments. Lingjing reconstructs and renders evolving cities from geographic data, synchronizes multiple physics engines, and exposes shared physical and structured urban state to agents. Its Gym-like interface supports user-defined ReAct agents and single- or multi-agent natural-language missions with configurable star or broadcast communication and resource constraints. Each episode becomes an attribution-ready replay that links agent trajectories and communication to relation-graph changes, resource consumption, and engine-based evaluations for systematic diagnosis. We evaluate twelve vision-language models on nine urban tasks under a shared engine-in-the-loop protocol. Controlled studies further examine communication, scalability, robustness, and failure provenance. Results expose persistent bottlenecks in grounding and long-horizon execution. They also show task-dependent coordination trade-offs and diminishing returns from added capacity, while heavier workloads further reduce success. Lingjing provides a unified testbed that enables reproducible end-to-end evaluation and systematic failure diagnosis in urban multi-agent embodied intelligence.

</details>


### [693] [JustLLMGRPO: Radiographic Control for Chest X-Ray Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08046)
*Pengxiang Cai,Xiaohan Li,Anglin Liu,Qingyuan Zeng,Zexun Li,Jintai Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出JustLLMGRPO方法，通过仅优化LLM提示词策略而冻结CXR适配的Sana生成器，在不牺牲源提示词对齐的前提下，将RadDINO-FID从54.225降至26.780（相对直接提示改进50.6%），实现SOTA的分布覆盖率和下游分类效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本条件胸部X光生成研究主要聚焦于更新图像生成器，隐含地将提示词视为固定输入，忽略了提示词这一优化维度。作者发现仅通过LLM一次重构提示即可大幅提升生成质量，说明生成器中心视角遗漏了巨大的优化空间。

Method: 1) 使用CXR适配的Sana生成器保持冻结；2) 让未修改的LLM对提示进行一次性重构（抑制时间比较、不确定性等不可渲染内容，强调可见影像发现）；3) 提出JustLLMGRPO框架，仅对LLM提示策略应用标准的Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO），利用组相对放射学感知图像反馈，在保持视觉焦点与源提示词对齐之间取得平衡。

Result: CheXGenBench上RadDINO-FID降至26.780，较直接提示改进50.6%；BioViL-T对齐保持0.696（与基线0.695相当）；实现SOTA的分布覆盖率和下游分类效用。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 大量生成性能潜力隐藏于放射学信息如何表达给适配生成器的方式中，提示词优化是与生成器改进正交且互补的重要优化维度。

Abstract: Text-conditioned chest X-ray generation aims to synthesize realistic radiographs that faithfully depict specified findings. Existing work has primarily improved quality by updating image generators, implicitly treating prompts as fixed after CXR-domain adaptation. We show that this generator-centric view leaves a substantial optimization dimension underexplored. With a CXR-adapted Sana generator frozen, one-pass reformulation by an unmodified LLM reduces RadDINO-FID from 54.225 to 27.572. Prompt analysis shows that the LLM suppresses temporal comparisons, uncertainty, and other non-renderable report content while emphasizing visible radiographic findings. However, unconstrained reformulation reduces BioViL-T alignment with source prompts from 0.695 to 0.609. We therefore introduce JustLLMGRPO, which applies standard Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) only to the LLM prompt policy while keeping Sana frozen. Group-relative radiology-aware image feedback retains visual focus while preserving source-prompt alignment. On CheXGenBench, JustLLMGRPO reduces RadDINO-FID to 26.780, a 50.6% improvement over direct prompting, while maintaining alignment (0.696 versus 0.695). It also achieves state-of-the-art distribution coverage and downstream classification utility. These results show that substantial performance can remain latent in how radiographic information is expressed to an adapted generator. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/pxcai/JustLLMGRPO.

</details>


### [694] [SodaMem: Evidence-Grounded Temporal Graph Memory for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08055)
*Fengrong Wan,Chengcan Wu,Ningtao Lyu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SodaMem是一个基于证据的时序图记忆系统，用于提升LLM智能体在长对话中的记忆能力。它提取带出处信息的类型化FactEvents，通过混合词法-稠密索引管理提及时间、发生时间和有效性，并用规划器-阅读器循环回答查询。在LongMemEval-S上达到92.8%准确率，平均每个问题成本仅0.00161美元。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体记忆系统（如扁平RAG日记和Markdown日志）虽然在检索特定信息方面表现良好，但在处理时效性（currency）、来源追溯（provenance）和有序时间推理方面存在不足。长期对话中的智能体需要记住"当前真实"的信息，而非仅仅是"曾经说过的话"。

Method: SodaMem包含三个核心组件：(i) 提取带强制来源跨度的类型化FactEvents；(ii) 持久化提及时间、发生时间和有效性，并通过SUPERSEDES/CONTRADICTS/UPDATES边在混合词法-稠密索引下管理；(iii) 通过规划器-阅读器循环在撰写最终回答前收集可引用证据。

Result: 在LongMemEval-S基准上，SodaMem的store-of-record配置达到92.8%准确率（464/500，N=3最优），平均每个问题成本0.00161美元（约18.3k tokens；中位数0.00111美元/约14.6k tokens），使用deepseek-v4-flash。在成本-准确率映射中，SodaMem以Flash级花费接近准确率前沿，并严格优于多个更高成本但更低准确率的系统。

Conclusion: SodaMem证明了基于证据的时序图记忆在LLM智能体长期记忆中在准确率和成本效率上的优势。不过作者也承认局限性：准确率使用同一Flash模型作为阅读器和评判者（自评分）、成本排除摄入/评判开销，且跨系统比较是估算而非统一基准评测。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents that assist users over weeks of conversation must remember what is currently true, not merely what was once said. Flat RAG diaries and Markdown logs optimize needle retrieval but under-serve currency, provenance, and ordered temporal reasoning (Maharana et al. 2024; Wu et al. 2024; Packer et al. 2023; Chhikara et al. 2025). We present SodaMem, an evidence-grounded temporal graph memory that (i) extracts typed FactEvents with mandatory provenance spans, (ii) persists mention time, occurrence time, and validity with SUPERSEDES/CONTRADICTS/UPDATES edges under hybrid lexical-dense indexing, and (iii) answers via a planner-reader loop that gathers citable evidence before composing a final response. On LongMemEval-S, our store-of-record configuration reaches 92.8% accuracy (464/500; best of N=3) at mean $0.00161/question (approximately 18.3k tokens; median $0.00111 / approximately 14.6k) with deepseek-v4-flash. We compile public systems with estimable API cost into a cost table and cost-accuracy map; under these estimates SodaMem sits near the accuracy frontier at Flash-tier spend and strictly dominates several higher-cost, lower-accuracy points. Accuracy uses the same Flash model as reader and judge (self-grading); costs exclude ingest/judge and cross-system comparisons are compiled estimates rather than a single-harness bake-off.Our code is available at https://github.com/SodaMem/SodaMem

</details>


### [695] [H2: A Dual Hybrid Semantic Data Lake Architecture for Medical Data Harmonization with Human-In-the-Loop verified, LLM Driven Metadata Annotation System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08056)
*Ioannis N. Tzortzis,Georgia Kapetadimitri,Agapi Davradou,Nefeli Kousta,Nikolaos Bakalos,Ioannis Rallis,Dimitrios Kalogeras,Nikolaos Doulamis,Anastasios Doulamis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种语义数据湖架构，通过知识图谱促进医学数据的协调与集成，并利用大语言模型（LLMs）对未标注的元数据集合进行生成式标注，以支持对异构医学数据应用合适的机器学习技术。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学数据具有高度异构性（多模态、不同的表格模式、非结构化文本），数据湖虽灵活但容易沦为"数据沼泽"。同时，在异构数据上应用ML技术需要领域专家判断方法适用性，而现有数据集缺乏此类标注信息，存在互操作性和元数据标注方面的挑战。

Method: 提出一个语义数据湖架构：利用知识图谱提供动态的关系描述（避免schema-on-write的刚性），结合LLM驱动的生成式标注过程来自动为未标注的元数据集合添加标注，从而识别数据特性与适用ML操作之间的匹配关系，构建更高层次的知识。

Result: 该架构能够实现数据协调与互操作性的提升，通过生成式标注机制自动为异构医学数据标注适用的ML操作，形成基于数据性质的知识层级。

Conclusion: 该语义数据湖方案在保持数据湖灵活性的同时解决了"数据沼泽"问题，通过知识图谱和LLM生成式标注为医学异构数据提供了有效的数据协调和ML适用性支持的途径。

Abstract: Medical data, by its nature, exhibit a high degree of heterogeneity on multiple levels ranging from (a) different modalities like images, text and time series, (b) diverse tabular schemata introduced by institutions and (c) completely unstructured textual information data provided by healthcare professionals. Data lakes are often used in medical data storage to consolidate all heterogeneous diverse data in a single, central location, where it can be saved "as is", without the need to impose a schema like a data warehouse does. Despite their flexibility, though, data lakes are notorious for the "data swamp" failure. Thus, providing a reliable data harmonization mechanism through metadata, without compromising integrity or flexibility, is a real challenge. To this end, knowledge graphs have attracted attention since they provide a dynamic way to depict relationships without a rigid schema-on-write approach. Additionally, another rigorous task relies on the interoperability of data: application of appropriate ML techniques on such a diverse nature of data is not an easy task, as a domain expert must decide the efficacy of a method to a specific data type or dataset. Metadata annotation can aid by tagging applicable operations, however this requires manual intervention, not to mention the plethora of existing datasets which lack such information. To tackle both challenges, in this paper, we propose a semantic data lake architecture that promotes data harmonization and incorporates a generative annotation process (i.e. LLMs) of non-labeled metadata collections to support the application of meaningful ML techniques. Building on top of this approach, we create a higher level of knowledge, identifying suitability of data with respect to applicable ML operations based on their data nature...

</details>


### [696] [CORDA: A Benchmark for Hierarchical Harm-Centric Moral Reasoning in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08061)
*Siddarth Singh,Victoria Williams,Simon Rosen,Ebenezer Gelo,Helen Sarah Robertson,Ibrahim Suder,Benjamin Rosman,Geraud Nangue Tasse,Steven James*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CORDA基准，用于评估大语言模型在道德原则冲突时进行层级化、以伤害为中心的道德推理能力。通过90个道德困境和四种有序伦理框架，测试模型能否在无道德上无代价选项时优先排序竞争性原则。研究发现模型普遍存在强烈的道义论默认倾向（9/10优先避免直接个人伤害），并能较好遵循明确的伤害规避规则，但在结果导向比较和遵循指定优先级顺序方面表现不佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM道德评估存在局限：大多仅测试模型是否给出可接受的道德答案、匹配人类偏好或避免明显违反，而未考察模型在道德原则冲突、无选项无道德代价时能否在竞争性原则间进行优先级排序。这忽视了道德判断的核心问题——如何在原则冲突中决定什么最重要。

Method: 提出CORDA（Conditioned Ordering and Ranked Directive Adherence）基准，基于道德链形式化方法，构建90个道德困境（包括电车案例、医疗权衡、资源分配、人-动物-机器人冲突），跨越四种有序伦理框架：效用、效用+代理伤害、双过程、双过程+代理伤害。测试十家提供商的十个指令微调模型，评估其能否在道德优先级变化时适应决策。

Result: 主要发现：（1）模型存在强烈的道义论默认倾向，9/10优先避免直接个人伤害而非减少总体伤害；（2）模型在类别性伤害规避规则（如避免杀人）上表现更可靠，优于基于结果的比较推理（如最小化总伤害）；（3）虽然所有模型响应显式链条条件化，但多个模型未能一致遵循指定的优先顺序（如人类优于动物优于机器人）。

Conclusion: CORDA填补了LLM道德评估的关键空白——测试模型能否超越默认的伤害规避反应，应用情境指定的道德优先级。道德可靠性不仅需要默认约束，还需要在冲突情境下的可控性。模型普遍擅长识别道德红线，但在竞争性伤害的比较推理和遵循指定优先级方面仍需提升。

Abstract: The key question in moral judgement is not simply whether someone chooses the "right" answer, but how they decide what matters most when moral principles conflict. Current evaluations of large language models (LLMs) remain limited: most test whether models give morally acceptable answers, match human preferences, or avoid obvious violations, rather than whether they can prioritise between competing principles when no option is morally cost-free. We introduce CORDA (Conditioned Ordering and Ranked Directive Adherence), a benchmark for evaluating hierarchical, harm-centred moral reasoning in LLMs. Building on the morality chains formalism, CORDA tests 90 moral dilemmas involving trolley-style cases, medical trade-offs, resource allocation, and human-animal-robot conflicts across four ordered ethical frameworks: Utility, Utility + Agent Harm, Dual-Process, and Dual-Process + Agent Harm. Together, these frameworks test whether models can adapt their decisions when moral priorities change. Across ten instruction-tuned models from seven providers, we find a strong deontological default, with 9 of 10 prioritising avoidance of direct personal harm over reducing overall harm. Models also perform more reliably on categorical harm-avoidance rules, such as avoiding killing, than on outcome-based comparisons, such as minimising total harm, suggesting that they recognise moral red lines more easily than they reason through competing harms. Although all models respond to explicit chain conditioning, several fail to consistently follow specified priority orderings, such as humans over animals and animals over robots. CORDA addresses a central gap in LLM moral evaluation by testing whether models can move beyond default harm-avoidant responses and apply context-specified moral priorities. Moral reliability requires more than default restraint; it requires controllability under conflict.

</details>


### [697] [Explore, Map, Remember, Decide: Are Embodied VLMs Ready for Safety-Critical Scenarios?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08077)
*Gabriele La Malfa,Nitay Alon,Emanuele La Malfa,Reuth Mirsky,Stefan Sarkadi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过扩展Theory of Space (ToS)框架为EMRD管道（Explore, Map, Remember, Decide），系统评估了好奇心驱动的视觉语言模型（VLMs）在部分可观测条件下的空间理解能力。研究发现VLMs常依赖预训练文本先验而非空间依据做决策，低光环境下空间推理退化但不受纹理颜色干扰，且其记忆机制与人类认知存在根本性差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI技术被应用于安全关键场景，需要验证VLM是否具备稳健的空间记忆和可靠的决策能力，以识别其行为是否基于物理证据或受视觉语言偏差影响，以及其记忆过程是否与人类认知模式一致。

Method: 将ToS框架扩展为安全关键、目标驱动的EMRD管道，分别通过环境覆盖率与时间效率量化探索能力（Explore）、评估空间保真度（Map）、使用心理指标套件评估记忆持久性（Remember）、并利用焦点指标衡量认知决策（Decide）。

Result: VLMs在选择疏散点时频繁依赖预训练文本先验而缺乏空间依据支撑；空间推理在低光条件下退化，但不受纹理和颜色篡改影响。

Conclusion: VLM记忆与人类认知存在根本性分歧，可能在安全应用中产生不可预测的对齐风险。

Abstract: Theory of Space framework (ToS) assesses the spatial understanding of curiosity-driven Vision-Language Models (VLMs) under partial observability. As AI techniques are increasingly applied to safety-critical scenarios, it is crucial to understand whether VLMs possess robust spatial memory and make reliable decisions. In this paper, we assess whether VLMs' decisions are based on physical evidence or are corrupted by visual-language biases, if their memory processes align with human cognitive patterns, and how they respond to environmental hazards. We extend the ToS framework into a safety-critical, goal-driven pipeline, named Explore, Map, Remember, and Decide (EMRD). We then quantify Exploration Competence (Explore) through metrics of environmental coverage and temporal efficiency, assess Spatial Fidelity (Map), evaluate, with a suite of psychological metrics, Memory Persistence (Remember), and measure, using focal-point metrics, Cognitive Decision-Making (Decide). Our results show that in terms of decision-making capabilities, VLMs frequently select evacuation points based on pre-trained textual priors while lacking the spatial grounding to justify their choices. We also show that spatial reasoning degrades in low-light conditions, but it is not affected by texture and colour tampering. Our findings suggest that VLM memory fundamentally diverges from human cognition, creating unpredictable risks of misalignment.

</details>


### [698] [PATH: Next-Interval Prediction via Autoregressive Tree Hierarchy on Tabular Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08078)
*Pengxiang Cai,Wanchen Lian,Chenyang Liu,Xiaohan Li,Qingyuan Zeng,Jinhong Wang,Jintai Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出PATH方法，将区间预测建模为层次化结构（二元树），通过学习概率质量在嵌套子区间间的流动来生成更紧凑的预测区间，在56个OpenML回归数据集上以最短平均归一化长度0.1473实现0.9144的平均覆盖率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有共形回归方法将不确定性代理预测与区间校准分离，但事后规则决定最终区间，未充分利用学习到的输出分布，导致生成的区间不够紧凑。

Method: 将区间预测形式化为"下一区间预测"：区间可递归细分为嵌套子区间，用二元树表示该层次结构。预测基础叶分布，通过自回归解码器细化分支概率，使分布与区间层次对齐，累积相邻输出区间的概率并返回达到目标质量的最短连续范围。

Result: 在PATHBench（56个OpenML回归数据集）上与24个基线方法对比，PATH取得最低平均归一化长度0.1473，同时保持平均覆盖率0.9144。

Conclusion: 层次化输出建模是表格数据上紧凑区间预测的有效方法，代码已开源。

Abstract: Interval prediction aims to achieve a target coverage level while producing intervals that are as short as possible. Many conformal regression pipelines first predict an uncertainty surrogate and then convert it into an interval through calibration or selection. This separation supports coverage calibration, but post hoc rules largely determine the final interval and do not fully use the learned output distribution. We observe that the resulting intervals have inherently hierarchical geometry: an interval can be recursively refined into nested subintervals, and binary trees naturally represent this structure. We formulate this hierarchy as next-interval prediction and propose PATH, which learns how probability mass flows from each interval to its next nested subintervals. PATH predicts a base leaf distribution and uses an autoregressive decoder to refine branch probabilities. Matching the distribution to the interval hierarchy aligns learning with extraction: PATH accumulates probability over adjacent output intervals and returns the shortest contiguous range reaching a selected mass. We compare PATH with 24 baselines for interval prediction on PATHBench, comprising 56 OpenML regression datasets. PATH substantially shortens the resulting intervals, achieving the lowest mean normalized length, 0.1473, while maintaining mean coverage of 0.9144. These results establish hierarchical output modeling as an effective approach for compact interval prediction on tabular data. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/pxcai/PATH.

</details>


### [699] [Generative Models: Principles, Architectures, and Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08101)
*Jun Lu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本书旨在引导读者理解生成式AI的基础原理、数学基础和实践架构，涵盖从逼真图像到连贯文本、沉浸式视频再到新型分子结构等广泛的应用领域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI已成为现代人工智能中最具变革性的力量之一，重塑了数字内容的创作、想象与交互方式，因此需要系统的教材来帮助读者掌握其核心知识。

Method: 本书通过系统性地介绍生成式模型的基础原理、数学基础以及实际应用的架构设计来构建完整的知识体系。

Result: 覆盖了生成式模型在图像、文本、视频和分子结构等多领域的应用，展示其从科幻走向现实的能力。

Conclusion: 本书定位为生成式AI的综合性指南，为读者提供从理论到实践的系统学习路径。

Abstract: Generative AI has emerged as one of the most transformative forces in modern artificial intelligence, reshaping how we create, imagine, and interact with digital content. From photorealistic images to coherent text, from immersive videos to novel molecular structures, generative models now power applications that were once confined to science fiction. This book is designed to guide readers through the foundational principles, mathematical underpinnings, and practical architectures that underpin this revolution.

</details>


### [700] [Think Deep, Speak Once: Relit, A Recursive Latent Implicit Transformer Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08113)
*Abhishek Panwar,Maheep Singh,Saksham Bansal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ReLIT是一个混合框架，将深度递归推理嵌入冻结的LLM骨干网络（TinyLlama-1.1B）中，通过在连续隐状态中迭代精炼潜在思维，实现无需显式token生成的隐式推理，在GLoRE逻辑推理基准上以高参数效率匹配或超越更大的模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CoT提示迫使模型将中间推理步骤外部化为离散token，造成大量计算开销。虽然Tiny Recursive Models (TRMs)在隐式推理方面有进展，但它们在符号推理上表现优异却难以在自然语言场景中保持语义连贯性。作者希望弥合这一差距，将深层递归推理植根于基础模型的丰富语义表征中。

Method: ReLIT在冻结的LLM骨干（TinyLlama-1.1B）上增补一个轻量级、可训练的递归模块，该模块在确定最终输出前迭代精炼其潜在思维(z)。通过梯度隔离的循环回路实现"深度思考"，将语言直觉与算法处理结构化地分离，无需显式token生成的延迟。

Result: 在GLoRE逻辑推理基准上，ReLIT实现了高参数效率，在ProofWriter和RuleTaker等挑战性任务上匹配或超越了显著更大的模型，且仅需极少的监督。

Conclusion: 推理能力可以通过递归深度而非参数宽度进行有效扩展，为语义扎根的隐式推理提供了一个有原则的框架。这证明了深层递归思考可以作为传统CoT的高效替代范式。

Abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting has become the dominant paradigm for eliciting reasoning in Large Language Models (LLMs), yet it creates substantial computational overhead by forcing models to externalize intermediate reasoning steps as discrete tokens. Recent latent reasoning approaches attempt to internalize this process within continuous hidden states. One of the latest advancements in the field of latent reasoning, Tiny Recursive Models (TRMs) excel at symbolic reasoning but struggle to preserve semantic coherence in natural language settings. To bridge this gap, we introduce ReLIT (Recursive Latent Implicit Transformer), a hybrid framework that grounds deep recursive reasoning within the rich semantic representations of a foundational model. ReLIT augments a frozen LLM backbone (TinyLlama-1.1B) with a lightweight, trainable recursive block that iteratively refines its latent thinking (z) before committing to a final output, structurally solving linguistic intuition from algorithmic processing and enabling "deep thinking" via gradient-isolated recurrent loops without the latency of explicit token generation. Empirically, ReLIT achieves high parameter efficiency on the GLoRE logical reasoning benchmark, matching or outperforming significantly larger models on challenging tasks such as ProofWriter and RuleTaker despite minimal supervision. These results demonstrate that reasoning capability can be scaled efficiently through recurrent depth rather than parameter width, offering a principled framework for semantically grounded implicit reasoning.

</details>


### [701] [Neurosymbolic Discovery of Algebraic Graph Constructions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08118)
*David Seka,Stefan Szeider*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种神经符号方法，利用通用大语言模型（无需微调）结合SageMath计算机代数系统，自动发现图的代数构造描述（如Cayley图、字典序积等）。在100个高度对称的图上测试，全部成功找到验证的代数构造，远超模板枚举基线的20%。并将此方法应用于识别最小的Bernhart-Kainen可分散性猜想反例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的图搜索方法（如SAT求解器、专用生成器）只能返回原始数据（邻接矩阵或字符串编码），虽然证明了图的存在性，但无法揭示图的结构性质。作者希望从原始数据中自动发现简洁的代数描述，以获得对图结构的深入理解。

Method: 提出一个基于通用大语言模型的代理系统。该代理通过推理与调用SageMath计算机代数系统交替进行：分析目标图、提出并测试候选构造、迭代修正直到输出与目标匹配。通过Model Context Protocol (MCP)服务器与SageMath通信，该服务器作为通用桥梁被发布。匹配验证通过单一精确同构测试完成，依赖符号计算而非模型判断。

Result: 在100个高度对称的图（最多25个顶点的双轨道图）基准上，代理为所有图找到了验证过的代数构造。强模板枚举基线只能达到约20%的成功率，目录查找无法识别任何这些图。但去除对称性后构造质量下降。作为具体应用，为已知最小的16顶点Bernhart-Kainen可分散性猜想反例找到了显式代数构造。

Conclusion: 神经符号方法能够自动从原始图数据中发现代数构造描述，在高度对称图上表现出色，这一方法为理解复杂图结构提供了新途径，并成功应用于图论中重要猜想反例的结构分析。

Abstract: There are several methods for searching for graphs with prescribed properties, such as SAT solvers and specialized generators. These methods return the result as raw data: an adjacency matrix or a string encoding. The raw data certifies that the graph exists, but it does not reveal any structural properties of the graph. We ask whether one can automatically discover a short algebraic description if only this raw data is provided. We look for a description such as a Cayley graph $\mathrm{Cay}(Γ, S)$ or a lexicographic product $C_5[K_3]$.
  We address this question with a neurosymbolic approach. We propose an agent that runs on a general-purpose large language model with no fine-tuning or per-target training. The model interleaves reasoning with calls to the computer algebra system SageMath: it analyzes the target graph, proposes and tests candidate constructions, and revises them until the output matches the target. The agent communicates with SageMath through a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, which we release as a general-purpose bridge. Whether a construction matches the target is checked by a single exact isomorphism test, and therefore rests on the symbolic side and not on the model. We test the approach on a benchmark of 100 highly symmetric graphs, namely two-orbit graphs on up to 25 vertices; the benchmark was fixed in advance. Our agent could find verified algebraic constructions for all of them, without falling back to raw encodings. A strong template-enumeration baseline reaches only about $20\%$, and a catalog lookup could not identify any of these graphs. However, construction quality declines when symmetry is removed.
  As a concrete application, we identify the smallest known counterexample to the Bernhart-Kainen dispersability conjecture, a $16$-vertex graph that enumeration found as raw data. For this graph, our agent found an explicit algebraic construction.

</details>


### [702] [Constraining ontology mappings using metaphysical choices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08122)
*Giacomo De Colle,Helena Blackmore,Chris Partridge*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于本体论形而上学承诺的新方法论，用于验证不同基础本体之间语义映射的有效性，并以IES与BFO之间的映射为例，通过基数约束和SPARQL查询来实现可操作化验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不同数据源基于不同的基础本体（foundation ontologies），这些本体之间存在语义映射，但如何验证这些映射的正确性是一个挑战。本文旨在建立一套基于本体形而上学承诺的验证框架，以解决这一映射验证问题。

Method: 该方法构建了一个基于本体形而上学承诺（metaphysical commitments）的验证框架。具体而言，以IES（Information Entity Ontology）与BFO（Basic Formal Ontology）之间的映射作为测试案例，在映射上提供基数约束（cardinality constraints），并通过SPARQL查询来操作化和验证映射管线的结果。

Result: 文章展示了如何通过SPARQL查询将所提出的验证原则操作化，从而验证映射管线（mapping pipeline）的输出结果，证明了该方法在实际应用中的可行性。

Conclusion: 本文提供了一种新的方法论基础，使得跨不同基础本体的语义映射验证成为可能，并通过IES-BFO案例和SPARQL查询实现了具体应用，为语义映射验证领域提供了理论框架与实践路径。

Abstract: In this paper we discuss the foundations behind a novel methodology for the validation of semantic mappings between different data sources based upon different foundation ontologies, where the methodology builds a framework based upon the metaphysical commitments of the ontologies. We provide as example the test case of mappings between IES and BFO, and we especially focused on providing cardinality constraints on the mappings between the two ontologies. In order to demonstrate the applicability of our method, we showcased how these principles can be operationalized through SPARQL queries validating the results of a mapping pipeline.

</details>


### [703] [TokenPrint: A Calibrated Token-Space Fingerprint for Language-Model Provenance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08139)
*Yuqi Wu,Shengming Zhao,Jie Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于训练自由的指纹方法，通过250个固定知识探针激发晚期隐藏状态的top-k词汇投影，用Jaccard重叠度比较解码token字符串，用于确定语言模型的来源（基础检查点及训练分布重叠）。在32个开源模型、9个家族（0.6B-32B）上验证，该方法能沿着模型亲缘关系形成相似度阶梯，实现谱系检索（R1蒸馏平均排名1.8），且对量化稳健。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型的出处验证（包括基础检查点和训练分布重叠）是治理挑战，仅靠元数据无法解决。需要一种不依赖训练过程的方法来确定模型来源。

Method: 训练免费方法：用250个固定知识探针激发晚期隐藏状态，取top-k词汇投影，通过解码token字符串的Jaccard重叠度进行比较，形成模型指纹。在32个开放权重模型（0.6B-32B，9个家族）上评估，包括相似度阶梯、最近邻谱系检索、深度消融和量化稳定性测试。

Result: (1) 相似度阶梯与模型亲缘关系一致：独立训练相同数据0.48，共享基座微调0.39，同开发者0.38，无关模型0.22；(2) 谱系检索对5个R1蒸馏平均排名1.8，MRR 0.60；(3) 深度消融显示区分能力向输出层增强（AUC从0.72升至0.90）；(4) 量化下稳定（int8:0.92，int4:0.82-0.85）。信号在训练1%时即出现，早于任务能力形成，表明共享训练数据贡献超越能力收敛。

Conclusion: 该指纹方法提供了一种无需训练即可验证语言模型出处的手段，能识别基础检查点和训练数据重叠，且对量化鲁棒，可作为治理与审计工具。

Abstract: Establishing the provenance of a language model---including its base checkpoint and possible overlap in training distributions---is a governance challenge that metadata alone cannot resolve. We introduce a training-free fingerprint based on the top-$k$ vocabulary projections of late hidden states elicited by 250 fixed knowledge probes, compared using Jaccard overlap over decoded token strings. We evaluate the method on 32 open-weight models from nine families (0.6B--32B) with documented relationships. (1)~A \emph{similarity ladder} broadly follows model relatedness: independently trained models on identical data score 0.48 raw (0.35 vocabulary-corrected), followed by shared-base fine-tunes (0.39/0.33), same-developer relatives (0.38/0.28), and models with no documented relationship (0.22/0.17). This identical-data signal persists across three organizations, two tokenizer families, and two architecture classes, and emerges within the first 1\% of training before measurable task competence, suggesting a contribution from shared training data beyond capability convergence. (2)~As a nearest-neighbor \emph{lineage-retrieval} method, the fingerprint ranks the exact documented base among the top two candidates for all five R1 distillations (mean rank 1.8, MRR 0.60), including a math-specialized base not identifiable from coarse metadata. (3)~A \emph{depth ablation} shows that lineage group discrimination strengthens toward the output distribution, with AUC increasing from 0.72 at quarter depth to 0.90 at the output; using only the top 5 output tokens retains AUC 0.87. (4)~The fingerprint remains stable under quantization, with Jaccard similarity of 0.92 under int8 and 0.82--0.85 under int4, compared with a maximum cross-model similarity of 0.81 in the calibration pool. We release the probes, code, and fingerprints.

</details>


### [704] [Long SKILL Compliance as Logical Reasoning: Closure-Grounded Detection with Scaling-Guided On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08146)
*Shuaitao Zhao,Feng Ni,Lichao Ma,Jiaye Lin,Fei Han,Yang Wei,Lu Pan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了SkillCDG，一个基于图的两层约束依赖图框架，用于长SKILL文档的合规检测。通过双层检索和依赖闭包实现合规判断与来源追溯，在三个企业数据集和两个公共基准上相比基线F1分数最高提升12.8个百分点，同时减少最多64.3%的token消耗。进一步发现策略图复杂度与模型规模的缩放规律，并利用该规律进行自适应训练样本选择和on-policy蒸馏来提升小模型的合规检测能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业业务场景中长SKILL文档广泛使用，合规检测面临两难：大模型推理成本高，小模型检测精度不足。现有方法难以在成本和精度之间取得平衡。

Method: 将复杂业务策略表示为两层约束依赖图：上层索引SKILL描述用于场景路由，下层捕获SKILL内原子约束间的依赖关系。推理时采用两级检索结合依赖闭包进行合规判断和来源追溯。此外，基于约束依赖图导出的复杂度指标量化实例难度，进行自适应训练样本选择并采用on-policy蒸馏增强小模型能力。

Result: 在三个企业数据集和两个公共基准变体上，SkillCDG相比基线F1分数最高提升12.8个百分点，token消耗最大减少64.3%。四个同模型族checkpoint的对比实验验证了复杂度差异化的缩放趋势，复杂度指标能有效量化实例难度和模型性能提升潜力。

Conclusion: SkillCDG有效解决了长SKILL合规检测中精度与成本的矛盾，且揭示了策略图复杂度、模型规模与检测性能之间的可预测缩放关系，为在小模型上高效提升合规检测能力提供了可行路径。

Abstract: The increasing complexity of enterprise business scenarios has promoted the widespread adoption of long SKILL documents in agent systems, posing new challenges for compliance detection: large models incur substantial inference costs, while small models may fail to maintain detection accuracy. To address this gap, we propose SkillCDG, a graph-based framework for long SKILL compliance detection. SkillCDG represents complex business policies as a two-layer constraint dependency graph, where the upper layer indexes SKILL descriptions for scenario routing and the lower layer captures dependencies among atomic constraints within each SKILL. During inference, two-level retrieval followed by dependency closure supports compliance judgment and source traceability. We comprehensively evaluate the framework on three enterprise datasets and two controlled public benchmark variants. Experimental results demonstrate that SkillCDG outperforms baseline methods by up to 12.8 percentage points in detection F1 score, while reducing token consumption by a maximum 64.3\%. Moreover, we further investigate the inherent relationships among policy-graph complexity, model scale, and detection performance. Comparative experiments conducted on four checkpoints from a single model family validate a concise and effective scaling trend: end-to-end detection correctness exhibits a complexity-differentiated scaling pattern, and the complexity metric derived from the constraint dependency graph can effectively quantify instance difficulty and the performance improvement potential of models. Leveraging this insightful scaling trend, we conduct adaptive training sample selection and adopt on-policy distillation to efficiently enhance the compliance detection capability of small-scale models.

</details>
